# Analytical-Service

## Area

# Areas
Get a list of all of the areas of interest. An optional parameter can be provided to filter the list, see the information below.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Area/Areas.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/areas
**Sample Request**
http://myserver/NetworksAnalyticalService/areas/
**Sample Response**

```
[
    {
      "UserName": "MORIN TWP.",
      "Id": {
        "G3E_FID": 434343,
        "G3E_FNO": 24000,
        "AoiLi": ""
      },
      "Children": [
        {
          "UserName": "EXAMPLE CHILD",
          "Id": {
            "G3E_FID": 233133371,
            "G3E_FNO": 24000,
            "AoiLiId": ""
          },
          "Children": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

```

## Optional Parameter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Area/Areas.html#optional-parameter)
An optional name parameter will filter the results only to hierarchies containing what is provided.
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/areas?name={name}
**Sample Request**
http://myserver/NetworksAnalyticalService/areas?name=Morin TWP
**Sample Response**

```
[
    {
      "UserName": "MORIN TWP.",
      "Id": {
        "G3E_FID": 434343,
        "G3E_FNO": 24000,
        "AoiLi": ""
      },
      "Children": [
        {
          "UserName": "EXAMPLE CHILD",
          "Id": {
            "G3E_FID": 233133371,
            "G3E_FNO": 24000,
            "AoiLiId": ""
          },
          "Children": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

```

# Area  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/Areas](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Area/Areas.html)  | Get a list of all areas of interest. The list can be filtered based on an optional name parameter.  |

# Transform2DPoints
Transforms an array of 2d points from source to destination coordinate system.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/CoordSystem/Transform2DPoints.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/Coordsystem/Transform?SRC={SourceCoordSystem}&DEST={DestinationCoordSystem}&POINTS={ArrayOf2dPoints}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| SRC  | Source coordinate system name. This can either be a valid coordinate system defined within the configuration or a valid EPSG code. A valid EPSG code should be prefixed by 'EPSG:' (example 'EPSG:3857').  |  
| DEST  | Destination coordinate system name. This can either be a valid coordinate system defined within the configuration or a valid EPSG code. A valid EPSG code should be prefixed by 'EPSG:' (example 'EPSG:3857').  |  
| POINTS  | String array of input 2D points.The axes order of the input points should represent the axes order of the source coordinate system.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksAnalyticalService/Coordsystem/Transform?SRC=State%20Plane&DEST=EPSG:4326&POINTS=2192019.5444331,383985.776302349,2192069.5444331,384035.776302349
**Sample Response**

```
"43.0512955461408,-89.2816982554648,43.0514315481401,-89.2815095847551"

```

# Transform3DPoints
Transforms an array of 3d points from source to destination coordinate system. This method is useful if elevation data is involved.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/CoordSystem/Transform3DPoints.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/Coordsystem/Transform3d?SRC={SourceCoordSystem}&DEST={DestinationCoordSystem}&POINTS={ArrayOf3dPoints}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| SRC  | Source coordinate system name. This can either be a valid coordinate system defined within the configuration or a valid EPSG code. A valid EPSG code should be prefixed by 'EPSG:' (example 'EPSG:3857').  |  
| DEST  | Destination coordinate system name. This can either be a valid coordinate system defined within the configuration or a valid EPSG code. A valid EPSG code should be prefixed by 'EPSG:' (example 'EPSG:3857').  |  
| POINTS  | String array of input 3D points.The axes order of the input points should represent the axes order of the source coordinate system.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksAnalyticalService/Coordsystem/Transform3d?SRC=EPSG:4326&DEST=State%20Plane&POINTS=39.73915360,-104.98470340,1608.637939453125
**Sample Response**

```
"-2199495.58999113,-446162.627504101,92.1129544486687"

```

## Results

# GetTraceResults
Returns all the trace results corresponding to the given trace number (tno).
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraceResults.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{TraceServiceName}/results/trace/{tno}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Optional  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Tno  | Trace Number.  | No  |  
| pageNo  | Page Number.  | Yes  |  
| pageSize  | Page Size.  | Yes  |  
| Augment  | Adding new attributes to the result set by providing attribute numbers(ano's) or attribute field names (ComponentName.AttributeFieldName).  | Yes  |  
| Sum  | Sum of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  | Yes  |  
| Avg  | Average of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  | Yes  |  
| Max  | Maximum value of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  | Yes  |  
| Min  | Minimum value of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  | Yes  |  
| GroupBy  | Grouping the response with a response parameters.  | Yes  |  
| OrderBy  | Ordering the response with a response parameters.  | Yes  |  
| Distinct  | Distinct value of the response with a response parameter.  | Yes  |  
| Subst  | Substituting a parameter in the result.  | Yes  |  
| Function  | Executing an oracle function which always returns a scalar value.  | Yes  |

## Remarks[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraceResults.html#remarks)
This method supports pagination and aggregation. If pagination parameters are specified, it returns all the trace parameters in pages honoring the page size, when pagination parameters are specified.
It returns entire Trace results corresponding to the given Trace number, including the additional attributes.
If aggregation parameters are specified, then aggregation is performed on the result set. These requests are included as part of optional parameters. Multiple aggregation parameters will be supported. All the operations performed are added under a new parameter "aggregate". It includes name, field and value of the requested aggregates. Simple arithmetic operations can also be performed on the response fields for aggregation. Supported operators for arithmetic operation are +, -, *, /. The arithmetic expression will be evaluated for each response item and then the resulting aggregation will be performed. Accepted input types for aggregation are attribute numbers and response field names. The corresponding field name for the specified attribute number should be part of the response. Sample allowable inputs: SUM=100, MIN=g3e_fid
For augmentation, accepted input types are attribute number and ComponentName.AttributeFieldName. user can also specify an alias name which is used to display in the result set. The augmented fields can also participate in aggregation or substitution. Multiple augmented fields can be specified using a comma seperator. Sample allowable inputs: augment=100,100@augmentedfield1,componentname.augmentfield2,componentname.augmentfield2@augmentedfield3
Substitution is performed on individual attributes or attributes in specific ranges. First parameter is the attribute parameter that needs to be evaluated, second parameter is the expression that needs to be evaluated upon and the third parameter is the substituted value that is assigned. The switching value will be replaced with the original value in the response. For any response item that do not fall under the expression, the original value for that parameter is retained. Multiple substitution fileds can be provided by using a comma seperator. Supported operators are : =, <>, <, >, >=, <=, OR, AND, NOT LIKE, LIKE, IN. Sample allowable inputs: Subst=G3E_FID,Small,G3E_FID >= 470408 AND G3E_FID <= 470600, G3E_FID,Medium,G3E_CNO = 29 AND G3E_CID = 1
If function parameter is specified, then the input function is executed. The function return value when executed is always a scalar value. Adds a new parameter to the result set with its response as the function return value. The new parameter name is provided as the alias name when specifying the function parameter. When alias name is not provided the function name will be added as the new parameter name. The parameters to the Oracle function will always be G3E_FNO and G3E_FID from the output result set. The resulting value through the execution of this function is always a single value which is displayed as the parameter value.
When input parameters include augmentation, functions, aggregation and substituion, the order of execution is augmentation, functions, substitution, GroupBy/OrderBy/Distinct and then aggregation.

# GetTraces
Returns the executed traces each containing TRACEID and NAME. Traces can be filtered using filter and pagination parameters. If none is present, all the traces are returned. Traces are ordered by name.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraces.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{TraceServiceName}/results/traces
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Position  | Description  | Mandatory  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| skip  | query  | Records to skip. Must be integer >= 0  |   |  
| count  | query  | Records to return. Must be integer >= 1  |   |  
| filter  | query  | Filter for trace NAME property, using standard sql wildcards.  |   |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalService/results/traces?skip=0&count=10&filter=Gas%
**Sample Response**

```
[
           {
             "TRACEID": 37978,
             "NAME": "mfrost2Trace All"
           },
           {
             "TRACEID": 37979,
             "NAME": "rgabrys1046413"
           },
           {
             "TRACEID": 37976,
             "NAME": "rgabrysTrace All"
           },
           {
             "TRACEID": 37980,
             "NAME": "Trace by Phase"
           },
           {
             "TRACEID": 37982,
             "NAME": "TEST1"
           },
           {
             "TRACEID": 37983,
             "NAME": "TEST3"
           }
        ]

```

## Remarks[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraces.html#remarks)
Response contains: 'TRACEID' - unique identifier for the trace. 'NAME' - user defined name for trace.
Both or none paging parameters must be present in request.

# Results  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/Traces](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraces.html)  | Returns all the executed traces, each containing TRACEID and TRACENAME.  |  
| GET  | [/Trace/{Tno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraceResults.html)  | Returns all the trace results corresponding to the given trace number (tno).  |

## Search

# Execute
Perform a search and return the results.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/Execute.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/search/execute/{amno}?[Jobs={list of job names} | ActiveJob={job name} | apiVersion={apiVersion}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| amno  | G3E_AMNO from the search definition.  |  
| pageNo  | Optional page Number. When pagination parameters are specified, the query results are returned in pages based on the requested page number and page size. Page number 1 is the first page.  |  
| pageSize  | Optional page Size.  |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| apiVersion  | Analytical service version. Supported versions are 2.0.2012 and above.  |  
**Post Body Templates**
Text Parameter

```
{
    "Parameters": [{
            "ParameterId": 1,
            "TextValue": "{text}"
        }
    ]
}

```

DateTime Parameter

```
{
    "Parameters": [{
            "ParameterId": 1,
            "DateTimeValue": "{date time string}"
        }
    ]
}

```

PickList Parameter

```
{
    "Parameters": [{
            "ParameterId": 1,
            "PickListKey": "{pick list key}"
        }
    ]
}

```

Text Parameter and AOI/AOILI and FilterSet

```
{
  "Parameters" : [
    {
      "ParameterId": 1,
      "TextValue": "{text}"
    }
  ],
  "Aoi" : { // Object returned by the /Areas endpoint. E.g. :
    "UserName": "{Area Name}",
    "Id": {
      "G3E_FID": {FID},
      "G3E_FNO": {FNO},
      "AOILIID": "{AOILI}"
    },
    "Children": []
  },
  "OverrideAoiThreshold": false,
  "FilterSet": "Trace.19445"
}

```

**Post Body**  
| Post Body Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Parameters  | Array of search input parameter objects. Each parameter object can be one of: TextValue, DateTimeValue, PickListKey, LongValue, DoubleValue  |  
| Parameters[n].ParameterId  | The ID of the parameter.  |  
| Parameters[n].TextValue  | Search definition takes a text string as input.  |  
| Parameters[n].DateTimeValue  | Search definition takes a date / time as input.  |  
| Parameters[n].PickListKey  | Search definition takes a pick list item as input.  |  
| Parameters[n].LongValue  | Search definition takes an integer number as input.  |  
| Parameters[n].DoubleValue  | Search definition takes a floating point number as input.  |  
| Aoi  | Object returned by the Areas endpoint. Used to pass AOI and/or AOILI to a search definition that requires one as input.  |  
| OverrideAoiThreshold  | Optional. The AoiThreshold is a metadata defined limit for the maximum number of features from an area to use when restricting searches. (See the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER topic in the HxGN NetWorks Core-Admin help). If the AoiOverwriteThreshold metadata parameter is set to -1 (meaning override is possible); and if the current database user has the role associated with G3E_AOIOverwriteThreshold in the G3E_ROLEASSOC_OPTABLE, then this OverrideAoiThreshold POST body parameter controls whether or not the limit will be enforced. When OverrideAoiThreshold is set to false and the AOI contains more possible feature instances than the limit, the search execution will return an error message that denotes how many possible matches were in the area. When this value is set to true, the search execution continues and returns all matching results. The default value is false.  |  
| SpatialFilter  | Specifies a GeoJson Polygon that is used to restrict the search execution results. All of the features in the search result will be restricted to features that are within or touching the specified polygon. Detail features are included if their geographic referencing feature is in the polygon. Polygon is the only geometry type supported for spatial filters. A search request cannot contain both an AOI and a SpatialFilter value. The OverrideAoiThreshold parameter and the associated AOI processing also apply to the area defined by the spatial filter.  |  
| MeasureFeatures  | When specified as true, the search result will be augmented with the length or area measurement of each feature that can be measured. If the search result was restricted by an AOI or spatial filter polygon, then the percentage of the features that fall within the spatial filter area will also be computed. Specifically, the geometry of the features that intersect the spatial boundary will be clipped and measured and the clipped measurement / the original measurement will be reported as a percent value.  |  
| MeasureOnCurvedEarth  | When specified as true, the length or area measurement of each feature will be done using the geographic reference space; otherwise, the measurements will be done on the projection reference space.  |  
| FilterSet  | Optional. Specifies a previous trace or search result set to join against to restrict the feature instances that will be included in the response. The pending edits in a job can also serve as a filter set. The FilterSet property value must match one of the following: (1) Trace.{traceId} (2) Search.{searchId} (3) Job.{jobId} (4) {table}.{column}.{value}  |  
**Results Template**

```
{
  "G3E_AMNO": {amno},
  "ResultId": "{resultId}",
  "ResultUserName": "{resultUserName}",
  "DatabaseAlias": "{databaseAlias}",
  "Configuration": "{gtechConfiguration}",
  "MaxLimitExceeded": {bool},
  "AoiThresholdExceededMessage": {threshold exceeded message},
  "ComponentField": "{componentField}",
  "ComponentFieldUserName": "{componentFieldUserName}",
  "InformationalField": "{informationalField}",
  "InformationalFieldUserName": "{informationalFieldUserName}",
  "ComponentField2": "{componentField2}",
  "ComponentFieldUserName2": "{componentFieldUserName2}",
  "InformationalField2": "{informationalField2}",
  "InformationalFieldUserName2": "{informationalFieldUserName2}",
  "Parameters": {inputParameters},
  "ResultItemsCount": {resultCount},
  "ResultItems": {resultItems}
}

```

**Results**  
| Results Name  | Always Returned Or Optional  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_AMNO  | Always  | The analysis mapping number for this search. G3E_ANALYSISMAPPING_OPTABLE.G3E_AMNO  |  
| ResultId  | Optional  | The result id used to call WMS.GetLayer and used to call /search/delete or /search/fetch. The resultId is not set for searches that return no rows.  |  
| ResultUserName  | Always  | The user facing name of the search results.  |  
| DatabaseAlias  | Always  | The database service name from tnsnames.ora.  |  
| Configuration  | Always  | The NetWorks configuration name from the CCM file.  |  
| MaxLimitExceeded  | Always  | Boolean true or false if the maximum number of records was exceeded.  |  
| AoiThresholdExceededMessage  | Optional  | This user message is present when the metadata defined AoiThreshold limit has been exceeded and the current user has the necessary user role to override the threshold. Example message: "The number of possible search results from the area of interest, {0}, exceeds the threshold, {1}. Do you want to override the threshold and retrieve all results?" If the user wants to override, the client should resubmit the search execute request with "OverrideAoiThreshold": true added to the POST body of the request.  |  
| ComponentField  | Optional  | The property name of the component field in the result items. Use this to find the component field value in the results.  |  
| ComponentFieldUserName  | Optional  | The user facing name of the component field. Use this for the column header in the master results display.  |  
| InformationalField  | Optional  | The property name of the informational field in the result items. Use this to find the informational field value in the results.  |  
| InformationalFieldUserName  | Optional  | The user facing name of the first component field. Use this for the column header in the master results display. The metadata for Find Feature and Find Component provides localized names for some of the data columns returned in the result items. The result items array of objects will use the component attribute names and informational attribute names. The corresponding user visible names are provided in the results header for display purposes.  |  
| InformationalField  | Optional  | The property name of the first informational field in the result items. Use this to find the informational field value in the results.  |  
| InformationalFieldUserName  | Optional  | The user facing name of the first informational field. Use this for the column header in the master results display.  |  
| ComponentField2  | Optional  | The property name of the second component field in the result items. Use this to find the component field value in the results.  |  
| ComponentFieldUserName2  | Optional  | The user facing name of the second component field. Use this for the column header in the master results display.  |  
| InformationalField2  | Optional  | The property name of the second informational field in the result items. Use this to find the informational field value in the results.  |  
| InformationalFieldUserName2  | Optional  | The user facing name of the second informational field. Use this for the column header in the master results display.  |  
| Parameters  | Always  | The search execute input parameters.  |  
| ResultItemsCount  | Always  | The count of the number of result items found.  |  
| ResultItems  | Always  | An array of result items. Properties added by the search service are prefixed with GAO_NET.  |

**Remarks** This method supports pagination. When pagination parameters are specified, it returns the query results in pages based on the requested page number and page size. When no pagination parameters are specified, it returns all of the search results corresponding to the given result Id. This method supports API versioning, apiVersion value of 2.0.2012 or later will support long and double parameter values.
The response header will contain the X-Paging-xxx set of header tags (i.e. X-Paging-PageNo, X-Paging-PageSize, X-Paging-PageCount, X-Paging-TotalRecordCount).

# Get PicklistValuesbyANO
Returns the picklist values for the given attribute number.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/Get-PicklistValuesbyANO.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/Search/pickListvalues/{ano}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Optional  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| ano  | Desired attribute number as string.  | No  |  
| pageNo  | Page Number.  | Yes  |  
| pageSize  | Page Size.  | Yes  |  
| filter  | Return only values that match this filter.  | Yes  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalService/Search/picklistvalues/327545676?filter=Active&pageNo=1&pageSize=5
**Sample Response**

```
[
  {
    "Key": "Active",
    "Value": "Active"
  },
  {
    "Key": "Active Alignment Sheet",
    "Value": "Active Alignment Sheet"
  },
  {
    "Key": "Active MAOP",
    "Value": "Active MAOP"
  },
  {
    "Key": "Active Regulatory Area",
    "Value": "Active Regulatory Area"
  },
  {
    "Key": "Active Structure",
    "Value": "Active Structure"
  }
]

```

## Remarks[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/Get-PicklistValuesbyANO.html#remarks)
This method supports both pagination and typeahead filtering.
Returns the list of picklist values, in pages honoring the page size, when it is called with pagination parameters.
Returns the list of picklist values starting with the filter parameter value, when it is called with filter parameter.
Here, the picklist values are ordered based on the field 'G3E_ORDERBYKEY'.
Response contains:
'key' is the picklist keyname
'value' is the picklist keyvalue
Response contains:
'key' is the picklist keyname
'value' is the picklist keyvalue

# GetDetailByDetailId
Gets the MBR of a detail given its detail number.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetDetailByDetailId.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/search/detail/{detailId}[?lsno={lsno}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| detailId  | Detail number (typically G3E_DETAILID value).  |  
| lsno  | Legend settings number (typically G3E_LSNO value). Optional. When provided, the searchs filters out detail records with different legend settings number.  |  
**Sample Response**

# GetPicklistValuesbyANO with field value filter
Returns the picklist values for the given attribute number and other input parameters. The input parameters includes field value filter string along with the attribute values involved in the filter.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetPicklistValuesbyANO-with-field-value-filter.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/Search/pickListvalues/{ano}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Optional  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| ano  | Desired attribute number as string.  | No  |  
| pageNo  | Page Number.  | Yes  |  
| pageSize  | Page Size.  | Yes  |  
| filter  | Return only values that match this filter.  | Yes  |  
**Post Body Templates**

```
{
// FieldValueFilter value for the requested attribute
"FieldValueFilter": "'TRUE'='TRUE'/*G3E1*/&#7107=CONFIGURATION_NAME_ENG/*G3E1*//*G3E2*/&#7106=EQUIPMENT_TYPE_ENG/*G3E2*/",
  // List of parameters containing participating attributes and its corresponding values
  "Parameters" : [
    {
      "Ano":"{participating attribute number}",
      "Value":"{value of the participating attribute}"}
    ]
}

```

**Post Body** |Post Body Name|Description |--|-- |FieldValueFilter|FieldValueFilter value for the requested attribute |Parameters|List of parameters containing participating attributes and its corresponding values |Parameters[n].Ano|The attribute number participating in field value filter. |Parameters[n].Value|The user selected value of the participating attribute.
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalService/Search/picklistvalues/7106?filter=Active&pageNo=1&pageSize=5
**Sample Post Body**

```
{
    "FieldValueFilter": "'TRUE'='TRUE'/*G3E1*/&#7107=CONFIGURATION_NAME_ENG/*G3E1*//*G3E2*/&#7106=EQUIPMENT_TYPE_ENG/*G3E2*/",
    "Parameters" : [
      {
        "Ano":"7107",
        "Value":"ABM"
      }
    ]
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
[
  {
    "Key": "ABM",
    "Value": "ABM"
  },
  {
    "Key": "ABM / TBM",
    "Value": "ABM / TBM"
  },
  {
    "Key": "C-SERVER",
    "Value": "C-SERVER"
  }
]

```

## Remarks[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetPicklistValuesbyANO-with-field-value-filter.html#remarks)
This method supports both pagination and typeahead filtering.
Returns the list of picklist values, in pages honoring the page size, when it is called with pagination parameters.
Returns the list of picklist values starting with the filter parameter value, when it is called with filter parameter.
Returns the list of picklist values honoring the fieldvaluefilters, when provided in post body parameters.
Here, the picklist values are ordered based on the field 'G3E_ORDERBYKEY'.
Response contains:
'key' is the picklist keyname
'value' is the picklist keyvalue

# GetPicklistValuesWithFilter
Returns the picklist values for the given search parameter.
## GET, POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetPicklistValuesWithFilter.html#get-post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{TraceServiceName}/search/picklistvalues/{amno}/{ano}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Position  | Description  | Mandatory  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| amno  | path  | Analysis mapping number.  | Y  |  
| ano  | path  | Attribute number as string.  | Y  |  
| pageNo  | query  | Page Number.  |   |  
| pageSize  | query  | Page Size.  |   |  
| filter  | query  | Return only values which begin with this filter (case-insensitive).  |   |  
| apiversion  | query  | When set to `2.0`, the result is wrapped in JSON object and the results are in `Items` property.  |   |  
**Request body** (only for POST verb)
JSON object with key-value mapping, where the key is G3E_ANO and the value is the string representation of the current value.
Example:

```
{
  "24000000": "1",
  "24000018": "Test"
}

```

**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalService/search/picklistvalues/44/327545676?filter=Active&pageNo=1&pageSize=5
**Sample Response**

```
[
            {
              "Key": "Active",
              "Value": "Active"
            },
            {
              "Key": "Active Alignment Sheet",
              "Value": "Active Alignment Sheet"
            },
            {
              "Key": "Active MAOP",
              "Value": "Active MAOP"
            },
            {
              "Key": "Active Regulatory Area",
              "Value": "Active Regulatory Area"
            },
            {
              "Key": "Active Structure",
              "Value": "Active Structure"
            }
          ]

```

## Remarks[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetPicklistValuesWithFilter.html#remarks)
This method supports both pagination and typeahead filtering.
Returns the list of picklist values, in pages honoring the page size, when it is called with pagination parameters.
Returns the list of picklist values starting with the filter parameter value, when it is called with filter parameter.
Here, the picklist values are ordered based on the field 'G3E_ORDERBYKEY'.
Response contains:
'key' is the picklist keyname
'value' is the picklist keyvalue

# GetSearches
Gets the list of all search definitions, excluding quicksearch definitions.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearches.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/search/searches[?application={application} | apiVersion={apiVersion}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| application  | Bit mask for G3E_ANALYSIMAPPING_OPTABLE.G3E_APPLICATION. When not specified, a value of 8 (NetWorks) is used.  |  
| apiVersion  | Analytical service version. Supported versions are 2.0.2012 and above.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearches.html#response)
Array of `SearchMetadataType` instances.
### SearchMetadataType[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearches.html#searchmetadatatype)  
| Name  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_AMNO  | number  | Analysis mapping number  |  
| UserName  | string  | Analysis mapping name  |  
| G3E_ACNO  | number  | Analysis category number  |  
| CategoryName  | string  | Analysis category name  |  
| Parameters  | [SearchParameterType]  | Array of parameters of the query  |  
| IsAoiRequired  | bool  | Flag: Is active AOI required?  |  
| IsAoiLiRequired  | bool  | Flag: Is AOI LI required?  |  
### SearchParameterType[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearches.html#searchparametertype)  
| Name  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_ANO  | number  | Attribute number  |  
| ParameterId  | number  | Ordinal of the parameter in query. G3E_ORDINAL.  |  
| ReferenceOrdinal  | number  | Reference ordinal for repeated G3E_ANO values. G3E_REFERENCEORDINAL.  |  
| G3E_USERNAME  | string  | User name of the search parameter  |  
| Type  | string  | Data type of the value. Allowed values: `Text`, `PickList`, `DateTime`, `Double`, `Long`.  |  
| G3E_PNO  | number  | Picklist number.  |  
| FieldValueFilterAttributes  | [number]  | If a field value filter is defined, contains an array of G3E_ANO values required for field value filter. Otherwise `null` which means that field value filter is not defined.  |  
**Remarks** If the search definition has IsAoiLiRequired set to true, then the last parameter is a placeholder for the area of interest location identifier's string value. The Post body that is passed to the search/execute/{amno} method must contain an Aoi object definition and its AOILIID property must be non-null.
If the search definition has IsAoiRequired set to true, then the Post body that is passed to the search/execute/{amno} method must contain an Aoi object definition in the JSON (see execute method).
If the search definition has apiVersion parameter set to 2.0.2012 or later, the response attribute parameters will support long and double parameter values.
**Sample Response**

```
[
  {
    "G3E_AMNO": 27,
    "UserName": "(QR) Equipment Configuration",
    "G3E_ACNO": 4,
    "CategoryName": "Quick Find",
    "Parameters": [
      {
        "G3E_ANO": 7106,
        "ParameterId": 1,
        "G3E_USERNAME": "Equipment Type",
        "Type": "PickList",
        "G3E_PNO": 3,
        "IsOptional": true,
        "FieldValueFilter": "'TRUE'='TRUE'/*G3E1*/&#7107=CONFIGURATION_NAME_ENG/*G3E1*//*G3E2*/&#7106=EQUIPMENT_TYPE_ENG/*G3E2*/",
        "FieldValueFilterAnos": [
          {
            "Ano": "7107",
            "IsOptional": true
          },
          {
            "Ano": "7106",
            "IsOptional": true
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "G3E_ANO": 7107,
        "ParameterId": 3,
        "G3E_USERNAME": "Equip. Config. Name",
        "Type": "PickList",
        "G3E_PNO": 4
      },
      {
        "G3E_ANO": -1,

# GetSearchResults
Returns all the analysis (query or trace) results corresponding to the given **result identifier**.
Results identifier formats:  
| Type  | Format  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Query  |  **Search.**{AMNO}.{QUERYID}  |  
| Trace  |  **Trace.**{TNO}  |  
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearchResults.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{TraceServiceName}/search/results/fetch?resultid={resultid}&pageNo={pageNo}&pageSize={pageSize}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Mandatory  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| resultid  | Result identifier  | Y  |  
| pageNo  | Page Number, 1-based.  |   |  
| pageSize  | Page Size.  |   |  
| Augment  | Adding new attributes to the result set by providing attribute numbers(ano's) or attribute field names(ComponentName.AttributeFieldName).  |   |  
| Sum  | Sum of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  |   |  
| Avg  | Average of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  |   |  
| Max  | Maximum value of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  |   |  
| Min  | Minimum value of a response parameter or simple arithmetic computation of response fields.  |   |  
| GroupBy  | Grouping the response with a response parameters.  |   |  
| OrderBy  | Ordering the response with a response parameters.  |   |  
| Distinct  | Distinct value of the response with a response parameter.  |   |  
| Subst  | Substituting a parameter in the result.  |   |  
| Function  | Executing an oracle function which always returns a scalar value.  |   |  
**Sample Request**

## Remarks[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearchResults.html#remarks)
This method supports pagination. When pagination parameters are specified, it returns the query results in pages based on requested page number and page size. When no pagination parameters are specified, it returns all of the search results corresponding to the given result Id.
If aggregation parameters are specified, then aggregation is performed on the result set. These requests are included as part of optional parameters. Multiple aggregation parameters will be supported. All the operations performed are added under a new parameter "aggregate". It includes name, field and value of the requested aggregates. Simple arithmetic operations can also be performed on the response fields for aggregation. Supported operators for arithmetic operation are +, -, *, /. The arithmetic expression will be evaluated for each response item and then the resulting aggregation will be performed. Accepted input types for aggregation are attribute numbers and response field names. The corresponding field name for the specified attribute number should be part of the response. Sample allowable inputs: SUM=100, MIN=g3e_fid
For augmentation, accepted input types are attribute number and ComponentName.AttributeFieldName. user can also specify an alias name which is used to display in the result set. The augmented fields can also participate in aggregation or substitution. Multiple augmented fields can be specified using a comma seperator. Sample allowable inputs: augment=100,100@augmentedfield1,componentname.augmentfield2,componentname.augmentfield2@augmentedfield3
Substitution is performed on individual attributes or attributes in specific ranges. First parameter is the attribute parameter that needs to be evaluated, second parameter is the expression that needs to be evaluated upon and the third parameter is the substituted value that is assigned. The switching value will be replaced with the original value in the response. For any response item that do not fall under the expression, the original value for that parameter is retained. Multiple substitution fileds can be provided by using a comma seperator. Supported operators are : =, <>, <, >, >=, <=, OR, AND, NOT LIKE, LIKE, IN. Sample allowable inputs: Subst=G3E_FID,Small,G3E_FID >= 470408 AND G3E_FID <= 470600, G3E_FID,Medium,G3E_CNO = 29 AND G3E_CID = 1
If function parameter is specified, then the input function is executed. The function return value when executed is always a scalar value. Adds a new parameter to the result set with its response as the function return value. The new parameter name is provided as the alias name when specifying the function parameter. When alias name is not provided the function name will be added as the new parameter name. The parameters to the Oracle function will always be G3E_FNO and G3E_FID from the output result set. The resulting value through the execution of this function is always a single value which is displayed as the parameter value.
When input parameters include augmentation, functions, aggregation and substituion, the order of execution is augmentation, functions, substitution, GroupBy/OrderBy/Distinct and then aggregation.

# GetSearchSettings
Get the configured search settings.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearchSettings.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{AnalyticalServiceName}/search/settings
**Remarks**
The SearchForDetailsMax and the QuickSearchMax values are configured in the  section of the web.config file for the Analytical Service. SearchForDetailMax defines the maximum number of detail or schematic results that will be returned. The default is 4096. The QuickSearchMax defines the maximum number of results that will be returned from any quick search query. The default is 500.
The DateFormat setting is hard coded to "MM/dd/yyyy". Its purpose is to define the neutral format for clients to use when passing in dates as search parameter values. This setting has no effect on how dates are presented to the end user.
**Sample Response**

```
{
  "SearchForDetailsMax": 4096,
  "QuickSearchMax": 500,
  "DateFormat": "MM/dd/yyyy"
}

```

# Search
The HxGN NetWorks Analytical web service provides methods that allow clients to query the HxGN NetWorks Core data using the metadata defined finds and simple attribute queries. It also supports the retrieval of information about available details and schematics.
## Supported Search Workflows[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#supported-search-workflows)
### Dynamically discover the Analytical service:[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#dynamically-discover-the-analytical-service)
Call the NetWorksSolutionService/{alias}/analytical method to retrieve information on the deployed analytical service for this configuration.
### Initialize the client to use the Analytical service:[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#initialize-the-client-to-use-the-analytical-service)
Call the /search/settings method to retrieve information on the deployed analytical service's limits on detail results, search results and the format of date values when sending dates as input parameters.
Call the /search/details/fnos and /search/schematics/fnos methods to retrieve the list of feature types that can have details or schematics. This information could be used to enable the client to search for details when a feature is selected (i.e. the selected feature's FNO is in the list).
### Search for Details or Schematics so user can view it:[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#search-for-details-or-schematics-so-user-can-view-it)
There are a number of different ways to retrieve information on details or schematics. All of them return the same response which contains information that can be displayed to the user to make a selection, and information needed to display the selected detail or schematic map view.
Call the /Search/Details or /Search/Schematics method to return a JSON response that provides details about the all available details or schematics. The client could display the information as a list or drop down and allow the user to select one.
Call the /Search/Details/fnos/{fno} or /Search/Schematics/fnos/{fno} method to return a JSON response that provides details about the all available details or schematics that match the specified feature type.
Call the /Search/Details/names?name={name} or /Search/Schematics/names?name={name} method to return a JSON response that provides details about the all available details or schematics that match the specified feature name. The {name} value will be automatically wildcarded on the end of the value to allow the user to just enter a few letters before the client executes a search. The search by name methods also allow the explicit wildcard character '%' to be added in the value. For example, name=FEM would match a detail named, FEMRITE, and name='%RIT' would also match FEMRITE.
Call the /Search/Details/fnos/{fno}/names?name={name} or /Search/Schematics/fnos/{fno}/names?name={name} method to return a JSON response that provides details about the all available details or schematics that match the specified feature type and name value.
### Display the detail or schematic map view[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#display-the-detail-or-schematic-map-view)
Within the response to any search for details or schematics, the Details object contains the ID, NAME, and LSNO values for the detail or schematic. The NAME value is what should be displayed to the user. The LSNO value is used to dynamically discover the WMS service that can display the map image, and the ID is the detailID or schematicID that will be used in the dynamic layer name in the Layers parameter when calling the WMS for details.
Call the NetWorksSolutionService/{alias}/wms/{lsno} method to get the information on the WMS service that can display the detail or schematic in a map view. Then call the GetLayer method of that WMS for details service with LAYERS=Detail.{ID value} to get the GetCapabilities response that includes the bounding box to fit the map to in a subsequent call to the WMS GetMap method that also specifies the Layers=Detail.{ID value}. (See WMS Service methods for details).
### Perform a predefined search for feature data[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#perform-a-predefined-search-for-feature-data)
Call the /search/quicksearches method to get the list of quick searches to display, typically in a drop down combobox that allows the user to select from the list. The single input field could be either a text box or a drop down combobox depending on whether the parameter type is a picklist. If the parameter type in the quicksearch definition is anything other than a picklist, then the client would display a parameter label and a textbox field to collect the input value. If the parameter type is picklist, then the client would call the /search/picklistvalues/{ano} method to get the picklist key - value pairs to populate a combobox. The picklist value is the user visible value to show in the combobox, but the picklist key value is what should be passed to the execute method for the corresponding parameter.
Call the /search/searches method to get the list of all searches that are not quick searches. The client could display a flat list of these searches or it could group them by their search category. Call the /search/searches/categories method to get the category number and user visible name for all categories. Specifically, the client can group the search definitions under the search category whose G3E_ACNO values match. The parameter handling is the same as the quicksearch, except that there can be zero or more parameters. The parameters can be picklist, text, date-time, long or double values. If the search definition specifies that the parameter is optional, then the client still needs to include the parameter in the search parameters with its value set to null. Null picklist and text values can also be specified as a single blank.
When all parameter values have been collected and formatted into the POST body Json format, call the /search/execute/{amno} method to query the database and get the search results response.
### Spatially restrict search execution[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#spatially-restrict-search-execution)
If the search definition specifies True for IsAoiLiRequired or IsAoiRequired, then the client must prepare and append an AOI object after the Parameters array in the Post body to the /search/execute/{amno} method. An array of AOI objects is returned from the {analyticalService}/Areas controller. The client could display the areas and let the user pick an area of interest to restrict his searches to. If the search definition has IsAoiliRequired=True then the selected AOI object must have a non-null AoiLi property value. Note that not all areas have a corresponding area of interest location identifier (AoiLi) value.
Any search that has IsAoiRequired set to true can also use an adhoc defined spatial filter instead of an area of interest. The client would create a GeoJson polygon and send it as the "SpatialFilter" parameter in the POST body of the search execute request. The execute search POST body can contain either an Aoi or SpatialFilter parameter - but not both. In both cases, the metadata defined values for AOI threshold limits and the ability to override the limits will be applied.
### Use filter sets to restrict search execution[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#use-filter-sets-to-restrict-search-execution)
Any search execution can be further restricted by the specifying a FilterSet parameter in the POST body. A filter set specifies a previous trace or search result set to join against to restrict the feature instances that will be included in the response. The pending edits in a job can also serve as a filter set. The FilterSet property value must match one of the following types:
Trace.{traceId}
Search.{searchId}
Job.{jobId}
{table}.{column}.{value}
### Measure features in a search result[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#measure-features-in-a-search-result)
Any search execution result set can be augmented with the measurement of the features. If the MeasureFeatures parameter in the POST body is set to true, then the three additional columns, LENGTH, AREA, and PERCENT, are added to the results. For linear geometry features, the LENGTH column contains the measured length in the units of the current configuration. Likewise, area geometry features contain the measured area. If the search result was spatially restricted by either an Aoi or an adhoc spatial filter, then the PERCENT column contains the ratio of the measure of the part of the feature geometry that is inside the spatial boundary divided by the measure of the total geometry. By default, all measurements are done using the curved Earth reference space, but the client can override that by setting the MeasureOnCurvedEarth parameter to false, which will measure using the projection reference space.
### Fetch previous search results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#fetch-previous-search-results)
Within the response to any successful search, the ResultId property value is the "handle" to the saved search results in the database. The search results will remain in the database until the client explicitly deletes them with a call to /search/results/delete.
When the search was executed, the client received either all or part of the results depending on whether paging control parameters were used on the search/execute request Url. At any point in the future, clients can pull additional pages of the results by calling /search/results/fetch?resultId={resultId}&pageSize={rowsPerPage}&pageNo={pageNumber}.
When pagination parameters are specified, the query results are returned in pages based on requested page number and page size. When no pagination parameters are specified, all of the search results are returned. To assist the clients in managing the paging of the results, the response header will contain the X-Paging-xxx set of header tags (i.e. X-Paging-PageNo, X-Paging-PageSize, X-Paging-PageCount, X-Paging-TotalRecordCount).
### Augment the Search Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#augment-the-search-results)
Any search execution result set can be augmented with new attributes by providing the AUGMENT optional parameter. User can provide attribute numbers and attribute field name as input to the AUGMENT parameter. Call the /Search/Results/Fetch?resultId={resultId}&Augment={Attribute Number}&Augment={ComponentName.AttributeFieldName} to retrieve augmented parameters along with the search result set.
### Aggregation on Search Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#aggregation-on-search-results)
Aggregation can be performed on the result set by providing aggregate optional parameters. Supported aggregates are SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG, GROUPBY, ORDERBY and DISTINCT. User can provide attribute numbers or response field names that needs to participate in the aggregate operation. Simple arithmetic operations can also be performed on the response fields for aggregation. Supported operators for arithmetic operation are +, -, *, /. The arithmetic expression will be evaluated for each response item and then the resulting aggregation will be performed. Call the /Search/Results/Fetch?resultId={resultId}&Sum={parameterName}&Min={parameterName}&Max={parameterName}&Avg={parameterName} to perform aggregation on the search result set.
### Substitute on Search Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#substitute-on-search-results)
Substitute operation can be performed on the result set parameters by providing the SUBST optional parameter. It is performed on individual attributes or attributes in specific ranges. All the operators supported by DataTable can be used in substitute operation. Call the /Search/Results/Fetch?resultId={resultId}&Subst={Substitute ParameterName},{Condition},{Substituted Value} to perform substitution functionality on the search result set.
### Function Call on Search Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#function-call-on-search-results)
An Oracle function which returns a scalar value can be executed by providing the FUNCTION optional parameter. The resultant value is added as a new parameter to the Search result set. Call the /Search/Results/Fetch?resultId={resultId}&Function={OracleFunctionName}@{ParameterName} to execute the oracle function and add to the search result set.
### Display the search results on the map view[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#display-the-search-results-on-the-map-view)
The ResultId property value is also used as part of the dynamic layer name for the search result. The name will be Search.{ResultId}. To display the results on the map view, the client first calls the WMS GetLayer method with LAYERS=Search.{ResultId} to get the GetCapabilities response that includes the bounding box to fit the map to in a subsequent call to the WMS GetMap method that also specifies the Layers=Search.{ResultId}. (See WMS Service methods for details).
### Delete search results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#delete-search-results)
Call the /search/results/delete?resultId={resultId from search/execute response} method to cleanup the saved search results in the database. It is the client's responsibility to do this cleanup since it is the only one that knows when it is finished working with a specific search result.
## Supported application number for search workflows:[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search.html#supported-application-number-for-search-workflows)
The bit mask value for NetWorks is 8. If the application parameter is not specified, then the default value of 8 is used for NetWorks Web Services. Execute the pl/sql statement if a search is intended to be displayed through NetWorks Analytical Service. UPDATE G3E_ATTRIBUTEQUERY SET G3E_APPLICATION = 8 WHERE G3E_AQNO=; Note: Perform Metadata Publish for the changes to be reflected.

This method supports both pagination and typeahead filtering.
Returns all the line patterns available, when called without any parameters.
Returns the list of line patterns, in pages honoring the page size when it is called with pagination parameters.

## Trace

# ComputeMarkerPoints
Computes the marker location points for an executed trace based on user defined stop criteria.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/ComputeMarkerPoints.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{TraceServiceName}/Trace/computemarkerpoints
**Post Body Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Required  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| tno  | Trace number of the executed trace.  | Yes  |  
| StopCriteria  | Input stop criteria.  | Yes  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalservice/Trace/computemarkerpoints
Post Body :

```
{
    "StopCriteria":25,
    "TraceId":19775
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
{
    "PointX": -8511548.62955291,
    "PointY": 5507937.9876390938,
    "DetailId": 0
}

```

**Remarks**
Pre-requisite to execute the API:
A new GAONET_PARAMETER table is introduced which contains the following columns:  
| **Column Name**  | **Description**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| GAO_PNO  | Maps to G3E_RINO value for the Interface  |  
| GAO_KEY  | Unique identifier for the table, Even though GAO_PNO is unique, it might be null for some entries. Eg: If the Compute Partial Start Value Interface Argument Group Number is null, then the relevant G3E_RINO values will not exist for Stop criteria field name, Cable Value Filed Name and Cumulative Value Field Name.  |  
| GAO_TYPE  | For ComputeMarkerPoints API, it checks for OTDR value  |  
| GAO_PARAMETERNAME  | G3E_USERNAME field of G3E_RELATIONIFACE_OPTABLE  |  
| GAO_PARAMETERDESCRIPTION  | G3E_TYPE field of G3E_RELATIONIFACE_OPTABLE  |  
| GAO_PARAMETERVALUE  | G3E_INTERFACE field of G3E_RELATIONIFACE_OPTABLE  |  
| GAO_PARAMETERTYPE  | Will be the interface argument data type  |  
| GAO_EDITDATE  | Edit Date  |  
Sample values that are stored in the GAONET_PARAMETER table for OTDR:  
| **GAO_PNO**  | **GAO_KEY**  | **GAO_TYPE**  | **GAO_PARAMETERNAME**  | **GAO_PARAMETERDESCRIPTION**  | **GAO_PARAMETERVALUE**  | **GAO_PARAMETERTYPE**  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| 1  | 10  | OTDR  | Compute Marker Location Interface Number  |   | 21  | 4  |  
| 2  | 10  | OTDR  | Compute Marker Location Interface Argument Group Number  |   | 715001  | 4  |  
| 3  | 10  | OTDR  | Compute Geo Point Interface Number  |   | 22  | 4  |  
| 4  | 10  | OTDR  | Compute Geo Point Interface Argument Group Number  |   | 715002  | 4  |  
| 5  | 10  | OTDR  | Compute Partial Start Value Interface Number  |   | 29  | 4  |  
| 6  | 10  | OTDR  | Compute Partial Start Value Interface Argument Group Number  |   | -1  | 4  |  
| 7  | 10  | OTDR  | Stop Criteria Field Name  |   | INPUT_STOP_CRITERIA  | 10  |  
| 8  | 10  | OTDR  | Cable Value Field Name  |   | STOP_CRITERIA  | 10  |  
| 9  | 10  | OTDR  | Cumulative Value Field Value  |   | CUMULATIVE_STOP_CRITERIA  | 10  |  
Response contains:
'PointX' is the x coordinate of the marker point.
'PointY' is the y coordinate of the marker point.
'DetailId' is the identifier of the detail drawing where the marker point exists.

# ExecuteTrace
Executes the trace and returns a tracenumber for the given input parameters.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/ExecuteTrace.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{TraceServiceName}/Trace/execute?[Jobs={list of job names} | ActiveJob={job name}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
**Post Body Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Required  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| SeedFno  | describes the seed feature type.  | Yes  |  
| SeedFid  | is the feature identifier from where the trace should be started and checks whether it belongs to the given SeedFno or not.  | Yes  |  
| UserName  | is the user defined name for trace.  | Yes  |  
| MappingId  | should be a unique identifier for the given SeedFno.  | Yes  |  
| HintIdentifiesFeature  | is a boolean value and is used in executing the trace in the selected hint feature direction.  | No  |  
| OverWrite  | a boolean value to overwrite the existing trace.  | No  |  
| Attributes  | required for executing trace.  | No  |  
| GoalFid  | the feature identifier where the trace should be stopped.  | No  |  
| HintFid  | used to choose the trace direction based on given feature identifier.  | No  |  
| Aoi  | Object returned by the Areas endpoint. Used to enable an AOI and/or AOILI restriction in trace execution.  | No  |  
| OverrideAoiThreshold  | The AoiMultiThreshold is a metadata defined limit for the maximum number of possible features from an AOI area to process in the trace. (See the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER topic in the HxGN NetWorks Core Admin help). If the AoiOverwriteThreshold metadata parameter is set to -1 (meaning override is possible); and if the current database user has the role associated with G3E_AOIOverwriteThreshold in the G3E_ROLEASSOC_OPTABLE, then this OverrideAoiThreshold POST body parameter controls whether or not the limit will be enforced. When OverrideAoiThreshold is set to false and the AOI contains more possible feature instances than the limit, the trace execution will return an error message that denotes how many possible features were in the trace. When this value is set to true, the trace execution continues and returns all results. The default value is false.  | No  |  
| SpatialFilter  | Specifies a GeoJson Polygon that is used to restrict the trace execution results. All of the features in the trace result will be restricted to features that are within or touching the specified polygon. Detail features are included if their geographic referencing feature is in the polygon. Polygon is the only geometry type supported for spatial filters. A trace request cannot contain both an AOI and a SpatialFilter value. The OverrideAoiThreshold parameter and the associated AOI processing also apply to the area defined by the spatial filter.  | No  |  
| MeasureFeatures  | When specified as true, the trace result will be augmented with the length or area measurement of each feature that can be measured. If the trace result was restricted by an AOI or spatial filter polygon, then the percentage of the features that fall within the spatial filter area will also be computed. Specifically, the geometry of the features that intersect the spatial boundary will be clipped and measured and the clipped measurement / the original measurement will be reported as a percent value.  | No  |  
| MeasureOnCurvedEarth  | When specified as true, the length or area measurement of each feature will be done using the geographic reference space; otherwise, the measurements will be done on the projection reference space.  | No  |  
| StartingPointX  | X coordinate for the Cost Constraint Trace starting point.  | No  |  
| StartingPointY  | Y coordinate for the Cost Constraint Trace starting point.  | No  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalservice/Trace/execute
Post Body:

```
{
    "SeedFno": "316",
    "SeedFid": "653521",
    "UserName": "SampleTrace",
    "MappingId": "992",
    "HintIdentifiesFeature": "True",
    "OverWrite": "True",
    "Attributes": [{
            "Key": "1006",
            "Value": "True"
        }
    ],
    "GoalFid": "1111",
    "HintFid": "2222"
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
123

```

**Sample Request #2**
http://hostname/NetworksAnalyticalservice/Trace/execute
Post Body:

      "StartPoint":"7443576.40872164,1049699.66912877",                            
      "Attributes":[{"Key":"23","Value":20},{"Key":"24","Value":"50"},{"Key":"25","Value":2},{"Key":"26","Value":3}]

**Sample Response**
If the trace request enabled an AOI or AOILI restriction and the number of features in the trace exceeded the AoiMultiThreshold in metadata, then the request fails. If the user has the necessary user role to override the threshold, then the following message is returned: "The number of trace result features in the area of interest, {0}, exceeds the threshold, {1}. Do you want to override the threshold and retrieve all results?" If the user wants to override, the client should resubmit the trace execute request with "OverrideAoiThreshold": true added to the POST body of the request.
If the user doesn't have the override role, or if the metadata prevents overrides, then the trace fails with the following message: "The number of trace result features in the area of interest, {0}, exceeds the threshold, {1}."
If the trace was successful, then the trace result number (tno) is returned. Clients use the /trace/results/{tno} method to retrieve the actual trace results.

```
123

```

# Trace
# Trace API Overview
The HxGN NetWorks Analytical web service provides methods that allow clients to perform metadata defined traces of the HxGN NetWorks Core data's connectivity model.
# Supported Trace Workflows
## Dynamically discover the Analytical service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#dynamically-discover-the-analytical-service)
Call the `NetWorksSolutionService/{alias}/analytical` method to retrieve information on the deployed analytical service for this configuration.
Initialize the client to use the Analytical service trace functionality: Call the `/Trace/SeedFnos` method to retrieve the list of feature types that can start a trace. This information could be used by the client to enable trace workflows when the selected feature type is in the list of seed Fnos.
## Perform a predefined trace[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#perform-a-predefined-trace)
When the user selects a feature and the feature type (FNO) matches one of the trace seed Fnos, the client can call `/Trace/Types/{fno}` to get the list of predefined trace definitions for that feature type. Each trace definition includes a user visible name to display, the trace mappingId and the trace type (from G3E_TRACETYPES table).
When the user selects the desired trace definition, the client uses the corresponding trace MappingId value to call the `/Trace/Parameters/{mappingId}` method to retrieve the full description of the trace inputs that are needed to execute the trace. The response tells the client whether hint and / or goal features need to be determined and whether there are trace attribute values that need to be collected from the user for the trace filter or stop criteria.
If the trace parameter's PromptForHint property is true, then call the `/Trace/Hint?SeedFID={seedFid}&MappingId={mappingId}` method to get a list of candidate features that can serve as the hint feature for the trace. If the trace definition's PromptForGoal property is true, then the client directs the user to select a terminating feature for the trace. If the GoalFnoCandidates list is not null, then the terminating feature's type must match one of the Fnos in the GoalFnoCandidates list.
If the trace parameter's Attributes property is not empty, then the client must use the information to collect attribute values that will be used by the trace filter or stop criteria. If the Attributes IsPickListAttribute property is true, the client can call `/Trace/Picklistvalues/{ano}` to get the Json array of picklist key-value pairs to display to the user.
The user must supply a name for the trace results. The client can call `/Trace/Exists/{traceName}` to determine whether or not the specified trace result name already exists. If it does exist, the client can either get another name from the user, or ask the user if he wants to overwrite the previous trace results that are associated with the specified name. The trace result UserName and Overwrite properties are part of the execute method's POST body.
When all trace parameter values have been collected and formatted into the POST body Json format, call the /trace/execute method to run the trace in the database, store the trace results in database tables and get the trace number (TNO) for the result set as the response.
## Spatially restrict trace execution[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#spatially-restrict-trace-execution)
The set of features returned by a trace execution can be restricted to just those feature that are within a spatial area. The spatial area can be defined in the trace execute POST body as either an AOI parameter or a SpatialFilter parameter - but not both.
An array of AOI objects is returned from the `{analyticalService}/Areas` controller. The client could display the areas and let the user pick an area of interest to restrict his trace to. Alternatively, the client could allow the user to create a GeoJson polygon and send it as the "SpatialFilter" parameter in the POST body. In both cases, the metadata defined values for AOI threshold limits and the ability to override the limits will be applied.
## Measure features in a trace result[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#measure-features-in-a-trace-result)
Any trace execution result set can be augmented with the measurement of the features. If the MeasureFeatures parameter in the POST body is set to true, then the three additional columns, LENGTH, AREA, and PERCENT, are added to the results. For linear geometry features, the LENGTH column contains the measured length in the units of the current configuration. Likewise, area geometry features contain the measured area. If the search result was spatially restricted by either an Aoi or an adhoc spatial filter, then the PERCENT column contains the ratio of the measure of the part of the feature geometry that is inside the spatial boundary divided by the measure of the total geometry. By default, all measurements are done using the curved Earth reference space, but the client can override that by setting the MeasureOnCurvedEarth parameter to false, which will measure using the projection reference space.
## Display the trace results on the map view[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#display-the-trace-results-on-the-map-view)
The response to any successful trace execution includes the trace number of the result set. This trace number (TNO) is the "handle" to the saved trace results in the database. The dynamic layer name for this trace result is `Trace.{tno}`. To display the results on the map view, the client first calls the WMS GetLayer method with LAYERS=Trace.{tno} to get the GetCapabilities response that includes the bounding box to fit the map to in a subsequent call to the WMS GetMap method that also specifies the `LAYERS=Trace.{tno}`. (See WMS Service methods for details).
## Retrieve previously saved trace results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#retrieve-previously-saved-trace-results)
When a trace is executed, the trace results are saved in tables in the database until the client explicitly deletes them. Call the `/Trace/Traces` method to get a Json list of the trace number (TNO) and trace name of every saved trace result set. This list could be presented to the user so he can select a previously executed trace for redisplay or for custom processing.
Call the `/Trace/Results/{tno}` method to return a Json array of the trace results. The client could display the information as a data grid to allow the user to examine the features in the trace one at a time.
## Augment the Trace Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#augment-the-trace-results)
Any trace result set can be augmented with new attributes by providing the AUGMENT optional parameter. User can provide attribute numbers and attribute field name as input to the AUGMENT parameter. Call the `/Trace/Results/{tno}?Augment={Attribute Number}&Augment={ComponentName.AttributeFieldName}` to retrieve augmented parameters along with the trace result set.
## Aggregation on Trace Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#aggregation-on-trace-results)
Aggregation can be performed on the result set by providing aggregate optional parameters. Supported aggregates are SUM, MIN, MAX, AVG, GROUPBY, ORDERBY and DISTINCT. User can provide attribute numbers or response field names that needs to participate in the aggregate operation. Simple arithmetic operations can also be performed on the response fields for aggregation. Supported operators for arithmetic operation are +, -, *, /. The arithmetic expression will be evaluated for each response item and then the resulting aggregation will be performed. Call the `/Trace/Results/{tno}?Sum={parameterName}&Min={parameterName}&Max={parameterName}&Avg={parameterName}` to perform aggregation on the trace result set.
## Substitute on Trace Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#substitute-on-trace-results)
Substitute operation can be performed on the result set parameters by providing the SUBST optional parameter. It is performed on individual attributes or attributes in specific ranges. All the operators supported by DataTable can be used in substitute operation. Call the `/Trace/Results/{tno}?Subst={Substitute ParameterName},{Condition},{Substituted Value}` to perform substitution functionality on the trace result set.
## Function Call on Trace Results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#function-call-on-trace-results)
An Oracle function which returns a scalar value can be executed by providing the FUNCTION optional parameter. The resultant value is added as a new parameter to the Trace result set. Call the `/Trace/Results/{tno}?Function={OracleFunctionName}@{ParameterName}` to execute the oracle function and add to the trace result set.
## Delete trace results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace.html#delete-trace-results)
Call the `/trace/delete/{trace name}` method to cleanup the saved trace results in the database. It is the client's responsibility to do this cleanup since it is the only one that knows when it is finished working with a specific trace result.
# Methods  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/Types](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetTraceTypes.html)  | Returns all trace definitions which are present in the connected database.  |  
| GET  | [/Types/{FeatureNumber}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetTraceTypesFno.html)  | Returns the list of trace definitions for the given feature number which are present in the connected database.  |  
| GET  | [/Parameters/{TraceMappingID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetTraceParameters.html)  | Returns the trace parameters for the given trace mapping identifier.  |  
| GET  | [/Delete/{TraceName}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/DeleteTrace.html)  | Deletes the trace if exists.  |  
| GET  | [/Exists/{TraceName}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/DoesTraceExist.html)  | Returns true if the given tracename exists.  |  
| GET  | [/PickListValues/{ANO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetPicklistKeyValues.html)  | Returns the picklist values for the given attribute number.  |  
| POST  | [/Execute](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/ExecuteTrace.html)  | Executes the trace and returns a tracenumber for the given input parameters.  |  
| GET  | [/hint?SeedFID={seedFID}&mappingID={mappingID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetHintFeatureCandidate.html)  | Returns the list of hint feature instances for the given seedFid and mappingID.  |  
| GET  | [/SeedFNOs](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetSeedFeatureCandidate.html)  | Returns all the FNO's that are eligible to perform trace.  |  
| GET  | [/MappingId?TraceId={TraceID}&SeedFno={SeedFNO}&TraceType={TraceType}&TraceUsername={TraceUsername}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetMappingId.html)  | Returns the MappingId for the given TraceId, SeedFno, and either TraceType or TraceUsername.  |  
| GET  | [/Reports/{mappingId}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetTraceReports.html)  | Returns the list of valid report for given mappingID.  |  
| POST  | [/ComputeMarkers/{tno}?rpno={rpno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/ComputeMarkers.html)  | Computes marker points for executed cost constraint trace.  |  
| POST  | [/computemarkerpoints](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/ComputeMarkerPoints.html)  | Computes the marker location points for an executed trace based on user defined stop criteria.  |

# SetFullExportSchedule
This API is obsolete.
Set the time and date to run a Full Export.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/CIM/SetFullExportSchedule.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{CIMManagementServiceName}/Export/Full/Schedule/Set?starttime=xxxxxx&startDate=xxxxxxxx
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| starttime  | The time to start the Full Export in 24 hour hhmmss format. For example, 1:15 pm (13:15:00) would be 131500.  |  
| startdate  | The date to run the Full Export in yyyyMMdd format. October 3, 2017 would be 20171003.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{CIMManagementServiceName}/Export/Full/Schedule/Set?starttime=091800&startdate=20171027
**Sample Response**

```
{
       "StartDate": "10/27/2017",
       "StartTime": "09:18:00",
       "Success": true,
       "Message": "Full Export scheduled to run."
   }

```

# TransformConfigurationToDatabase
Transform coordinates of 1 or 2 points from **configuration** to **database** coordinate system for specified NetWorks configuration.
Axis orientation of coordinate systems is ignored and the method always assumes axis horizontal-vertical orientation ((X, Y), (Easting, Northing) or (Longitude, Latitude)) regardless of coordinate system parameters.
All numeric parameter values use . as decimal separator. No grouping separator is allowed.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/TransformConfigurationToDatabase.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
/configuration/{configuration}/configtodb?x={x}&y={y}[&z={z}][&x1={x1}][&y1={y1}][&z1={z1}][&n={dimensions}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| configuration  | NetWorks configuration  |  
| x  | X ordinate of 1st point  |  
| y  | Y ordinate of 1st point  |  
| z  | Z ordinate of 1st point. Optional. When not present, 0 is assumed.  |  
| x1  | X ordinate of 2nd point. Optional.  |  
| y1  | Y ordinate of 2nd point. Optional.  |  
| z1  | Z ordinate of 2nd point. Optional. When not present, 0 is assumed.  |  
| n  | Number of dimensions. Optional. Allowed values: 2, 3. When not present, 2 is assumed. Affects number of dimensions in return value.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksCoordinateSystemService/configuration/NETWORKS/configtodb?x=1303620&y=7055284
**Sample Response**

```
[
    4480851.860617144,
    5917510.0418096054
]

```
