# TransformPointArray
Transform coordinate array from source to destination coordinate system.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/TransformPointArray.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
/configuration/{configuration}/transform?s={s}&d={d}[&n={n}][&iao={iao}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| configuration  | NetWorks configuration  |  
| s  | Source coordinate system name. This can either be a valid coordinate system defined within the configuration or a valid EPSG code. A valid EPSG code should be prefixed by 'EPSG:' (example 'EPSG:3857').  |  
| d  | Destination coordinate system name. This can either be a valid coordinate system defined within the configuration or a valid EPSG code. A valid EPSG code should be prefixed by 'EPSG:' (example 'EPSG:3857').  |  
| n  | Number of dimensions. Optional. Allowed values: 2, 3. When not present, 2 is assumed. Affects number of dimensions in both input and output.  |  
| iao  | Flag: ignore axes ordering. Optional. Allowed values: 0, 1. When `0`, axis ordering is honored according to coordinate system parameters in both input and output. When `1`, axis ordering is ignored and all values are expected in X,Y ordering ((X, Y), (Easting, Northing), (Longitude, Latitude)). When not present, 0 is assumed. Affects number of dimensions in return value.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksCoordinateSystemService/configuration/NETWORKS/transform?s=EPSG:3857&d=GK4
**Sample Request body**

```
[
    1303620.0,
    7055284.0,
    1303621.0,
    7055285.0
]

```

**Sample Response**

```
[
    4480851.860617144,
    5917510.0418096054,
    4480852.4607003834,
    5917510.6356232725
]

```

# Coordinate System Service
Coordinate System Service provides methods for getting information on coordinate systems and transformation of coordinates between coordinate systems.
## Information[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service.html#information)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/configuration/{configuration}/names](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/GetCoordSystemNames.html)  | Get list of coordinate system names defined within a configuration.  |  
| GET  | [/configuration/{configuration}/list](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/GetCoordSystemParameters.html)  | Get list of coordinate systems defined within a connected configuration along with their parameters.  |  
| GET  | [/configuration/{configuration}/info/configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/GetConfigurationCSParameters.html)  | Get parameters of coordinate system of selected NetWorks configuration.  |  
| GET  | [/configuration/{configuration}/info/database](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/GetDatabaseCSParameters.html)  | Get parameters of database coordinate system underlying selected NetWorks configuration.  |  
| GET  | [/configuration/{configuration}/info](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service/GetCSParameters.html)  | Get parameters of specified coordinate system.  |

# Data-Transfer-Service

# BeginTransaction
Begin an upload transaction. The method returns a unique transaction identifier (tid), which is used with subsequent operations.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#uri)
POST /transaction
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#parameters)
None.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#normal-response-200)
Response with transaction id (tid) of the transaction.

```
{
  "success": true, 
  "tid": "ns0im266d799odjv8vg5woy91fmbej12"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html#server-error-500)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_UPLOAD_FAILED",
    "ErrorMessage": "Error details"
}

```

# CommitTransaction
Commit a multi-operation transaction, previously opened by [BeginTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html).
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#uri)
POST /transaction/**{tid}** /
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction id (`tid`)  |  
### Body (optional)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#body-optional)
When present, to be stored as `package.json` file.

```
{
   "description": "Uploaded redlines",
   "type": "redlines",
   "owner": "ginius",
   "version": "1.0"
}

```

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
  "success": true
}

```

### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#bad-request-400)

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html#server-error-500)

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

# DeleteTransactionFile
Delete previously uploaded file from an open transaction.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#uri)
DELETE /transaction/**{tid}** /file/**{file}**[?opt=**{opt}**]
### Path parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#path-parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction identifier  |  
| file  | String  | Y  | File name or file path, URL-encoded. Paths containing `..` segments are forbidden.  |  
### Query parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#query-parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| opt  | String  |   | Default 0. When not 0, file does not have to exist.  |  
## Request, variant 2[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#request-variant-2)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#uri-1)
DELETE /transaction/**{tid}** /file?file=**{file}**[&path=**{path}** &opt=**{opt}**]
### Path parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#path-parameters-1)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction identifier  |  
### Query parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#query-parameters-1)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| file  | String  | Y  | File name, URL-encoded. Paths containing `..` segments are forbidden.  |  
| path  | String  |   | Relative path to file, URL-encoded. Paths containing `..` segments are forbidden.  |  
| opt  | String  |   | Default 0. When not 0, file does not have to exist.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
    "success": true
}

```

### No content (204)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#no-content-204)
Returned if optional parameter **opt** is not 0 and file does not exist.
### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#bad-request-400)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "Success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

```
{
    "Success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND",
    "ErrorMessage": "File not found"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Forbidden (403)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html#forbidden-403)
Returned when the request points to an existing object to which the current user has no access rights.

```
{
    "Success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "AccessDenied"
}

```

# GetTransactions
Get list of committed transactions by search criteria.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#uri)
GET /transactions?from=**{from}** &to=**{to}** &$skip=**{$skip}** &$top=**{$top}** &**{attribute}** =**{value}**[&{attribute}={value}]
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| from  | Date  | N  | Start timestamp, formatted as `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`. When not specified, all transactions are read from the start.  |  
| to  | Date  | N  | End timestamp, formatted as `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`. When not specified, upper limit is not enforced.  |  
| $skip  | Number  | N  | Number of records to skip.  |  
| $top  | Number  | N  | Maximum number of records to return. Server imposes its own limit which cannot be overridden by this parameter.  |  
| {attribute}  | String  | N  | Arbitrary attribute of package to filter on (e.g. `type`). All transactions which have `{attribute}` value equal to `{value}` in `package.json` file are returned.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
  "success": true,
  "more": true,
  "transactions": [
    {
      "tid": "1231231231231asdfasdf",
      "ts": "20210101T01:23:34",
      "type": "redlines",
      "owner": "xyasdf12346345",
      "size": 65536
    }, {
      "tid": "2231231231231asdfasdf",
      "ts": "20210202T01:23:34",
      "type": "redlines",
      "owner": "9697987asfdf9494",
      "size": 128486
    }
  ]
}

```

### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#bad-request-400)

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_INVALID_QUERY",
    "ErrorMessage": "Invalid query"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactions.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.

# GetTransactionState
Return state of transaction identified by `tid`. Transaction states are:
  * `OPEN`
  * `COMMITTED`
  * `UNKNOWN` - transaction is not found neither among open nor committed.

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#uri)
GET /transaction/**{tid}** /state
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction id (`tid`)  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#normal-response-200)
Transaction is **open**.

```
{
  "success": true,
  "state": "OPEN"
}

```

Transaction is **committed**.

```
{
  "success": true,
  "state": "COMMITTED"
}

```

Transaction is neither **open** nor **committed** , but the `tid` is formally valid.

```
{
  "success": false,
  "state": "UNKNOWN"
}

```

### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#bad-request-400)
Returned when a malformed `tid` is passed in request.

```
{
  "Success": false,
  "ErrorCode": "ERR_INVALID_TID",
  "ErrorMessage": "Invalid transaction id"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionState.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.

# GetMessages
Get list of messages from transaction tracking table.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#uri)
GET /message/list[?filter={filter}&orderby={orderby}&skip={skip}&count={count}&dbuser={0|1}&user={0|1}]
### Query parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#query-parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| filter  | string  |   | SQL-like WHERE clause for filtering data.  |  
| orderby  | string  |   | SQL-like ORDER BY clause. If not specified, messages are ordered by message identifier.  |  
| skip  | integer  |   | Number of records to skip. The value must be equal or greater than 0. Default is 0.  |  
| count  | int  |   | Maximum number of records to return. The value must be greater than 1. Default is 10.  |  
| dbuser  | int  |   | When present and non-zero, the records are filtered on NWG_CREATEDBY column using the current database user.  |  
| user  | int  |   | When present and non-zero, the records are filtered on NWG_USER column using the configured identifier attribute (claim) of the current OpenId Connect user. Default claim is `sub`.  |  
### Filtering and ordering[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#filtering-and-ordering)
The list of allowed fields for filtering is restricted to:  
| Field name  | Data type  |  
| --- | --- |  
| msgid  | integer  |  
| tid  | string  |  
| wid  | string  |  
| type  | string  |  
| state  | string  |  
| createdon  | date-time  |  
| createdby  | string  |  
| editedon  | date-time  |  
| editedby  | string  |  
| user  | string  |  
| configuration  | string  |  
| job  | string  |  
| description  | string  |  
| parenttid  | string  |  
| ordinal  | integer  |  
#### Allowed operators[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#allowed-operators)
AND, OR, NOT, IN, BETWEEN, <, >, <=, >=, <>, LIKE.
#### Literals[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#literals)  
| Type  | Format  | Examples  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| string  | Apostrophe delimited. Use double apostrophe (`''`) as escape sequence  | 'Abc'  |  
| integer  | Integer with digits 0..9  | 123  |  
| double  | Floating point number with `.` as decimal separator, without grouping separator.  | 124.45  |  
| date-time  | SQL-standard DATE or TIMESTAMP literal (`DATE 'yyyy-mm-dd'`, `TIMESTAMP 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.fff'`)  |  `DATE '2021-05-16'`, `TIMESTAMP '2021-05-16 01:23:45.666'`  |  
#### ORDER BY clause[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#order-by-clause)
OrderBy parameters accepts SQL-like ORDER BY clause, examples: `MSGID DESC`, `CONFIGURATION, CREATEDON DESC`.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/Messages/GetMessages.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
    "messages": [
        {
            "msgid": 22,
            "tid": "37hhj1r4dh7rg33ro0i9ueigcuzv051w",
            "wid": "psizrwksbxd3ulizoackw2ekp48194e8",
            "type": "features",
            "state": "ERROR",
            "job": "11685",
            "description": "MyJob",
            "createdby": "GINIUS",
            "createdon": "2023-10-18T15:18:51+02:00",
            "editedby": "GINIUS",
            "editedon": "2023-10-18T15:18:51+02:00",
            "user": "0e55502b-4f69-4356-a225-77d3c545b1b1"
        }
    ]
}

```

{
    "type": "https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.5.1",
    "title": "ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT",
    "status": 400,
    "detail": "Specified argument was out of the range of valid values. (Parameter 'skip')",

# UploadFile
Upload contents of a file to an open transaction. There are two options available:
  * Upload file as multipart/form-data
  * Upload data in regular body (JSON) with provided file name.

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#uri)
**POST** /transaction/**{tid}** /file
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction id (`tid`)  |  
### Request type 1 (form-data)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#request-type-1-form-data)
The file content is sent in the request body. The body must use **multipart/form-data** encoding (see [POST](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods/POST)). Two named parameters are accepted:  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| file  | File  | Y  | File contents and name.  |  
| path  | String  | N  | Relative path of the file. Use `/` as path delimiter. Optional.  |  
### Request type 2 (JSON body)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#request-type-2-json-body)
The file content is sent as JSON in the request body. Query parameters:  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| file  | String  | Y  | File name.  |  
| path  | String  |   | Relative path of the file. Use `/` as path delimiter (URL encoding is reqiured).  |  

```
{
   "columns": ["Header 1", "Header 2" ],
   "rows" : [
      ["row 1", 123 ],
      ["row 2", 456 ]
  ]
}

```

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
    "Success": true
}

```

### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#bad-request-400)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```

    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.

# WebFinger Discovery
Returns [WebFinger](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7033) discovery document for the service. This can be used to retrieve the URL of the **OpenID Connect** issuer and the **Client Id** to be used by the mobile devices.
This method does not require authentication.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/WebFinger-Discovery.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/WebFinger-Discovery.html#uri)
GET /.well-known/webfinger?resource=**{user}** &rel=http://openid.net/specs/connect/1.0/issuer
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/WebFinger-Discovery.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| user  | String  | Y  | User name. Value is not important, the service will return the same response for any value.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/WebFinger-Discovery.html#response)
When OpenID Connect issuer is configured in OpenIdConfig.json, its URL is returned in the href of the link with rel=`http://openid.net/specs/connect/1.0/issuer`.
There are additional parameters returned:
  * **client_id** under the **properties** of link with rel=`http://openid.net/specs/connect/1.0/issuer`. Value is mapped from configuration value `infrastructureServiceAuthentication:ClientId`. client_id is expected to be used by public clients (those which do not require client secrets) for direct communication with OIDC.
  * link with rel=**web_authenticator** href value is mapped from configuration value `infrastructureServiceAuthentication:WebAuthenticatorUri`.  
When present, the client should use this as the entry URI for the Web Authenticator flow.

```
{
    "subject": "acct:user1",
    "links": [
        {
            "rel": "http://openid.net/specs/connect/1.0/issuer",
            "href": "http://localhost:8080/auth/realms/NetWorks",
            "properties": {
                "client_id": "NWM"
            }
        },
        {
            "rel": "web_authenticator",
            "href": "http://localhost/MobileAuthenticatorService/mobileauth/OpenIdConnect"
        }
    ]
}

```

# Dialog-Web-Service

# AttributeUpdate
Inserts and updates the record for the selected attributes record.
## PUT[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/AttributeUpdate.html#put)
**Request URL Template**
/Feature/Attribute?pCONF={PCONF}&pLCID={PLCID}&pJOB={PJOB}&apiVersion={apiVersion}[&ActiveJob={job name}][&skipfi={skipfi}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| PCONF  | Connected GTech configuration  |  
| PLCID  | Locale language indentifier of client  |  
| PJOB  | GTech job identifier  |  
| apiVersion  | GTDWS service version. Supported versions are 2.2.0 and 2.3.0.  |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional. Edits from this request are added to the job's pending edits.  |  
| skipfi  | Optional. 1 or true to bypass Functional Interface invocation. If not specified, parameter `skipfi` defined in _web.config_ _appSettings_ section is used. If not defined default, value 0 (false) is used.  |  
Picklist now supports Restricted and Unrestricted behavior on picklist attribute. We need to pass G3E_TANO and its value in post body from version 2.3.0.
For restricted picklist, the service will validate the "NEWVALUE" across the picklist. If "NEWVALUE" doesn't exists service throws the exception. For Unrestricted picklist, the service will not validate the "NEWVALUE" across the picklist.
When there is an error from package related to metadata, a generic error will be shown. The Oracle error along with the ORA error code will be logged in database.
**Sample Request for 2.3.0**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/Feature/Attribute?apiVersion=2.3.0&pLCID=0009
**Sample Request Body**

```
{
    "items": [{
            "TANO": 173010201,
            "FID": 231949887,
            "FNO": 17300,
            "CID": 1,
            "NEWVALUE": "PROT_OUT_HALF"
        }
    ]
}

```

**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/Feature/Attribute?apiVersion=2.2.0&pLCID=0009
**Sample Request Body**

```
{
    "items": [{
            "ANO": 220106,
            "FID": 231962958,
            "FNO": 2200,
            "CID": 1,

        }
    ]
}

    {
      "FID": 231962958,
      "CID": 1
    }
  ]
}

```

## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/AttributeUpdate.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
/Feature/Attribute?pCONF={PCONF}&pLCID={PLCID}&pJOB={PJOB}&version={VERSION}[&ActiveJob={job name}][&skipfi={skipfi}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| PCONF  | Connected GTech configuration  |  
| PLCID  | Locale language indentifier of client  |  
| PJOB  | GTech job identifier  |  
| apiVersion  | GTDWS service version. Supported versions are 2.1.0, 2.2.0 and 2.3.0.  |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional. Edits from this request are added to the job's pending edits.  |  
| skipfi  | Optional. 1 or true to bypass Functional Interface invocation. If not specified, parameter `skipfi` defined in _web.config_ _appSettings_ section is used. If not defined, default value 0 (false) is used.  |  
Picklist now supports Restricted and Unrestricted behavior on picklist attribute. We need to pass G3E_TANO and its value in post body from version 2.3.0.
For restricted picklist, the service will validate the "NEWVALUE" across the picklist. If "NEWVALUE" doesn't exists service throws the exception. For Unrestricted picklist, the service will not validate the "NEWVALUE" across the picklist.
When there is any error from package related to metadata, generic error will be shown and Oracle error will be logged in database.
To validate hyperlinks, the called must pass "ISHYPERLINK" parameter and its value in post body. Passing 1 is for validating shared path and 2 is for validating web URL.
**Sample Request for 2.3.0**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/Feature/Attribute?apiVersion=2.3.0&pLCID=0009
**Sample Request Body**

```
{
    "items": [{
            "TANO": 173010201,
            "FID": 231949887,
            "FNO": 17300,
            "CID": 1,
            "NEWVALUE": "PROT_OUT_HALF",
            "ISHYPERLINK": "2"
        }
    ]
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
{
  "items": [
    {
      "FID": 231962958,
      "CID": 1
    }
  ]
}

```

# AutoPopulateAttribute
AutoPopulates the Attributes with given TANO. The response includes both the value and key for a given G3E_TANO.FID and CID can also be given for autopopulate.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/AutoPopulateAttribute.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
/AutoPopulateAttribute/{TRIGGERTANO}?pFID={PFID}&pCID={PCID}&apiVersion={apiVersion}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| TRIGGERTANO  | Desired TriggerTANO as a string.  |  
| FID  | Feature Identifier.  |  
| CID  | Component Identifier.  |  
| apiVersion  | GTDWS service version. Supported versions are 2.2.0 and 2.3.0.  |  
**Case 1: FID is null**
TANO and value of all attributes in the filter need to be sent in post body.
**Case 2: FID and CID are not null**
TANO and value of all attributes in the filter need not to be sent in post body. This is applicable when Trigger set attributes are available in multiple tabs.
Note: When CID is null/invalid first available record for the given FID will be considered.
When there is an error from package related to metadata, a generic error will be shown. The Oracle error along with the ORA error code will be logged in database.
**Request Body format**

```
[{
    "ATTRIBUTETANO": 600400346,
    "ATTRIBUTEVALUE": "864"
}, {
    "ATTRIBUTETANO": 600400348,
    "ATTRIBUTEVALUE": "1"
}]

```

**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/AutoPopulateAttribute/600400355?FID=133167742&CID=1&apiVersion=2.2.0
**Sample Response**

```
{"items":[{"ATTRIBUTETANO":600400357},{"ATTRIBUTETANO":600400358},{"ATTRIBUTETANO":600400362},
{"ATTRIBUTETANO":600400363},{"ATTRIBUTETANO":327040251},{"ATTRIBUTETANO":327040252 },
{"ATTRIBUTETANO":327040248," ATTRIBUTEPNOKEY ":"288","ATTRIBUTEPNOVALUE": "288" },{"ATTRIBUTETANO":600400360},
{"ATTRIBUTETANO":600400355," ATTRIBUTEPNOKEY ":"288","ATTRIBUTEPNOVALUE":"288" }]}

```

# CreateFeature

The method requires an entry in table **NWG_CREATE_FEATURE** for each G3E_FNO which is created using this API. The GIN_PROCEDURE_NAME must be set to a procedure with the following signature:
`PROCEDURE <name> (PFNO IN NUMBER, PUDTKEYTABLE OUT TUDTKEYTABLE)`
NetWorks is delivered with a generic procedure **CAO_CREATE_FEATURE**.

# GetPicklist
Gets the picklist records for the selected attribute number along with multicolumn value.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/GetPicklist.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{ServiceName}/PickList/{ANO}?pLCID={PLCID}&pIndex={PINDEX}&pSize={PSIZE}&pFilter={PFILTER}}&apiVersion={apiVersion}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| PLCID  | Locale language indentifier of client  |  
| PINDEX  | Paging index number  |  
| PSIZE  | Paged records to be returned  |  
| PFILTER  | Filter string for picklist  |  
| apiVersion  | GTDWS service version. Supported versions are 2.2.0 and 2.3.0.  |  
**Multicolumn Picklist**
Picklist GET and POST APIs support multicolumn. In the response of this API, ATTRIBUTEADDITIONAL is for additional column values. The order of these values depend on G3E_ATTRIBUTEPNOADDITIONFIELDS property returned in response of DialogTab for this ANO\TANO.
For type ahead filtering, if filter needs to be done on reserved characters, partially encoded form needs to be sent from client. Specially partial encoding needs to be done for "+","/"
For example: reserved character "+" needs to be sent like %2B, "/" needs to be sent with %2f.
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/PickList/7118?pLCID=0009&pFID=133167742&apiVersion=2.2.0&pFilter=Z%2b
When there is an error from package related to metadata, a generic error will be shown. The Oracle error along with the ORA error code will be logged in database.
**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/PickList/208010008?apiVersion=2.2.0&pFilter=building

        ]

}

```

# GetPicklistTano
Gets the picklist records for the selected tab attribute number.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/GetPicklistTano.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{ServiceName}/PickList/TANO/{TANO}?pLCID={PLCID}&pIndex={PINDEX}&pSize={PSIZE}&pFilter={PFILTER}&apiVersion={apiVersion}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| PLCID  | Locale language indentifier of client  |  
| PINDEX  | Paging index number  |  
| PSIZE  | Paged records to be returned  |  
| Filter  | Filter string for Picklist.  |  
| apiVersion  | GTDWS service version. Supported versions are 2.2.0 and 2.3.0.  |  
**Multicolumn Picklist**
Picklist GET and POST API's support multicolumn. In the response of this API, ATTRIBUTEADDITIONAL is for additional column values. The order of these values depend on G3E_ATTRIBUTEPNOADDITIONFIELDS property returned in response of DialogTab for this ANO\TANO.
For type ahead filtering, if filter needs to be done on reserved characters, partially encoded form needs to be sent from client. Special partial encoding is needed for "+","/"
For example: reserved character "+" needs to be sent like %2B, "/" needs to be sent with %2f.
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/PickList/TANO/7118?pLCID=0009&pFID=133167742&apiVersion=2.2.0&pFilter=Z%2b
When there is an error from package related to metadata, a generic error will be shown. The Oracle error along with the ORA error code will be logged in database.
**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/PickList/TANO/324020159?apiVersion=2.2.0&Filter=building
**Sample Response**

```
{
    "items": [{
        "ATTRIBUTEPNOKEY": "PP",
        "ATTRIBUTEPNOVALUE": "PP",
        "ATTRIBUTEADDITIONAL": [
            "SPECIES1",
            "35",
            "5",
            "8",
            "4"
        ]
    }]
}

```

# GetSecondaryDataInfo
Gets the secondary data feature numbers.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/GetSecondaryDataInfo.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/SecondaryData/Features?pTYPE={PTYPE}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| PTYPE  | Imported or non-imported data  |  
Retrieves the list of feature numbers based on pType input. If pType is not provided, it returns the list of all the secondary data feature numbers, if the pType value is 0, it returns the list of all the secondary data non-imported feature numbers. if the pType value is specified as 1, it returns the list of all the secondary data imported feature numbers.
**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/SecondaryData/Features?ptype=0
**Sample Response**

```
{
    "items": [
        100,
        101,
        102
     ]

}

```

# PostPicklisttab
This API is to support field value filter along with multicolumn. The response includes key, value, and additional columns value for a given G3E_TANO.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/PostPicklisttab.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{ServiceName}/PickList/{TANO}?pCONF={pCONF}&pLCID={PLCID}&pJOB={pJOB}&Index={PINDEX}&Size={PSIZE}&pFID={PFID}&pCID={PCID}&Filter={PFILTER}&apiVersion={apiVersion}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| pCONF  | Connected GTech configuration  |  
| pLCID  | Locale language indentifier of client  |  
| pJOB  | GTech job identifier  |  
| PINDEX  | Paging index number  |  
| PSIZE  | Paged records to be returned  |  
| PFID  | Feature Identifier used for Fieldvalue Filtering  |  
| PCID  | Compoenent Identifier used for Fieldvalue Filtering  |  
| PFILTER  | Filter string for Picklist  |  
| apiVersion  | GTDWS service version. Supported versions are 2.2.0 and 2.3.0.  |  
**FieldValue Filter**
When G3E_FIELDVALUEFILTER for TANO is not null, this API helps to retrieve the filtered picklist. In the request, TANO along with the involved TANOs and its values should be passed in request body. The response returns the filtered Picklist.
For example: TANO - 208010008 has G3E_FIELDVALUEFILTER set. In request body, the TANO's and selected values are sent. The service will evaluate the filter using these values.
If FID is passed, field value filter is evaluated by considering database values for missing TANOs.
**Case 1: FID is null**
TANO and value of all attributes in the filter need to be sent in post body.
**Case 2: FID and CID are not null**
TANO and value of all attributes in the filter need not to be sent in post body. The missing values will be considered from database. This is applicable when Field value filter attributes are available in multiple tabs.
Note: When CID is null/invalid first available record for the given FID will be considered.
For type ahead filtering, if filter needs to be done on reserved characters, partially encoded value needs to be sent from client. Specially partial encoding needs to be done for "+","/"
For example: reserved character "+" needs to be sent like %2B, "/" needs to be sent with %2f.
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/PickList/7118?pLCID=0009&pFID=133167742&apiVersion=2.2.0&pFilter=Z%2b
When there is an error from package related to metadata, a generic error will be shown. The Oracle error along with the ORA error code will be logged in database.
**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/picklist/300100172?pLCID=0009&FID=133167742&CID=1&apiVersion=2.2.0
**Sample Request**
http://{HostName}/{GTDWS ServiceName}/PickList/22010101?apiVersion=2.2.0&FID=231957315&pFilter=ARM
**Post Request Body**

```
[
    {"ATTRIBUTETANO":22010102,"ATTRIBUTEVALUE":"BELL"},
    {"ATTRIBUTETANO":22010181,"ATTRIBUTEVALUE":"CLD"},
    {"ATTRIBUTETANO":22010182,"ATTRIBUTEVALUE":"EXT"}
]

```

**Post Request Body with Field value filter**

```
[
    {"ATTRIBUTETANO":22010102,"ATTRIBUTEVALUE":"BELL"}
]

```

**Sample Response with field value filter**

```
{
  "items": [
    {
      "ATTRIBUTEPNOKEY": "ARMCO",
      "ATTRIBUTEPNOVALUE": "ARMCO PIPE",
      "ATTRIBUTEADDITIONAL": null
    },
    {
      "ATTRIBUTEPNOKEY": "CONDUIT",
      "ATTRIBUTEPNOVALUE": "CONDUIT",
      "ATTRIBUTEADDITIONAL": null
    }
  ]
}

```

# Dynamic-WMS-Service

# DeleteSource
Delete a dynamically registered source.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#workflow)
If already loaded, unload the source from memory.
Try to delete the source folder. Mark the source for deletion by creating a `.deleted` file in the source directory. This will indicate other Dynamic WMS's that the source should no longer be used. It will be removed by a background process.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#uri)
**DELETE** /source/**{sid}**
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| sid  | String  | Y  | Identifier of the data source. Refers to location of the DDC file to be rendered.  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#request-body)
N/A
## Success Response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#success-response-200)

```
{
    "success": true
}

```

## Bad Request (400) - No such sid[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#bad-request-400---no-such-sid)

```
{
    "success": false,
    "errorCode": "ERR_INVALID_SOURCE",
    "errorMessage": "No such source"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/DeleteSource.html#server-error-500)
Returned when internal processing in the Work server fails.

# GetCapabilities
Get capabilities for the WMS service for the source DDC file requested.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#workflow)
If not yet in cache:
  * Find source folder under `Storage.Root` by provided `sid`.
  * Open DDC file.

Get DDC layer and BBOX information. Construct GetCapabilities document and return it.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#uri)
**GET** /wms/**{sid}**?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities&version=1.3.0
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| sid  | String  | Y  | Identifier of the data source. Refers to location of the DDC file to be rendered.  |  
| service  | String  | Y  | Fixed: `WMS`  |  
| request  | String  | Y  | Fixed: `GetCapabilities`  |  
| version  | String  | Y  | WMS version. Allowed values: `1.3.0`  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#request-body)
N/A
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#response)
OGC standard GetCapabilities response.
Each layer in DDC is translated into a single WMS layer. Coordinate system equal to the NetWorks CS for the NW configuration configured for the service. Data extent is computed from DDC extents.
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#normal-response-200)
For XML schema, see [capabilities_1_3_0.xsd](http://schemas.opengis.net/wms/1.3.0/)
### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetCapabilities.html#server-error-500)
Returned when internal processing in the Work server fails.
For XML schema, see [exceptions_1_3_0.xsd](http://schemas.opengis.net/wms/1.3.0/)

# GetFeatureInfo
Get info on features located on map coordinates.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#workflow)
If not yet in cache:
  * Find source folder under `Storage.Root` by provided `sid`.
  * Open DDC file.

Render the map as bitmap using Locate method and find features. Return the list of feature identifiers and their attributes.
Allowed values for `INFO_FORMAT` are:
  * `text/xml`, `application/vnd.ogc.gml`, `application/xml`: Output is a `wfs:FeatureCollection` with geometries encoded as GML 3.2.1.

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#uri)
**GET** /wms/**{sid}**?service=WMS&request=GetFeatureInfo&version=1.3.0&BBOX={BBOX}&LAYERS={LAYERS}&CRS={CRS}&I={I}&J={J}&WIDTH={WIDTH}&HEIGHT={HEIGHT}
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| sid  | String  | Y  | Identifier of the data source. Refers to location of the DDC file to be rendered.  |  
| service  | String  | Y  | Fixed: `WMS`  |  
| request  | String  | Y  | Fixed: `GetFeatureInfo`  |  
| version  | String  | Y  | WMS version. Allowed values: `1.3.0`  |  
| layers  | String  | Y  | Layers to display on map. Comma-separated list of layer names.  |  
| bbox  | String  | Y  | Bounding box for map extent. Value is minx,miny,maxx,maxy in units of the CRS.  |  
| crs  | String  | Y  | Spatial Reference System for map output. Valid values are in the capabilities document.  |  
| height  | Integer  | Y  | Height of map output in pixels.  |  
| width  | Integer  | Y  | Width of map output in pixels.  |  
| format  | String  | Y  | Format for the map image output. Valid values are in the capabilities document.  |  
| info_format  | String  | Y  | Possible values are given in the capabilities document.  |  
| styles  | String  |   | Styles in which layers are to be rendered. Ignored.  |  
| transparent  | Boolean  |   | Whether the map background should be transparent. Values are `true` or `false`. Default is `true`.  |  
| bgcolor  | String  |   | Background color for the map image. Value is in the form RRGGBB. Default is `FFFFFF` (white).  |  
| exceptions  | String  |   | Format in which to report exceptions. Default value is `application/vnd.ogc.se_xml`.  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#request-body)
N/A
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#response)
GetFeatureInfo response, with `application/vnd.ogc.gml` formatting.
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetFeatureInfo.html#normal-response-200)

```

# GetMap
Get rendered bitmap for given parameters.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#workflow)
When Dynamic WMS receives a request for a `sid`, it checks if the DDCs are already loaded in memory. If not, they are loaded from source folder under `Storage.Root` by provided `sid`. Subsequent requests hit the already loaded DDCs until they're evicted from memory cached due to inactivity.
Verify CRS matches the configuration. If BBOX is outside of extent, render empty PNG.
Render the map as bitmap. Return rendered PNG.
##### Note
  * The internal operation is as stateless as possible. There's no need to call _GetCapabilities_ (or _GetLayer_) before making a _GetMap_ request.
  * A separate internal process periodically checks usage of loaded DDCs. Those which were not in uses for some time (configurable) are released from memory.

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#uri)
**GET** /wms/**{sid}**?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetMap&VERSION=1.3.0&LAYERS={LAYERS}&BBOX={BBOX}&CRS={CRS}&WIDTH={WIDTH}&HEIGHT={HEIGHT}
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| sid  | String  | Y  | Identifier of the data source. Refers to location of the DDC file to be rendered.  |  
| service  | String  | Y  | Fixed: `WMS`  |  
| request  | String  | Y  | Fixed: `GetMap`  |  
| version  | String  | Y  | WMS version. Allowed values: `1.3.0`  |  
| layers  | String  | Y  | Layers to display on map. Comma-separated list of layer names. Special value `__ALL__` can be used to request all layers at once.  |  
| bbox  | String  | Y  | Bounding box for map extent. Value is minx,miny,maxx,maxy in units of the CRS.  |  
| crs  | String  | Y  | Spatial Reference System for map output. Valid values are in the capabilities document.  |  
| height  | Integer  | Y  | Height of map output in pixels.  |  
| width  | Integer  | Y  | Width of map output in pixels.  |  
| format  | String  | Y  | Format for the map image output. Valid values are in the capabilities document.  |  
| styles  | String  |   | Styles in which layers are to be rendered. The parameter is **Ignored**.  |  
| transparent  | Boolean  |   | Whether the map background should be transparent. Values are `true` or `false`. Default is `true`.  |  
| bgcolor  | String  |   | Background color for the map image when transparent is `false`. Value is in the form RRGGBB. Default is `FFFFFF` (white).  |  
| exceptions  | String  |   | Format in which to report exceptions. Default value is `application/vnd.ogc.se_xml`.  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#request-body)
N/A
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#response)
PNG file with rendered map.
### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetMap.html#server-error-500)
Returned when internal processing in the Work server fails.
For XML schema, see [exceptions_1_3_0.xsd](http://schemas.opengis.net/wms/1.3.0/)

# GetRegisteredSources
Get list of registered sources, optionally filtered.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#workflow)
Retrieve list of already registered dynamic WMS sources from the storage. Filter list sources by input conditions and paging parameters.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#uri)
**GET** /sources[?][kw={keywords}][&name={name}][&bbox={bbox}][&skip={skip}][&count={count}]
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| keywords  | String  |   | Comma separated list of keywords.  |  
| name  | String  |   | Pattern for matching file names. Use wildcard format: `?` for single character, `*` for multiple characters.  |  
| bbox  | String  |   | Bounding box to search for sources. Formatted as WMS GetMap BBOX parameter (four numbers `minx,miny,maxx,maxy`) in CRS configured for the Dynamic WMS instance.  |  
| skip  | Integer  |   | Paging parameter. Number of records to skip from start.  |  
| count  | Integer  |   | Paging parameter. Number of records to return.  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#request-body)
N/A
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
  "success": true,
  "sources": [
    {
      "sid": "85asd223235423454565365",
      "name": "test.dgn",
      "keywords": ["test", "test 1"]
      "bbox": {
        "minx": 123123,
        "miny": 3434343,
        "maxx": 4545454,
        "maxy": 546565,
        "crs": "EPSG:3857"
    }
  ]
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dynamic-WMS-Service/GetRegisteredSources.html#server-error-500)
Returned when internal processing in the Work server fails.
For XML schema, see [exceptions_1_3_0.xsd](http://schemas.opengis.net/wms/1.3.0/)

# Export-Service

# Export
Exports data from source to destination format.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Export-Service/Export.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{ExportServiceName}/export?Name={name}&SrcFormat={srcFormat}&DestFormat={destFormat}&SrcCrs={srcCrs}&DestCrs={destCrs}&;SrcConfig={srcConfig}&DestConfig={destConfig}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Name  | Export Name.  |  
| SrcFormat  | Source Format.  |  
| SrcFormat  | Source Format.  |  
| DestFormat  | Destination Format.  |  
| SrcCrs  | Source Coordinate System. Optional Parameter. Can be an EPSG code or G/Techology coordinate system name.  |  
| DestCrs  | Destination Coordinate System. Optional Parameter. Can be an EPSG code or G/Techology coordinate system name.  |  
| SrcConfig  | Source Configuration. Optional Parameter.  |  
| DestConfig  | Destination Configuration. Optional Parameter.  |  
**Post Body**
Should contain the source input format data.
**Remarks**
If SrcCrs is not specified, the service derives the coordinate system from the provided SrcConfig parameter. If both the SrcCrs and SrcConfig parameters are missing, it uses the configuration of the service to determine the source coordinate system.
If DestCrs is not specified, the service derives the coordinate system from the provided DestConfig parameter. If both the DestCrs and DestConfig parameters are missing, it uses the configuration of the service to determine the destination coordinate system.
**Sample Requests**
http://{HostName}/{ExportServiceName}/export?Name=Export.Redlines&SrcFormat=application/vnd.gtech.redlines.xml&DestFormat=application/vnd.networks.redlines.json&SrcCrs=EPSG:4326&DestCrs=EPSG:3857
http://{HostName}/{ExportServiceName}/export?Name=Export.Redlines&SrcFormat=application/vnd.networks.redlines.json&DestFormat=application/vnd.gtech.redlines.xml&SrcCrs=EPSG:4326&DestConfig=TESTCONFIG
http://{HostName}/{ExportServiceName}/export?Name=Export.Redlines&SrcFormat=application/vnd.gtech.redlines.xml&DestFormat=application/vnd.networks.redlines.json&SrcConfig=TESTCONFIG&DestConfig=TESTCONFIG3857
http://{HostName}/{ExportServiceName}/export?Name=Export.Redlines&SrcFormat=application/vnd.networks.redlines.json&DestFormat=application/vnd.gtech.redlines.xml&SrcConfig=TESTCONFIG3857&DestCrs=EPSG:4326
http://{HostName}/{ExportServiceName}/export?Name=Export.Redlines&SrcFormat=application/vnd.networks.redlines.json&DestFormat=application/vnd.gtech.redlines.xml
**Response**
Returns the data in the destination format.

# GetDefinition
Gets the feature layers definition based on the configured export format.

# Export Service
The Export Service is used to export data from source to destination format.
## Export Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Export-Service.html#export-service-1)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/NetWorksExportService/definition](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Export-Service/GetDefinition.html)  | Returns all the WMS services for the configured solution.  |  
| POST  | [/NetWorksExportService/export](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Export-Service/Export.html)  | Exports data from source to destination format.  |

# Feature-Data-Service

## Data

# ConvertGeometryFormat
Convert geometries into a selected format. The output can be 2D or 3D. Optionally, complex geometries with circular arcs can be stroked and simplified.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/ConvertGeometryFormat.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/geometry/convert?gf={gf}[&dims={dims}][&resolution={resolution}]`
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| gf  | string  | Y  | Output geometry format. Allowed values: wkt, networksjson, geojson. Default is wkt.  |  
| dims  | integer  |   | Dimensions of the output. Allowed values: 2, 3. Default is 3.  |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units pre display unit). When specified, all circular arcs are stroked to polylines and geometries are simplified (consecutive polyline segments are merged).  |  
**Body**
A JSON object with one or more properties. Each property contains a single geometry. The property name is repeated in the response to allow matching geometries in request and response. There is no restriction on the property names (beyond standard JSON rules). Geometries in the request can be specified in mixed formats. The API will deserialize the geometry according to its format specifier.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/ConvertGeometryFormat.html#response)
Data of the detail window, with storage, projected and geographic (WGS84) MBR.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/ConvertGeometryFormat.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/geometry/convert?gf=geojson&dims=2
_Body_

```
{
    "a": {
        "networksjson": {
            "type": "OrientedPoint",
            "origin": [
                1,
                2,
                0
            ],
            "orientation": [
                0.4472142375143948,
                0.8944268699924094,
                0
            ]
        }
    },
    "b": {
        "wkt": "LINESTRING Z(1 2 3,4 5 6,7 8 9)"
    }
}

```

**Example Response**

```
{
    "a": {
        "geojson": {
            "type": "Point",
            "coordinates": [
                1,
                2
            ],
            "orientation": [
                0.4472142375143948,
                0.8944268699924094
            ]
        }
    },
    "b": {
        "geojson": {
            "type": "LineString",
            "coordinates": [
                [
                    1,
                    2
                ],
                [
                    4,
                    5
                ],
                [
                    7,
                    8
                ]
            ]
        }
    }
}

```

# GetDetailInfo
Get parameters of a detail window by its detail identifier. The method looks for this detail in all detail attribute components.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDetailInfo.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/details/detail/{detailid}[?type={type}]`
**Path variables**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| {detailid}  | int  | Y  | Detail identifier  |  
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| type  | int  |   | 0 = Detail, 1 = Schematic. When omitted, both types are returned.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDetailInfo.html#response)
Data of the detail window, with storage, projected and geographic (WGS84) MBR.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDetailInfo.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/details/detail/55
**Example Response**

```
{
    "details": [

            "mbr": {

                }
            },
            "detailid": 55,
            "name": "15330000000006600064",
            "type": 0,
            "lsno": 16,
            "ownerfno": 323
        }
    ]
}

```

# GetDetailInfoWithOwnerFNO
Get parameters of a detail window by its detail identifier and the G3E_FNO of the owner.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDetailInfoWithOwnerFNO.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/details/detail/{detailid}/{fno}[?type={type}]`
**Path variables**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| {detailid}  | int  | Y  | Detail identifier.  |  
| {fno}  | int  | Y  | G3E_FNO of the owner.  |  
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| type  | int  |   | 0 = Detail, 1 = Schematic. When omitted, both types are returned.  |

# GetDialogTab
Return dialog tab content (tab attributes with their values translated by picklists) from the database.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDialogTab.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/dialog/tab/{dtno}/{fno}/{fid}[&attributes={attributes}]`
**Path variables**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| {dtno}  | int  | Y  | G3E_DTNO  |  
| {fno}  | int  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |  
| {fid}  | int  | Y  | G3E_FID  |  
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| {attributes}  | Int  |   | Flag: 1=include dialog tab attribute metadata in response. Other values: attributes are not included. Default is 1.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDialogTab.html#response)
Dialog tab data, optionally with dialog tab attribute metadata. For dialog tabs with repeating components, each row has property `cid` with G3E_CID of the repeating component instance.
Each row contains a map with G3E_TANO as key. Values are returned as objects with properties: `c` (string), `n` (number), `d` (date-time). Attributes with picklists have additional property `t` with display value for the picklist key.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDialogTab.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/tabs/323/1002458?type=Edit
**Example Response**

# GetDialogTabFromData
Return dialog tab content from feature component data sent by the client in the request. The method differs from the GetDialogTabData in that it accepts the current and related component data in request, whereas GetDialogTabData retrieves the feature component data from the database. The purpose if this method is to allow the clients to construct dialog tab content interactively from current state of a feature being edited on the client.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDialogTabFromData.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/dialog/tab/{dtno}`
**Body**
Body contains the row data of the component instance(s) displayed on the dialog tab and necessary related components (non-repeating components of the current feature). The format is the same as the response from the GetFeatureData method.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDialogTabFromData.html#response)
See response from GetDialogTabData.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetDialogTabFromData.html#example)

# GetFeatureData
Returns feature data.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetFeatureData.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/feature/{fno}/{fid}[?cno={cno}][&gf={gf}][&dims={dims}] [&resolution={resolution}]`
**Path variables**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| {fno}  | int  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |  
| {fid}  | int  | Y  | G3E_FID  |  
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| {cno}  | string  |   | Comma-separated list of G3E_CNOs to retrieve. When not specified, all components are retrieved.  |  
| {gf}  | string  |   | Output geometry format. Allowed values: wkt, networksjson, geojson. Default is wkt.  |  
| {dims}  | integer  |   | Dimensions of the geometries in output. Allowed values: 2, 3. Default is 3.  |  
| {resolution}  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, the geometries are returned as stored in the database.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetFeatureData.html#response)
Serialized feature data.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetFeatureData.html#example)

# GetForeignKeyValuesForTabAttribute
Returns rows from foreign key or domain table configured for given dialog tab attribute and G3E_FNO. The G3E_FNO is used to lookup the related dialog in G3E_DIALOGS_OPTABLE, where G3E_TYPE is the name of of the foreign key or domain table.
See [NWG_INTERFACEMAPPING](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_INTERFACEMAPPING.html) for configuration.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetForeignKeyValuesForTabAttribute.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/foreignkey/tabattribute/{tano}/{fno}[?skip={skip}&count={count}&filter={filter}&translate={translate}]`
**Path variables**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tano  | int  | Y  | G3E_TANO  |  
| fno  | int  | Y  | G3E_FNO. Used to lookup the dialog in G3E_DIALOGS_OPTABLE.  |  
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| skip  | int  |   | 0-based offset of the first row to retrieve. Must be 0 or more.  |  
| count  | int  |   | Number of records to retrieve. Must be 1 or more.  |  
| filter  | string  |   | SQL-like WHERE clause which is appended to the database query. Only a limited set of operators is supported (as in style or label rules filters).  |  
| translate  | int  |   | When `1`, translate key values in attributes with picklists to values. Other values: no translation is done, original values from FK table are returned. Default is `1`.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetForeignKeyValuesForTabAttribute.html#response)
The fields property contains an array of field names returned in each item of the items property. The fields are derived from the dialog tab defined for the foreign key or domain table.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetForeignKeyValuesForTabAttribute.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/foreignkey/tabattribute/30601004/306?skip=0&count=3
**Example Response**

```

        "NOM_CURRENT",

        "PRICEUNIT",

    ],

        },
        {

# GetListOfDetails
Returns details/schematics windows linked to a feature. Returns both owned detail windows and detail windows in which this feature participates.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetListOfDetails.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/details[?fno={fno}&type={type}&lsno={lsno}&name={name}&match={match}&skip={skip}&count={count}]`
**Path variables**
None.
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| fno  | int  |   | G3E_FNO of the detail owner. When specified, only details owned by this G3E_FNO are returned.  |  
| type  | int  |   | 0 = Detail, 1 = Schematic. When omitted, both types are returned.  |  
| lsno  | int  |   | G3E_LSNO of the legend in the detail row. When specified, only detail records referencing this G3E_LSNO are returned.  |  
| name  | string  |   | Filter condition for detail name. See `match` parameter for details how to interpret this value.  |  
| match  | string  |   | Comparison operator for lookup by name. When `match` is missing or `like`, `{name}` is expected to contain a pattern for case-insensitive comparison using SQL LIKE operator (using `%` and `_` wildcards). When `match` is set to `exact`, the detail name is compared using `=` operator.  |  
| skip  | int  |   | Paging parameter. Number of rows to skip. Must be greater or equal to 0.  |  
| count  | int  |   | Paging parameter. Number of rows to return. Must be greater or equal to 1.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetListOfDetails.html#response)
Detail and schematic window data
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetListOfDetails.html#example)
**Example Request**
`http://machinename/fds/details?type=0&name=%abc%&skip=10&count=10`
**Example Response**

```
{
  "details": [
    {
      "detailid": 57,
      "name": "15330000000006625761",
      "type": 0,
      "lsno": 16,
      "ownerfno": 323
    },
    {
      "detailid": 55,
      "name": "15330000000006600064",
      "type": 0,
      "lsno": 16,
      "ownerfno": 323
    }
  ]
}

```

| count  | int  |   | Number of records to retrieve. Must be 1 or more.  |

# GetPicklistValuesForTabAttributeFiltered
Returns content of picklist table for given G3E_TANO. Values of other attributes required for field value filters are passed in the request body and are used to filter the picklist values.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetPicklistValuesForTabAttributeFiltered.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/picklist/tabattribute/{tano}[?key={key}&skip={skip}&count={count}&filter={filter}]`
**Path variables**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tano  | int  | Y  | G3E_TANO  |  
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| key  | string  |   | Key value of the picklist (value of the G3E_TANO). When present, it is used to filter the picklist data.  |  
| skip  | int  |   | 0-based offset of the first row to retrieve. Must be 0 or more.  |  
| count  | int  |   | Number of records to retrieve. Must be 1 or more.  |  
| filter  | string  |   | SQL-like WHERE clause which is appended to the database query. Only a limited set of operators is supported (as in style or label rules filters).  |  
**Body**
Body contains a single property named attributes, which is a JSON object. Each property of this object is a G3E_ANO value, the value of the property is the attribute value. Values use attribute value encoding as in ProcessTransactions request.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetPicklistValuesForTabAttributeFiltered.html#response)
The same response as [GetPicklistValuesForTabAttribute](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetPicklistValuesForTabAttribute.html).
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetPicklistValuesForTabAttributeFiltered.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/picklist/tabattribute/2300?skip=0&count=10
_Body_

```
{
  "attributes": {
    "22010102": "2",
    "22010181": "3"
  }
}

```

**Example Response**
See example in [GetPicklistValuesForTabAttribute](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetPicklistValuesForTabAttribute.html).

# GetRegionFromGeometry
Determine subsetting region for provided geometry or geometries.
**NOTE**
This API works with region geometries published in DDCs only. Region geometry changes in database (in a job or posted, but not published) are not processed.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetRegionFromGeometry.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/subsetting/region`
**Body**
A JSON object with one or more properties. Each property contains a single geometry. The property name is repeated in the response to allow matching geometries in request and response. There is no restriction on the property names (beyond standard JSON rules). Geometries in the request can be specified in mixed formats. The API will deserialize the geometry according to its format specifier.
_Example_
See request example for ConvertGeometryFormat.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetRegionFromGeometry.html#response)
Response is a JSON object with properties named as in request. Each property is either a string (region identifier) or null, if the region wasn�t determined.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetRegionFromGeometry.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/subsetting/region
**Example Response**

```
{
    "a": "19386",
    "b": "19386",
    "c": "13060021",
    "d": "13060021",
    "e": "19386",
    "f": "13060086",
    "g": null,
    "point1": "13060086",
    "point1-in-geojson": "13060086"
}

```

# TabAttributeAutoPopulate
Automatically populates list of picklist attributes configured in `G3E_TRIGGERSET_OPTABLE` for given `G3E_TANO`. It substitutes attribute values provided in request in the trigger set filter and returns picklist values, if exactly one record matches the filter. When 0 or more than 1 records are returned, it returns null values, when `NullDerivedAttrWhenNotUnique` general parameter is set to -1 (or by default), no result otherwise.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TabAttributeAutoPopulate.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/picklist/autopopulate`
**Body**
Body contains G3E_TANO of an attribute for which the automatic population was triggered. It also contains dictionary of attributes (in G3E_ANO: value form) needed to evaluate trigger filter.
_Example_

```
{
    "tano": 124010208,
    "attributes": {
        "5114": "KCE-FJA-2"
    }
}

```

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TabAttributeAutoPopulate.html#response)
Contains dictionary with tab attribute values, if exactly one record match the predefined filter. Null values otherwise.
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TabAttributeAutoPopulate.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/picklist/autopopulate
**Body**
See above.
**Example Response**

```
{
    "tabattributes": {
        "124010204": "KCE-FJA-2",
        "529930361": null,
        "124010203": "NCX-1000 FDI Protected",
        "124010202": "ADC",
        "124010201": "CABINET",
        "529930269": "KCE-FJA-2",
        "529930268": "NCX-1000 FDI Protected",
        "529930267": "ADC",
        "529930266": "CABINET",
        "124010504": "KCE-FJA-2",
        "124010503": "NCX-1000 FDI Protected",
        "124010502": "ADC",
        "124010501": "CABINET",
        "529930362": null,
        "529930363": null
    }
}

```

# TranslatePicklistValues
The API is used to translate attribute values to their presentation values retrieved from picklist/foreign/domain tables in bulk. Accepts a list of:
  * TANO, key value
  * TANO, key value, filter attribute values (array of (ANO, value) pairs)

Returns a list of translated values, in the same order as in request.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TranslatePicklistValues.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/picklist/translate`
**Body**
Body contains a single property named items, which is a dictionary. Each key of this dictionary is user reference of attribute to match the one in response. Value is an object containing G3E_TANO, key value and filtering attributes.
Attribute _keyvalue_ can contain a string or numeric value.
_Example_

```
{
  "items": {
    "ref1": {
      "tano": 310010003,
      "keyvalue": "309"
    },
    "ref2": {
      "tano": 627010002,
      "attributes": {
        "164660021": "622",
        "164660004": "1"
      }
    },
    "ref3": {
      "tano": 62701000,
      "keyvalue": "103"
    },
    "ref4": {
      "tano": 627010002,
      "keyvalue": "11111s1"
    }
  }
}

```

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TranslatePicklistValues.html#response)
Contains dictionary with translated values (if `value` property is populated) or error codes (in `error` property). Keys match the ones from request body.
### Error codes[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TranslatePicklistValues.html#error-codes)  
| Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| ERR_INVALID_TANO  | Invalid G3E_TANO value.  |  
| ERR_NO_ROWS_FOUND  | Query returned 0 rows for given input parameters.  |  
| ERR_TRANSLATION_FAILED  | Query failed. This is usually caused by wrong metadata or database state.  |  
## Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TranslatePicklistValues.html#example)
**Example Request**
http://machinename/fds/picklist/tabattribute/2300?skip=0&count=10
**Body**
See above.
**Example Response**

```
{
  "values": {
    "ref1": {
      "value": "Electric (Foreign)"
    },
    "ref2": {
      "value": "104"
    },
    "ref3": {
      "error": "ERR_INVALID_TANO"
    },
    "ref4": {
      "error": "ERR_TRANSLATION_FAILED"
    }
  }
}

```
