# Query Feature Data
## Edit Feature Data[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data.html#edit-feature-data)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}?[{oDataOptions}][& BBOX={left,bottom,right,top}][&FilterSet={filterSetId}][&MeasureFeatures={true or false}][&MeasureOnCurvedEarth={true or false}][& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Features-By-Filter)  | Returns the requested feature data for the specified feature type that matches the optional OData filter options and bounding box.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}?[{oDataOptions}][& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Feature-By-Fid)  | Returns the requested feature data for the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}/{componentName}[/{cid}]?[{oDataOptions}][& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Feature-Component)  | Returns the requested component for the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value, and G3E_CID if component is repeating.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}/{componentName}[/{cid}]/{attributeName}[/$value]?[& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Feature-Component-Attribute)  | Returns the requested component attribute for the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value, and G3E_CID if component is repeating.  |

# Feature Model Service
The HxGN NetWorks Feature Model Service provides API for querying HxGN NetWorks Core data and metadata and editing HxGN NetWorks Core features.
## Get Feature Data[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service.html#get-feature-data)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}?[{oDataOptions}][& BBOX={left,bottom,right,top}][&FilterSet={filterSetId}][&MeasureFeatures={true or false}][&MeasureOnCurvedEarth={true or false}][& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Features-By-Filter)  | Returns the requested feature data for the specified feature type that matches the optional OData filter options and bounding box.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}?[{oDataOptions}][& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Feature-By-Fid)  | Returns the requested feature data for the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}/{componentName}[/{cid}]?[{oDataOptions}][& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Feature-Component)  | Returns the requested component for the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value, and G3E_CID if component is repeating.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}/{componentName}[/{cid}]/{attributeName}[/$value]?[& Jobs={list of job names} or ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Query-Feature-Data/Get-Feature-Component-Attribute)  | Returns the requested component attribute for the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value, and G3E_CID if component is repeating.  |  
## Edit Feature Data[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service.html#edit-feature-data)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| POST  | [/data/{featureName}?[{oDataOptions}][& ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Edit-Feature-Data/Insert-a-New-Feature)  | Returns a new instance of the specified feature type.  |  
| PUT  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}?[{oDataOptions}][& ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Edit-Feature-Data/Update-Existing-Feature)  | Updates the specified feature instance that matches the specified G3E_FID value and returns the requested feature information.  |  
| DELETE  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}?[ ActiveJob={job name}]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Edit-Feature-Data/Delete-Feature)  | Deletes the specified feature instance.  |  
| DELETE  | [/data/{featureName}/{fid}/{componentName}/{cid}?[ ActiveJob={job name} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Edit-Feature-Data/Delete-a-Repeating-Component)  | Deletes the specified component instance from the specified feature.  |  
## Get Model Metadata for Features[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service.html#get-model-metadata-for-features)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/metadata/modelfeatures[/{filter}]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/Model-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Model-Features)  | Returns metadata about the feature types in the published feature model.  |  
| GET  | [/metadata/modelfeature/{fno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service/Model-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Model-Feature-by-Fno.html)  | Returns metadata about the specific feature type.  |  
## Get General Metadata for Features[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service.html#get-general-metadata-for-features)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/metadata/features[/{filter}]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Feature-Model-Service/General-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Features)  | Returns metadata about the HxGN NetWorks Core feature types.  |  
| GET  | [/metadata/feature/{fno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service/General-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Feature-by-Fno.html)  | Returns metadata about the specific HxGN NetWorks Core feature type.  |  
| GET  | [/metadata/component/{cno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service/General-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Component-by-Cno.html)  | Returns metadata about the specific HxGN NetWorks Core component type.  |  
| GET  | [/metadata/relationship/{rno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service/General-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Relationship-by-Rno.html)  | Returns metadata about the specific HxGN NetWorks Core relationship type.  |  
| GET  | [/metadata/attribute/{ano}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Model-Service/General-Feature-Metadata/Get-Metadata-for-Attribute-by-Ano.html)  | Returns metadata about the specific HxGN NetWorks Core attribute type.  |

# Feature-Transaction-Service

# GetJobAsWorkset
Retrieve pending edits from a job and return them in the format of a serialized workset.
##### Note
The workset contains complete list of components of the features created or edited in the job, including component instances, which were not changed. This is designed to support offline workflows.
## Internal workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#internal-workflow)
  * Read job attributes from database.
  * Get pending edits for job.
  * Serialize job attributes to workset.
  * Create list distinct of FNO/FID pairs.
  * For each feature in list: 
    * Read component data from database.
    * Map [feature data to workset transactions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#feature-data-mapping).

### Feature data mapping[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#feature-data-mapping)
  * For each feature create `UpdateFeature` transaction with new `fref`.
  * For each component row create `UpdateComponent` transaction. Write attributes from the component.
  * Deleted features (i.e. features with no component instance) and deleted components are not mapped.

## Limitations[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#limitations)
  * Relationships (including detail/schematic) are not supported yet.

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/workset/job?jobs={jobs}[&lcid={lcid}&gf={gf}&resolution={resolution}&dims={dims}]`
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| jobs  | String  | Y  | Job identifier. Exactly one job identifier must be specified.  |  
| lcid  | String  |   | LCID to use when retrieving metadata. When not present, the default LCID is used – explicitly configured LCID in service settings or the current culture of the process if no LCID is configured.  |  
| gf  | String  |   | Geometry format. Allowed values: `networksjson`, `geojson`, `wkt` (default).  |  
| resolution  | Double  |   | Resolution (ground units per display unit) to use when retrieving geometries. When present, arc geometries are stroked.  |  
| dims  | Integer  |   | Geometry dimensions to retrieve. Allowed values: `2`, `3`.  |  
## Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#request-body)
Request body is ignored.
## Response body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#response-body)
Instance of [Workset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#workset).
### Workset[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#workset)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| status  | Number  | Y  | Workset status. Always set to `0` (OPEN).  |  
| refvalue  | Number  | Y  | Next available `fref` for workset.  |  
| attributes  | Object  |   | Job property values encoded as JSON object.   
  
The property key is the attribute field name in uppercase. LTT key attributes (G3E_ID, G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, G3D_CID) are ignored even if present.  
  
The property value is the attribute value.  
  
See [Attribute value encoding](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html).  |  
| transactions  | Array of [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction)  | Y  | List of feature components as transactions.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#normal-response-200)
Workset with features created or modified by the job.
### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#bad-request-400)
Returned when any of the input parameters is invalid.
### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.

## ProcessTransactions

# Attribute value encoding
Attribute data types and their encoding in requests and responses:
## string[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html#string)
Encoded as JSON string value.

```
{ 
  "TEXT": "Example text 1" 
}

```

## number[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html#number)
Encoded as JSON number, with . as decimal separator. Both integer and double values are supported.

```
{ 
  "LENGTH": 12.56 
}

```

## datetime[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html#datetime)
Wrapped in a JSON object with single `"d"` property containing string value in ISO 8601 format.

```
{ 
  "LAST_CLEANING_DT": { 
    "d": "2020-01-02T15:46:22"
  } 
}

```

## geometry[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html#geometry)
Wrapped in a JSON object with single `"wkt"`, `"networksjson"` or `"geojson"` property which contains a WKT string representation of the geometry, JSON representation of the NetWorks geometry format or GeoJSON respectively.
See [Geometry serialization](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Geometry-serialization.html) for details.

```
{
  "G3E_GEOMETRY": {
    "wkt": "POINT M (4501991.49 5925480.29 1570000)"
  }
}

```

```
{
  "G3E_GEOMETRY": {
    "networksjson": {
      "type": "OrientedPoint",
      "origin": [4501991.49, 5925480.29, 3],
      "orientation": [0, 1, 0]
  }
}

```

## file[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html#file)
Wrapped in a JSON object with single `"f"` property which contains the relative path to the file within the transaction.
_Note_
Feature Transaction Service performs transformation of the incoming value (see [Hyperlink mapping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html), but does not copy or move the physical file. This is done by Work Service as [post-processing](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features/Post-processing.html) after the ProcessTransactions completes.

```
{
  "ATTACHMENT_HL": {
    "f": "photo1.jpg"
  }
}

```

## binary[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html#binary)
Wrapped in a JSON object with single `"b"` property containing string value with Base64 encoding.

```
{
  "INTERFACE": {
    "b": "dGVzdA=="
  }
}

```

# Hyperlink mapping
File references in `CreateComponent`, `UpdateComponent` transactions are transformed before inserting or updating data in database. The purpose of this step is to transform the relative path to a file within transaction to attribute value and also to a physical path (which may be different). The transformed physical path is returned in response of the [ProcessTransactions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html) request in links property of the attribute.
Hyperlink transformation uses the following configuration parameters in table [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html):
  * HyperlinkFilter
  * HyperlinkPathTemplate
  * HyperlinkValueTemplate

All file references (`"f"` attributes), which pass regular expression defined in `HyperlinkFilter` are transformed. If `HyperlinkFilter` is empty, all files references are processed.
`HyperlinkValueTemplate` is the template for attribute value. If not specified, the source value is copied without modification.
Secondary link is constructed using `HyperlinkPathTemplate`. This value is not stored in database. It is returned in the response to the caller in the links property of the transaction. The caller is expected to use this value to perform a physical file operation with the file.
Hyperlink templates are strings which may contain placeholders. Placeholders are enclosed in curly brackets `{}`. Each placeholder has a source, optional format string separated by `:` and zero or more processing instructions, separated by `|`.
Placeholder format:

```
{source}
{source:format}
{source|processing}
{source:format|processing1|processing2|…|processingN}

```

## Available placeholders[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html#available-placeholders)  
| Source  | Data type  | Processing  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| value  | string  | Original value of the hyperlink.  |  
| fid  | number  | G3E_FID of the current feature  |  
| fno  | number  | G3E_FNO of the current feature  |  
| cid  | number  | G3E_FID of the current component instance  |  
| cno  | number  | G3E_FNO of the current component instance  |  
| date  | datetime  | Current date and time.  |  
| job  | string  | Current job identifier.  |  
| uid  | string  | Unique identifier, 32 character long.  |  
## Formatting[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html#formatting)
For formatting numeric values, see .NET numeric format strings ([documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/standard-numeric-format-strings)). For formatting date and time values, see .NET date and time format strings ([documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/custom-date-and-time-format-strings)).
## Processing instructions[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html#processing-instructions)  
| Instruction  | Processing  |  
| --- | --- |  
| substr(start,length)  | Substring, starting at index start (0-based), length characters long.  |  
| file  | Returns file name without path.  |  
| filename  | Returns file name without path and extension.  |  
| fileext  | Returns file extension.  |  
| filepath  | Returns file path.  |  
## Example 1 – HyperlinkFilter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html#example-1--hyperlinkfilter)
Regular expression to match any file path except for those starting with `http://`, `https://` or `file://`

```
^(?!(?:file|https?)[:]\/\/.*$).*

```

## Example 2 – HyperlinkValueTemplate or HyperlinkPathTemplate[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html#example-2--hyperlinkvaluetemplate-or-hyperlinkpathtemplate)

```
%ATTACHMENTS%\{date:yyyy}\{date:MM}\{uid|substr(0,2)}\{uid|substr(2,2)}\{uid}\{fid:0000000000}-{fno}\{cno}-{cid}\{value|file}

```

With context values:
  * file reference `attachment1.pdf`
  * date `2020-01-02`
  * unique id `01234567890123456789012345678901`
  * FNO,FID,CNO,CID = `999,25252,456,1`

Is translated to:

```
%ATTACHMENTS%\2020\01\01\23\01234567890123456789012345678901/0000025252-999/456-1/attachment1.pdf

```

# Internal workflow
## Feature CRUD[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Internal-workflow.html#feature-crud)
Feature CRUD transactions are executed in the order specified in the request. It is therefore important that transactions which establish context (`CreateFeature`, `UpdateFeature`, `CreateDetail`, `UpdateDetail`) precede those which reference given feature or detail window.  
| Transaction  | Processing  |  
| --- | --- |  
| CreateFeature  | * Generate G3E_FID from database.  
* Initialize internal mapping (fref -> G3E_FID).  |  
| UpdateFeature  | * Initialize internal mapping (fref -> G3E_FID).  |  
| DeleteFeature  | * Initialize internal mapping (fref -> G3E_FID).  
* Mark given (G3E_FNO, G3E_FID) pair for deletion.  |  
| CreateDetail  | * Generate G3E_DETAILID from database (if not explicitly specified in request).  
* Initialize internal mapping (dref -> G3E_DETAILID).  |  
| UpdateDetail  | * Initialize internal mapping (dref -> G3E_DETAILID).  |  
| CreateComponent  | * When editing, load existing component instances from database.  
* Add new component instance.  
* Determine new G3E_CID (as maximum + 1)  
* Set attribute values from request.  
* Set G3E_DETAILID (if requested)  |  
| UpdateComponent  | * Load existing component instances from database.  
* Find component instance by G3E_CID.  
* Set attribute values from request.  
* Set G3E_DETAILID (if requested)  |  
| DeleteComponent  | * Load existing component instances from database.  
* Find component instance by G3E_CID.  
* Mark component for deletion.  |  
| AttachDetail  | * Determine detail attribute component from metadata.  
* Create new detail attribute component instance (if it does not exist) or find existing component instance (using componenttref)  
* Compute detail MBR from data in request.  
* Perform configuration to storage coordinate transformation.  
* Set detail reference attributes (from referenced CreateDetail or UpdateDetail).  |  
| DetachDetail  | * Determine detail attribute component from metadata.  
* Create new detail attribute component instance (if it does not exist) or find existing component instance (using componenttref)  
* Remove G3E_DETAILID (set to NULL)  |  
## Functional interfaces[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Internal-workflow.html#functional-interfaces)
Feature Transaction Service is not binary-compatible with original G3E.exe model, therefore it does not support direct execution of Functional and other interfaces. Some built-in interfaces are reimplemented for the FTS model and executed:
  * PFIFace.SetSubsettingAttribute Computes regional subsetting region from feature geometry and sets the subsetting attribute.

## Serialize model to database transactions[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Internal-workflow.html#serialize-model-to-database-transactions)
The cumulative updates done to the feature object model in memory are executed as individual DELETE, UPDATE or INSERT statements to the database. Multiple updates to the same component by more than one transaction result in only one command.
The logic in pseudo-code:

```
For each feature in current transaction:
    If (feature is marked for deletion)
        For each component (order by G3E_DELETEORDINAL)
           Delete all instances 
    Else
        For each component (order by G3E_DELETEORDINAL) 
            If "deleted"
                DELETE
        For each component (order by G3E_INSERTORDINAL)
            If "updated"
                UPDATE (updated attributes)
            If "inserted"
                INSERT (attributes with explicitly set values)

```

## Relationships[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Internal-workflow.html#relationships)
Relationship processing in FTS matches logic implemented by Relationship Manager in HxGN NetWorks Core.
**EstablishRelationship** transaction processing:
**Ownership**
  * Create support component in parent (if needed).
  * Get G3E_ID of parent component (this involves a database request).
  * Create support component in child (if needed).
  * Set owner ID field in child.

**Many-Ownership**
  * Create support component in parent (if needed).
  * Verify that parent is not already among existing parents in child support component.
  * Create support component in child (if needed).
  * Set owner in child component.

**Node-Edge Connectivity**
  * Create support component in active feature (if needed).
  * Create support component in related feature (if needed).
  * Find node IDs for both features.
  * Determine new node ID 
    * If both are NULL or 0, generate new ID from sequence in database.
    * If node ID of active feature is empty, use ID of related feature.
    * If both IDs are populated, use node ID of related feature.
  * Set corresponding node attributes.

**Node-Ordered Connectivity**
  * Determine Linear feature from Active and Related feature.
  * Create support component in Linear feature (if needed).
  * Update corresponding FNO and FID fields.

**DeleteRelationship** transaction processing:
**Ownership**
  * Get support component in parent (if needed).
  * Get G3E_ID of parent component.
  * Get support component in child (if needed).
  * Check if relationship exists.
  * Set child owner ID to NULL.

**Many-Ownership**
  * Get support component in child (if needed).
  * Find related component instance with related parent feature.
  * Delete component instance in child.

**Node-Edge Connectivity**
  * Get list of related features of active feature.
  * Get list of related features of related feature.
  * Get support component in active feature.
  * Get support component in related feature.
  * Set corresponding nodes (see table below).

**Node-Ordered Connectivity**
  * Determine Linear feature from Active and Related feature.
  * Get support component in Linear feature (if needed).
  * Find related (non-Linear) feature row.
  * Update corresponding FNO and FID fields to NULL.

**Node-Edge connectivity** delete logic
A = Active feature R = related feature  
| Active nodes of FNO  | Related nodes of FNO  | Active node ID occurrences  | Related node ID occurrences  | Actions (nodes set to NULL)  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| 1  | 1  | 1  | 1  | A(1), A(2), R(1), R(2)  |  
| 1  | 1  | 1  | M  | A(1), A(2)  |  
| 1  | 1  | M  | 1  | R(1), R(2)  |  
| 1  | 1  | M  | M  | A(1), A(2)  |  
| 1  | 2  | 1  | 1  | R(node)  |  
| 1  | 2  | 1  | M  | A(1), A(2)  |  
| 1  | 2  | M  | 1  | R(node)  |  
| 1  | 2  | M  | M  | R(node)  |  
| 2  | 1  | 1  | 1  | A(node)  |  
| 2  | 1  | 1  | M  | A(node)  |  
| 2  | 1  | M  | 1  | R(1), R(2)  |  
| 2  | 1  | M  | M  | A(node)  |  
| 2  | 2  | 1  | 1  | A(node), R(related node)  |  
| 2  | 2  | 1  | M  | A(node)  |  
| 2  | 2  | M  | 1  | R(related node)  |  
| 2  | 2  | M  | M  | R(related node)  |

# PL SQL extensibility
[ProcessTransactions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html) supports extensibility by calling configurable PL/SQL procedures after start and before end of transaction processing.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/PL-SQL-extensibility.html#workflow)
  * Begin database transaction.
  * Execute `DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_CLIENT_INFO` (only if [parameter](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) `FTS_Application_ClientInfo` is configured and non-empty).
  * Execute procedure configured in parameter `FTS_ProcessTransactions_PreProcess` (if configured).
  * ..._perform transaction processing_...
  * Execute procedure configured in parameter `FTS_ProcessTransactions_PostProcess` (if configured).
  * Execute `DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.SET_CLIENT_INFO (NULL)` (only if [parameter](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) `FTS_Application_ClientInfo` is configured and non-empty).
  * Commit database transaction.

## G3E_WORKOPERATIONSPOSTPROCESS[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/PL-SQL-extensibility.html#g3e_workoperationspostprocess)
##### Note
Feature Transaction Service does **not** execute procedure `G3E_WORKOPERATIONSPOSTPROCESS` directly. This procedure is a private API, not accessible to users which are not the schema owner. To run the procedure, wrap it in procedure or package and include it in post-processing via `FTS_ProcessTransactions_PostProcess` parameter.
## Usage Notes[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/PL-SQL-extensibility.html#usage-notes)
Customization procedures can examine the client info using `DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.READ_CLIENT_INFO` to detect execution in the [ProcessTransactions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html) context.
Triggers on component tables can track changed records in a package state and perform necessary post-processing in the procedure configured in `FTS_ProcessTransactions_PostProcess` parameter.
## See also[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/PL-SQL-extensibility.html#see-also)
  * [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html)

# ProcessTransactions
Synchronously processes CUD transactions on feature data. The transactions are processed in a job specified in parameters or outside of a job context (STT mode), if not job was specified. The result of the transaction is returned in output. It includes newly created identifiers (e.g. G3E_FID, G3E_CID, G3E_DETAILID), mapped to temporary identifiers in the request.
See also:
  * [Internal workflow](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Internal-workflow.html) for details on processing.
  * [Hyperlink mapping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Hyperlink-mapping.html)
  * [PL SQL extensibility](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/PL-SQL-extensibility.html)
  * [Map user properties to attributes](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Dialog-Web-Services/Map-user-properties-to-attributes.html)

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/transaction[?jobs={jobs}&lcid={lcid}]`
**Query params**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| jobs  | String  |   | Job identifier. When not present, the transaction is executed without a job context.  |  
| lcid  | String  |   | LCID to use when retrieving metadata. When not present, the default LCID is used – explicitly configured LCID in service settings or the current culture of the process if no LCID is configured.  |  
## Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#request-body)
Instance of [ProcessTransactionRequest](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#processtransactionrequest).
### ProcessTransactionRequest[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#processtransactionrequest)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| transactions  | Array of [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction)  | Y  | List of transactions to process.  |  
### Transaction[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| type  | String  | Y  | Type of the transaction  |  
| tref  | Int  |   | Transaction reference. The value is copied to the corresponding element in the output, to be used by the caller to correlate transaction entries in request and response. Not used internally by the transaction processing.  |  
Allowed transaction types:  
| Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| CreateFeature  | Create a new feature.  |  
| UpdateFeature  | Update an existing feature.  |  
| DeleteFeature  | Delete an existing feature completely.  |  
| CreateComponent  | Create a component instance in a newly created or existing feature instance.  |  
| UpdateComponent  | Update a component instance in an existing feature instance.  |  
| DeleteComponent  | Delete a component instance in an existing feature instance.  |  
| EstablishRelationship  | Establish a relationship between two features. Any of the features can be new or already exist in the database.  |  
| DeleteRelatioship  | Delete relationship between two features. The relationship must already exist.  |  
| CreateDetail  | Create a new detail window (G3E_DETAILID).  |  
| UpdateDetail  | Update an existing detail window (identified by G3E_DETAILID).  |  
| AttachDetail  | Attach a detail window to detail attribute component of a feature.  |  
| DetachDetail  | Detach a detail window from detail attribute component of a feature.  |  
A _CreateFeature_ or _UpdateFeature_ record is needed when updating feature attributes, creating or deleting components or establishing/deleting relationships (for features on both sides of the relationship).
### FeatureTransactionBase[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#featuretransactionbase)
Derived from [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction). The type attribute must match one of the following:
  * CreateFeature
  * UpdateFeature
  * DeleteFeature

  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| fref  | int  | Y  | Feature reference. The value identifies this feature in other transactions in the request. This mechanism enables referencing feature instances before their G3E_FID is available.  
The actual value has no meaning outside of the context of this request.  |  
| G3E_FNO  | Int  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |  
| G3E_FID  | Int  | (Y)  | G3E_FID. For _CreateFeature_ the value must not be present, for others it is mandatory.  |  
| offline  | boolean  |   | When `true`, the all components of the feature are included in the workset, to signalize clients that no more data needs to be loaded when editing the feature. This property is ignored by the API.  |  
### ComponentTransactionBase[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#componenttransactionbase)
Derived from [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction). The type attribute must match one of the following:
**CreateComponent** creates a new component instance in related feature and sets its attributes. For non-repeating components of a feature, it behaves like Create-or-Update (if G3E_CID is not specified). If G3E_CID is specified, it must not match any existing row. For repeating components, a new row is always created.
**UpdateComponent** updates attributes of a component instance. For non-repeating components of a feature, it behaves like Create-or-Update (if G3E_CID is not specified). If G3E_CID is specified, it must match an existing row. For repeating components, G3E_CID is mandatory.
**DeleteComponent** deletes a component instance. G3E_CID is mandatory.  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| fref  | Int  | Y  | Feature reference. References fref in a CreateFeature or UpdateFeature record which preceeds this transaction.  |  
| G3E_CNO  | Int  | Y  | G3E_CNO  |  
| G3E_CID  | Int  | (Y)  | G3E_CID. For CreateComponent the value is optional, for UpdateComponent it is mandatory only for repeating components, for DeleteComponent it is mandatory.  |  
| dref  | Int  |   | Detail (schematic) window reference. Identifies a CreateDetail or UpdateDetail transaction which precedes this transaction.  
  
When populated, G3E_DETAILID from the detail transaction is written into this component instance.  |  
| attributes  | object  |   | Attribute values encoded as JSON object.   
  
The property key is the attribute field name in uppercase. LTT key attributes (G3E_ID, G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO, G3D_CID) are ignored even if present.  
  
The property value is the attribute value.  
  
See [Attribute value encoding](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html).  |  
### RelationshipTransactionBase[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#relationshiptransactionbase)
Derived from [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction). The type attribute must match one of the following:
  * EstablishRelationship
  * DeleteRelationship

  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| fref  | Int  | Y  | Feature reference of the active feature. References fref in a CreateFeature or UpdateFeature record which preceeds this transaction.  |  
| node  | Int  |   | Logical node (0, 1 or 2) on the active feature. Mandatory only for selected relationships.  
  
_Ownership_  
  
For Child-Parent direction, identifies primary (1) or secondary (2) owner. If not present, primary is assumed.  
  
_Node-Edge Connectivity_  
  
Node1 or Node2 of the feature.  |  
| relatedfref  | Int  | Y  | Feature reference of the related feature. References fref in a CreateFeature or UpdateFeature record which preceeds this transaction.  |  
| relatednode  | Int  |   | Logical node (0, 1 or 2) on the related feature. Mandatory only for selected relationships.  
  
_Ownership_  
  
For Parent-Child direction, identifies primary (1) or secondary (2) owner in the child. If not present, primary is assumed.  
  
_Node-Edge Connectivity_  
  
Node1 or Node2 of the feature.  |  
| G3E_RNO  | Int  | Y  | G3E_RNO of the relationship.  |  
| attributes  | Object  |   | Attribute values encoded as JSON object. The attribute values are written to the relationship support component of the active feature.  
  
For Node-Ordered Connectivity, the attributes are written to the linear feature regardless of if it’s active or related.  
  
See [Attribute value encoding](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions/Attribute-value-encoding.html).  |  
### DetailTransactionBase[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#detailtransactionbase)
Derived from [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction). The type attribute must match one of the following:
**CreateDetail** transaction creates a new detail window reference. Technically this only means that a new G3E_DETAILID is generated. Subsequent AttachDetail command must be received to attach this G3E_DETAILID to a detail attribute component of a feature. CreateDetail allows explicit G3E_DETAILID to be passed in. Newly created G3E_DETAILID is reported in response.
**UpdateDetail** does the same as CreateDetail, except for that it requires G3E_DETAILID to be passed in. Alternatively, it can be retrieved from other CreateDetail or UpdateDetail within the same transaction if multiple detail references to the same G3E_DETAILID need to be created (with different attributes).  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| dref  | Int  | Y  | Detail (schematic) window reference. The value identifies this detail window in other transactions in the request. This mechanism enables referencing detail windows before their G3E_DETAILID is available.  |  
| G3E_DETAILID  | Int  |   | G3E_DETAILID – identifier of the detail window. When processing a CreateDetail window, this value is optional. If missing, a new value is generated from the database.  |  
| relateddref  | Int  |   | Detail transaction reference. When this property is populated, it must contain a valid dref in this transaction, which resolves to a valid G3E_DETAILID.  
  
The design goal of this property is to allow the caller to create multiple references to the same detail window (identified by G3E_DETAILID) with possibly different attributes.  |  
| attributes  | object  |   | Detail window attribute values encoded as JSON object. The encoding is the same is in CreateComponent. See Detail window attributes (below) for a list of allowed attribute names.  |  
**Detail window attributes**
The attributes names used in the request are fixed. They're mapped to attributes in the model using metadata. All attributes are optional. AttachDetail only writes the provided attributes to the detail attribute component. Completeness and validity of the data is the responsibility of the client.  
| Name  | Type  | Attribute  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| USERNAME  | String  | G3E_USERNAMEANO  | Detail window user name.  |  
| LEGEND  | Int  | G3E_LEGENDSETT-INGSNUMBERANO  | Legend settings number.  |  
| MBRXLO  | double  | G3E_DETAILMBRXLOANO  | XLO of the MBR. See also MBR attribute.  |  
| MBRYLO  | double  | G3E_DETAILMBRYLOANO  | YLO of the MBR. See also MBR attribute.  |  
| MBRXHI  | double  | G3E_DETAILMBRXHIGHANO  | XHI of the MBR. See also MBR attribute.  |  
| MBRYHI  | double  | G3E_DETAILMBRYHIGHANO  | YHI of the MBR. See also MBR attribute.  |  
| MBR  | Geometry  | G3E_DETAILMBRXLOANO  
  
G3E_DETAILMBRYLOANO  
  
G3E_DETAILMBRXHIGHANO  
  
G3E_DETAILMBRYHIGHANO  | Alternative way of passing the detail MBR as a geometry.  
  
AttachDetail computes the MBR of the geometry passed in (any type) and stores the geometry MBR in the detail window attributes.  |  
| DETAILTYPE  | Int  | G3E_DETAILTYPEANO  | Detail type.  |  
| LOCATION  | String  | G3E_LOCATIONANO  | Location.  |  
### DetailReferenceTransactionBase[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#detailreferencetransactionbase)
Derived from [Transaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#transaction). The type attribute must match one of the following:
  * AttachDetail
  * DetachDetail

**AttachDetail** transaction attaches a detail window to a detail attribute component of a feature. If there is more than one component which can store detail attribute reference, a related component transaction (CreateComponent or UpdateComponent) must be referenced to properly identify the G3E_CNO, and for repeating components, also G3E_CID. If the component is not repeating, the transaction creates instance of the detail attribute component and updates its attributes. If the component is repeating and does not exist yet, a new component instance is created. If it necessary to create or update a specific instance, issue a CreateComponent or UpdateComponent transaction before AttachDetail and reference it using _componenttref_.
**DetachDetail** detaches the G3E_DETAILID from the detail attribute component of the instance. The transaction looks for G3E_DETAILID in detail attribute records and sets the attribute to NULL if it matches. If componenttref is populated, G3E_DETAILID is only removed when both G3E_CNO, G3E_CID and G3E_DETAILID match. This way it’s possible to selectively remove a detail from a feature.  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| fref  | Int  | Y  | Feature reference. References fref in a CreateFeature or UpdateFeature record which preceeds this transaction.  |  
| dref  | Int  | Y  | Detail (schematic) window reference. Identifies a CreateDetail or UpdateDetail transaction which precedes this transaction.  |  
| componenttref  | Int  |   | Component transaction reference. When this property is populated, it must contain a valid tref in this transaction, which identifies a CreateComponent or UpdateComponent transaction which precedes this transaction.  
  
AttachDetail or UpdateDetail uses G3E_CNO and G3E_CID values to precisely identify the component instance to update.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#response)
The response contains a list of transactions in the same structure as the request, except:
  * property `tref` is the same as in the request object. This enables matching transaction records in request and response.
  * `attributes` are not written to the response.
  * newly generated G3E_CID and/or G3E_CID values are present.
  * `errors` property contains a list of errors from validation or processing. If any error is present (with some exceptions, see table), the transactions in the request were not executed and the HTTP status code is 400.
  * `links` property contains mapped hyperlink and file references. `source` property contains the original value passed in the request, `destination` contains the mapped physical path. The file is not copied by Feature Transaction Service, it is the duty of the caller to use source and destination to do the physical file operation.

## Error codes[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html#error-codes)  
| Code  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| ERR_DUPLICATE_FREF  | A single `fref` is used by more than one CreateFeature, UpdateFeature or DeleteFeature transaction.  |  
| ERR_DUPLICATE_FID  | A single G3E_FID is used by more than one CreateFeature, UpdateFeature or DeleteFeature transaction.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_FREF  |  `fref` value is not registered in any CreateFeature, UpdateFeature or DeleteFeature transaction.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_FNO  | G3E_FNO is invalid.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_CNO  | G3E_CNO is invalid.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_FID  | Invalid G3E_FID used for DeleteFeature.  
  
Note: This error code is only a warning and does not cause the request to fail.  |  
| ERR_NO_FID  | G3E_FID is missing.  |  
| ERR_FID_NOT_EXPECTED  | G3E_FID is not expected in CreateFeature transaction.  |  
| ERR_NO_CID  | G3E_CID is missing.  |  
| ERR_ACCESS_DENIED  | User does not have role to execute the operation.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_RELATIONSHIP  | G3E_RNO, G3E_FNO and related G3E_FNO do not have a valid relationship metadata record.  |  
| ERR_CID_ALREADY_EXISTS  | G3E_CID already exists in the component referenced in CreateComponent transaction.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_CNO_FOR_FNO  | Invalid G3E_CNO referenced for a G3E_FNO.  |  
| ERR_DATA_TYPE_MISMATCH  | Attribute data contains invalid value for configured data type.  |  
| ERR_CID_NOT_FOUND  | Row with G3E_CID was not found when trying to update or delete a component.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_RNO  | G3E_RNO is invalid.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_RELATIONSHIP_NODE  | Relationship node identifier of the feature (1 or 2) can’t be processed for this relationship.  |  
| ERR_NO_RELATIONSHIP  | Relationship you're trying to delete does not exist.  |  
| ERR_DB_ERROR  | Error was raised by the database during execution of a DML statement. Check server logs for details.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_TREF  | Referenced `tref` is not registered in any transaction.  |  
| ERR_DUPLICATE_DREF  | A single `dref` is used by more than one CreateDetail or UpdateDetail transaction.  |  
| ERR_INVALID_DREF  |  `dref` is not registered in any CreateDetail or UpdateDetail transaction.  |  
| ERR_NO_DETAIL_REF_CNO  | G3E_CNO of detail attribute reference can’t be determined from provided data or no such G3E_CNO exists.  |  
| ERR_NO_DETAILID  | G3E_DETAILID was not provided.  |

# Feature Transaction Service
Feature Transaction Service provides public web service API for CUD operations over features in HxGN NetWorks database. Its intended consumers are online clients (Portal) and 3rd party applications.
## Feature CRUD[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service.html#feature-crud)  
| Name  | Verb  | Path  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| [ProcessTransactions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/ProcessTransactions.html)  | POST  | /transaction  | Perform CRUD over feature data.  |  
## Job interoperability[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service.html#job-interoperability)  
| Name  | Verb  | Path  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| [GetJobAsWorkset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html)  | POST  | /workset/job  | Get job pending edits as workset.  |

# Fiber-Model-Service

## Data

# Containment
Returns the fiber inner duct connections for a given fiber feature.
The fiber inner ducts returned indicates the following status:
  * Cut or Straight Through.
  * Coupled or Not Coupled.

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Containment.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Containment/{Fno}/{Fid}?Jobs={list of job names}&ActiveJob={job name}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Fno  | Required  | Feature number of the fiber infrastructure feature.  |  
| Fid  | Required  | Feature identifier of the fiber infrastructure feature.  |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional  | Job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional  | Comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |

http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Containment/4200/65

# Feature
Returns feature data for a given fiber feature instance.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Feature.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Feature/{Fno}/{Fid}/{Filter}?Jobs={list of job names}&ActiveJob={job name}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Fno  | Required  | Fiber feature number.  |  
| Fid  | Required  | Fiber feature identifier.  |  
| Filter  | Optional  | Data filter.  |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional  | Job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional  | Comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Feature/7200/21
**Sample Response**

```
[
            {
              ConnectionType: "StraightThrough",
              TotalLength: 53,
              SuperType: "Conductor",
              Fno: 7200,
              Fid: 21,
              IsDefective: false,
              HasGraphics: true,
              Location: "ABCYONXT",
              Type: "Cable",
              Username: "Fiber Cable",
              Description: "Fiber Cable - Position - 21"
            }
          ]

```

## Optional Parameter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Feature.html#optional-parameter)
An optional filter parameter will filter the results only to the given feature number. Use comma delimited string as the filter value (example: "basic,material") when applying more than one filter type.
  * Basic - Returns basic information of the given Fiber feature.
  * Material - Returns material data like bundles, strands, port groups and ports of the given Fiber feature.
  * SpliceConnections - Returns the splice connections data for a given splice bearing Fiber feature.
  * Parent - Returns parent relationship of the given Fiber feature.
  * Child - Returns child relationship of the given Fiber feature.
  * Connectivity - Returns the node-edge or node-ordered connectivity relationship of the given Fiber feature.
  * ContainedBy - Returns the contained by relationship of the given Fiber feature.
  * Container - Returns the container relationship of the given Fiber feature.
  * Relationship - Returns all relationship of the given Fiber feature.
  * All - Returns all the information (basic, material, relationship and splice connections) of the given Fiber feature.

**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Feature/11800/1571/Relationship
**Sample Response**

```
[  
             {  
                InfrastructureType:"Node",
                SuperType:"Enclosure",
                Fno:11800,
                Fid:1571,
                IsDefective:false,
                HasGraphics:true,
                Location:"ABCYONXT",
                Children:[  
                   {  
                      MountingPlateOrdinal:1,
                      MountingPositionOrdinal:1,
                      NumberOfMountingPositionsRequired:1,
                      SuperType:"Enclosure",
                      Fno:12500,
                      Fid:1573,
                      IsDefective:false,
                      HasGraphics:false,
                      Location:"ABCYONXT",
                      Type:"Splice Tray",
                      Username:"Fiber Tray",
                      Description:"Fiber Tray - Plate 1, Position 1 - 1573"
                   }
                ],
                From:[  
                   {  
                      ConnectionType:"StraightThrough",
                      TotalLength:57,
                      SuperType:"Conductor",
                      Fno:7200,
                      Fid:19,
                      IsDefective:false,

                   }

# FeatureEditors
Returns list of feature editors supported for a given fiber feature.
The enumerated values returned are:
  * Custom
  * SpliceConnection
  * ParentChild
  * Containment
  * Connectivity

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/FeatureEditors.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Feature/Editors/{Fno}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Fno  | Required  | Fiber feature number.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Feature/Editors/11800
**Sample Response**

```
[
            "SpliceConnection",
            "ParentChild",
            "Containment"
          ]

```

# Features
Returns list of fiber features along with its type and super type.

**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Features/{Fno}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Fno  | Optional  | Fiber feature number.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Features

```
[
            {
              Fno: 4200,
              Username: "Fiber Branch Enclosure",

              Fno: 4000,
              Username: "Fiber Duct",
              Type: "Duct",
              SuperType: "Infrastructure"
            }
          ]

```

## Optional Parameter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Features.html#optional-parameter)
An optional FNO parameter will filter the results only to the given feature number.

```
[
            {
              Fno: 4200,
              Username: "Fiber Branch Enclosure",
              Type: "Branch Enclosure",
              SuperType: "Infrastructure"
            }
          ]

```

# SpliceConnections
Returns splice connections for a given splice bearing fiber feature along with the details of the connected or owned fiber features.
  * The splice connections returned includes the splice connection attributes.
  * The device ports or conductor strands returned indicates the following status:
  * Connected or Disconnected.
  * Groove Assigned or Unassigned.
  * Only the containers connected to the splice bearing feature are returned for a given conductor.

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/SpliceConnections.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/SpliceConnections/{Fno}/{Fid}?Jobs={list of job names}&ActiveJob={job name}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Fno  | Required  | Feature number of the splice bearing fiber feature.  |  
| Fid  | Required  | Feature identifier of the splice bearing fiber feature.  |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional  | Job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional  | Comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/SpliceConnections/11800/7251
**Sample Response**

```

                {  
                   Ordinal:1,

                      Fno:7200,
                      Cno:0,
                      Fid:7261,
                      Cid:0
                   },
                   ToFeature:{  
                      Fno:7200,
                      Cno:0,
                      Fid:7264,
                      Cid:0
                   },
                   From:1,
                   To:1,
                   Type:"Splice Connection",
                   Attributes:[  
                      {  
                         Name:"CONNECTION_TYPE",

## Optional Parameter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/SpliceConnections.html#optional-parameter)
An optional filter parameter will filter the results thereby reducing the returned payload. Use comma delimited string as the filter value (example: "connections,from") when applying more than one filter type.
  * Connections - Returns splice connections data excluding all relationship data.
  * Children - Returns child relationship data excluding all other relationship and splice connections data.
  * From - Returns the From fiber feature data in a node-ordered connectivity relationship excluding all other relationship and splice connections data.
  * To - Returns the To fiber feature data in a node-ordered connectivity relationship excluding all other relationship and splice connections data.
  * ExcludeAttributes - Excludes all attribute data associated with splice connections, bundles, strands, port groups and ports.

**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/SpliceConnections/11800/7251/Connections

| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Features](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Features.html)  | Returns list of fiber features along with its type and super type.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Feature/{Fno}/{Fid}/{Filter}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Feature.html)  | Returns feature data for a given fiber feature instance.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Feature/Editors/{Fno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/FeatureEditors.html)  | Returns list of feature editors supported for a given fiber feature.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/SpliceConnections/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/SpliceConnections.html)  | Returns splice connections for a given splice bearing fiber feature along with the details of the connected or owned fiber features.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Containment/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Containment.html)  | Returns the fiber inner duct connections for a given fiber feature.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Feature/Graphicalancestor/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/GraphicalAncestor.html)  | Returns the closest graphical ancestor to a given fiber feature.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Path/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Path.html)  | Returns the path for a given fiber conductor, device, link or channel.  |

# FeatureReports
Returns list of reports associated with a given fiber feature.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/FeatureReports.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Report/List/{Fno}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Fno  | Required  | Fiber feature number.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Report/List/7200
**Sample Response**

```
[

              ReportType: "Path",
              Username: "Fiber Path",
              Description: "Determines the path of a fiber conductor (given a fiber strand) or a fiber device (given a fiber port)"

            {

              ReportType: "Usage",
              Username: "Fiber Usage",
              Description: "Determines the usage of a fiber conductor (given a fiber strand) or a fiber device (given a fiber port)"
            }
          ]

```

# GeneratePathReport
Generates the fiber path report that describes the physical connections along a trace, given a starting fiber device port or conductor strand.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/GeneratePathReport.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Report/GeneratePathReport?Jobs={list of job names}&ActiveJob={job name}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional  | Job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional  | Comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
**Post Body Templates**

```
{
	          "StartFeatureFno":7200,
	          "StartFeatureFid":1552,
	          "Low":1,
	          "High":1,
	          "WaveLength":1550
          }

```

**Post Body**  
| Post Body Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| StartFeatureFno  | Fiber feature number of the starting conductor or device.  |  
| StartFeatureFid  | Fiber feature identitifier of the starting conductor or device.  |  
| Low  | Start device port or conductor strand ordinal.  |  
| High  | End device port or conductor strand ordinal.  |  
| OtdrLength  | OTDR length stop criterion value. The marker location computed is along the conductor on which the cumulative length measured is greater than or equal to the stop criterion.  |  
| OtdrLoss  | OTDR loss stop criterion value. The marker location computed is along the conductor on which the cumulative loss measured is greater than or equal to the stop criterion.  |  
| WaveLength  | Wavelength attenuation value. The loss measured is calculated based on the wavelength specified.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Report/GeneratePathReport
**Sample Post Body**

```
{
	          "StartFeatureFno":7200,
	          "StartFeatureFid":1552,
	          "Low":1,
	          "High":1,
	          "WaveLength":1550
          }

```

# GenerateUsageReport
Generates the fiber usage report that describes the usage of a fiber device or conductor.
The output report shows the percentage and actual count of fibers that are In Use, Available, and Unlit.
  * In Use means that the fiber has a light source from a device like a Fiber Patch Panel and is terminated at a customer (for example, Optical Network Unit).
  * Available means the fiber has a light source, but is not terminated at any customer downstream.
  * Unlit means the fiber has no light source.

## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/GenerateUsageReport.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/Fiber/Report/GenerateUsageReport?Jobs={list of job names}&ActiveJob={job name}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| ActiveJob  | Optional  | Job name whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
| Jobs  | Optional  | Comma separated list of jobs whose pending edits will participate in the operation.  |  
**Post Body Templates**

```
{
	          "StartFeatureFno":7200,
	          "StartFeatureFid":29758,
	          "Low":1,
	          "High":10
          }

```

**Post Body**  
| Post Body Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| StartFeatureFno  | Fiber feature number of the starting conductor or device.  |  
| StartFeatureFid  | Fiber feature identitifier of the starting conductor or device.  |  
| Low  | Start device port or conductor strand ordinal.  |  
| High  | End device port or conductor strand ordinal.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksFiberModelService/Fiber/Report/GenerateuUsageReport
**Sample Response**
**Sample Post Body**

```
{
	          "StartFeatureFno":7200,
	          "StartFeatureFid":29758,
	          "Low":1,
	          "High":10
          }

```

# Report

| GET  | [/Fiber/Report/List/{Fno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/FeatureReports.html)  | Returns list of reports associated with a given fiber feature.  |  
| POST  | [/Fiber/Report/GeneratePathReport](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/GeneratePathReport.html)  | Generates the fiber path report that describes the physical connections along a trace, given a starting fiber device port or conductor strand.  |  
| POST  | [/Fiber/Report/GenerateUsageReport](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/GenerateUsageReport.html)  | Returns feature data for a given fiber feature instance.  |

# Fiber Model Service
## Feature[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service.html#feature)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Features](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Features.html)  | Returns list of fiber features along with its type and super type.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Feature/{Fno}/{Fid}/{Filter}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Feature.html)  | Returns feature data for a given fiber feature instance.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Feature/Editors/{Fno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/FeatureEditors.html)  | Returns list of feature editors supported for a given fiber feature.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/SpliceConnections/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/SpliceConnections.html)  | Returns splice connections for a given splice bearing fiber feature along with the details of the connected or owned fiber features.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Containment/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Containment.html)  | Returns the fiber inner duct connections for a given fiber feature.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Feature/GraphicalAncestor/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/GraphicalAncestor.html)  | Returns the closest graphical ancestor to a given fiber feature.  |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Path/{Fno}/{Fid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Data/Path.html)  | Returns the path for a given fiber conductor, device, link or channel.  |  
## Report[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service.html#report)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/Fiber/Report/List/{Fno}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/FeatureReports.html)  | Returns list of reports associated with a given fiber feature.  |  
| POST  | [/Fiber/Report/GeneratePathReport](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/GeneratePathReport.html)  | Generates the fiber path report that describes the physical connections along a trace, given a starting fiber device port or conductor strand.  |  
| POST  | [/Fiber/Report/GenerateUsageReport](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Fiber-Model-Service/Report/GenerateUsageReport.html)  | Generates the fiber usage report that describes the usage of a fiber device or conductor.  |

# Job-Service

# CloseJob
Close the specified job if there are no pending edits.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CloseJob.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/job/{jobId}/close?jobDialogType={jobDialogType}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | Job identifier  |  
| jobDialogType  | Job dialog type identifier, specifying set of properties returned for job.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/job/7120/close
**Sample Response**
Close job with id '7120'.

```

  {
    Identifier: "7120",
    Description: "",
    Owner: "ginius",
    Status: "Closed",
    Properties: []
  }

```

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CloseJob.html#get)
Close the specified job if there are no pending edits and the job is not in use by other users.
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/close/{jobId}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | The job identifier for the job. It must be an exact match to the job identifier in the job table.  |  
| jobDialogType  | Optional. Specifies the value of the G3E_TYPE field from the G3E_DIALOGS_OPTABLE that is used to define which properties are returned in the response. When no jobDialogType parameter is specified, the response will only contain the job identifier, owner, status and description.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/close/16255?jobDialogType=G3E_EDITJOB
**Sample Response**
The properties for the closed job are returned in the response.

# CreateJob
Creates a new job with the specified job id, if specified. The job attributes for specified `jobDialogType` are returned. These attributes can be edited and passed into the EditJob API for updating.
Request body in POST version is optional. If present, it can contain job properties which are set at the time of creation of the job. Only non-readonly parameters for specified `jobDialogType` can be passed in.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CreateJob.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/job/{jobId?}?jobDialogType={jobDialogType}
**Request Parameters**
If no jobId is provided, it is generated by the service.  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | Job identifier  |  
| jobDialogType  | Job dialog type identifier, specifying set of properties returned for job.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/job/userEdits252
**Sample Response**
Create new job with id 'userEdits252'.

```
{
    "Identifier": "userEdits252",
    "Description": "",
    "Owner": "ADMIN",
    "Status": "Open",
    "Properties": []
}

```

**Sample Request with job properties in request body**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/job/userEdits252
Request body

```
{
    "Description": "User XYZ field edits",
    "Properties": [
        {
            "FieldName": "G3E_JOBCLASS",
            "Value": "12"
        }
    ]
}

```

**Sample Response**
Create new job with id 'userEdits252'.

```
{
    "Identifier": "userEdits252",
    "Description": "",
    "Owner": "ADMIN",
    "Status": "Open",
    "Properties": [{
            "FieldName": "G3E_JOBCLASS",
            "UserName": "Job class",
            "Value": "12",
            "DataType": 4,
            "IsReadonly": true,
            "Ano": 7,
            "IsPicklist": true
        },
        {
            "FieldName": "G3E_ID",
            "UserName": "Job ID",
            "Value": "988",
            "DataType": 4,
            "IsReadonly": true,
            "Ano": 5,
            "IsPicklist": false
        }
    ]
}

```

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CreateJob.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/create/{jobId?}
**Request Parameters**
If no jobId is provided, it is generated by the service.  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | Optional. The job identifier for the new job. Job identifiers cannot be reused. They must be unique. If no jobId is specified, then a default job identifier is generated.  |  
| jobDialogType  | Optional. Specifies the value of the G3E_TYPE field from the G3E_DIALOGS_OPTABLE that is used to define which properties are returned in the response. When no jobDialogType parameter is specified, the response will only contain the job identifier, owner, status and description.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/create/16255?jobDialogType=G3E_NEWJOB
**Sample Response**
The properties for the new job are returned in the response. The client can edit this Json job data object and Post the edited Json as the body of a job service Edit request.

# Get Picklist Values
Returns the picklist values for the given attribute number.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Get-Picklist-Values.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/pickListvalues/{ano}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  | Optional  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Ano  | Desired attribute number as string.  | No  |  
| pageNo  | Page Number.  | Yes  |  
| pageSize  | Page Size.  | Yes  |  
| Filter  | Return only values that match this filter.  | Yes  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksJobService/picklistvalues/340014?filter=Proposed&pageNo=1&pageSize=5
**Sample Response**

```
{
    "items": [
        {
            "Key": "Proposed",
            "Value": "Proposed"
        },
        {
            "Key": "Proposed Dist",
            "Value": "Proposed Dist"
        },
        {
            "Key": "Proposed Removed",
            "Value": "Proposed Removed"
        },
        {
            "Key": "Proposed Removed Dist",
            "Value": "Proposed Removed Dist"
        },
        {
            "Key": "Proposed Retired",
            "Value": "Proposed Retired"
        }
    ],
    "totalCount": 7
}

```

**Remarks**
This method supports both pagination and typeahead filtering.
Returns the list of picklist values, in pages honoring the page size, when it is called with pagination parameters.
Returns the list of picklist values starting with the filter parameter value, when it is called with filter parameter.
Here, the picklist values are ordered based on the field 'G3E_ORDERBYKEY'.
Response contains:
'key' is the picklist keyname
'value' is the picklist keyvalue

# GetJobsByFilter
Provides job attribute information for the jobs that match one or more filter parameters.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/GetJobsByFilter.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/jobs?id={id}&owner={owner}&status={status}&description={description}&jobDialogType={jobDialogType}&pageNo={pageNo}&pageSize={pageSize}
**Request Parameters**
Any combination of the filter parameters, id, owner, status and description, can be specified. Requests must include at least one filter. The filter parameter values are used in a wild card match to the values in the corresponding columns in the job table. Multiple filters are AND'ed together in the query for jobs. JobDialogType is not a filtering condition, but it defines set of additional properties returned for each job. PageNo and pageSize are used for paging the result.  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| id  | Job identifier  |  
| owner  | The user identity that created the job.  |  
| status  | Job status (typical values: Open, Closed, Posted, Partially Posted, Discarded).  |  
| description  | A brief description of what the job is about.  |  
| jobDialogType  | Job dialog type identifier, specifying set of properties returned for each job.  |  
| pageNo  | Number of the page for paged result.  |  
| pageSize  | Size of one page for paged result.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/jobs?owner=WMSADMIN&description=Permanent

# GetPendingEdits
Gets the list of pending edits for the specified jobs.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/GetPendingEdits.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/pendingedits/{jobIdList}?v={version}&pageNo={pageNo}&pageSize={pageSize}
**Request Parameters**
A list of information about pending edits (feature name, feature keys and job name) is returned for each of the specified jobs. Parameter 'v' (version) is used to distinguish old (legacy) and current response format. If omitted, v defaults to 0 and therefore legacy format is used. Using version parameter without value causes use of current response format. PageNo and pageSize are used for paging the result.  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobIdList  | A comma separated list of job identifiers. The job identifiers must be an exact match to the job id in the job table.  |  
| v  | Version of response format. 0 - legacy, 1 - current. Default is 0. If used without value, then 1.  |  
| pageNo  | Number of the page for paged result.  |  
| pageSize  | Size of one page for paged result.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/pendingedits/job1,job2?v
**Sample Response**
The list of features that have been edited in job 'job1' followed by the list of features edited in job 'job2' will be returned.
