# Post
Post pending edits for the specified job.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Post.html#post-1)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/job/{jobId}/post?pageNo={pageNo}&pageSize={pageSize}
**Request Parameters**
A list of validation errors is returned for the specified job. Job has to have pending edits. PageNo and pageSize are used for paging the result.  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | Job identifier  |  
| pageNo  | Number of the page for paged result.  |  
| pageSize  | Size of one page for paged result.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/job/j303/post
**Sample Response**
The list of validation errors for job 'j303'.

```
[
    {
        "ErrorDescription": "desc",
        "ErrorLocation": "loc",
        "ErrorPriority": "P4",
        "FeatureKey": {
            "Fno": 202,
            "Cno": 13,
            "Fid": 322769,
            "Cid": 3
        }
    }
]

```

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Post.html#get)
Post all pending edits within the specified job. The edited features will be checked to make sure that all required components, attributes and relationships have been created. Also, the Validate method of all associated Functional interfaces and Validation interfaces will be executed.
If there are no validation errors at or above the metadata configured validation priority, then the job's feature edits will be checked for conflicts with master records of the same features that were posted by other jobs.
If there are no job conflicts, then the HxGN NetWorks Core Job Life Cycle processing occurs (if configured). If the Job Life Cycle processing succeeds, then the feature edits are posted in the database.
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/post/{jobId}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | The job identifier for the job. It must be an exact match to the job identifier in the job table.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/post/WmsTestJob
**Sample Response**
A JSON array of validation error objects is returned. Only the validation errors that are blocking the post operation are returned. For example, if G3E_GeneralParameter_Optable's ValidationPriority value is "P2", then only the P1 and P2 error objects are returned. Each object specifies the feature keys, error priority, error description and error location as follows:

```
// JSON array of validation errors.
[
  { 
    "Fno":<featureNumber>,
    "Fid":<featureId>,
    "Cno":<componentNumber>,
    "Cid":<componentId>,
    "ErrorPriority":<either "P1","P2","P3", or "P4">,
    "ErrorDescription":<error message>,
    "ErrorLocation":<software component that reported error>
  },
  ...
]

```

**Remarks** All pending edits within the specified job are posted to the database. The job remains open.

# Transition Job State
Transition the job to the next job state, or return information about the current state of the job.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Transition-Job-State.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/transitionjobstate/{jobId}/{newState?}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | The job identifier for the job.  |  
| newState  | Optional. Specifies the new state of the job and the new state of all pending edit features in the job whose state matches the current job state. When the newstate parameter is omitted, the response shows the current state of the job and the count of all pending edit features in the job grouped by their current state.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/transitionjobstate/JOBNO33229/UNDER_CONSTRUCTION
**Sample Response** The response shows the job's current state, the set of next states it can transition to, and a list of a count of the pending edit features grouped by their state.

```
{
    "JobId": "JOBNO33229",
    "JobState": "UNDER_CONSTRUCTION",
    "NextStates": [
        "CLOSED"
    ],
    "FeatureCounts": [
        {
            "State": "CLOSED",
            "Count": 1
        },
        {
            "State": "UNDER_CONSTRUCTION",
            "Count": 2
        }
    ]
}

```

# Translate Feature State
Translate specified features to the default next state or the specified next state based on their current state; or return a list of possible next states based on the current state of the features.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Translate-Feature-State.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/translatefeaturestate/{jobid}/{newState?}[? useDefault={true | false} ]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | The job identifier for the job.  |  
| newState  | Optional. Specifies the new state value for the feature state attribute of all input features. If the newstate parameter is omitted and the useDefault query parameter is omitted or false, then the response shows the list of possible next state values based on the current feature state value of the features.  |  
| useDefault  | Optional. Determines whether the default next state in the transitions metadata will be used when the newstate parameter is omitted.  |  
**Post Body Template**

```
// JSON array of objects in POST body
[ { "Fno": fnoValue1, "Fid": fidValue1}, { "Fno": fnoValue2, "Fid": fidValue2}, ... ]

```

**Post Body**  
| Post Body Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Feature List  | Array of feature objects (Fno and Fid).  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/translatefeaturestate/WmsTestJob?useDefault=false
**Sample Post Body**

```
[ { "Fno": 100, "Fid": 3759617},{ "Fno": 326, "Fid": 3747378},{ "Fno": 100, "Fid": 3759633} ]

```

**Sample Response** The response is a list of objects, one for each distinct current state from the set of input Fids. Each object shows the current state, its new state (if a transition was successful), its default next state (if it has one) and the set of next states that can be transitioned to. For example, if the input features are currently in either the "Proposed" or "In Service" feature state, then response would be as follows: (Note: actual progression of feature states is controlled by each customer's metadata).

```
[
    {
        "CurrentState": "Proposed",
        "NewState": "",
        "DefaultNextState": "Constructed",
        "NextStates": [
            "Constructed",
            "Conceptual"
        ]
    },
    {
        "CurrentState": "In Service",
        "NewState": "",
        "DefaultNextState": "Proposed Removed",
        "NextStates": [
            "Proposed Removed",
            "Out of Service",
            "Proposed Retired"
        ]
    }
]

```

Since the set of input features in the Post body doesn't have any common next state value to transition to, no new state value can be specified on the request. However, since all features have a metadata defined default next state value, the request can be sent again with useDefault=true to make each feature transition to its default next state. The example request and response are shown below:
**Sample Request 2**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/translatefeaturestate/WmsTestJob?useDefault=true
**Sample Response 2** Note that each current state transitioned to default next state from the response above and is shown as the NewState. After a successful state transition where NewState has a value, the DefaultNextState and NextStates list show the possible states from the NewState value.

```
[
    {
        "CurrentState": "Proposed",
        "NewState": "Constructed",
        "DefaultNextState": "In Service",
        "NextStates": [
            "In Service",
            "Out of Service"
        ]
    },
    {
        "CurrentState": "In Service",
        "NewState": "Proposed Removed",
        "DefaultNextState": "Operational Removed",
        "NextStates": [
            "Operational Removed",
            "Out of Service",
            "In Service"
        ]
    }
]

```

**Sample Request 3**
Since each of the current states from the previous request had a next state in common (i.e. "Out of Service"), that common state can be specified as the new state value for all the input features.
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/translatefeaturestate/WmsTestJob/Out%20of%20Service?useDefault=false
**Sample Response 3** Note that each current state transitioned to specified next state from the request.

```
[
    {
        "CurrentState": "Constructed",
        "NewState": "Out of Service",
        "DefaultNextState": "In Service",
        "NextStates": [
            "In Service",
            "Proposed Retired",
            "Proposed Removed"
        ]
    },
    {
        "CurrentState": "Proposed Removed",
        "NewState": "Out of Service",
        "DefaultNextState": "In Service",
        "NextStates": [
            "In Service",
            "Proposed Retired",
            "Proposed Removed"
        ]
    }
]

```

# Validate
Validate the specified job's pending edits.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Validate.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/job/{jobId}/validate?pageNo={pageNo}&pageSize={pageSize}
**Request Parameters**
A list of validation errors is returned for the specified job. Job has to have pending edits. PageNo and pageSize are used for paging the result.  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | Job identifier  |  
| pageNo  | Number of the page for paged result.  |  
| pageSize  | Size of one page for paged result.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/job/j8045/validate
**Sample Response**
The list of validation errors for job 'j8045'.

```
[
    {
        "ErrorDescription": "desc",
        "ErrorLocation": "loc",
        "ErrorPriority": "P4",
        "FeatureKey": {
            "Fno": 100,
            "Cno": 31,
            "Fid": 1053890,
            "Cid": 1
        }
    }
]

```

## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Validate.html#get)
Validate all pending edits within the specified job. The edited features will be checked to make sure that all required components, attributes and relationships have been created. Also, the Validate method of all associated Functional interfaces and Validation interfaces will be executed.
**Request URL Template**
http://{HostName}/{JobServiceName}/validate/{jobId}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| jobId  | The job identifier for the job. It must be an exact match to the job identifier in the job table.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://localhost/NetworksJobService/validate/WmsTestJob
**Sample Response**
A JSON array of validation error objects is returned. Each object specifies the feature keys, error priority, error description and error location. The error priority values are P1, P2, P3 and P4 where P1 is the most severe. Only the validation errors whose error priority is higher than the ValidationPriorityFilter value from the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table will be included in the response.

```
// JSON array of validation errors.
[
  { 
    "Fno":<featureNumber>,
    "Fid":<featureId>,
    "Cno":<componentNumber>,
    "Cid":<componentId>,
    "ErrorPriority":<either "P1","P2","P3", or "P4">,
    "ErrorDescription":<error message>,
    "ErrorLocation":<software component that reported error>
  },
  ...
]

```

**Remarks** All pending edits within the specified job are validated. A job cannot be posted if there are any validation errors that are higher than or equal to the ValidationPriorityThreshold value from the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table.

# Job Service
# Job Service API Overview
The HxGN NetWorks Job Service provides methods that allow clients to use HxGN NetWorks Core jobs in their viewing and editing workflows, and to manage jobs. The get jobs by filter, get picklist values and get pending edits workflows require the Networks_UseJobs license feature. All other job service workflows require the Networks_ManageJobs license feature.
# Supported Job Workflows
## Create a new job[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#create-a-new-job)
Call the `/create/{jobId?}` method to create a new HxGN NetWorks Core job. If the job identifier is included in the call, it must be unique among all jobs. If no job identifier is sent to the method, then a new job identifier is generated by concatenating the G3E_JOBDEFINITION.G3E_JOBPREFIX value and the next sequence value from the G3E_JOB_SEQ sequence that is unique.
The JSON response always includes the new job's core properties: identifier, description, owner, and status. The identifier property is the job Id that was passed in or the generated job Id. Description is initially an empty string value; owner is the Oracle user from the request's database connection; and the status property will be set to "Open". When the optional jobDialogType query string parameter is specified, then all of the attributes associated with the specified dialog are appended to the response as a properties collection.
## Close an existing job[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#close-an-existing-job)
Call the `/close/{jobId}` method to close an existing HxGN NetWorks Core job that is no longer needed. The job cannot be closed if there is another user is actively using the job. Also, any pending edits must be either posted or discarded before the job can be closed.
The JSON response always includes the same core properties, identifier, description, owner, and status, that create job returned except that the status value will be set to `"Closed"`. When the optional jobDialogType query string parameter is specified, then all of the attributes associated with the specified dialog are appended to the response as a properties collection.
## Edit a job's properties[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#edit-a-jobs-properties)
Call the /edit method to post updates to a job's properties. Only the Description value and those properties that are marked, "IsReadonly": false, can be edited.
The methods that create jobs, close jobs and get jobs all take a query string parameter that specifies a jobDialogType that describes how to present the job's properties. Clients can take this JSON response, edit the values of the non-readonly properties, and POST the edited payload back to the /edit method. The new job properties response is returned based on the jobDialogType of the `/edit` request.
## Get picklist values for a job property[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#get-picklist-values-for-a-job-property)
Call the `/picklistvalues/{ano}` method to retrieve the key value pairs of possible property values for the specified job attribute number `{ano}`. In the job properties response from create, close, edit and jobs methods, a job property with IsPicklist set to true has a picklist that can be retrieve by using the job property's Ano field.
If the client is going to display the job's properties to the user, then this API supplies the picklist values to display to the user for a specific picklist key. In the display and edit job properties workflow, the picklist values are usually displayed in a drop down combobox that the user selects from.
## Get a filtered list of jobs to work with[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#get-a-filtered-list-of-jobs-to-work-with)
Call the /jobs method with one or more filters to get a list of jobs. Any combination of the filter parameters, which are based on the job's core properties (e.g. id, owner, status and description), can be specified. Requests must include at least one filter. The filter parameter values are used in a wild card match to the values in the corresponding columns in the job table. Multiple filters are AND'ed together in the query for jobs.
Clients call the /jobs method to retrieve information about jobs to present to the users. Most NetWorks Services APIs accept either a Jobs= query parameter, or an `ActiveJob=<active job>` to do edits in. The amount of job information returned is controlled by the jobDialogType query string parameter. Since the number of jobs that match the filter criteria can be large, the method supports pagination of the results via the pageNo and pageSize query string parameters.
## List the pending edits in a job[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#list-the-pending-edits-in-a-job)
Call the `/pendingedits/{jobId}` method to get the complete list of edits within the job. Each pending edit in the response contains the feature name, feature keys, and LTT_STATUS (such as Add, Delete, or Edit.)
Clients can use the jobId and feature keys in a subsequent call to the WMS GetGeometry method to get the GeoJson geometry that can be used to do a client side highlight on the map, or just fitting the map to the edited feature.
## Discard pending edits in a job[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#discard-pending-edits-in-a-job)
Call the `/discard` method to remove all pending edits within a job. Alternatively, the client can call the `/discardbyfid` method with a POST body containing a JSON array of Fids to discard specific feature edits.
## List pending edits that have conflicts[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#list-pending-edits-that-have-conflicts)
Call the `/conflicts` method to determine if any of the pending edits in the job have conflicts with the master version of the same features in the database. A conflict occurs when a feature that has been edited in the current job is also edited by another job that posts its edits first. A job with conflicts cannot be posted.
The `/conflicts` method returns a JSON array of conflicts. Each conflict contains the jobId, feature name, feature keys, LTT_STATUS and the database table that has the conflicting value. There is no further Job Service API for resolving conflicts. Conflict resolution can be done using the G/Designer desktop.
## Validate the pending edits in a job[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#validate-the-pending-edits-in-a-job)
Call `/validate/{jobId}` to check whether the pending edits in the job conform to all of the HxGN NetWorks Core business rules for the structure of the features, components, attributes and relationships; and the custom rules in the Validate methods of the associated functional interfaces.
The response is a JSON array of validation errors where each error contains the feature keys, error priority, error description and error location information. The error priority values are P1, P2, P3 and P4 where P1 is the most severe. Only the validation errors whose error priority is higher than the ValidationPriorityFilter value from the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table will be included in the response. A job cannot be posted if there are any validation errors that are higher than or equal to the ValidationPriorityThreshold value from the G3E_GENERALPARAMETER table.
## Post pending edits[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#post-pending-edits)
Call `/post/{jobId}` to post all pending edits within the specified job. The edited features will be checked to make sure that all required components, attributes and relationships have been created. Also, the Validate method of all associated Functional interfaces will be executed. If there are no validation errors at or above the metadata configured validation priority, then the job's feature edits will be checked for conflicts with master records of the same features that were posted by other jobs. If there are no job conflicts, then the feature edits are posted in the database as the new master version of the feature.
## Transition Job and / or Feature State[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html#transition-job-and--or-feature-state)
HxGN NetWorks Core allows its customers to specify a column on a common component to hold the "state" of the feature. (See G3E_WORKMGMT_OPTABLE where G3E_TYPE='Feature'.) There are two Job Service workflows that manage this "state" of the features.
Call `/transitionjobstate/{jobId}/{newState?}` to transition the state of the job, and the state of all pending edit features whose current state matches the job state, to a specified new state. If no newState value is specified, then the request is treated as a query for the current job state and the states of the pending edits features in the job. This workflow assumes that the set of possible job states is at least a subset of the set of possible feature states.
Call `/translatefeaturestate/{jobId}/{newState?}` to transition the state of a specified set of features to either a default next state or a specified new state. If no newState value is specified, then the request is treated as a query for the current job state, default next state and possible other next states for the set of specified features.
# Methods  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/jobs?id={id}&owner={owner}&status={status}&description={description}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/GetJobsByFilter.html)  | Provides job attribute information for the jobs that match one or more filter parameters.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId?}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CreateJob.html)  | Creates a new job with the specified job id, if specified. The job attributes are returned. These attributes can be edited and passed into the Edit API for updating.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId}/edit](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/EditJob.html)  | Update the specified job's attributes. The job attributes are in the post body.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId}/close](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CloseJob.html)  | Close the specified job if there are no pending edits.  |  
| GET  | [/pendingedits/{jobIdList}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/GetPendingEdits.html)  | Gets the list of pending edits for the specified jobs.  |  
| GET  | [/conflicts/{jobIdList}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/GetConflicts.html)  | Gets the list of conflicts between job edits and master deltas for the specified job.  |  
| GET  | [/picklistvalues](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Get-Picklist-Values.html)  | Returns the picklist values for the given attribute number.  |  
| GET  | [/transitionjobstate/{jobId}/{newState?}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Transition-Job-State.html)  | Transition job to specified state or return information about current state of job.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId}/validate](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Validate.html)  | Validate the specified job's pending edits.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId}/post](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Post.html)  | Post pending edits for the specified job.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId}/discard](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/Discard.html)  | Discard pending edits for the specified job.  |  
| POST  | [/job/{jobId}/discardbyfid](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/DiscardByFids.html)  | Discard pending edits for the specified FIDs for the specified job. The FIDs are specified in the message body.  |  
| POST  | [/translatefeaturestate/{jobId}/{newState?}[? useDefault={true or false} ]](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks/API/Job-Service/Translate-Feature-State)  | Translate specified features to the default next state or the specified next state based on their current state; or return a list of possible next states based on the current state of the features.  |

# Get Area Info by Names
Gets the information for the given area of interests (AOIs).
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Area-Info-by-Names.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/area/{names}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| names  | Required  | Specifies a comma separated list of area of interest (AOI) names.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetWorksMobileDataService/area/SWITCHING CENTRE: PRINCE,SWITCHING CENTRE: KING
**Sample Response**
A JSON response is returned containing the information for the given AOIs.

# Get Area Names
Gets the list of all area of interests (AOIs) configured in the database.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Area-Names.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/area/names
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetWorksMobileDataService/area/names
**Sample Response**
A JSON response is returned containing the list of AOIs.

# Get Config
Returns the URL of the HxGN NetWorks Vector Tile Service associated with the current HxGN NetWorks Mobile Data Service.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Config.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/config
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetWorksMobileDataService/config
**Sample Response**
A JSON response is returned containing the configuration info.

```
{
    "VectorTileServiceUrl": "http://hostname/NetWorksVectorTileService"
}

```

# Get Publish Status
Returns the current status of the given publish task.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Publish-Status.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/publish/status/{taskid}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| taskid  | Required  | Specifies the Id of the initiated publish task.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetWorksMobileDataService/publish/status/{taskid}
**Sample Response**
A JSON response is returned that contains the status of the given publish task.

```
{
    "Id": "9605c293-0ecf-402f-928f-55de00c6ea99",
    "Status": "InProgress",
    "Message": "Publish data message: Spatial filtering data based on input polygons. Fnos = 2500,2600,1000,11300,3000,19200,1300,3200,2000,1100,1400,19000,10500,10300,10900,14900. \nPublish tiles message: Publish tiles of 3/19 level in progress.",
    "Error": "",
    "DataPublishStatus": "InProgress",
    "TilePublishStatus": "InProgress",
    "DetailsPublishStatus": "InProgress",
    "CurrentLevel": 3
}

```

# Get Region Info by Names
Gets the information for the given regions.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Region-Info-by-Names.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/region/{names}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| names  | Required  | Specifies a comma separated list of region names.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetWorksMobileDataService/region/IRTNON12,IRSLON37

A JSON response is returned containing the information for the given regions.

# Get Region Names
Gets the list of all regions configured as regional subsets that are mapped to configurations within the database.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Region-Names.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/region/names
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksMobileDataService/region/names
**Sample Response**
A JSON response is returned containing the list of regions.

```
[
    "IRTNON12",
    "IRSLON37",
    "IRKPON41",
    "JRVSON01",
    "KRWDON01",
    "KTNRON09",
    "KTNRON08",
    "KTNRON06",
    "KGVLON05",
    "KNTRON12",
    "LMBTON13",
    "LGTNON13",
    "LMTNON07",
    "LNWDON07",
    "LTWLON01",
    "LONDON14"
]

```

# Publish
Initiates a task to bulk publish vector tiles and HxGN NetWorks Core data and metadata for given filter polygons.
The Id from the returned payload can be used to check status of the publish task or to fetch data once the publish is complete.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Publish.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/publish/start
**Post Body Templates**

```
{
    "RefreshCache": true,
    "PublishMaxZoomLevel": 19,
    "PublishData": true,
    "PublishTiles": true,
    "PublishDetails": true,
    "IncludeStyles": false,
    "IncludeGlyphs": false,
    "PackageFormat": "gpkg",
    "Polygons": [
        {
            "type": "Polygon",
            "coordinates": [
                ...
            ]
        }
    ]
}

```

**Post Body Parameters**
A list of validation errors is returned for the specified job. Job has to have pending edits. PageNo and pageSize are used for paging the result.  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| RefreshCache  | Optional  | A boolean value to recreate and overwrite the existing vector tiles regardless of the expiry. Default value is false.  |  
| PublishMaxZoomLevel  | Optional  | Specifies the maximum zoom level to publish vector tiles for. Value should be less than or equal to configured maximum zoom level. Default value is the maximum zoom level configured when deploying the service.  |  
| PublishData  | Optional  | A boolean value that indicates whether to publish attribute data and metadata. Default value is true. Details data (i.e., attributes, traces, searches, dialogs metadata, and its corresponding data) published if the PublishDetails value is true.  |  
| PublishTiles  | Optional  | A boolean value that indicates whether to publish vector tiles. Default value is true.  |  
| PublishDetails  | Optional  | A boolean value that indicates whether to publish details. Default value is false.  |  
| IncludeStyles  | Optional  | A boolean value that indicates whether to include styles. Default value is false. Details styles are included if the PublishDetails value is true.  |  
| IncludeGlyphs  | Optional  | A boolean value that indicates whether to include glyphs. Default value is false.  |  
| PackageFormat  | Optional  | Specifies the package format either 'gpkg' or 'file'. If the PackageFormat is not defined, the tiles and details are published into disk only but do not fetch them and put it in either geopackage or file.  |  
| Polygons  | Required  | Polygons are used as spatial filters when publishing vector tiles and attribute data.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetWorksMobileDataService/publish/start
**Sample Post Body**

```
{
    "RefreshCache": true,
    "PublishMaxZoomLevel": 19,
    "PublishData": true,
    "PublishTiles": true,
    "PublishDetails": true,
    "IncludeStyles": false,
    "IncludeGlyphs": false,
    "PackageFormat": "gpkg",
    "Polygons": [
        {
            "type": "Polygon",
            "coordinates": [
                [
                    [
                        -8959172.43504343,
                        5393143.1109897075
                    ],
                    [
                        -8959668.743908595,
                        5394105.732456211
                    ],
                    [
                        -8960316.09987446,
                        5394023.313255787
                    ],
                    [
                        -8961733.695365734,
                        5394187.442375599
                    ],
                    [
                        -8961741.27487681,
                        5394042.9939445425
                    ],
                    [
                        -8961875.334572688,
                        5393843.307152777
                    ],
                    [
                        -8959172.43504343,
                        5393143.1109897075
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        }
    ]
}

    "Id": "9605c293-0ecf-402f-928f-55de00c6ea99",

# Mobile Data Service
The HxGN NetWorks Mobile Data Service provides RESTful APIs for bulk publishing of vector tiles and HxGN NetWorks Core metadata and data.
## Publish Data and Tiles[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service.html#publish-data-and-tiles)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/area/names](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Area-Names.html)  | Gets the list of all AOI's configured in the database.  |  
| GET  | [/area/{names}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Area-Info-by-Names.html)  | Gets the information for the given area of interests (AOIs).  |  
| GET  | [/region/names](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Region-Names.html)  | Gets the list of all regions configured as regional subsets that are mapped to configurations within the database.  |  
| GET  | [/region/{names}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Region-Info-by-Names.html)  | Gets the information for the given regions.  |  
| POST  | [/publish/start](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Publish.html)  | Initiates a task to bulk publish vector tiles and HxGN NetWorks Core data and metadata for given filter polygons.  |  
| GET  | [/publish/status/{taskid}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Publish-Status.html)  | Returns the current status of the given publish task.  |  
| GET  | [/fetch/data](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Fetch-Data.html)  | Downloads the published data file(s) for the completed publish task.  |  
| GET  | [/config](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Mobile-Data-Service/Get-Config.html)  | Returns the URL of the HxGN NetWorks Vector Tile Service associated with the current HxGN NetWorks Mobile Data Service.  |

# NetExport-Service

# BeginTransaction
Begin an upload transaction. The method returns a unique transaction identifier (tid), which is used with subsequent operations.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#uri)
GET /transaction
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#parameters)
None.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#normal-response-200)
Response with transaction id (tid) of the transaction.

```
{
  "success": true, 
  "tid": "ns0im266d799odjv8vg5woy91fmbej12"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/BeginTransaction.html#server-error-500)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_UPLOAD_FAILED",
    "ErrorMessage": "Error details"
}

```

# CommitTransaction
Commit a multi-operation transaction, previously opened by [BeginTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service.html)/BeginTransaction).
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#uri)
GET /transaction/**{tid}** /
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction id (`tid`)  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
  "success": true
}

```

### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#bad-request-400)

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/CommitTransaction.html#server-error-500)

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

# Export
Initiates a task to export and HxGN NetWorks Core data and metadata for a given format.
The requestId from the returned payload can be used to check status of the export task or to fetch data once the export is complete.
## POST[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Export.html#post)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/export
**Post Body Templates**

```
{
    "ConnectionLogins": "",
    "OutputFileName": "",
    "ExtractGeomFeatureNumber": "",
    "ExtractGeomFeatureID": "",
    "ExtractID": "",
    "ExtractLocation": "",
    "PaperScale": "",
    "TemplateFileName": "",
    "GlyphLocation": "",
    "AutoCADVersionNumber": "",
    "AutoCADCreateLayers": "",
    "ClientName": "",
    "AreaExtent": "",
    "ImportID": "",
    "ImportDataset": "",  
    "UseMBR": "",
    "ClipGeometries": "",
    “AttributeFilterComponentView": "",
    “Max": "",
    “TransactionId”: ""
}

```

**Post Body Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| ConnectionLogins  | Required  | The login information for G/Technology database connections.  |  
| OutputFileName  | Required  | The name of the export/import file.  |  
| ExtractGeomFeatureNumber  | Required  | The feature number of the geometry bounding the export.  |  
| ExtractGeomFeatureID  | Required  | The feature ID of the geometry bounding the export.  |  
| ExtractID  | Required  | The export format ID.  |  
| ExtractLocation  | Required  | The location of the output files.  |  
| PaperScale  | Required  | The paper scale for the export.  |  
| TemplateFileName  | Required  | The template/coordinate system file name to be used in the export/import.  |  
| GlyphLocation  | Required  | The cell file name for design file and font folder location for AutoCAD format for export.  |  
| AutoCADVersionNumber  | Required  | The AutoCAD version number.  |  
| AutoCADCreateLayers  | Required  | The automatic creation of layers in AutoCAD for export.  |  
| ClientName  | Required  | ClientName.  |  
| AreaExtent  | Required  | The list of points bounding an area for the export.  |  
| ImportID  | Required  | The name of the import dataset.  |  
| ImportDataset  | Required  | The export format ID.  |  
| UseMBR  | Required  | Specifies to use the MBR of the bounding geometry feature instance for export.  |  
| ClipGeometries  | Required  | Specifies to clip the exported geometries at the bounding geometry feature instance.  |  
| AttributeFilterComponentView  | Required  | Specifies whether the filter should be directly applied to the component view.  |  
| Max  | Required  | Max  |  
| TransactionId  | Required  | TransactionId of the uploaded files.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NWNetExportService/NetExport/Export
**Sample Post Body**

```
{  
  "ConnectionLogins": "gt/gt1101@ALLPROD;MAINT1330958042",  
  "OutputFileName": "test.ddc", 
  "ExtractGeomFeatureNumber": 200,
  "ExtractGeomFeatureID": 11311080,
  "ExtractID": -1,
  "ExtractLocation": "D:\\DDCWRITER\\Out",
  "PaperScale": 0,
  "TemplateFileName": "",
  "GlyphLocation": "C:\\WINDOWS\\Fonts",
  "AutoCADVersionNumber": "2018",
  "AutoCADCreateLayers": false,
  "ClientName": "Test",
  "AreaExtent": "859460.132282107,1577598.75379156,864192.401689614,1577598.75379156,864192.401689614,1579700.61248978,859460.132282107,1579700.61248978",
  "ImportID": 6,
  "ImportDataset": "D:\\DDCWRITER\\In\\1.kml",
  "UseMBR": false,
  "ClipGeometries": false,  
  "AttributeFilterComponentView": false,
  "ParameterValues": "0",  
  "MAX": 0, 
  "transactionId": "l2n01nj1a1a6240n9dnqnec36ugegjya"
}
    

```

**Sample Response**

```
{
  "am8lnxgp2pigglcre6nni4nxdmyqtvy5"  
}

```

# Get Status
Returns the current status of the given export task.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Get-Status.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/export/status/{requestid}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| requestid  | Required  | Specifies the Id of the initiated export task.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NwNetExportService/NetExport/status/{requestid}
**Sample Response**
A JSON response is returned that contains the status of the given publish task.

```
{
    "Completed"
}

```

# GetExportResult
Download the exported data file(s) for the completed export task.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/GetExportResult.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/export/result/{requestid}
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| requestid  | Required  | Specifies the Id of the completed export task.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NwNetExportService/NetExport/result/{requestid}
**Response**
The exported data file(s) for the given requestid are downloaded with “Export.zip” as the file name. The downloaded file will be a zip file that contains the below combination of files according to post body parameters mentioned in the Export process.  
| Parameter Names  | Resulted file  |  
| --- | --- |  
| {  
"ExtractID ": ,  
"ImportID ": -1  | Zip file contains: kml file or geojson file or shape files or MapInfo files or DGN file or DWG file.  |  
| {  
"ExtractID ": -1,  
"ImportID ":   | Zip file contains: Zip file contains: both DDC and CDT files.  |

# Upload
Upload contents of a file to an open transaction. Available option is:
  * Upload file as multipart/form-data

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#uri)
**POST** /transaction/**{tid}** /file
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tid  | String  | Y  | Transaction id (`tid`)  |  
### Request (form-data)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#request-form-data)
The file content is sent in the request body. The body must use **multipart/form-data** encoding (see [POST](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods/POST)). Two named parameters are accepted:  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| file  | File  | Y  | File contents and name.  |  
| path  | String  | N  | Relative path of the file. Use `/` as path delimiter. Optional.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#response)
### Normal response (200)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#normal-response-200)

```
{
    "Success": true
}

```

### Bad request (400)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#bad-request-400)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_TRANSACTION_NOT_OPEN",
    "ErrorMessage": "Transaction is not open"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/NetExport-Service/Upload.html#server-error-500)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_UPLOAD_FAILED",
    "ErrorMessage": "Error details"
}

```

# NetExport Service
The NetExport Service provides a RESTful API for exporting the NetWorks Core data to different formats (e.g., ArcInfo, AutoCAD, MapInfo, KML, etc.) as configured in NetExport metadata tables. Also, convert compatible third-party geospatial data to NetWorks Core data.

#### 20H1

# Portal platform
This documents the various technical changes to the Portal.
**General**
  * No longer requires a 32 bit app pool in IIS.
  * No longer uses an Oracle connection to the GTech database.
  * Requires .NET Framework 4.7.2.

**Licensing** License checks are now made each time the client is started. Each portal instance requires an `networks_portal_esc` license token to be available.

# Portal UI
## Map and main toolbar[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#map-and-main-toolbar)
First button is now the sidebar collapse button.
A button with a magnifying glass has been added, this open the query dialog.
In the menu button a new option has been added _Mobile client..._. This will re-open the portal with a simplified client suitable for mobile devices.
Button mouse over highlight background color is now light blue.
Button selected background color is now dark blue and the foreground color is white.
Underneath the map toolbar in the top right hand corner is a map loading indicator.
In the top left of the map is the map rotation indicator. This is visible when the map is rotated. Clicking/Tapping this indicator will reset the map rotation to the nominal rotation (as defined by whatever projection is being used.
At the bottom left of the map a mouse-coordinate location indicator has been added above the scale bar.
The Hexagon icon has been removed from the bottom center of the map and moved to the sidebar footer.
## Sidebar[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#sidebar)
Tabs have been simplified and can now be oriented vertically, though by default they are still horizontal. The sidebar header has been removed. A sidebar footer has been added which displays the Hexagon icon.
## Modified sidebar panels[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#modified-sidebar-panels)
### Legend[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#legend)
Clicking a partial checked entry will now 'uncheck' it and all sub entries.
Moving the mouse over the right hand side of the panel will highlight a 'settings' icon. Clicking the icon will open a context menu which will allow the user to
  * Change the visibility of legend entry and its sub entries.
  * Change the locatability of a legend entry and its sub entries, if enable for that entry.
  * Change the opacity of a legend entry and its sub entries via a slider. Note that for entries of a WMS service opacity is applied to all entries from that WMS service. Its not possible to set opacity for an individual layer in WMS services.

### Features[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#features)
An 'Edit on selection' toggle button has been added to the toolbar. By default this is toggled on. If toggled off clicking on an item in the list below will only highlight the item in the map and will not open the editor.
### Trace[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#trace)
In the feature selection dialogs there is now a 'Select' button at the bottom and the 'Related features' button has been removed. Click an item in the list will no longer update the trace panel. The user must now press the 'Select' to update the main panel and this will close the selection dialog. If no item is selected in the list and the user presses the 'Select' button it will update the main panel with the top most item in the list.
## New sidebar panels[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#new-sidebar-panels)
### Areas[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#areas)
This presents the user with a tree of pre-defined 'map bookmarks'. Clicking an item within this tree will fit the map to the bookmark. At the top of the panel is a 'fit' toggle button which by default is toggled on. Toggling the button off will change the behaviour of click an item such that it only highlights the item in the map and does not fit the map to the item.
### Jobs[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#jobs)
Allows the user to select one or more GTech Jobs to view or a single job to make active. At the top of the panel is a '+' button and a 'wastebin' button. The '+' button open the search dialog, the 'wastebin' button will clear the list below the buttons, clearing all jobs.
Below the buttons is the list of currently selected jobs. The list is split into two columns displaying the name and a check box column. If no items in the list are checked then portal will be set to view all the jobs in the list (for the services that support jobs). If an item is checked then it will act as the active job (again for the services that support jobs). Under the list are a set of fields which give more information about the job highlighted in the list.
The search dialog contains four text fields into which search parameters can be typed. Pressing the search button returns a list of jobs that match the parameters. The user can then check the jobs they wish to select and press the Apply button to copy them to the main panel.
## New dialogs[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#new-dialogs)
### Query dialog[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/20H1/Portal-UI.html#query-dialog)
The query dialog is split into three panels.
The left hand panel contains a dropdown in which the query type can be selected and a list containing a list of available queries for that type.
Selecting a query in the left hand panel populates the top right panel with a set of fields which allow the user to type in values for the query. At the panel are two buttons. A search button which will initiate a search with the parameters and an edit button which is initially disabled. Pressing the search button will populate the bottom right panel with a table of results. Click on an item in the bottom right will highlight and fit the map to the item and enable the edit button. Pressing the edit button will open the editor for the item.
