    * Automatic inversion of style colors matching background color
    * [Enabling of feature tooltips](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Networks-Vector-Source.html) now set in workspace.
  * [Configurable background color](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings.html)
  * OpenID Connect: [Authorization code flow support](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Security/Use-OpenID-Code-Authorization-Code-flow.html)
  * Performance improvements 
    * Startup time improvements
    * Details and Schematics dialog improvements (no map counts)
  * GPS function is now [configurable](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings.html). It can be configured too 
    * Center map on the initial GPS position (no tracking).
    * Center map on GPS position (tracking).
    * Track GPS position. Re-center map when position leaves map view.
  * Enhanced support for GetFeatureInfo from external WMS services such as 
    * ESRI
    * GeoServer
    * MapServer
  * [Enhanced support for browser functionality (history and bookmarks)](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings.html)
    * Browser URL is updated for geographic legends with position and legend selection.
    * Browser URL can now be bookmarked.
    * Portal can be configured to work the same for detail and schematic legends.
  * [Enhancements to error handling](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file.html)
    * By default ASP.NET errors are not returned.
  * [Enhancements to logging](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file.html)
    * Portal can be configured to log incoming requests, users and authorization failures.
  * Technological stack 
    * Upgrade to OpenLayers 6.4.3
    * Changed logging to use common logging (NLog) instead of log4net

## Administration Console[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2101.html#administration-console)
  * [Run custom batch files after deployment](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Deployment-customization.html)

## CIM Export[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2101.html#cim-export)
  * [Run pre- and post-process procedures before and after export](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/CIM-Export/Reference/CIM-Export-parameters.html)

## Licensing[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2101.html#licensing)
  * [Per-Request licensing mode](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Licensing.html)/

# 2102
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#portal)
### Map[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#map)
  * Tooltips on mouse hover for Vector service features now available. 
    * Mouse over a line in the tooltip will temporarily highlight that feature.
    * Click on a line in the tooltip will open the editor on that feature.
  * Improvements to [startup from query string](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Integration/Launch-Portal-from-other-applications.html). 
    * Where multiple details/schematics exist for a specified feature users can select between them.
  * Geographic map button 
    * If the user is in a detail/schematic map the button will return them to the last (or default) geographic view.
  * [Google Maps](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Google-map-source.html) rendering performance improvement. 
    * Google Maps are retrieved via XYZ source, which speeds up loading due to caching on the client, [tile size](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Google-map-source.html) in the workspace may need to be updated as it should now be a multiple of 256.
  * When viewing detail/schematic maps the default has been changed so the browser now maintains history. 
    * History has been fixed so user can see which legend a history item is linked to.
    * Portal can now start with a detail/schematic map.
  * Improved hit testing for text and symbol vector geometries.
  * Enhancements to support of [external WMS](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/WMS-source.html) GetFeatureInfo.
  * Update to [scale bar](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings.html) - display scale readout.
  * Vector Service rendering improvements: [settings for minimum line width, render buffer and image ratio](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Networks-Vector-Source.html), overridable in [Print settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Print/Customization-of-print-settings.html).
  * Preservation of z-index for legend entries across sessions.
  * Support for [WFS requests using HTTP GET](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/WFS-Source.html), WFS 2.0.0.

### Feature editor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#feature-editor)
  * Improved initial load time.
  * Static and dynamic filtering of picklists based on other attributes is now supported.
  * Multi column picklists are implemented.
  * Paging for picklists.
  * Improvements to formatting for numeric and date type fields.
  * Improved hyperlink editing. 
    * Click on the underlined text to open the linked file (if available).
  * Users can edit multiple tabs at once before saving.
  * [Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Feature-Editor.html) will now check if the current user can edit a feature or not and will apply configuration depending on result. 
    * Extended configuration options for the editor to allow for addition and removal of menu buttons.
    * Extended API to allow developers to override and modify feature editor load and save of features.
  * Required fields labels are shown in bold.

### Feature selection[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#feature-selection)
  * Fit: Context-aware highlight of feature geometries (geographic or detail/schematic legend).
  * Selection from vector source now sorted by geometry type (i.e. point, polyline and polygon) to allow for quicker selection.
  * Can now add and remove [toolbar buttons](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Results-tables/Configure-buttons.html).
  * [Configurable table buttons](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Results-tables/Configure-buttons.html) which allow a user to immediately open details, edit or fit a feature regardless of toolbar button state.
  * Mouse over an item will temporarily highlight it in the map.
  * Click an item will highlight the item in the map. Click again to unhighlight it.
  * Highlight for Vector service features can be configured to highlight primary geometry only, non-label geometry or all geometry in current legend.

### Trace[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#trace)
  * View trace results as a table with paging. 
    * Can be opened from the Trace sidebar panel in the grid under Trace layers.

### Query[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#query)
  * Filtering of picklists based on other query parameters is now supported.

### Search, Query & Trace results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#search-query--trace-results)
  * [Configurable toolbar](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Results-tables/Configure-buttons.html).
  * [Configurable table buttons](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Results-tables/Configure-buttons.html) which allow a user to immediately open details, edit or fit a feature regardless of toolbar button state.
  * Click on an item to highlight, click again to unhighlight.
  * Results for Query and Trace are now presented as pages.
  * Results can be [downloaded as an Excel spreadsheet](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Results-tables/Download-results-as-Excel.html) (up to a configured maximum number of rows). 
    * [Export data to Excel configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Export-data-to-Excel-configuration.html)
    * Work Service [configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Services-Deployment/Work-Service.html) and [details](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/ExportData.html).
  * [Add results to legend](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Results-tables/Add-results-to-legend.html): Geometry for results can be downloaded and shown as part of the current legend (up to a configured number of rows).

### Redline & Measure line[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#redline--measure-line)
  * Redlines and Measuring lines will now [snap](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Placement/Snapping.html) to features from the vector service. 
    * [Snapping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Placement/Snapping.html) can currently be configured to snap to vertexes and edges, and the snap distance can be configured.
  * Export Redline XML format with [NetWorks configuration, legend number](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Map-Legend.html) and G3E_DETAILID.
  * Export and upload button can be hidden via [Settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings.html).

### General[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#general)
  * Improved support for OIDC in the portal. 
    * Access is now prevented to portal pages and workspaces if user is not authenticated. They are redirected to login.
    * [Workspace filtering](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Workspace-filtering.html): Can now configure workspaces to only be available to users with specific claims.
  * Can now configure the NetWorks configuration per [workspace](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace.html).
  * Can now configure the links to Networks services per [workspace](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace.html).
  * Improved [proxy function](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file/Proxy.html) to allow HTTP headers to be forwarded and returned, and prevent authorization header being attached to requests.
  * Upgraded to ExtJS 7.4 and OpenLayers 6.9.0 (without GeoTIFF support).

### Printing[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#printing)
  * New flag in [print template](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Print-Templates.html) to allow text be written right-to-left

### Portal API[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#portal-api)
  * [Add WMS, WFS and WMTS sources to legend dynamically](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc.html).
  * [Set and clear active job id](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/Networks/Portal/API/$NWP/jobs.md).
  * [Hooks in feature editor to alter standard load and save](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html).
  * [Additional sidebar functions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/sidebar.html) to set its width and visibility.
  * [Toolbar functions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/toolbar.html) to set action buttons state.
  * [Workspace functions](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/workspace.html) to get workspace configuration.

## Services[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#services)
### Analytical Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#analytical-service)
  * New [GetSearchResults](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Search/GetSearchResults.html) API to support query and trace result workflows in NetWorks Portal.

### Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#vector-service)
  * New API for [geometry retrieval](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry.html).
  * [Polyline clipping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Configuration.html)
  * Compatibility: added support for TextPoint geometries.
  * Performance 
    * Improved performance of geometry and tooltip retrieval APIs.
    * Response compression in HTTPS mode.
  * Configurable [expansion factor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Configuration.html) for bounding box for data retrieval.

### Solution Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#solution-service)
  * [Configure alternative path to NetWorksDeployedServices.xml](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Solution-Service.html). Allows multiple deployment configurations on a single machine via manual configuration.

### Work Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#work-service)
  * Configurable [Executable](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Executable.html) workload. Provides REST API to support long-running command line processes.
  * New [ExportData](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/ExportData.html) workflow supporting export of tabular data to Excel.

## Administration Console[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2102.html#administration-console)
  * [Command line deployment tools](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/Command-line-deployment-tools.html) and [Deploy.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/Deploy.exe.html).
  * [Deployment customization](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Deployment-customization.html) enhancements. 
    * Command line tool for post-deployment customization [RunCustomization.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/RunCustomization.exe.html).
  * [Common deployment settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Common-deployment-settings.html).
  * [Deploy services as always running](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Deploy-services-as-always-running.html)
  * Publish CSS with symbol and text fonts for Vector Service rendering in Portal and register it in the workspace.

# 2201
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#portal)
### Workspaces[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#workspaces)
The portal can, and is by default, now configured to read [workspaces from a folder](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/File-location-and-loading.html) .
### Coordinates toolbar[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#coordinates-toolbar)
Coordinates toolbar is now more [configurable](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Placement/Coordinates-Toolbar.html).
**IMPORTANT** Customers using manually configured workspaces should update these as the entry `<JValue>coordinateswindow</JValue>` in the coordinates toolbar function is now obsolete.
### Trace[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#trace)
The Portal can be configured to use the Vector service to display trace results in the map instead of the WMS service. This can improve performance and simplify deployment. See [Workspace settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Workspace-settings.html).
Trace execution runs asynchronously using Work Service and new [ExecuteTrace.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/ExecuteTrace.exe.html) tool. Analytical Service is still used for retrieval of trace metadata.
### Details/schematics[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#detailsschematics)
The portal can be configured to use WMS and/or the vector service to visualize detail/schematics. Using vector service only can improve performance and simplify deployment. However the vector service cannot render any raster data. See [Workspace settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Workspace-settings.html).
### Map[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#map)
Tooltips can now be optionally made available for data coming from WFS services and other vector data such as query results. See [map source configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Map-sources.html).
It is now possible to specify in the workspace that a legend entry is **not** queryable/locatable. This will prevent a user from switching it to locatable in the legend. In addition this change will allow WMS services to be not locatable by default, but allow the user to switch them to be locatable via the UI. See [map legend configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Map-Legend.html).
### Legend[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#legend)
Legend panel UI has been modified with the following new functions:
  * Save and restore legend settings.
  * Create legend link, which in addition to encoding map legend selection and position also uploads the current legend settings (visibility, opacity etc.) and redlines so that they can be transferred to another user.

See [Save, restore and link legend settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Legend/Save%2C-restore-and-link-legend-settings.html).
Legend 'context' menu has been modified:
  * The menu is now context sensitive. Functions which are not available for a particular legend entry will not be visible.
  * A new function to [reset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Legend/Reset%2C-Rename-and-Remove.html) the settings for only the selected legend entry and child entries has been added.
  * A new function to open a simple [style editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Legend/Style.html) for styles of vector data from WFS, query and trace has been added.

Legend entries added from Attach CAD, Trace, Query and Search functions will now persist between session until removed by the user, for example, via the legend context menu.
Filtered legend entries are now marked with a filter icon before the entry name.
See also [Legends](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Legend.html).
### Query[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#query)
Query dialog UI has been modified:
  * Search and clear buttons have been moved to a [toolbar](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Query.html).
  * Save and remove buttons have been added which allow the user to save the query and its parameter values to a separate list so it can be re-run at a later point. See [Save query](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Query/Save-query.html).
  * Enter key will now by default execute the search.
  * Support for executing external HTTP(S) based search services and WFS services has been added. See [External queries](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Query/External-queries.html).

### Settings dialog[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#settings-dialog)
A simple settings dialog has been added which allows users to override:
  * GPS mode
  * Geometry snapping

This will be used to as a basis for further settings in the future.
### Print[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#print)
  * The use of PhantomJS is now deprecated and by default the print function is configured to use NodeJS/Puppeteer.
  * The number of active print processes can now be controlled via [settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Print/Controlling-print-processes.html) in the web.config file.

### NetPlot[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#netplot)
  * Added support for built-in NetWorks PDF Printer. See [NetPlot](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/NetPlot.html) for details.

### OpenID Connect[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#openid-connect)
  * Added support for PKCE in [Authorization Code flow](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Security/Use-OpenID-Code-Authorization-Code-flow.html)

### API[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#api)
A new function, [NWP.features.setHyperlinkTest](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features.html), has been added which will support opening of custom URL protocols from the default and feature editor.
A new client back end has been added. This uses indexeddb to store portal settings and other data such as legend setting snapshots and legend entries added by the user. See [NWP.application](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/application.html).
### Vector rendering[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#vector-rendering)
Improved or added rendering of:
  * Dash-gap patterns, including placements on symbols on the line.
  * Area hatch fill patterns.
  * Line styles with offset.
  * Text justification in multiline labels.
  * Text underline styles.
  * Text box border and background.

### Technology upgrade[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#technology-upgrade)
Upgraded OpenLayers to version 6.14.0 and proj4js to 2.7.5.
### Attach CAD files[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#attach-cad-files)
  * Conversion of Shapefiles (SHP) is now done using a tool delivered with NetWorks [CreateDDCFromShapefile.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/CreateDDCFromShapefile.exe.html). This allows upload of multiple SHP files at once and creation of WMS sources with multiple layers. PRJ files are accepted as coordinate system files along with CSF files.

## Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#vector-service)
  * Added clipping of polygon geometries in `/data` endpoint. Clipping invisible parts of polygons improves performance (less data to transfer, faster rendering). See [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Configuration.html).
  * `/data` endpoint now supports returning component view tooltips together with geometries. See [GetFeatures](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html).
  * Improved handling of TextPoint geometries from secondary data. Text encoding can be [configured](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Configuration.html).

## WMTS[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#wmts)
  * Client side caching improvements: GetTile response now returns Last-Modifier HTTP header and all headers in 304 (Not modified) response.

## Dynamic WMS[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#dynamic-wms)
  * Configurable option to identify WMS layers by ordinals instead of DDC layer name. Useful for uploaded CAD files with lots of layers. See [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Dynamic-WMS-Service/Configuration.html).

## Coordinate System Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#coordinate-system-service)
  * [Coordinate system configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Coordinate-Systems-Service.html) is now shared with NetWorks in the NetWorks `Program/Config` folder.

## Diagnostics[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#diagnostics)
  * .NET Core based services (Vector, Data Transfer, Dynamic WMS, Work, Deltas) are now deployed with default [logging configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Diagnostics.html), which writes all internal errors and warnings to the primary log.

## Security[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#security)
  * Added support for [Password Vault Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Security/Password-Vault-Service-support.html). In this version, configuration of the Password Vault Service support is manual, without UI configuration or deployment tooling.

## CIM Export[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#cim-export)
  * Added support for explicit incremental (differential) export mode, see [Partial incremental export of data](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/CIM-Export/Reference/Partial-incremental-export-of-data.html).

## Administration Console[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#administration-console)
### Service Deployment[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2201.html#service-deployment)
  * [PublishFonts.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/PublishFonts.exe.html) used during Portal deployment now has a configurable black and white list of fonts to exclude/include in processing.

# 2202
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2202.html#portal)
### Secondary data support[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2202.html#secondary-data-support)
Attributes of secondary features (both imported and non-imported) can now be viewed using Portal's Feature Editor, which displays either the Properties dialog (if defined) or list of a attributes from the component view. This functionality requires a Vector Service instance.
### Feature Editor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2202.html#feature-editor)
  * Improvements in handling of date, datetime and time data types.
  * Validation of maximum string lengths based on data type information.

## Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2202.html#vector-service)
  * Added support for 3D in GeoJSON output (see [Vector Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks-internal/Obsolete/API/Vector-Service.md)).
  * Added support for retrieval and output of component view attributes into GeoJSON (see [Vector Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/NetWorks-internal/Obsolete/API/Vector-Service.md)).

## Dialog Web Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2202.html#dialog-web-service)
  * New API to retrieve list of Secondary features (see [Secondary Data](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/GetSecondaryDataInfo.html)).
  * New parameter skipfi in AttributeUpdate API and web.config to bypass execution of Functional Interfaces (see [AttributeUpdate](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/AttributeUpdate.html)).
  * Data type information is now returned in GetDialogTab response.

## Password Vault Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2202.html#password-vault-service)
Password Vault Service serves the same purpose as Password Vault Manager in NWCore products - to separate sensitive information (passwords) from storage in OpenID Connect providers.
See:
  * [Password Vault Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Password-Vault-Service.html)
  * [Password Vault Service Legacy](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Password-Vault-Service-Legacy.html)
  * [Password Vault Service support](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Security/Password-Vault-Service-support.html)

Set of tools for benchmarking web service performance.

# 2301
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#portal)
###  [Feature Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#feature-editor)
  * Client environment for placing new and editing existing HxGN NetWorks features.
  * Changes are managed in a workset and not applied to the database until the workset is submitted. Multiple worksets can be managed in the client.
  * Worksets are saved to the server while changes are being made.
  * Driven by standard placement metadata (except for placement selection tree).
  * Placement of new geometries using feature or placement configuration mode. 
    * Supported placement techniques: Interactive IPT (default, with limitations), Offset Point SPT.
    * Supported geometry types: Boundary (without holes and arcs), CompositePolygon (without arcs), CompositePolyline (without arcs), Polygon, Polyline, OrientedPoint and TextPoint.
  * Editing of existing features and geometries.
  * Attribute editor with support for: 
    * Text, number and date data types
    * Simple, Multi-column and cascading/filtered picklists
    * Traversal attributes
    * File upload for hyperlink fields
    * Repeating components in grid or stacked layout
  * Submit processing: 
    * Create new job in database.
    * Perform CRUD modifications in the job.
  * Current limitations / not supported: 
    * Style and label rule evaluation.
    * Custom placement techniques.
    * Construction aids.
    * Functional interfaces.
    * Foreign key query interface.
    * Relationships.
    * Details / schematics.
    * Edit of features in an existing job.
    * Tracking of workset status after submit in the client.
    * Edit of workset after submit in the client.

###  [Plugin API](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Plugin-API.html)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#plugin-api)
  * An API that is common to both HxGN NetWorks Core Portal and HxGN NetWorks Core Mobile.
  * Allows a UI plugin to be hosted in either the Portal or Core Mobile.
  * A plugin defined as a UI component created using HTML, CSS and JavaScript/Typescript.

### Print[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#print)
  * Switched to Puppeteer version 19.0.0 or newer, with a shared Chromium installation.
  * Improvements in internal synchronization, to prevent empty pages.

### Technology upgrades[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#technology-upgrades)
  * OpenLayers upgraded to version 7.2.2
  * Puppeteer version 19.0.0 or newer

* * *
## Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#vector-service)
  * DDC reading performance improvements. Possible improvements up to 100% on some data sets.
  * Polygon and line clipping in all processing pathways. Improved performance when processing large polygons, mainly during rendering (Dynamic WMS, Core Mobile).
  * Added support for optimized styles in DDCs. Vector Service now honors G3E_STYLEID columns.

* * *
##  [Feature Data Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Feature-Data-Service.html)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#feature-data-service)
  * New web service providing [API](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service.html) for retrieval of feature related metadata and data, aimed at replacing Dialog Web Service in the future.
  * Returns and accepts geometries in Networks JSON, GeoJSON and WKT formats, both 2D and 3D.

* * *
##  [Feature Transaction Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Feature-Transaction-Service.html)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#feature-transaction-service)
  * New web service providing [API](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service.html) for creation, modification and deletion of feature data, including relationships and detail/schematic windows.

* * *
## Dialog Web Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#dialog-web-service)
  * Honor G3E_SELECTROLE, G3E_EDITROLE and G3E_DELETEROLE of processed G3E_FNO when accessing or modifying feature data.
  * Optimized performance of file download operations. Accept partial paths stored in attribute values combined with lookup using OtherPaths.

* * *
## Job Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#job-service)
  * [CreateJob](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CreateJob.html) API now accepts additional properties in request body and creates job record using a single INSERT statement.

* * *
## Work Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#work-service)
  * Queue folder and file structure was improved to support deployment in load balancing environments, where multiple Work Service instances share the same queue storage.
  * New _Features_ workload to support Feature Editor workflows: create job, perform CRUD over features, run post processing.

* * *
## Data Transfer Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#data-transfer-service)
### API changes[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#api-changes)
  * [UploadFile](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/UploadFile.html) now accepts regular POST with JSON body (in addition to multipart encoding)
  * [CommitTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html) triggers optional configurable post processing - submit work to Work Service passing current `tid` in request. Identifier(s) of submitted work (`wid`) is returned in response. See [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service/Configuration.html).
  * [GetTransactionFile](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionFile.html) accepts optional query string parameter opt=[0|1]. When set to value other than 0 (default), the file may not exist and the API does return status 204 instead of 400.
  * New API: [DeleteTransactionFile](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/DeleteTransactionFile.html). Delete a file in an open transaction.
  * New API: [RevertTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/RevertTransaction.html). Opposite of CommitTransaction, moves the committed transaction to open state, with all payload.
  * New API: [GetUserRoles](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetUserRoles.html). In OIDC mode, get list of Oracle roles assigned to caller.

### Other[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#other)
  * Clean-up functionality - automatically remove completed and open transactions N days after last change. See [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service/Configuration.html).

* * *

OpenAPI 3.0.0 specifications for selected services are available under `\NetWorks\Program\WebHelp\Console\doc\openapi`, relative to product installation path.

## Tooling[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#tooling)
### New command line tools[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#new-command-line-tools)
These new command line tools support new web services (Feature Data Service and Feature Transaction Service) and Feature Editor functionality.
  * [PublishAttributeTypes.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/PublishAttributeTypes.exe.html) for exporting attribute data type information from CNOxxx.RAW files to XML.
  * [PublishMetadataDDC.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/PublishMetadataDDC.exe.html) for conversion of input XML file(s) in serialized DataSet format to a metadata DDC file.
  * [PublishWSMetadata.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/PublishWSMetadata.exe.html) for conversion of published NetWorks metadata in .RAW files to a DDC file.

### Experimental[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2301.html#experimental)
  * [PublishDDCData.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/PublishDataDDC.exe.html) tool for optimized publishing of geometry data from database to DDC files.

# 2302
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#portal)
### Map[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#map)
Scale bar has been moved from the bottom right to the bottom left. This was done to prevent it interfering with the coordinates toolbar.
The settings dpi and units have been added to allow for more configuration of the scalebar.
### Settings[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#settings)
The following client settings have been added.  
| Name  | Value  | Remarks  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| coordinates.componentSeparator  | `' '`  | Used by the coordinates toolbar copy & paste functionality. Defaults to whitespace  |  
| coordinates.decimalSeparator  |   | Used by coordinates toolbar copy & paste functionality. Defaults to the localized string common.format.decimalSeparator.  |  
| coordinates.geographicFormat  | `'dms'`  | The format geographic coordinates are shown in. Can be `'dms'` or `'dec'`.  |  
| coordinates.geographicPrecision  | `6`  | Number of decimal places shown for geographic coordinates shown in decimal format.  |  
| coordinates.geographicSecondsPrecision  | `3`  | Number of decimal places shown for second when geographic coordinates are shown in d : m : s format.  |  
| coordinates.geographicSwapAxes  | `true`  | If true geographic coordinates are shown latitude, longitude.  |  
| coordinates.projectedPrecision  |   | Number of decimal places shown for projected coordinates. Defaults to strings common.format.decimalPrecision.  |  
| coordinates.projectedSwapAxes  | `false`  | If true projected coordinates are shown X,Y.  |  
| coordinates.updateOnExtentChange  | `true`  | If true then when the map extent is changed then coordinates toolbar is updated with the map views new center  |  
| measure.enableArea  | `true`  | Whether total area labels are displayed or not.  |  
| measure.enableCoordinate  | `true`  | Whether coordinate marker labels are displayed or not.  |  
| measure.enableSegmentLength  | `true`  | Whether segment length labels are displayed or not.  |  
| measure.enableTotalLength  | `true`  | Whether total length labels are displayed or not.  |  
| measure.persistGeometry  | `true`  | Whether measure geometry is stored on the client between sessions or not.  |  
| measure.precision  |   | Number of decimal places shown for measures e.g. distance and area. Defaults to strings common.format.decimalPrecision.  |  
| measure.useGeodesicCalculations  | `true`  | Whether the client calculates the geodesic distance or projected distance.  |  
| scaleline.displayScale  | `true`  | Whether the scale is displayed.  |  
| scaleline.dpi  | `90.7`  | The 'dots per inch' used to calculate scale. The default is the OGC default value.  |  
| scaleline.scaleBar  | `true`  | Whether the scale bar is a bar or a line.  |  
| scaleline.steps  | `1`  | If scale bar is true then the number of sections the bar is split into. It is recommended that this is 1 or an even number.  |  
| scaleline.units  | `'metric'`  | The units used by the scale bar. Can be `'metric'`,`'degrees'`,`'imperial'`,`'us'` or `'nautical'`.  |  
| settingsDlg.height  | `330`  | Default height of the settings dialog in CSS pixels.  |  
| settingsDlg.width  | `500`  | Default width of the settings dialog in CSS pixels.  |  
See [Settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Settings.html) .
### Settings dialog[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#settings-dialog)
The following settings have been made available to the user
_Precision coordinates_
  * Update coordinate on map move - User can choose as to whether the coordinates toolbar coordinate is updated with the map view center coordinate when the map extent is changed by, for example, user actions or GPS position updating.
  * Decimal separator - Allows the user to define the decimal place character used to display coordinates. This is most useful if the user is pasting coordinates into the coordinates toolbar and the decimal place character being pasted is different from the users normal locale.
  * Coordinate number separator - Allows the user to define the character used to separate the coordinate numbers when copying and pasting.

_Precision coordinates - Geographic_
  * Precision - The number of decimal places shown when viewing geographic coordinates in decimal format.
  * Format - Allows the user to choose whether they view geographic coordinates as decimal numbers or as degrees, minutes and seconds.
  * Coordinate order - Allows the user to display the coordinate as either latitude, longitude (default) or longitude, latitude.

_Precision coordinates - Projected_
  * Precision - The number of decimal places shown for projected coordinates.
  * Coordinate order - Allows the user to display the coordinate as either X, Y (default) or Y, X.

_Measure_
  * Calculate geodesic distance - When checked distances between two points show the geodesic distance otherwise the projected distance.
  * Show coordinate label - Display the coordinate as a label when placing coordinate markers.
  * Show segment lengths labels - Display segment length labels when placing measuring lines or areas.
  * Show length label - Display total length label when placing measuring lines.
  * Show area label - Display total area when placing measuring polygons.

### Zoom toolbar (right hand toolbar)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#zoom-toolbar-right-hand-toolbar)
  * Default workspace template for this toolbar has been modified too:

```
<Function name="zoomtoolbar">
   <Config>
      <JProperty name="items">
         <JArray>
            <JValue>mapoverview</JValue>
            <JValue>mapzoomin</JValue>
            <JValue>mapzoomout</JValue>
            <JValue>mapgps</JValue>
            <JValue>mapattribution</JValue>
         </JArray>
      </JProperty>
   </Config>
</Function>

```

### Measure functions[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#measure-functions)
  * It is now possible to snap to measure geometry. This allows the user to, for example, create marker points at exact locations and then draw redlines connecting them.
  * When placing coordinate markers the label will display the coordinate text displayed in the coordinates toolbar. Note that this only applies to coordinate markers and not coordinates labels available for Redlines. For Redlines the coordinate displayed will always be in the projection used by the legend, though the precision, decimal point and coordinate separator will be those defined in settings.
  * Measure geometry is maintained between sessions like redlines. This behavior can be overridden by adjusting the settings on portal deployment if required.
  * The measure functions have been moved from the right hand toolbar to the coordinates toolbar.

###  [Coordinates toolbar](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Placement/Coordinates-Toolbar.html) (bottom toolbar)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#coordinates-toolbar-bottom-toolbar)
  * Default workspace template for this toolbar has been modified too:

```
<Function name="coordinatestoolbar">
   <Config>
      <JProperty name="items">
         <JArray>
            <JValue>coordinatescollapse</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinatesystems</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinatesfield</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinatecopy</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinatepaste</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinateselect</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinatefit</JValue>
            <JValue>coordinateplace</JValue>
            <JValue>measureline</JValue>
            <JValue>measurearea</JValue>
            <JValue>clearmeasures</JValue>
         </JArray>
      </JProperty>
   </Config>
</Function>

```

  * Coordinate format dropdown is removed. This was done as it was both misleading and caused multiple errors. In the portal, the unit (e.g. metres or degrees), positive axes (e.g. N & E or S & W), and whether the coordinate system is a projection or not, is defined by the coordinate system and cannot currently be adjusted. It is possible for the user to adjust the format geographic coordinates are displayed in, and the order coordinates are display in, via the settings dialog.
  * While waiting on the server the coordinate systems picklist and coordinate fields are disabled.
  * The function to center the map on the currently displayed coordinate and place a coordinate marker has been split into two separate buttons.
  * The copy function has been modified so that it now copies the text as shown in the toolbar into the clipboard with a separator which can be specified by the user in the settings dialog.
  * A paste function has been added. When pasting a coordinate it must be in the order and format being displayed in the toolbar. For example if pasting a coordinate which is using `.` as the decimal character and `,` separating the two numbers (e.g. `123.4, 567.8`) then these characters must match those set in the settings dialog.
  * The select coordinate function has been modified. After activating the function, every time the user clicks the map the displayed coordinate will be updated. This will continue until the user starts another map interaction or presses the select coordinate button again.
  * Pressing enter in the coordinates field will place a coordinate marker.

### Redlining[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#redlining)
  * Redline XML header elements can be modified via [redline settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html). The category for redlines has been changed from '_LER' to '_Default'.
  * Dash patterns have been modified to more closely resemble those used in Designer-Analyst. Added 'Dash dot dot' pattern.
  * Fields in the panels now automatically fill the available width of the redline panel.
  * Text weight and style dropdowns have been merged into one to simplify the user experience.
  * Field order in the Import panel is changed to simplify the user experience, as the settings of the file selector are now dependent on the format field.
  * Redlines are automatically imported on file selection to reduce clicking. On successful import a notification is displayed. Import button can be used to re-import the selected file.
  * [Settings file](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings.html) has been restructured to allow for more configuration of redline default styles and measure styles. In particular redline text and symbol geometry can now be set as scale dependent, as per how text and symbols work in Designer-Analyst. As delivered the _default_ remains as scale independent for backwards compatibility. This can be overridden on deployment if required. See also [this article](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Redlines.html) and sub articles for more information.
  * Scale dependency and rotation for redline text and symbol geometry is maintained when exporting or importing Redline XML. Currently line and outline widths are treated as scale independent by the Portal.
  * For symbol fonts it is now possible to configure [which symbols](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html) are available on a per font basis.
  * [Default text alignment](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Style-Properties.html) for redline text geometry has been changed to the equivalent of left baseline to match Designer-Analyst. Default symbol alignment is still set to 'Center Center'.
  * [Styles for measure](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Style-Properties.html) have been updated to aid readability.
  * By default, symbols, labels and decorations (e.g. length and area labels) rotate with the map view.
  * Angle label decorations now print. However, the indicator arc still does not.
  * On import of WKT or GML the current values of the UI are used to setup default style values for the imported geometry.

### Feature Editor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#feature-editor)
  * Submitted worksets remain on the client in read-only state. This allows the user to review the changes after submitting. Worksets that are no longer needed can be deleted by the user.
  * New [Workset Monitor Plugin](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Workset-Monitor-Plugin.html) for tracking and maintenance of submitted Feature Editor worksets.

### Vector Rendering[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#vector-rendering)
  * Added [support](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Map-display/Vector-Service-rendering-compatibility.html) for G3E_POINTSTYLE.G3E_ROTATION when rendering point styles.

### Trace[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#trace)
  * List of traces to redisplay now supports pagination and filtering.

  * [GetTraces](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Results/GetTraces.html) and [GetTraces](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Analytical-Service/Trace/GetTraces.html) APIs now support pagination and filter parameters.

##  [Work Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service.html)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#work-service)
  * Supports state for [Monitoring](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html) of submitted [Feature Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html) worksets.
  * Added support for multiple NetWorks configurations when processing submitted Feature Editor worksets. See Work Service [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Configuration.html) for more information.

* * *
##  [Vector Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service.html)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#vector-service)
  * Filter condition parsing and execution for style, label rules and legend filtering was re-implemented to fix some long documented issues (integer/double comparison, NULL vs. `0` in numeric values, LIKE support). For details and options on how to enable legacy parsing and execution mode see [Filter operators](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Filter-operators.html).

* * *
## Tools[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#tools)
  * [CreateDDCFileSubset.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/CreateDDCFileSubset.exe.html) is now able to merge multiple DDC files into one, with approximate size target for resulting CDT file(s).
  * Obsolete tool _UCCLI.exe_ was removed from the product. Use [Command line deployment tools](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/Command-line-deployment-tools.html) to deploy services and Portal from the command line.

* * *
## General[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#general)
### Compatibility with previous versions of NetWorks Core database[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#compatibility-with-previous-versions-of-networks-core-database)
  * NetWorks Web Services now have a documented option to install and run the software on an older version of the Core database, see [Usage with older databases](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html). This does not guarantee full compatibility but allows installation of newest version of services and Portal while desktop clients stay on previous software versions.
  * Administration Console _Designer WMTS Sites_ module was modified to support databases prior to 11.01.2301.

### Technology upgrades[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2302.html#technology-upgrades)
  * Upgraded .NET to 8.0.0. This affects services based on ASP.NET Core stack (Vector, Data Transfer, Work, Dynamic WMS, Feature Data, Feature Transaction, Coordinate System, Password Vault Service).

# 2401
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#portal)
### API[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#api)
  * Updated documentation for [NWP.map.addSourceEntry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/map.html). Added more examples under [Examples](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/Networks/Portal/API/Examples.md).
  * Added new [notification](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Notifications.html) 'workspaceready' which is sent when the workspace is read and the UI is ready.
  * Added new [function](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/workspace.html) 'ready()' which returns a boolean

### Editor (old)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#editor-old)
  * Relationships: Display logical Connection 1 and Connection 2 for Node-Edge Connectivity relationships.

### Feature Editor plug-in[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#feature-editor-plug-in)
  * [Foreign Key Query](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html) support.
  * Auto population of dialog tab attributes (based on metadata in `G3E_TRIGGERSET` and `G3E_AUTOPOPULATE` tables).
  * Display related features of a feature in workset or selected from map. Allows editing of non-graphical features by selecting them from the relationship tree.
  * Support for [job to workset interoperability](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html). 
##### Note
There is a change in [Portal workspace configuration for Feature Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#portal-deployment).
  * Support for [workset locking](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html).
  * Detection of [parallel edits to workset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#concurrency-violation).
  * Enforce mandatory attributes and components before submitting. 
    * Customizable severity of [validations](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Validation.html).
  * Configurable [dialog type](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) for creating new jobs after submitting workset. This functionality allows configuration of [default values for mandatory job attributes](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility/Default-values-for-job-attributes.html) which are not present in Feature Editor UI.
  * Display a warning when user tries to submit workset without any features.
  * Apply dialog tab attribute default values (`G3E_DIALOGATTRIBUTES_OPTABLE`.`G3E_DEFAULT`) when creating new features.
  * Feature Editor plug-in can be started on a specific feature from external application by passing G3E_FNO and G3E_FID in query string. This functionality is not applicable in Feature Editor deployed with Portal.

### Redlines[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#redlines)
  * Added more options for defining default redline [styling](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Style-Properties.html). 
##### Note
The 'styleProperties.redlineLine' now only defines default styles for two point redline lines. Polylines and freehand polylines have separate configurations. Similarly 'styleProperties.redlinePolygon' now only defines default styles for polygons. Rectangles and circles have separate configurations. The property set 'redlineLabel' has been **removed** and replaced with 'redlineText'.
  * Added support for redline [categories](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Redlines/Categories.html). Default categories can be configured by making a categories xml file available on the portal server.
  * Only redlines associated with a default category are saved automatically between Portal sessions. A default category is a category defined in the categories xml file or if no the categories xml file is supplied then the application default category. 
##### Note
Before upgrading to version 11.01.2401 users should save/export redlines they wish to keep into a file otherwise they will be lost. It is recommended that users always save/export important redlines into a file.
  * When saving redlines in 'Redline XML' format, the category tag is dynamically generated. In previous versions it came from [redline settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html).
  * Added support for redline groups.
  * Added support for moving overlapping redlines up and down.
  * Added fit to selected redline(s) function.
  * Added copy redline(s) function.
  * Added place freehand linestring function.
  * Main redline toolbar is now [configurable](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Toolbars-and-buttons.html).
  * Improved support for text and symbol fonts whose names contains whitespace or other non-word characters. See [redline settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html) for more information and changes to the Portal settings.js file.

### Workset Monitor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#workset-monitor)
  * UI improvements: Refresh data button, sorting button (newest, oldest first), toolbar stays visible when scrolling.
  * Enhanced workset filtering. Supports property based filtering (selected properties) and filtering using SQL-like expression over all workset columns.

### Vector Rendering[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#vector-rendering)
  * Allow [customization of line height and offsets](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Map-display/Use-custom-font-metrics-to-fix-rendering-of-symbol-and-text-fonts.html) when rendering labels to match Core.

### Print[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#print)
  * Removed support for PhantomJS in printing. PhantomJS was last updated in 2016 and is replaced in print with the use of [Puppeteer](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Print/Use-Puppeteer-for-Print.html).
  * Added support for defining PPI per template.
  * Improved printing of vector polylines with scale-dependent width. Styles are scaled to match the PPI of the printed output.

### Attach CAD[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#attach-cad)
  * Configure predefined CSF file for uploaded CAD files (new parameter `ConvertCAD:DefaultCsf` in Work Service [configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Configuration.html)). End users don't need to upload CSF files together with CAD files if their projection matches the predefined CSF.

### Other improvements[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#other-improvements)
  * Disable Locatable checkbox once Visible checkbox is turned off in the legend.

### Technology[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#technology)
  * Upgraded OpenLayers to version 8.2.0.

### Deployment and configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#deployment-and-configuration)
  * Configure Portal with [preloaded fonts for label and symbol rendering](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Preload-fonts-when-deploying-Portal.html) to speed up rendering with proper fonts after opening Portal.
  * Set `SameSite` and `Secure` attribute of cookies to satisfy security requirements. Configuration is possible via [appSettings and connectionStrings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file/appSettings-and-connectionStrings.html).

## Services[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#services)
### Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#vector-service)
  * Added query parameter `resolution` to [Features](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features.html) and [Geometry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry.html) API to enable external control over arc densification in geometries returned in GeoJSON. Default resolution is [configurable](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Configuration.html) using `GeoJSON:Resolution` parameter.
  * Honor environment variable `NW_DDC_TEXT_POINT_ENCODING` for encoding of TextPoint text values in DDC files. This value supplements the `DDC:TextPointEncoding` configuration parameter (see Vector Service [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Configuration.html)).

### Feature Data Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#feature-data-service)
  * New [GetForeignKeyValuesForTabAttribute](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetForeignKeyValuesForTabAttribute.html) API, supporting Feature Editor foreign key query functionality.
  * New [TabAttributeAutoPopulate](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/TabAttributeAutoPopulate.html) API, supporting Feature Editor dialog tab attribute auto-population.
  * Added triggerset metadata to [GetDialogTabMetadata](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Metadata/GetDialogTabMetadata.html) API.

### Feature Transaction Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#feature-transaction-service)
  * New [GetJobAsWorkset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html) API to support job-workset integration in Feature Editor.

### Work Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#work-service)
  * Submitting worksets from Feature Editor: Trigger execution of functional interfaces on created or changed features in MapServer after submitting a workset. 
##### Note
AddNew Functional Interfaces are not supported.
  * Internal concurrency: Worker scheduling in Per-Request licensing mode: scheduling of workers was changed to allow running up to `MaxConcurrentRequests` of any worker at a time. Formerly, each worker required a separate license.

### Job Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#job-service)
  * [CreateJob](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CreateJob.html): Apply dialog attribute defaults for when creating job.

### Data Transfer Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#data-transfer-service)
  * Selective tracking of messages in post-processing after CommitTransaction (see `postProcessing:Rules:{ordinal}:Track` in [Configuration](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service/Configuration.html)).

### Dialog Web Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#dialog-web-service)
  * Return information about Node-Edge connectivity node in relationship API [FeatureRelationInfo](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Dialog-Web-Service/FeatureRelationInfo.html).

### Feature Model Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#feature-model-service)
  * Use new license names `nwweb_fms` and `nwweb_fmsw`.

### Mobile Data Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#mobile-data-service)
  * Use new license name `nwweb_mds`.

### Tools[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#tools)
  * [CreateDDCFileSubset.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/CreateDDCFileSubset.exe.html) now honors environment variable `NW_DDC_TEXT_POINT_ENCODING` when writing TextPoint geometries in secondary data files.

## General[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#general)
  * [Pass configurable OpenID Connect claim](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Data-Access/User-identifier-in-database-operations.html) value to Oracle session to identify the logged in OIDC user. This functionality enables tracking end user identity (provided by OIDC) in the database operations along current Oracle user identity.

## License[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2401.html#license)
  * Increased license version checked-out by the software to `11.12401`.
  * Licenses `nwweb_jobsview` and `nwweb_activejob` are no longer enforced by services when accessing data in job context. `nwweb_jobsview` is required by Job Service in read-only API.
  * Feature Data Service licenses changed to `nwweb_fds` or `nwweb_fds_c`.
  * Feature Transaction Servivce licenses changed to `nwweb_fts` or `nwweb_fts_c`.

# 2402
## Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#portal)
### Map Sources[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#map-sources)
  * Added support for [Google Tiles Map Source](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Google-Tiles-Map-Source.html).

### Feature Editor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#feature-editor)
  * It is now possible to open details/schematics associated with the features being edited within the feature editor. This functionality is available in the Attributes panel, Graphic components panel and Workset features panel.
  * Support has been added to allow users to place new, edit existing and delete graphic components from existing details/schematics. Before placement the G3E_FNO and G3E_CNO and validated against the mapping defined in `G3E_DETAILMAPPING`.
  * Table [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) has a new column `NWG_APPLICATION` which enables configuration of application-specific parameters in one database.

### Jobs[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#jobs)
  * Display list of pending edits.
  * Fit jobs edits in the map.

### Print[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#print)
  * Placement of map source attributions into the print template using a new value `attributions` for the `autovalue` type. New `CellVerticalAlignment` and `CellHorizontalAlignment` allow configuration of alignment of content in a table cell. See [Print Templates](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Print-Templates.html) for details.

### Technological stack[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#technological-stack)
  * Upgraded OpenLayers to 10.1 and Proj4js to 2.12.

## Services[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#services)
### General[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#general)
  * Services honor environment variable `NW_LCID` for determination of LCID value for metadata and culture. This value overrides the LCID determined from current user's regional settings. It is useful in cases where the user's regional settings don't have a proper LCID (e.g. English (Germany)).

### Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#vector-service)
  * New API endpoint to retrieve features which are spatially related to a polygon geometry provided in request. See [Get features in area](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-features-in-area.html) for details.
  * New API endpoints to retrieve extent (bounding box) of geometries specified in the request. The new APIs complement the existing [Geometry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry.html) APIs.

### Feature Data Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#feature-data-service)
  * New API [GetDetailOwners](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Metadata/GetDetailOwners.html) to retrieve list of G3E_FNOs which can own a detail or schematic.
  * New API [GetListOfDetails](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Data-Service/Data/GetListOfDetails.html) to retrieve list of detail or schematic windows by search criteria.

### Feature Transaction Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#feature-transaction-service)
  * Map OpenID Connect user claims and environment information to feature attributes. See [Map user properties to attributes](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Dialog-Web-Services/Map-user-properties-to-attributes.html)) and [NWG_CONTEXTPROPERTY](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_CONTEXTPROPERTY.html).

### Workspace Administration Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#workspace-administration-service)
  * Workspace Administration application supports confidential OpenID Connect clients (i.e. with client secret) and Authentication Code flow. Up until this version the application only supported the Implicit flow which requires usage of a public OpenID Connect client and is inherently less secure.
  * Workspace Administration application and Workspace Admin Service for maintenance of Portal workspaces were merged into one package and are deployed together.

### Licensing[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#licensing)
  * Implemented bulk check-out of licenses in Per-Request mode (`_c` licenses). This speeds up service start-up time. If the requested number of licenses cannot be checked out, the license tries to check out at least one licenses.
  * Added new `MaxConcurrentRequestsWrite` parameter to Job Service and Dialog Web Service to enable checking out a different number of Per-Request licenses for read-only and read-write APIs. See [Licensing](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Licensing.html)) for details.

## Administration Console[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#administration-console)
### Service Deployment[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/changes/2402.html#service-deployment)
  * NetWorks Vector Service in Portal are configured with `RenderMaskSymbol` set to `true` automatically when deployed. The default value can be changed via [Common deployment settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Common-deployment-settings.html).
  * Configure common app. pool and application settings for all deployed services using [Common deployment settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Common-deployment-settings.html).

### portal

#### API

##### $NWP

# application
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/application.html#overview)
Represents the networks portal client application. Gives access to the client side databus, database and client services.
## database[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/application.html#database)
All portal settings and data are now stored in [indexeddb](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IndexedDB_API) which allows for more structure and greater amounts of data to be stored on the client. The database object is a wrapper around the indexeddb database which simplifies data access and filters records by the current workspace.
The portal uses the following tables:
  * aoi - reserved for future use.
  * configitem - cache for workspace configuration items.
  * legendentry - cache for user legend entries.
  * legendstate - cache for legend state snapshots.
  * savedquery - cache for my queries.
  * setting - cache for overriden settings.
  * state - cache for client state.
  * vectorresult - cache for query/analysis results
  * workspace - cache for workspaces.

## databus[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/application.html#databus)
The central messaging component.
## client()[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/application.html#client)
Returns a proxy client. These proxies to portal services.
## service()[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/application.html#service)
Returns a client service. These contain functionality for the portal.

###### features

# editor
Hooks for altering feature editor open and save functionality
## NWP.features.editor.continueLoad() ⇒ void[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditorcontinueload--void)
If the onbeforeload function returns false this function can be called to continue the load process.
## NWP.features.editor.continueSave() ⇒ void[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditorcontinuesave--void)
If the onbeforesave function returns false this function can be called to continue the save process.
## NWP.features.editor.onbeforeload[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditoronbeforeload)
Property that can be set to null or a function which takes one argument of type NWP.feature.Feature. The function is called before a feature is loaded into the editor. The properties of this feature can be altered and will be picked up by the feature editor. If the function returns false then the standard load will be stopped to allow for user defined operations to take place. When complete contineLoad() should be called to continue the loading operation.
## NWP.features.editor.onload[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditoronload)
Property that can be set to null or a function which takes one argument of type NWP.feature.GTechFeature. This allows for customizers to inspect the tabs, details and relationships being loaded. Attributes are loaded on tab selection.
## NWP.features.editor.onafterload[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditoronafterload)
Property that can be set to a function. Called after load process is complete. This allows for customizers to doing an post processing.
## NWP.features.editor.onbeforesave[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditoronbeforesave)
Property that can be set to null or a function which takes one argument of type NWP.feature.GTechSaveFeature. The function is called before a feature is saved. The properties of the feature can be altered and will be picked up by the feature editor. If the function returns false then the standard save will be stopped to allow for user defined operations to take place. When complete continueSaveAttributes() should be called to continue the save operation.
## NWP.features.editor.onsave[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditoronsave)
Property that can be set to null or a function which takes one argument of type boolean. The function is called after the save is complete. If the argument is true then the save was successful.
## NWP.features.editor.setLoading(isLoading) ⇒ void[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditorsetloadingisloading--void)
Sets the feature editor busy status. If isLoading is true then sets the editor to busy.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| isLoading  | `boolean`  | True to set the editor as busy, false to clear busy status.  |  
## NWP.features.editor.reload() ⇒ void[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features/editor.html#nwpfeatureseditorreload--void)
Reload the attributes into the editor from the server, overwriting any changes.
