## NWP.features.select([title], [fnos]) ⇒ `Promise`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features.html#nwpfeaturesselecttitle-fnos---promise)
Opens a feature selection dialog and returns a Promise which resolves with the selected feature when the user presses the 'Select Feature' button in the dialog.
Returns: `Promise` - A Promise that resolves with a NWP.feature.Feature objects.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| title  | `string`  | The title of dialog. Defaults to 'Select Feature'.  |  
| fnos  | `Array.<number>`  | An array of G3E_FNOs with which to filter the selection.  |  
## NWP.features.selectMultiple([title], [fnos], requestCallback)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features.html#nwpfeaturesselectmultipletitle-fnos-requestcallback)
Opens a feature selection dialog and calls provided callback with the selected feature as a parameter when the user presses the 'Select Feature' button in the dialog.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| title  | `string`  | The title of dialog. Defaults to `'Select Feature'`.  |  
| fnos  | `Array.<number>`  | An array of G3E_FNOs with which to filter the selection.  |  
| callback  | function  | Function that will be called after the user selects a feature. The selected feature is passed as an argument => `function (selectedFeature) { ... }`. If the function returns `false`, the selection window closes.  |  
## NWP.features.getSelectionSet() ⇒ `Array.<NWP.feature.Feature>`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features.html#nwpfeaturesgetselectionset--arraynwpfeaturefeature)

## NWP.features.setHyperlinkTest(regExp)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features.html#nwpfeaturessethyperlinktestregexp)
The portal uses a regular expression to determine if a hyperlink field contains an actual hyperlink and if so use the standard browser functionality to open the link. That regular expression is /^https?: /. If other custom protocols are registered with the browser this function can be used to replace the regular expression and allow the browser to function with these protocols.

Property that can be set to null or a function which takes one argument of type NWP.feature.Feature. The function is called before a feature is loaded into an editor. The properties of this feature can be altered and will be picked up by the feature editor. If the function returns false then the standard load will be stopped to allow for user defined operations to take place. ## NWP.features.onedit[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/features.html#nwpfeaturesonedit)
Property that can be set to null or a function which takes one argument of type NWP.feature.Feature. The function is called once the feature is loaded into an editor, note however, that the editor may not of completed loading when this function is called.

| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| msg  | `string`  | The text to display.  |  
| title  | `string`  | The title for the dialog. By default this is the application title i.e. 'NetWorks Portal'  |

## NWP.ogc.wfs.getCapabilitiesObject(args) ⇒ `Promise<object>`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc/wfs.html#nwpogcwfsgetcapabilitiesobjectargs--promiseobject)
Return GetCapabilities response from a WFS service parsed into a JavaScript object. This functionality uses OpenLayers [optionsFromCapabilities](https://openlayers.org/en/latest/apidoc/module-ol_source_WFS.html#.optionsFromCapabilities) function.

| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `NWP.map.source.WFS`  | WFS source parameters. `url` is mandatory.  |

```
$NWP.ogc.wfs.getCapabilitiesObject({
    url: "http://myserver/mywfs",
}).then(function(capabilities) {
    console.log(capabilities);
});

```

## NWP.ogc.wfs.getSourceOptionsFromCapabilities(args) ⇒ `Promise<object>`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc/wfs.html#nwpogcwfsgetsourceoptionsfromcapabilitiesargs--promiseobject)
Reads WFS capabilities from a service, parses the capabilities and returns initialization options for a `WFSSource`, which can be added dynamically to the Portal legend. The `args` contain filtering options.
Returns: `Promise<object>` - Promise with initialization options for a `WFSSource` source.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `NWP.map.source.WFS`  | WFS source parameters. `url` and 'featureType' are mandatory.  |  
**Important** This method does not analyze the structure of the feature type and does not detect the name of the property, which contains feature geometry. The geometry property name is required for advanced filtering operations. When needed, the `geometryName` and `geometryType` properties must be set explicitly by the caller.
See [Add WFS legend entry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WFS-legend-entry.html) for an example of using this function.

Return raw GetCapabilities response from a WMTS service.

```
$NWP.ogc.wmts.getCapabilities({

}).then(function(capabilitiesXml) {

```

## NWP.ogc.wmts.getCapabilitiesObject(args) ⇒ `Promise<object>`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc/wmts.html#nwpogcwmtsgetcapabilitiesobjectargs--promiseobject)
Return GetCapabilities response from a WMTS service parsed into a JavaScript object. This functionality uses OpenLayers [optionsFromCapabilities](https://openlayers.org/en/latest/apidoc/module-ol_source_WMTS.html#.optionsFromCapabilities) function.
Returns: `Promise<object>` - Promise with capabilities document parsed into a JavaScript object.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `NWP.map.source.WMTS`  | WMTS source parameters. `url1` is mandatory.  |  
### Example[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc/wmts.html#example-1)

```
$NWP.ogc.wmts.getCapabilitiesObject({
    url1: "http://server01/WmtsElectric/wmts",
}).then(function(capabilities) {
    console.log(capabilities);
});

```

## NWP.ogc.wmts.getSourceOptionsFromCapabilities(args) ⇒ `Promise<object>`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc/wmts.html#nwpogcwmtsgetsourceoptionsfromcapabilitiesargs--promiseobject)
Reads WMTS capabilities from a service, parses the capabilities and returns initialization options for a `WMTSSource`, which can be added dynamically to the Portal legend. The `args` contain filtering options if the WMTS supports more layers, tileMatrixes or formats.
Returns: `Promise<object>` - Promise with initialization options for a `WMTSSource` source.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `NWP.map.source.WMTS`  | WMTS source parameters. `url1` is mandatory.  |  
### Example - Parse capabilities, set custom extent and add WMTS dynamically to legend[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP/ogc/wmts.html#example---parse-capabilities-set-custom-extent-and-add-wmts-dynamically-to-legend)
In this example, the WMTS extent is set explicitly to fit into the extent of the view projection used by the Portal, which is smaller than the extent for EPSG:3857.

```
$NWP.ogc.wmts.getSourceOptionsFromCapabilities({
    url1: "http://server01/WmtsElectric/wmts",
    layer: "HIGH_VOLTAGE"
})
.then(function (sourceOpts) {
    sourceOpts.name = 'ext-wmts1';
    sourceOpts.userName = 'WMTS Electric';
    sourceOpts.extent = ol.proj.transformExtent([6, 45, 13, 54], 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857');

    $NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
        type: "source",
        source: sourceOpts,
        visible: true,
        name: "ext-wmts1"
    });
});

```

See also [Add WMTS legend entry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WMTS-legend-entry.html).

# $NWP
# Overview
The $NWP global has been extended with a number of methods to simplify integration. The functions described here are generic application level functions.
## $NWP.post(name, [data])[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwppostname-data)
Post notification to the application. Sends data to handlers registered with 'name'.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | The name of the notification.  |  
| [data]  | `Object`  | The data to send with the notification. The actual form of the data depends on 'name'.  |  
## $NWP.request(name, [args]) -> `Array.<Object>`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwprequestname-args---arrayobject)
Request data or invoke an action in the application. All handlers registered with 'name' will return a result.
**Returns** : `Array.<Object>` - The array of zero or more results.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | The name of the request.  |  
| [args]  | `Object`  | Additional parameters for the request.  |  
## $NWP.requestSingle(name, [args]) -> `Object` | `null`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwprequestsinglename-args---object--null)
Does the same as .request() but will only return the first result if there is one.
**Returns** : `Object` | `null` - The result.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | The name of the request.  |  
| [args]  | `Object`  | Additional parameters for the request.  |  
## $NWP.registerPostHandler(name, handler)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwpregisterposthandlername-handler)
DEPRECATED. Use on/un instead. Register a handler function for the named notification.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | Name of the notification.  |  
| handler  | `function`  | The actual handler. Should be a function which takes one parameter.  |  
## $NWP.on(name, listener, [thisArg])[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwponname-listener-thisarg)
Register a listener function for a notification.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | Name of the notification.  |  
| listener  | `function`  | The function to call when the notification occurs. Should be a function which takes one parameter.  |  
| [thisArg]  | `Object`  | The value to use as 'this' when calling the listener function.  |  
## $NWP.un(name, listener, [thisArg])[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwpunname-listener-thisarg)
Un-register a listener function for a notification.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | Name of the notification.  |  
| listener  | `function`  | The function to call when the notification occurs. Should be a function which takes one parameter.  |  
| [thisArg]  | `Object`  | The value to use as 'this' when calling the listener function.  |  
## $NWP.serviceRequest(args)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwpservicerequestargs)
Send a HTTP request to a registered portal service on the server. The response will be validated that it is JSON and it is the correct structure for portal services so this is not suitable for calling external services. Use 'serverRequest' instead in these cases.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `Object`  | The arguments for the request  |  
| args.serviceName  | `string`  | The name of the registered service. Required  |  
| [args.params]  | `Object`  | Key value pairs that will form the query string of the request.  |  
| [args.jsonData]  | `Object`  | JSON data to POST with the request.  |  
| args.callback  | `function`  | The function to call once the response is received. The callback is called with three parameters; jsonResult, XMLHttpResponse object and requestArgs.  |  
| [args.scope]  | `Object`  | The scope in which callback is called in.  |  
| [args.timeout]  | `number`  | The timeout for the request. As per default this is 30 seconds.  |  
## $NWP.serverRequest(args)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwpserverrequestargs)
Send a HTTP request. This is a more generic version of of service request. It is upto the callback function to validate the actual response data.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `Object`  | The arguments for the request. See <https://docs.sencha.com/extjs/6.7.0/classic/Ext.Ajax.html#method-request>  |  
## $NWP.fetchJson(args) -> `Promise`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwpfetchjsonargs---promise)
Send an HTTP request to a server and returns a Promise. If the request succeeds and the response is valid JSON then the promise will be resolved with the JSON response as parameter. Otherwise it will be rejected with an object containing two properties 'status' and 'message'.
**Returns** : `Promise` - A Promise object that resolves when the request returns successfully.  
| Param  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| args  | `Object`  | The arguments for the request.  |  
| [args.serviceName]  | `string`  | Name of the registered portal service. This or 'url' is required.  |  
| [args.url]  | `string`  | The url to send the request to. This or 'serviceName' is required.  |  
| [args.params]  | `Object`  | Optional key value pairs that will form the query string of the request.  |  
| [args.headers]  | `Object.<string, string>`  | Optional HTTP headers to add to the request.  |  
| [args.jsonData]  | `Object`  | Optional data which will form the request body. The object will be parsed as JSON and the request content type set to application/json. If 'method' is not set then the request method will be set to POST.  |  
| [args.method]  | `string`  | The HTTP method to use. Default is GET unless 'jsonData' is present then default is 'POST'.  |  
| [args.timeout]  | `number`  | The timeout for the request. As per default this is 30 seconds.  |  
| [args.username]  | `string`  | Optional user name for authentication purposes.  |  
| [args.password]  | `string`  | Optional password for authentication purposes.  |  
| [args.withCredentials]  | `boolean`  | Set to true to set the withCredentials property on the XHR object.  |  
| [args.hideError]  | `boolean`  | If the request results in an error then the default behaviour of the portal is to show a toast/popup informing the user that the request has failed. Set this to true to prevent this.  |  
## $NWP.createWindow(args, [title], [url], [height], [width], [x], [y]) -> `NWP.IFrameWindow`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/%24NWP.html#nwpcreatewindowargs-title-url-height-width-x-y---nwpiframewindow)

| [height]  | `number`  | Initial height of the window in pixels.  |

##### Examples

# Add in memory vector entry to legend
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-in-memory-vector-entry-to-legend.html#overview)
This example adds an in memory vector layer to the legend and updates its contents as the map viewport extent is modified from an external service.
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-in-memory-vector-entry-to-legend.html#configuration)
It is recommended that custom scripts are placed into a separate folder and published via IIS on the same origin as the Portal.
For example purposes copy the following script into a file with a .js extension under _portaldir_ /assets/js. Add a reference to the script in the workspace via the _scripts_ section e.g.

```
<Workspace name="default" username="Default>
    <Section type="scripts">
        <Script name="sc1">
            <Url>assets/js/addlocalvectorentry.js</Url>
        </Script>
    </Section>
</Workspace>

```

If you are manually changing the workspace xml file then the portals application pool needs to be recycled before changes can be loaded by the portal. Alternatively, restart IIS.
## Script[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-in-memory-vector-entry-to-legend.html#script)

```
/** URL to the WMS service. */
const URL_TEMPLATE = "proxy/networks/WfsElectricGINIUSANON/wfs?SERVICE=WFS&REQUEST=GetFeature&TYPENAME=V_E_CONSEG_30600_I_LN&SRSNAME=EPSG:5678&VERSION=1.1.0";
const MAX_RESOLUTION = 0.5;

/** Simple controller to automatically add a local vector entry geographic legends
 * and load data into as the map extent is changed. 
 */
class LocalVectorLegendController {

    _onLegendChanged;
    _onMapViewChanged;
    _currentSource;
    _format;

    constructor() {
        // Format object to convert service data into open layers features.
        this._format = new ol.format.WFS({
            featureNS: "http://www.intergraph.com/infrastructure/gml",
            featureType: "V_E_CONSEG_30600_I_LN",
            version: "1.1.0"
        });
        // Bind handlers to 'this'
        this._onLegendChanged = this.onLegendChanged.bind(this);
        this._onMapViewChanged = this.onMapViewChanged.bind(this);
        this.start();
    }
    /** Start the controller */
    start() {
        console.log("LocalVector legend controller started");
        $NWP.on("maplegendchanged", this._onLegendChanged);
    }
    /** Return open layers style for the source. */
    getStyle() {
        const stroke = new ol.style.Stroke({
            width: 2,
            color: "#FF0000"
        });
        const fill = new ol.style.Fill({
            color: "#FF000080"
        })
        const point = new ol.style.Circle({
            fill: fill,
            stroke: stroke,
            radius: 8
        });
        return new ol.style.Style({
            stroke: stroke,
            fill: fill,
            image: point
        });
    }
    /**
     * Abort controller
     */
    getAbortController() {
        if (!this._abortController || this._abortController.signal.aborted) {
            this._abortController = new AbortController();
        }
        return this._abortController;
    }
    /**
     * Do the actual service request.
     */
    async fetchData(extent) {
        // Ensure we only have one active request at any time.
        if (this._activeAbortController) {
            this._activeAbortController.abort();
        }
        this._activeAbortController = this.getAbortController();
        const url = `${URL_TEMPLATE}&BBOX=${extent.join(",")}`;
        const response = await fetch(url, {
            signal: this._activeAbortController.signal
        });
        const data = await response.text();
        this._activeAbortController = null;
        return data;
    }
    /**
     * Fetch data from the extenal service. Format it into features and load them.
     */
    async loadData(extent) {

        try {
            const data = await this.fetchData(extent);
            const features = this._format.readFeatures(data);
            console.log(features);
            // Source is an ol.source.Vector
            const source = this._currentSource;
            source.clear(true);
            source.addFeatures(features);

        } catch (e) {
            console.log(e);
            // Ignore errors
        }
    }
    /**
     * Process legend changes and add the WMS entry as required.
     */
    async onLegendChanged(legendArgs) {
        console.log("Legend changed");
        $NWP.un("mapviewupdated", this._onMapViewChanged);
        if (legendArgs.legendType !== 'detail' && legendArgs.legendType !== 'schematic') {
            this._currentExtent = null;
            // Check to see if we have already added the layer
            // Note that they are keyed on source name not source entry name.
            let mapLayer = $NWP.map.getMapLayers().find(l => l.name === 'customlocalvectorsource');
            if (!mapLayer) {
                // Else add it
                const sourceOpts = {
                    type: "localvector",
                    name: "customlocalvectorsource",
                    userName: "Custom vector source",
                    projection: "EPSG:5678",
                    featureUserNameFormatString: "{ToolTip}",
                    style: this.getStyle(),
                    useVectorImage: true
                }
                mapLayer = await $NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
                    type: "source",
                    source: sourceOpts,
                    drawingPriority: 15,
                    maxResolution: MAX_RESOLUTION,
                    visible: true,
                    queryable: true,
                    printable: true,
                    scope: 2,
                    name: `customlocalvectorlayer`,
                    userName: "My vector layer"
                });
                
            }
            this._currentSource = mapLayer.layer.getSource();
            const viewState = $NWP.map.getViewState();
            if (viewState.resolution <= MAX_RESOLUTION) {
                await this.loadData(viewState.extent);
            }
            $NWP.on("mapviewupdated", this._onMapViewChanged);
        } else {
            this._currentSource = null;
        }
    }
    /** On map view change load new data if applicable */
    onMapViewChanged(viewArgs) {
        console.log("View changed");
        if (this._currentSource && viewArgs.resolution <= MAX_RESOLUTION) {
            this.loadData(viewArgs.extent);
        }
    }
    /** Stop the controller. */
    stop() {
        $NWP.un("maplegendchanged", this._onLegendChanged);
        $NWP.un("mapviewupdated", this._onMapViewChanged);
        this._currentSource = null;
        console.log("Legend controller stopped.");
    }
}
// Instantiate controller immediately.
const controller = new LocalVectorLegendController();

```

This is an advanced example is based loading data from a NetWorks WFS source, it is intended as food for thought rather than an actual working example.
Note the scope cannot be set to 1 if you are using open layers styles directly. See [Add WFS legend entry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WFS-legend-entry.html) for an alternative way of defining styles.

# Add Networks Vector legend entry
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-Networks-Vector-legend-entry.html#overview)
The following demonstrates the data structures used adding a Networks Vector service legend entry, optionally with a filter.

```
$NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
    type: "source",
    source: {
        url: "proxy/networks/VectorServiceGINIUSANON",
        projection: "EPSG:5678",
        lsno: 7,
        editorName: "networksEditor",
        enableTooltips: true,
        minimumLineWidth: 1.0,
        type: "NetworksVector",
        paperScale: 500.0,
        renderMaskSymbols: true,
        enableComponentTooltips: true,
        dynamic: true,
        name: "customvectorsource",
        userName: "Custom Vector Source"
    },
    drawingPriority: 10,
    visible: true,
    queryable: false,
    scope: 2,
    name: "customvectorlayer",
    userName: "Custom Vector Layer",
    layers: [{
        name: "3060000",
        userName: "Ele-Conductor Segment-LV-Conductor Segment - Inventory",
        visible: true,
        queryable: true,
        type: "layer",
        id: "300015010",
	filter: {
            G3E_FID: {
                type: 'and',
                filters: [{
                    type: 'gte',
                    value: 1029940
                }, {
                    type: 'lte',
                    value: 1029999
                }]
            }
        }			
    }]
})

```

Note that for the NetWorks Vector service the layer name needs to be set to the leno of the GTech legend entry. The id is set to the dcrowno but that is optional.
Currently its not possible for a user to modify a filter added via the API.

# Add WFS legend entry
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WFS-legend-entry.html#overview)
This is an example of adding all available feature types from a WFS, under a single folder when the user clicks a button.
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WFS-legend-entry.html#configuration)
It is recommended that custom scripts are placed into a separate folder and published via IIS on the same origin as the Portal.
For example purposes copy the following script into a file with a .js extension under _portaldir_ /assets/js. Add a reference to the script in the workspace via the _scripts_ section e.g.

```
<Workspace name="default" username="Default>

        </Script>
    </Section>
</Workspace>

```

Modify the 'toolbar' function by adding an action button at the end

```
<Function name="toolbar">

              <JValue>sidebarcollapse</JValue>
              <JValue>mapselectmenu</JValue>

Note that the standard version of [font awesome](https://fontawesome.com/) is distributed with the portal. Its icons can be accessed by prefixing the icon name with 'x-fa fa-'. Open the browser console to view the output.
If you are manually changing the workspace xml file then the portals application pool needs to be recycled before changes can be loaded by the portal. Alternatively, restart IIS.
## Script[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WFS-legend-entry.html#script)

```
/** URL to the WFS service. */
const CUSTOM_WFS_URL = "http://muc-vnrel01/WfsElectricGINIUSANON/wfs";

/** Simple controller to automatically add legend entries to geographic legends. */
class WfsLegendController {
    _handler;
    constructor() {
        this._handler = this.onActionButtonPress.bind(this);
        this.start();
    }
    /** Start the controller */
    start() {
        console.log("WFS Legend controller started");
        $NWP.on("actionbuttonpress", this._handler);
    }
    onActionButtonPress(args) {
        console.log("Action button press")
        if (args.name === 'customaddwfs') {
            this.addWFSEntry();
        }
    }
    getStyle() {
        const stroke = new ol.style.Stroke({
            width: 2,
            color: "#FF0000"
        });
        const fill = new ol.style.Fill({
            color: "#FF000080"
        })
        const point = new ol.style.Circle({
            fill: fill,
            stroke: stroke,
            radius: 8
        });
        return new ol.style.Style({
            stroke: stroke,
            fill: fill,
            image: point
        });
    }
    /**
     * Process legend changes and add the WMS entry as required.
     */
    async addWFSEntry() {
        console.log("Add WFS Entry started...")
        const capabilities = await $NWP.ogc.wfs.getCapabilitiesObject({
            url: CUSTOM_WFS_URL
        });
        const folder = {
            name: "customWfsFolder",
            userName: "Custom WFS",
            expanded: true
        };
        let count = 0;
        for (const featureType of capabilities.FeatureTypeList) {            
            const sourceOpts = await $NWP.ogc.wfs.getSourceOptionsFromCapabilities({
                url: CUSTOM_WFS_URL,
                featureType: featureType.Name
            });
            sourceOpts.name = featureType.Name;            
            sourceOpts.useVectorImage = true;
            sourceOpts.enableTooltips = true;
            sourceOpts.style = this.getStyle2();
            await $NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
                type: "source",
                source: sourceOpts,                
                drawingPriority: 15,
                visible: true,
                queryable: true,
                printable: true,
                scope: 1,
                name: `layer-${featureType.Name}`,
                userName: featureType.UserName
            }, folder);
            count += 1;
        }
        console.log(`Added ${count} entries.`);
        console.log("Add WFS Entry complete.");
    }
    /** Stop the controller. */
    stop() {
        $NWP.un("actionbuttonpress", this._handler);
        console.log("WFS Legend controller stopped.");
    }
}
// Instantiate controller immediately.
const controller = new WfsLegendController();

```

Note that CUSTOM_WFS_URL needs to be changed to the URL of an available WFS service.
Note also that its not currently possible to use open layers styles or style functions and have scope equal to 1. You can however set scope to 1 and use workspace data structures for styling e.g.

```
    getStyle() {
        return {
            stroke: {
                width: 2,
                color: [255,0,0]
            },
            fill: {
                color: [255,0,0,0.5]
            },
            circle: {
                stroke: {
                    width: 2,
                    color: [255,0,0]
                },
                fill: {
                    color: [255,0,0,0.5]
                },
                radius: 8
            }
        }
    }

```

See [WFS Source](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/WFS-Source.html) for more details.

# Add WMS legend entry
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WMS-legend-entry.html#overview)
This shows an example of automatically adding a WMS legend entry to the Portal legend when the legend is changed..
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WMS-legend-entry.html#configuration)
It is recommended that custom scripts are placed into a separate folder and published via IIS on the same origin as the Portal.
For example purposes copy the following script into a file with a .js extension under _portaldir_ /assets/js. Add a reference to the script in the workspace via the _scripts_ section e.g.

```
<Workspace name="default" username="Default>
    <Section type="scripts">
        <Script name="sc1">
            <Url>assets/js/addwmsentry.js</Url>
        </Script>
    </Section>
</Workspace>

```

If you are manually changing the workspace xml file then the portals application pool needs to be recycled before changes can be loaded by the portal. Alternatively, restart IIS.
## Script[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WMS-legend-entry.html#script)

```
/** URL to the WMS service. */
const CUSTOM_WMS_URL = "http://myserver/mywms";
/** WMS services projecion. */
const CUSTOM_WMS_PROJ = "EPSG:3857";

/** Simple controller to automatically add legend entries to geographic legends. */
class LegendController {
    _handler;
    constructor() {
        this._handler = this.onLegendChanged.bind(this);
        this.start();
    }
    /** Start the controller */
    start() {
        console.log("Legend controller started");        
        $NWP.on("maplegendchanged", this._handler);
    }
    /**
     * Process legend change and add the WMS entry as required.
     */
    async onLegendChanged(legendArgs) {
        console.log("Legend changed");
        console.log(legendArgs);
        if (legendArgs.legendType !== 'detail' && legendArgs.legendType !== 'schematic') {
            const legendState = $NWP.map.getLegendState();
            // Check to see if we have already added it.
            const layer = legendState.layers.find(l => l.name === 'customWmsLayer');
            if (!layer) {
                await $NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
                    "type": "source",
                    "allLayers": true,
                    "source": {
                        "url1": CUSTOM_WMS_URL,
                        "projection": CUSTOM_WMS_PROJ,
                        "singleTile": true,
                        "exceptions": "XML",
                        "type": "WMS",
                        "dynamic": true,
                        "name": "customWmsSource",
                        "userName": "My Custom Source"
                    },
                    "drawingPriority": 15,
                    "visible": true,
                    "queryable": true,
                    "printable": true,
                    "scope": 2,
                    "name": "customWmsLayer"
                })
                console.log("WMS Layer added");
            }
        }
    }
    /** Stop the controller. */
    stop() {
        $NWP.un("maplegendchanged", this._handler);
        console.log("Legend controller stopped."); 
    }
}
// Instantiate controller immediately.
const controller = new LegendController();

```

Note that you will need to edit CUSTOM_WMS_URL and CUSTOM_WMS_PROJ to match an available WMS service.

## Script[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Add-WMTS-legend-entry.html#script)

```
/** URL to the WFS service. */
const CUSTOM_WMTS_URL = "http://muc-vnrel01/WmtsElectricGINIUSANON/wmts";

/** Simple controller to automatically add legend entries to geographic legends. */
class WmtsLegendController {
    _handler;
    constructor() {
        this._handler = this.onActionButtonPress.bind(this);
        this.start();
    }
    /** Start the controller */
    start() {
        console.log("WMTS Legend controller started");
        $NWP.on("actionbuttonpress", this._handler);
    }
    onActionButtonPress(args) {
        console.log("Action button press")
        if (args.name === 'customaddwmts') {
            this.addWMTSEntry();
        }
    }
    /**
     * Process legend changes and add the WMS entry as required.
     */
    async addWMTSEntry() {
        console.log("Add WMTS Entry started...")
        const capabilities = await $NWP.ogc.wmts.getCapabilitiesObject({
            url1: CUSTOM_WMTS_URL
        });
        const folder = {
            name: "customWmtsFolder",
            userName: "Custom WMTS",
            expanded: true
        };
        let count = 0;        
        for (const layer of capabilities.Contents.Layer) {
            const sourceOpts = await $NWP.ogc.wmts.getSourceOptionsFromCapabilities({
                url1: CUSTOM_WMTS_URL,
                layer: layer.Identifier
            });
            sourceOpts.name = layer.Identifier;            
            await $NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
                type: "source",
                group: "customWmtsFolder",
                source: sourceOpts,
                drawingPriority: 15,
                visible: true,                
                printable: true,
                scope: 2,
                name: `layer-${layer.Identifier}`,
                userName: layer.Title
            }, folder);
            count += 1;
        }
        console.log(`Added ${count} entries.`);
        console.log("Add WMTS Entry complete.");
    }
    /** Stop the controller. */
    stop() {
        $NWP.un("actionbuttonpress", this._handler);
        console.log("WMTS Legend controller stopped.");
    }
}
// Instantiate controller immediately.
const controller = new WmtsLegendController();

```

Note that CUSTOM_WMTS_URL needs to be changed to the URL of an available WMTS service. This implementation assumes that the capabilities document will contain a Contents/Layer section which some WMTS services do not publish.

# Initializing legends
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Initializing-legends.html#overview)
Some legend properties cannot be configured via the workspace currently, the following scripts show how they can be configured via the API.
## Set vector service filters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Initializing-legends.html#set-vector-service-filters)
### Example legend[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Initializing-legends.html#example-legend)

```
<Legend name="default" username="Default">
   <View>
      ...
   </View>
   <Entries>
      <SourceEntry>
         <Id>vector0</Id>
         <Name>vector0</Name>
         <UserName>Electric</UserName>
         <SourceName>vector-giniusanon</SourceName>
         <DrawingPriority>10</DrawingPriority>
         <Entries>
            <FolderEntry>
               <Id>300014000</Id>
               <Name>300014000</Name>
               <UserName>Low Voltage</UserName>
               <Entries>
                  <LayerEntry>
                     <Visible>True</Visible>
                     <Queryable>True</Queryable>
                     <Id>300015010</Id>
                     <Name>3060000</Name>
                     <UserName>Conductor</UserName>
                  </LayerEntry>
               </Entries>
            </FolderEntry>
         </Entries> 
      </SourceEntry>
   </Entries>
</Legend>

```

Note that you need to set the 'Id' property of legend entries. The portal will automatically add one if its not defined. The 'Id' property of the legend entry must be unique for all entries in the legend. By default the 'Id' property for entries under a Networks Vector source entry are set to the G3E_DCROWNO value from GTech but in principle can be anything. The 'Name' property for layer entries under a Networks Vector source entry however, must be set to a valid G3E_LENO.
### Setting a legend filter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Initializing-legends.html#setting-a-legend-filter)
Setting a legend filter is only valid for folder entries and layer entries under a Networks Vector source entry. The code for doing so is as follows:

```
$NWP.map.setLegendState({id: 'entryId', filter: { filter definition }}); 

```

You can also set filters for multiple entries as follows:

```
$NWP.map.setLegendState([{id: 'entryId1', filter: { filter definition 1}},
   {id: 'entryId2', filter: { filter definition 2}}
]); 

```

To clear a filter or filters the code is the same. You simply need to set the filter property to null as follows:

```
$NWP.map.setLegendState({id: 'entryId', null}); 

```

Filters are applied immediately and the map will update automatically. If you set a filter on a folder entry it will be applied to all sub entries automatically. Be aware, however, that if you do this you should only apply filters to attribute names that are common for all descendant layer entries. You can use the vector service **GetFilterAttributesForDCNode** function to get a list of valid attribute names plus other metadata.
### Filter definition[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Initializing-legends.html#filter-definition)
A filter is a simple javascript object {} that maps attribute names to predicate e.g.

```
$NWP.map.setLegendState({id: 'entryId', {STATE: predicate }); 

```

A predicate is a simple javascript object that must have a type property which must be set to one of the following values. Depending on the value of type the object must define one other property.  
| type  | operator  | applies to  | example  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| eq  | =  | number, string, date, boolean  | { type: 'eq', value: 123 }  |  
| ne  | !=  | number, string, date, boolean  | { type: 'eq', value: 123 }  |  
| lt  | <  | number, date  | { type: 'lt', value: 123 }  |  
| gt  | >  | number, date  | { type: 'gt', value: 123 }  |  
| lte  | <=  | number, date  | { type: 'lte', value: 123 }  |  
| gte  | >=  | number, date  | { type: 'gte', value: 123 }  |  
| in  |   | picklists  | { type: 'in', values: ['1','2','3'] }  |  
| like  | like  | string  | { type: 'like', value: 'abc*' }  |  
| notlike  | !like  | string  | {type: 'notlike', value: 'abc*'}  |  
| and  | and  | predicates  | { type: 'and', filters: [{ type: 'gt', value: 1 }, { type: 'lt', value: 10 }]  |  
| or  | or  | predicates  | { type: 'or', filters: [{ type: 'eq', value: 1 }, { type: 'eq', value: 2 }, { type: 'eq', value: 3 }]  |  
A full example

```
$NWP.map.setLegendState({id: '300014000', filter: 
{
    G3E_FID: {
        type: 'and',
        filters: [{
                type: 'gte',
                value: 3
            }, {
                type: 'lte',
                value: 25
            }
        ]
    },
    PLANNING_ID: {
        type: 'like',
        value: 'abc*'
    },
    STATE: {
        type: 'in',
        values: ['1', '11', '12', '13', '14', '15']
    }
}}); 

```

The filter can then be cleared using:

```
$NWP.map.setLegendState({id: '300014000', filter: null});

```

# Override feature selection behaviour
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Override-feature-selection-behaviour.html#overview)
The following script illustrates how to disable default feature tab selection behavior allowing one to inspect user selections which could be used to open a custom editor for a feature or start other processes in parallel.
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Override-feature-selection-behaviour.html#configuration)
It is recommended that custom scripts are placed into a separate folder and published via IIS on the same origin as the Portal.
For example purposes copy the following script into a file with a .js extension under _portaldir_ /assets/js. Then add a reference to the script in the workspace via the _scripts_ section e.g.

```
<Workspace name="default" username="Default>
    <Section type="scripts">
        <Script name="sc1">
            <Url>assets/js/overridefeatureselection.js</Url>
        </Script>
    </Section>
</Workspace>

```

## Script[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Override-feature-selection-behaviour.html#script)

```
/** Simple controller to do custom processing of user feature selection. */
class EditorController {
    _handler;
    constructor() {

        this._handler = this.onFeatureSelected.bind(this);
        // Have to wait until the workspace is ready before you can disable
        // feature selection behavior
        if ($NWP.workspace.ready()) {            
            this.start();
        } else {
            // Wait for start
            $NWP.on("workspaceready", this.start.bind(this));
        }
        
    }
    /** 
     * Start the controller.
     * Add notification handler for user feature selection. 
     */
    start() {
        console.log("Editor controller started");
        // Disable default feature selection behavior
        $NWP.features.setEditorDisabled(true);
        $NWP.on("featureselected", this._handler);
    }
    /**
     * Process the selected feature and open the appropriate editor
     */
    onFeatureSelected(feature) {
        console.log("onFeatureSelected");
        console.log(feature);
        // Here we just do the default action;
        $NWP.features.edit(feature);
    }
    /** Stop the controller. */
    stop() {        
        // Enable default feature selection behavior
        $NWP.features.setEditorDisabled(false);
        $NWP.un("featureselected", this._handler);
        console.log("Editor controller stopped."); 
    }
}
// Instantiate controller immediately.
const controller = new EditorController();

```

## The script[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Show-API-notifications.html#the-script)

```
class ShowNotifications {
    constructor() {
        this.start();
    }
    start() {
        this.registerHandlers();
    }

        this.unregisterHandlers();
    }
    registerHandlers() {
        var me = this;

        $NWP.on('actionbuttonpress', me.onAction, me);
        $NWP.on('mapactionbuttonpress', me.onMapAction, me);
        $NWP.on('drawactionbuttonpress', me.onDrawAction, me);
        $NWP.on('featureactionbuttonpress', me.onFeatureAction, me);

        $NWP.on('maplegendupdated', me.onMapLegendUpdated, me);

        $NWP.on('gtechfeatureload', me.onGtechFeatureLoad, me);
	$NWP.on('gtechjobschanged', me.onGtechJobsChanged, me);
	$NWP.on('sidebarpanelupdating', me.onSidebarPanelUpdating, me);
        $NWP.on('sidebarpanelupdated', me.onSidebarPanelUpdated, me);

    unregisterHandlers() {

        $NWP.un('actionbuttonpress', me.onAction, me);
        $NWP.un('mapactionbuttonpress', me.onMapAction, me);
        $NWP.un('drawactionbuttonpress', me.onDrawAction, me);
        $NWP.un('featureactionbuttonpress', me.onFeatureAction, me);

        $NWP.un('featureselectclear', me.onFeatureSelectClear, me);
        $NWP.un('mapviewupdated', me.onMapViewUpdated, me);
        $NWP.un('maplegendchanged', me.onMapLegendChanged, me);

        $NWP.un('gtechfeatureload', me.onGtechFeatureLoad, me);
	$NWP.un('gtechjobschanged', me.onGtechJobsChanged, me);
	$NWP.un('sidebarpanelupdating', me.onSidebarPanelUpdating, me);
        $NWP.un('sidebarpanelupdated', me.onSidebarPanelUpdated, me);
    }
    onAction(args) {

    }

        console.log('drawactionbuttonpress');
        console.log(args);
    }

# Using feature editor hooks
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Using-feature-editor-hooks.html#overview)
The following scripts demonstrate how you can use the feature editor hooks to modify the standard behavior of the feature editor.
## To apply[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Using-feature-editor-hooks.html#to-apply)
The examples require two different editor configurations named 'read' and 'write'. Define them in the workspace as follows:

```
<Section type="editor">
    <GtdwsEditor name="readonly" username="Readonly">
        <ReviewConfig>
            <Config>
                <JProperty name="items">
                    <!--Remove edit buttons from menu-->
                    <JArray>
                        <JValue>editorreload</JValue>
                        <JValue>editoropendetails</JValue>
                        <JValue>tbfill</JValue>
                        <JValue>featurefit</JValue>
                        <JValue>close</JValue>
                    </JArray>
                </JProperty>
            </Config>
        </ReviewConfig>
        <EditConfig>
            <Type>Review</Type>
            <!-- Force editable features to use Review -->
            <Config>
                <JProperty name="items">
                    <!--Remove edit buttons from menu-->
                    <JArray>
                        <JValue>editorreload</JValue>
                        <JValue>editoropendetails</JValue>
                        <JValue>tbfill</JValue>
                        <JValue>featurefit</JValue>
                        <JValue>close</JValue>
                    </JArray>
                </JProperty>
            </Config>
        </EditConfig>
    </GtdwsEditor>
    <GtdwsEditor name="write" username="Write">
        <ReviewConfig>
            <!--For features which GTech says cannot be edited -->
            <Config>
                <JProperty name="items">
                    <!--Remove edit buttons from menu-->
                    <JArray>
                        <JValue>editorreload</JValue>
                        <JValue>editoropendetails</JValue>
                        <JValue>tbfill</JValue>
                        <JValue>featurefit</JValue>
                        <JValue>close</JValue>
                    </JArray>
                </JProperty>
            </Config>
        </ReviewConfig>
        <!-- We use the default edit config -->
    </GtdwsEditor>
</Section>

```

## Require active job[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Using-feature-editor-hooks.html#require-active-job)
By checking if an active job has been set you can force the feature editor into readonly mode or write mode if the feature is editable.

```
// Call this function in the browser console to require an active job before the save is
// Enabled.
function requireActiveJob() {
	$NWP.features.editor.onbeforeload = function (feature) {
		if (!$NWP.jobs.getActiveJob()) {
			feature.editorName = 'readonly';
		} else {
			feature.editorName = 'write';
		}
	}
}

```

## Switch between review and edit[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Using-feature-editor-hooks.html#switch-between-review-and-edit)
Configure map sources to use the readonly editor configuration e.g.

```
<NetworksVectorSource name="vector-giniusanon" username="All (Vector)">
    <Url>http://muc-sgiv-ndev01/VectorServiceGINIUSANON</Url>
    <Lsno>7</Lsno>
    <EditorName>readonly</EditorName>
</NetworksVectorSource>

```

By adding an action button to the feature editor you can assign a function which reloads the feature editor and changes whether it is readonly or write.

```
function switchReviewEdit(edit) {
	$NWP.features.editor.onbeforeload = function (feature) {
		if (edit) {
			feature.editorName = 'write';
		} else {
			feature.editorName = 'readonly';
		}
	}
	$NWP.features.editor.reload(); //Note that if the user has edits they will be lost
}

```

## Async feature load and save[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Using-feature-editor-hooks.html#async-feature-load-and-save)
Configure map sources to use the readonly editor configuration.
The following examples show how you can interrupt the load and save operations can asynchronously be continued, allowing you to call other services and wait for their responses.

```
// Call this function in the browser console to simulate an asynchronous load.
function asyncEditorLoadOp() {
	$NWP.features.editor.onbeforeload = function (feature) {
		console.log('onbeforeload');
		// Do some operation i.e. validate the user for edit.
		$NWP.features.editor.setLoading(true); // Show the user that you're doing something.
		setTimeout(function () {
			// We're only allowed to edit conductor segments.
			if (feature.properties.G3E_FNO === 306) {
				feature.editorName = 'write';
			} else {
				feature.editorName = 'readonly';
			}
			console.log('continueload');
			$NWP.features.editor.continueLoad();
		}, 3000);
		return false;
	}
	$NWP.features.editor.onload = function (editorFeature) {
		console.log('onload');
	}
	$NWP.features.editor.onafterload = function (editorFeature) {
		console.log('onafterload');
                $NWP.features.editor.setLoading(false);
	}
}
// Call this function in the browser console to simulate an asynchronous save.
function asyncEditorSaveOp() {
	$NWP.features.editor.onbeforeload = function (feature) {
		feature.editorName = 'write';
	}
	$NWP.features.editor.onbeforesave = function (attributes) {
		// Do some operation i.e. create a job
		$NWP.features.editor.setLoading(true); // Show the user that you're doing something.
		setTimeout(function () {
			console.log('continuesave');
			//$NWP.jobs.setActiveJob(jobId);
			$NWP.features.editor.continueSave();
		}, 3000)
		return false;
	}
	$NWP.features.editor.onsave = function (success) {
		console.log('editor.onsave');
		$NWP.features.editor.setLoading(true); // Show the user that you're doing something.
		if (success) {
			// Post job and clear
			setTimeout(function () {
				$NWP.features.editor.setLoading(false);
				$NWP.jobs.clear();
				console.log('Job posted');
			}, 3000);
		} else {
			// Discard and clear
			setTimeout(function () {
				$NWP.features.editor.setLoading(false);
				$NWP.jobs.clear();
				console.log('Job dicarded');
			}, 3000);
		}
	}
}

```

# Examples
## Get a feature and highlight and edit it[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples.html#get-a-feature-and-highlight-and-edit-it)

```
$NWP.features.fetchGTechFeatures({G3E_FNO: 306, G3E_FID: 1030609}).then(function(result) {
   if (result.success) {
	$NWP.features.highlight(result.data, true);
        $NWP.features.edit(result.data[0]);
   }
});

```

## Get a map click[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples.html#get-a-map-click)

```
$NWP.map.drawGeometry($NWP.map.geometryType.POINT).then(function(result) {console.log(result)});

```

## Do stuff with redlines[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples.html#do-stuff-with-redlines)

```
var features = $NWP.redlines.get();
$NWP.redlines.clear();
if (features.length > 0) {
	$NWP.redlines.load(features);
	$NWP.redlines.fit();
}

```

## Open an iframe dialog[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples.html#open-an-iframe-dialog)

```
var win = $NWP.createWindow({title: 'Foo', height: 500, width: 500, url: '/websites/foo.html'});
win.show();
var f = win.getFrame();
win.setUrl('/websites/edit.svg');
win.collapse();
//win.hide();

```

## Add an in memory vector layer to the map legend[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples.html#add-an-in-memory-vector-layer-to-the-map-legend)

```
/** Copies current redlines into a custom vector layer */
(async function copyRedlines() {
	
	const redlines = $NWP.redlines.get();
	if (redlines.length === 0) {
		console.log("No redlines to copy.");
		return;
	}
    
	let mapLayer = $NWP.map.getMapLayers().find(l => l.name === "customvectorsource");
	if (!mapLayer) {
		const strokeStyle = new ol.style.Stroke({
			color: "#0000FF",
			width: 5
		});
		const fillStyle = new ol.style.Fill({
			color: "#0000FF80"
		});
		const pointStyle = new ol.style.Circle({
			stroke : strokeStyle,
			fill: fillStyle,
			radius: 10
		})
		const style = new ol.style.Style({
			stroke: strokeStyle,
			fill: fillStyle,
			image: pointStyle
		});
		const proj = $NWP.map.getViewState().projection;
		
		mapLayer = await $NWP.map.addSourceEntry({
			type: "source",
			name: "customsourceentry",
			userName: "My Layer",
			drawingPriority: 101,
			visible: true,
			queryable: true,
			style: style,
			source: {
				type: "localvector",
				name: "customvectorsource",
				userName: "My source",
				projection: proj,
				printable: true
			}
		});
	}
	const olLayer = mapLayer.layer;
	const fmt = new ol.format.GeoJSON();
	olLayer.getSource().addFeatures(fmt.readFeatures({type: "FeatureCollection", features: redlines}));
	$NWP.redlines.clear();		
})()

```

# Notifications
The following are the available notifications for which you can register a handler for.  
| Name  | Data  | Remark  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| actionbuttonpress  | [NWP.NameArgs](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions.html)  | Raised on action button click.  |  
| drawactionbuttonpress  | NWP.btn.FeatureActionArgs  | Raised on draw action completion.  |  
| featureactionbuttonpress  | NWP.btn.FeatureActionArgs  | Raised on feature action button click.  |  
| mapactionbuttonpress  | NWP.btn.MapActionArgs  | Raised on map action button click.  |  
| mapviewupdated  | NWP.map.ViewState  | Raised when map view changed (zoom, pan etc.)  |  
| maplegendchanged  | string (new legend name)  | Raised when new legend selected.  |  
| maplegendupdated  | NWP.map.LegendState  | Raised when legend is updated (e.g. entry visibility changed).  |  
| maplegendreset  | string (legend name)  | Raised when a legend is reset.  |  
| mapmodechanged  | NWP.map.ModeName  | Raised when map mode is changed.  |  
| featureselectionchanged  | NWP.feature.Feature[]  | Raised when the selection set in the feature panel is changed.  |  
| featureselected  | NWP.feature.Feature  | Raised when user selects a feature.  |  
| featureselectclear  |   | Raised when feature selection is cleared.  |  
| gtechfeatureselect  | NWP.feature.GTechFeature  | Raised when a feature with G3E_FNO and G3E_FID is selected in feature selection panel, related features panel, tooltip or results grids.  |  
| gtechfeatureload  | NWP.feature.GTechFeature  | Raised when a feature is loaded in feature editor.  |  
| gtechjobschanged  | NWP.jobs.JobStatus  | Raised when the user changes the active job or selects jobs to view.  |  
| sidebarpanelupdated  | NWP.sidebar.PanelName  | Raised when active sidebar panel is changed. Panel name contains the identifier(s) of the panel that has been opened.  |  
| sidebarpanelupdating  | NWP.sidebar.PanelName  | Raised when active sidebar panel is about to change. Panel name contains the identifier(s) of the panel that is being closed.  |  
| workspaceready  |   | Raised when the workspace is fully loaded and UI is ready.  |  
Request notifications have been moved to functions available from the $NWP object.

##### Type-definitions

# btn
## NWP.btn.FeatureActionArgs : `Object`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/btn.html#nwpbtnfeatureactionargs--object)
**Properties**  
| Name  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  | Configured name of the action.  |  
| feature  | [`NWP.feature.Feature`](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/feature.html)  | Selected feature.  |  
## NWP.btn.MapActionArgs : `Object`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/btn.html#nwpbtnmapactionargs--object)
**Properties**  
| Name  | Type  |  
| --- | --- |  
| name  | `string`  |  
| mapState  | [`NWP.map.ViewState`](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map.html)  |

# feature
## NWP.feature.GtechAttribute : `Object`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/feature.html#nwpfeaturegtechattribute--object)
Simple object which represents a GTech attribute properties and value
**Properties**  
| Name  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_ANO  | `number`  | Attribute identifier  |  
| G3E_TANO  | `number`  | Attribute tab identifier  |  
| G3E_CID  | `number`  | Component identifier  |  
| name  | `string`  | Field name  |  
| userName  | `string`  | Field label name  |  
| attributeText  | `string`  | Field presentation value  |  
| attributeValue  | `string`  | Field value  |  
| groupName  | `string`  | For repeating components represents a component  |  
| editor  | `NWP.feature.GtechFieldEditor`  | Configuration for the fields editor.  |  
## NWP.feature.GtechDetail : `Object`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/feature.html#nwpfeaturegtechdetail--object)
Simple object which represents a detail or schematic record
**Properties**  
| Name  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| id  | `number`  | Detail identifier  |  
| type  | `string`  | Type. Can be 'detail' or 'schematic'  |  
| userName  | `string`  | User identifier  |  
| G3E_LSNO  | `number`  | Legend number for the associated detail/schematic legend  |  
| G3E_FNO  | `number`  | Owning feature type identifier  |  
## NWP.feature.GtechFeature : `Object`[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/feature.html#nwpfeaturegtechfeature--object)
Simple object which represents the data loaded in the feature editor
**Properties**  
| Name  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_FID  | `number`  | Feature identifier  |  
| G3E_FNO  | `number`  | Feature type identifier  |

# legend
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/legend.html#overview)
Interfaces and types for the portal legend. Interfaces and types are shown in [typescript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/) notation.
## NWP.map.legend.Entry[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/legend.html#nwpmaplegendentry)

```
/** Common properties for all legend entries */
interface Entry {
    /** Internal identifier. */
    id?: string;

    /** External identifier. Required. */
    name: string;

    /** User identifier. Text that is displayed in the Legend UI. */
    userName?: string;

    /** Common identifier for relating sources together. */
    group?: string;

    /** Whether a visibility check box is displayed in the Legend UI with this legend entry. */
    checkVisible?: boolean;

    /** URL to a icon image to be displayed in the Legend UI with this legend entry. */
    icon?: string;

    /** Tooltip text displayed in the legend UI for this legend entry. 
    * This can include HTML markup. */
    tooltip?: string;

    /** Whether this legend entry (and any sub entries) are displayed in the legend UI. */
    hidden?: boolean;

    /** Whether this legend entry is by default expanded. Default is false. */
    expanded?: boolean;
}

```

**Notes**
  * See the [Map Legend](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Map-Legend.html) page for more information about how groups work in the Legend UI.
  * The `icon` URL is passed to the CSS [url()](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/url) function. If its a file URL it can be absolute or relative. Icons can be in any image format that browsers support e.g. SVG, PNG or JPEG. The recommended format is SVG. Icon images should be sized to 16x16 pixels.
  * Tooltip text is appended to the entry's `userName`.

## NWP.map.legend.FolderEntry[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/legend.html#nwpmaplegendfolderentry)

```
/** Structural legend entry for grouping layer entries for a map source. */
interface FolderEntry extends Entry {
    /** Type identifier. Must be 'folder'. */
    type: "folder";    
    
    /** Whether this entry can be removed or not from the legend by the user. */
    removable: boolean;

    /** Filter for this layer. 
     * Only applicable to layers of NetworksVector sources.
     */
    filter?: LayerFilter;

    /** Layers which are available in the map source and can be drawn in the map. 
     * Only applicable to WMS, NetworksWMS and NetworksVector sources. */
    layers: (LayerEntry | FolderEntry)[];
}

```

## NWP.map.legend.LayerEntry[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/legend.html#nwpmaplegendlayerentry)

```
/** Defines a sub layer for a map source in the legend UI. Only applicable for WMS, NetworksWMS and NetworksVector map sources. */
interface LayerEntry extends Entry {
    /** Type identifier. Must be 'layer'. */
    type: "layer";

    /** Whether geometry associated with this entry are by default visible in the map. */
    visible?: boolean;

    /** Whether the user can ever query/locate geometry associated with this entry in the map.
     * If false then 'queryable' will always be false. */
    nonQueryable?: boolean;

    /** Whether geometry associated with this entry are queryable/locatable in the map. */
    queryable?: boolean;

    /** Opacity for geometry associated with this entry in the map as a number between 0 and 1. 
     * 0 is completely transparent and 1 is completely opaque. 
     * Only applicable to layers of NetworksVector sources. */
    opacity?: number;

    /** Whether the visibility of geometry associated with this entry is dependent on scale or not. 
     * Only applicable to layers of NetworksVector sources. */
    scaleDependency?: boolean; 

    /** Filter for this layer. 
     * Only applicable to layers of NetworksVector sources.
     */
    filter?: LayerFilter;

    /** WMS style name to apply with this layer. 
     * Only applicable to layers of WMS sources.
     */
    style: string;
}

```

**Notes**
  * For more information about filters see the example ['Initializing legends'](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Examples/Initializing-legends.html).

## NWP.map.legend.SourceEntry[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/legend.html#nwpmaplegendsourceentry)

```
/** Represents a map source in the legend. */
interface SourceEntry extends Entry {
    /** Type identifier. Must always be 'source'. */
    type: "source";

    /** Parameters for the map source this entry represents. */
    source : Base;

    /** Used to determine render order of all map sources in the legend. 
     * Sources with a higher drawing priority is rendered above those with lower drawing priority. */
    drawingPriority?: number;

    /** Whether geometry associated with this entry are initially visible in the map. */
    visible?: boolean;

    /** Opacity for geometry associated with this entry in the map as a number between 0 and 1. 
     * 0 is completely transparent and 1 is completely opaque. */
    opacity?: number;

    /** Whether the user can ever query/locate geometry associated with this entry in the map.
     * If set to false then 'queryable' will always be false. 
     */
    nonQueryable?: boolean;

    /** Whether geometry associated with this entry are queryable/locatable in the map. */
    queryable?: boolean;

    /** Determines how the life time of the source entry is managed. Can be 
     *  0 - The application decides when the source entry is to be removed.
     *  1 - The user decides when the source entry is to be removed i.e. the source entry will persist between sessions until the user removes it.
     *  2 - The source entry will be removed at the end of a session i.e. when the user closes or refreshes the browser tab.
     */
    scope?: 0 | 1 | 2;

    /** If true request the sub layers to be displayed from the map service. Only applicable to WMS, NetworksWMS and NetworksVector sources. */
    allLayers?: boolean;

    /** Layers which are available in the map source and can be drawn in the map. Only applicable to WMS, NetworksWMS and NetworksVector sources. */
    layers?: (LayerEntry| FolderEntry)[];
}

```

**Notes**
  * See the section ['source'](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html) for information about the `source` properties `NWP.map.source.Base` type definition and its variants.
  * Map sources of type OSM, BingMaps, Google and WMTS do not support querying so setting nonQueryable or queryable to true will have no affect. NetworksWMTS does support querying.
  * SourceEntry items in the Legend UI only become removable via the UI if `scope` is set to 1.
  * If `allLayers` is set to true sub layers are not populated until the source entry is made visible in the legend. This means if `visible` is set to false and `checkVisible` is also set to false then the sub layers will never be loaded.
  * One should not set `allLayers` to true and `layers` to a value. Only one or the other.

## NWP.map.legend.LayerFilter[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/legend.html#nwpmaplegendlayerfilter)

```
type PrimitiveValue = number | string | boolean;

```

```
const SimplePredicateType = {
    EQUAL: "eq",
    NOTEQUAL: "ne",
    LESSTHAN: "lt",
    GREATERTHAN: "gt",
    EQUALORLESSTHAN: "lte",
    EQUALORGREATERTHAN: "gte",
    LIKE: "like",
    NOTLIKE: "notlike",
} as const;

```

```
interface SimplePredicate {
    type: typeof SimplePredicateType[keyof typeof SimplePredicateType],
    value: PrimitiveValue
}

```

```
interface PredicateIn {
    type: "in",
    values: PrimitiveValue[];
}

```

```
const ConnectivePredicateType = {
    AND: "and",
    OR: "or"
} as const

```

```
interface ConnectivePredicate {
    type: typeof ConnectivePredicateType[keyof typeof ConnectivePredicateType],
    filters: Predicate[]
}

```

```
type Predicate = SimplePredicate | PredicateIn | ConnectivePredicate;

```

```
/** Filter for a Networks Vector service layer. */
interface LayerFilter {
    [propertyName: string] : Predicate 
}

```

const MapSourceType = {

## StyleDef[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html#styledef)

/** Represents a color as an RGB code. The first three numbers should be whole numbers between 0 and 255 and represent, in this order, red, green and blue. 
 * The alpha channel should be a decimal number between 0 and 1 where 0 is completely transparent and 1 is completely opaque. */
type Rgba = [number, number, number, number?]

```

```
interface StrokeDef {
    /** The color of the stroke. */
    color : Rgba;

   /** Line cap style. Defaults to round. */
   lineCap? : "butt" | "round" | "square";

   /** Line join style. Defaults to round. */
   lineJoin?: "bevel" | "round" | "miter";

   /** Line dash as a CSS stroke dash array */
   lineDash?: number[];

   /** Line dash offset. */
   lineDashOffset?: number;

   /** Miter limit. */
   miterLimit?: number;

   /** Stroke width in CSS pixels. */

}

```

```
interface FillDef {
    /** The color of the fill. */
    color : Rgba;
}

```

```
interface CircleDef {
    /** Fill style for interior of the circle. */
    fill: FillDef;

    /** Stroke style for the circle boundary. */
    stroke: StrokeDef;

    /** Circle radius in CSS pixels. */
    radius: number;
}

```

```
interface RegularShapeDef {
    /** Fill style for interior of the shape. */
    fill: FillDef;

    /** Stroke style for the shape boundary. */
    stroke: StrokeDef;

    /** Shape radius in CSS pixels. */
    radius: number;    
    
    /** Second radius to make a star instead of a regular polygon. */
    radius2?: number;    

    /** Shape's angle in radians. A value of 0 will have one of the shape's points facing up. */

    /** Whether to rotate the shape with the view. */

}

```

```
interface TextDef {

    /** Font style as a CSS font. */
    font : string;

    /** Fill style for interior of the text. */

    /** Stroke style for the text boundary. */

    /** Horizontal text offset in CSS pixels. A positive will shift the text right. */

    /** Vertical text offset in pixels. A positive will shift the text down. */
    offsetY?: number;

    /** Scale factor to apply when rendering the text. */

    /** Rotation in radians (positive rotation clockwise). */
    rotation?: number;

    /** Whether to rotate the shape with the view. */

    /** Text alignment */
    textAlign?: "left" | "right" | "center" | "end" | "start";

    /** Text base line. */

}

```

```
interface StyleDef {
    /** Circle for points. Only circle or regular shape should be specified. Both are optional. */
    circle?: CircleDef;

    /** Regular shape for points. Only circle or regular shape should be specified. Both are optional. */
    regularShape?: RegularShapeDef;

    /** Fill style. */
    fill: FillDef;

    /** Stroke style. */
    stroke: StrokeDef;

}

## NWP.map.source.Base[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html#nwpmapsourcebase)

```
/** Common properties for all map source types */.
interface Base {

    /** Text to be displayed in the attribution control when this source is visible.
     * Can contain HTML markup. */
    attributions?: string;

    /** References the name of a configuration in the workspaces 'editor' section. */
    editorName?: string;

    /** Maximum extent for this source. */
    extent?: BoundingBox;

    /** Extra parameters that will be appended to all requests to the underlying map service. */
    extraParams?: Record<string, string>;

    /** A string template for formatting feature identifiers for the user. */
    featureUserNameFormatString? : string;

    /** Internal identifier for this source. */ 
    id?: string;

    /** The maximum map resolution at which this source is visible on the map. Defaults to Infinity. */
    maxResolution?: number;

    /** The minimum map resolution at which this source is visible on the map. Defaults to 0. */
    minResolution?: number;

    /** External identifier for this source. Required. */
    name: string;

    /** Whether this source will be printed by the print function */
    printable?: boolean;

    /** EPSG code used by this source. */
    projection?: string;

    /** Display name for this source. */
    userName?: string;
}

```

**Notes**
  * The base interface is not intended to be used directly. One should always use one the extensions to it specified in this document.
  * It is strongly recommended that a `projection` is always provided. If not the application will assume that the `extent` is in EPSG:4326 and that it can request data from the underlying map service in the legends projection.
  * Without an `extent` the fit function in the legend UI will be disabled for source entries.
  * If `editorName` is defined and features selected from the map source (if supported by the source) have G3E_FNO and G3E_FID attributes then they will be opened in the (old) feature editor. The value for `editorName` must reference a valid `name` in the workspaces 'editor' section.
  * For more information about `featureUserNameFormatString` see [Map sources](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Workspace/Map-sources.html).

## NWP.map.source.Bing[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html#nwpmapsourcebing)

```
interface Bing extends Base {
    /** Type identifier. Must always be 'Bing'. */
    type: "Bing";

    /** Your Bing maps API key. */
    key : string;

    /** A valid Bing maps imagery set. */
   imagerySet: string;

   /** A supported Bing maps culture code. */
   culture?: string;

   /** Whether to request high resolution images. */
   hidpi: boolean;

   /** The maximum zoom level to request. Default is 21. */
   maxZoom: number;
}

```

**Notes**
  * Features from Bing maps are not queryable/locatable in the map.

## NWP.map.source.LocalVector[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html#nwpmapsourcelocalvector)

```
import Style from "ol/style/Style";
import { StyleFunction } from "ol/style/Style";

interface LocalVector extends Base {
    /** Type identifier. Must always be 'localvector'. */
    type: "localvector";

    /** Whether geometry placement operations should snap to data in this map source. Default is false. */
    allowSnapping?: boolean;

    /** Whether the map tooltips mode will query this source. Default is false. */
    enableTooltips: boolean;

    /** If true saves the geometry in the map source so that its available across multiple sessions. Default is false. */
    saveState?: boolean;

    /** If saveState is true and the map source is attached to a geographic legend then allow the geometry in this source to be displayed in
    * all geographic legends in a map source with the same name. */
    shareState?: boolean;

    /** Style for the vectors as an open layers style, open layers style function or style definition. */
    style?: Style | StyleFunction | StyleDef;

    /** Whether geometry in the map source is spatially indexed. Default is true. */
    useSpatialIndex?: boolean;

    /** If true then use a ol/layer/VectorImage instead of an ol/layer/Vector. Default is false. */
    useVectorImage?: boolean;
}

```

**Notes**
  * When loading geometry into the underlying open layers source it should be in the maps projection. If required then OpenLayers has multiple functions which can achieve this. See for example <https://openlayers.org/en/latest/apidoc/module-ol_format_GeoJSON-GeoJSON.html> or <https://openlayers.org/en/latest/apidoc/module-ol_geom_Geometry-Geometry.html#transform> . The [NetWorks Coordinate System Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Coordinate-System-Service.html) also has multiple functions to transform coordinates and supports the full range of coordinate transformations that the NetWorks platform supports.
  * If `useSpatialIndex` is set to false then fit operations for the source are disabled.
  * Setting `useVectorImage` to true can significantly improve zoom and pan performance. The only disadvantage is that point symbols and texts are always rotated with the view and pixels are scaled during zoom animations.
  * If `saveState` is set to true geometry is stored as EPSG:4326 coordinates which can cause issues with accuracy when reloading geometry from state.
  * State is only shared between map sources in geographic legends. To share state the map sources must have the same `name` and both `saveState` and `shareState` must be set to true.

## NWP.map.source.NetworksVector[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html#nwpmapsourcenetworksvector)

```
interface NetworksVector extends Base {
    type: "NetworksVector";

    /** Whether geometry placement operations should snap to data in this map source. Default is false. */
    allowSnapping?: boolean;

    /** The identifier of the detail/schematic to render. */
    detailId?: number;

    /** Whether this source came from the workspace or was dynamically added. */
    dynamic? : boolean;

    /** Whether the map tooltips mode will query this source. Default is false. */
    enableTooltips?: boolean;

    /** If enableTooltips is true then attempt to use component tooltips. Default is false. */
    enableComponentTooltips?: boolean;

    /** Factor map viewport extent should be multiplied by when requesting features. Default is 1. */
    imageRatio?: number;

    /** The G3E_LSNO of the legend. */
    lsno: number;

    /** Minimum width of a line in CSS pixels. Default is 0.5. */    
    minimumLineWidth?: number;

    /** The style scaling factor. */
    paperScale?: number;

    /** A buffer in CSS pixels around the map viewport used when requesting features or hit detection. Default is 100. */
    renderBuffer?: number;

    /** Whether to render mask symbols. Default is false. */
    renderMaskSymbols?: boolean;

    /** URL of the service. */
    url: string;
}

```

**Notes**
  * When adding Networks Vector sources via the API `dynamic` should always be set to true.

## NWP.map.source.NetworksWFS[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/API/Type-definitions/map/source.html#nwpmapsourcenetworkswfs)

interface NetworksWFS extends WFS {
    /** Type identifier. Must always be 'NetworksWFS'. */
    type: "NetworksWFS";

   /** Template URL for tile requests. Must include Must include {x}, {y} or {-y}, and {z} placeholders.
