#### Feature-Editor

# Deploy Feature Editor with Portal
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#overview)
High-level deployment diagram of NetWorks Portal with services required for Feature Editor.
[![FeatureEditor_deployment_services_v02.svg](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/FeatureEditor_deployment_services_v02-2a576e90-4942-4e6f-a0b1-e4ebe3f537ea.svg)](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/FeatureEditor_deployment_services_v02-2a576e90-4942-4e6f-a0b1-e4ebe3f537ea.svg)
Feature Editor deployed with NetWorks Portal requires these HxGN NetWorks services:  
| Service  | Function  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Data Transfer Service  | Web API for transactional upload and download of workset data and uploaded files.  |  
| Feature Data Service  | Retrieval of feature metadata and data.  |  
| Feature Transaction Service  | Processing of CRUD over feature data.  |  
| Job Service  | Creation of HxGN NetWorks Core jobs in database.  |  
| Work Service  | Orchestration of asynchronous processing of submitted worksets.  |  
| Coordinate System Service  | Coordinate transformation.  |  
| Map Request Service  | Invocation of Functional Interfaces after performing CRUD.  |  
Directory storage locations:  
| Storage  | Function  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Transaction storage  | Directory structure with uploaded Data Transfer Service transaction files.  |  
| Attachment storage  | Directory structure for permanent storage of uploaded file attachments. Optional. Configurable in metadata table [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html), parameter _HyperlinkPathTemplate_.  |  
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#workflow)
  * [Install data model](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#install-data-model)
  * [Configure metadata](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#configure-metadata)
  * [Publish metadata](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#publish-metadata)
  * [Publish Feature Editor metadata to DDC files](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#publish-feature-editor-metadata-to-ddc-files)
  * [Configure Storage](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#configure-storage)
  * [Deploy services and Portal](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#deploy-services-and-portal)

## Install data model[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#install-data-model)
Starting with release 11.01.2301, Feature Editor data model is automatically installed together with other HxGN NetWorks Web Services database upgrade scripts.
To install the Feature Editor data model on an older database run script `GTDWS\FeatureEditor\Install-FeatureEditor.sql` (relative to NetWorks Web Services installation folder) using Oracle SQL*Plus and pass a single parameter - path to folder, where logs should be stored.
##### Note
The installation scripts can be executed multiple times. The installation framework ensures that only missing objects are created.
**Example**

```
cd "C:\Program Files (x86)\NetWorks\GTDWS\FeatureEditor"
sqlplus user/password@alias @Install-FeatureEditor.sql C:\temp\logs\

```

## Configure metadata[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#configure-metadata)
### Table NWG_PROCESSSELECTION[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#table-nwg_processselection)
This table defines the information presented in New feature window, a hierarchical list of processes (feature and placement configurations) available to the user. The structure of this table is based on G3E_PLACEMENTSELECTION, which is used by HxGN NetWorks Core Designer. NWG_PROCESSSELECTION will be used by other clients to avoid interference with G3E_PLACEMENTSELECTION.
##### Tip
To populate this table with the same content as G3E_PLACEMENTSELECTION, run script `\GTDWS\FeatureEditor\utils\PopulateNWG_PROCESSSELECTION.sql` located under HxGN NetWorks Web Services installation folder.
##### Note
Feature Editor does not support component configurations, placement of dimensioning and raster components. Remove all such records from the table.
### Table NWG_GENERALPARAMETER[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#table-nwg_generalparameter)
See [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) for reference on available configuration parameters.
## Publish metadata[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#publish-metadata)
Publish HxGN NetWorks Core metadata using standard process (_PublishMetadataMapFiles.exe_).
## Publish Feature Editor metadata to DDC files[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#publish-feature-editor-metadata-to-ddc-files)
### Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#overview-1)
This step converts a subset of published metadata tables for NetWorks Web Services to DDC/CDT metadata file `WSMetadata.ddc` / `WSMetadata.cdt` using tool [PublishWSMetadata.exe](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Tools/PublishWSMetadata.exe.html). The tool is located in HxGN NetWorks Web Services and Portal installation folder (default is `c:\Program Files (x86)\Intergraph\NetWorks\Program\`) under the _Tools_ folder.
### Steps[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#steps)
  * Open Command line console
  * Change current folder to the Tools folder

```
cd "c:\Program Files (x86)\Intergraph\NetWorks\Program\Tools\"

```

  * Run the tool with parameter `-c` followed by the name of the configuration

**Example**

```
PublishWSMetadata.exe -c PRODUCTION

```

## Configure storage[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#configure-storage)
### Transaction storage[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#transaction-storage)
Create a folder on the file system (local or network share). In this folder create two child folders: `open` and `committed`.
## Deploy services and Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#deploy-services-and-portal)
Open the HxGN NetWorks Web Services Administrator and login to the selected configuration. Using Service Deployment module, deploy instances of the following services.
#### Job Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#job-service)
Use default configuration.
#### Feature Data Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#feature-data-service)
Use default configuration.
#### Feature Transaction Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#feature-transaction-service)
Use default configuration.
#### Work Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#work-service)  
| Parameter  | Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Path to storage folder for CAD conversion uploaded files  | Specify any valid path. This folder is not used in Feature Editor workflows.  |  
| Path to storage folder for Dynamic WMS Service  | Specify any valid path. This folder is not used in Feature Editor workflows.  |  
| Path to storage folder for Export Data files  | Specify any valid path. This folder is not used in Feature Editor workflows.  |  
| Endpoint URL  | Specify a valid URL to listen on. If TCP port 9400 is used by other instance or service, use a different port.  |  
| Path to storage folder for Features files  | Specify full path to the **committed** folder.  
The account used to run the service must have read-write access to this folder.  |  
| Job Service  | Select Job Service instance deployed in previous steps.  |  
| Feature Transaction Service  | Select Feature Transaction Service instance deployed in previous step.  |  
#### Data Transfer Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#data-transfer-service)  
| Parameter  | Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Root folder of the physical package storage  | Use any valid path. This folder is not used in Feature Editor workflows.  |  
| Root folder for open transactions  | Specify full path to the **open** folder.  
The app. pool identity must have read-write access to this folder.  |  
| Root folder for committed transactions  | Specify full path to the **committed** folder.   
The app. pool identity must have read-write access to this folder.  |  
| Deployed Work Service  | Select Work Service instance deployed in previous step.  |  
#### Networks Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#networks-portal)
The Feature Editor plugin runtime is automatically deployed with Portal under `plugins/hxgn-feature-editor`, relative to Portal deployment folder. Feature Editor is not automatically added to workspace. To add it to workspace, follow these steps.
Create customization XML file to add Feature Editor to workspace:
  * Open a text editor (e.g. Notepad).
  * Copy the following XML to the editor.

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<configuration>
    <workspace>
        <add path="/config/Workspace/Section[@type='function']/Function[@name='sidebar']/Config/JProperty[@name='items']/JArray" position="last">
            <JObject>
                <JProperty name="xtype" value="iframepanel"/>
                <JProperty name="title" value="Editor"/>
                <JProperty name="url">
                    <JValue>plugins/hxgn-feature-editor/index.html</JValue>
                </JProperty>
                <JProperty name="id">
                    <JValue>hxgn-feature-editor</JValue>
                </JProperty>
            </JObject>
        </add>
        <add path="/config/Workspace" position="last">
            <Section type="plugins"/>
        </add>
        <add path="/config/Workspace/Section[@type='plugins']" position="last">
            <Plugin name="hxgn-feature-editor">
                <TypeIdentifier>hxgn-feature-editor</TypeIdentifier>
                <Path>plugins/hxgn-feature-editor/</Path>
                <Parameters>
                    <JProperty name="settings">
                        <JObject>
                            <!--
                            <JProperty name="disableJobSelection" type="boolean" value="false" />
                            <JProperty name="userIdentifierClaim" type="string" value="email" />
                            <JProperty name="allowLockOverride" type="boolean" value="true" />          
                            -->
                        </JObject>
                    </JProperty>
                </Parameters>
                <Services>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.fds</TypeIdentifier>
                        <Path>/FeatureDataService</Path>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.ipts</TypeIdentifier>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.render</TypeIdentifier>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.storage</TypeIdentifier>
                        <Path>/DataTransferService</Path>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.fm-job</TypeIdentifier>
                        <Path>/DataTransferService</Path>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.mapfeatures</TypeIdentifier>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.mapselection</TypeIdentifier>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
		        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.mapwindow</TypeIdentifier>
		    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.resource</TypeIdentifier>
                        <Path>assets.localized</Path>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.job-environment</TypeIdentifier>
                    </Service>
                </Services>
            </Plugin>
        </add>
    </workspace>
</configuration>

```

  * Modify Feature Editor [plug-in parameters](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#plug-in-parameters).
  * In Anonymous mode, replace service path names with actual instance names: 
    * `/FeatureDataService` with `/{FeatureDataService instance}`
    * `/DataTransferService` with `/{DataTransferService instance}`
  * In OpenID Connect (OIDC) Mode, replace with actual instance names: 
    * `/FeatureDataService` with `proxy/networks/{FeatureDataService instance}`
    * `/DataTransferService` with `proxy/networks/{DataTransferService instance}`
  * Save the file as `FeatureEditor.xml`.
  * On tab Workspace, check **Enable Custom Configurations** and do one of the following: 
    * Specify path to this XML file.
    * Specify path to a folder which contains this XML file.
  * Deploy the Portal instance.

### Plug-in parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#plug-in-parameters)  
| Parameter  | Data Type  | Description  | Default  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| disableJobSelection  | boolean  | When `true`, functionality of attaching existing database jobs is disabled.  | `false`  |  
| userIdentifierClaim  | string  | Name of OpenID Connect claim used to uniquely identify a user. The claim must be configured in Portal [web.config](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file/Authentication.html#published-claims) file.  |   |  
| allowLockOverride  | boolean  | When `true`, Feature Editor allows overriding locks on worksets locked by other users or opening worksets shared by other users. Set this parameter to `true` also in cases when workset locking is not used (Anonymous mode or OIDC mode when `userIdentifierClaim` is empty), but opening worksets shared by other users is required.  | `false`  |  
## Localizing the Feature Editor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#localizing-the-feature-editor)
The Feature Editor uses the same mechanism for loading files with localized strings as the portal. See [Localized files](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file/Localized-files.html).
It uses a separate file identified by the `id` property specified under `<Function name='sidebar'>` for the plugin with `-strings.json` appended to it. If the instructions in this section are followed then it will be `hxgn-feature-editor-strings.json`.
An example file is included in a deployed portal. See `assets/locale/en/hxgn-feature-editor-strings.json`. To localize the Feature Editor to a different language a copy of the file should be placed into the relevant locale sub folder. Then the display value strings should be translated.
The file a JSON file structured like:

```
{
    "strings": [
        {
            "name": "accept",
            "value": "Accept"
        },
        {
            "name": "attributeEditor",
            "value": "Attributes"
        },
...

```

Only modify the strings next to `"value"`. JSON strings need to be enclosed in `"` characters.

##### Extensibility

# Default values for job attributes
## Introduction[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility/Default-values-for-job-attributes.html#introduction)
When submitting a workset, Feature Editor creates new jobs in NetWorks database with a limited set of attributes. Only description, classification (if configured) are populated. Other attributes are not populated by default which may cause issues on databases where a custom required attribute exists.
## Workaround[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility/Default-values-for-job-attributes.html#workaround)
Feature Editor uses by default the `G3E_NEWJOB` dialog type to create new jobs using the Job Service [CreateJob](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service/CreateJob.html) API. An alternative dialog type can be created and configured, which has default values for the required attributes. Feature Editor will use this dialog type and populate the attributes.
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility/Default-values-for-job-attributes.html#configuration)
  1. Create a view over the job table.
The view is not used during processing, but it is required in order to satisfy database metadata constraints.
_Example_

```
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW V_G3E_JOB_FE AS SELECT * FROM G3E_JOB;

```

  2. Create new dialog tab in **G3E_DIALOGTAB** and **G3E_TABATTRIBUTE** with dialog attributes as in `G3E_NEWJOB` dialog. Configure **G3E_TABATTRIBUTE**.**G3E_DEFAULT** for any attribute which has to be populated with a default value.
  3. Create new dialog in **G3E_DIALOG** with **G3E_TYPE** set to the name of the view created in step 1, **G3E_FNO** set to 0.
  4. Configure parameter `NewJobDialogType` in [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html).
  5. [Publish metadata and Feature Editor metadata](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#publish-ws-metadata).

# Extensibility
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility.html#workflow)
  * [Default values for job attributes](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility/Default-values-for-job-attributes.html).

## Server[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility.html#server)

# Foreign Key or Domain Table Query support
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#overview)
Feature Editor supports display of query interface over foreign key or domain tables configured for attributes or dialog tab attributes. The mechanism follows the **Domain Foreign Key Query** logic described in **HxGN NetWorks Core** Administrator's Guide, with some improvements.
## Enabling conditions[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#enabling-conditions)
A Query button is displayed in the attribute editor field when:
  * The dialog tab attribute has `G3E_FOREIGNKEYTABLE` or `G3E_DOMAINTABLE` defined.
  * The `G3E_FKQRINO` is `NULL` OR The `G3E_FKQRINO` is configured and the corresponding interface is mapped (see [Interface mapping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#interface-mapping)) in [NWG_INTERFACEMAPPING](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_INTERFACEMAPPING.html).

The required metadata for definition of the foreign key query are the same as for **HxGN NetWorks Core** :
  * An entry in `G3E_COMPONENT` of type `2048` must exist for the foreign key or domain table.
  * An entry in `G3E_DIALOG` must exist where `G3E_TYPE` equals to the name of the table. `G3E_FNO` must be either a valid feature number or `0` if the dialog is used for multiple feature classes.
  * A dialog tab definition must exist in the dialog. The tab attributes are mapped to the filtering parameters for the query and the results. Picklists on the tab attributes are used when filtering data and for translation of key values in the foreign key table to their display values.

## Interface mapping[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#interface-mapping)
Interface mapping is required to determine which custom implementations of `IGTForeignKeyQuery` interface defined in metadata should be displayed using the built-in Foreign Key Query dialog. This is important, as not all `IGTForeignKeyQuery` are used to display contents of a foreign key or domain table.
Additionally, some implementations use custom argument groups and/or hard-coded parameters, and these need to be transparently conveyed to the Feature Editor workflows.
### Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#configuration)
Make an entry in [NWG_INTERFACEMAPPING](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_INTERFACEMAPPING.html) for each implementation of custom `IGTForeignKeyQuery` interface, which should be treated as a query to foreign key or domain table.  
| Field  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| NWG_INTERFACE  |  `ProgID` or `<assembly>:<namespace.class>` of the custom implementation.  |  
| NWG_PLATFORM  | Set to constant `all`.  |  
| NWG_MAPPEDINTERFACE  | See [Foreign Key Query mapped interface URI](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#foreign-key-query-mapped-interface-uri).  |  
### Foreign Key Query mapped interface URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#foreign-key-query-mapped-interface-uri)
Foreign Key query support in Feature Editor is activated when the mapped interface has the format:
`fkquery:?filterargordinal={filterargordinal}&fkalias={fkalias}`
**Query parameters**  
| Parameter  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| filterargordinal  |   | Pointer to `G3E_RELATIONIFACEARGS.G3E_ORDINAL`. When `G3E_FKQARGGROUPNO` is configured, this value points to the argument ordinal containing WHERE clause for additional filtering of the foreign key table.  |  
| fkalias  |   | Table alias used in the additional WHERE clause.  |  
**Examples**
  * `fkquery:` - Interface mapped without additional WHERE clause.
  * `fkquery:?filterargordinal=1&fkalias=FK` - Interface has WHERE clause in argument with ordinal `1`, and the WHERE clause uses `FK.` table alias (e.g. `FK.SUBUNIT = '123'`).

### Well known mappings[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#well-known-mappings)
####  **HxGN NetWorks Utilities**[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Foreign-Key-or-Domain-Table-Query-support.html#hxgn-networks-utilities)
To support Foreign Key Query dialog behavior with configurable filter on foreign key or domain table, configure this line in the table and publish metadata.  
| NWG_INTERFACE  | NWG_PLATFORM  | NWG_MAPPEDINTERFACE  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| `GinForeignKeyQuery:Intergraph.Ginius.UcMain.Product.Interface.ForeignKeyQuery.GinForeignKeyQuery`  | `all`  | `fkquery:?filterargordinal=1&fkalias=FK`  |

# Functional interfaces
Feature Editor client and services do not execute HxGN NetWorks Core functional interfaces during edits or when performing CRUD (except for regional subsetting done by Feature Transaction Service). This may lead to missing attribute values which are normally populated by Functional Interfaces.
To overcome this, it is possible to create a custom command, which when executed in the context of an active job in HxGN NetWorks Core Designer / Analyst, forces execution of functional interfaces on attributes by resetting their value to the same value. This triggers execution of the FIs.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Functional-interfaces.html#workflow)
The expected workflow is:
  * User creates a workset with feature modifications on the Client (Portal, Core Mobile) and submits the workset.
  * Services process the workset. The results is a new job in the database with feature changes.
  * The job is opened and activated in HxGN NetWorks Core Designer.
  * This custom command is executed to trigger execution of FIs.

## Code[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Functional-interfaces.html#code)
The following C# code contains the logic for this custom command. Prepare a new C# project, place the code into this project, reference `ADODB.dll` and `Intergraph.GTechnology.dll`, build the dll and reference it as a custom command in metadata.

```
using ADODB;
using Intergraph.GTechnology.API;
using Intergraph.GTechnology.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace Hxgn.Networks.Customization.ExecuteFi
{
  public class ExecuteFiCommand : IGTCustomCommandModeless, IDisposable
  {
    private const int CommitAfterUpdatedComponents = 100;
    private const short GdbSpatial = 32;

    private IGTTransactionManager _gtTransactionManager;
    private IGTApplication _gtApplication;
    private IGTJobManagementService _jobManagementService;
    private bool _disposed;

    private IDictionary<(short, int), IGTKeyObject> _features;
    private IDictionary<short, List<AttributeInfo>> _attributesWithFIForCno;

    public IGTTransactionManager TransactionManager { set => _gtTransactionManager = value; }

    public bool CanTerminate => true;

    public IGTDataContext DataContext => _gtApplication.DataContext;

    public ExecuteFiCommand()
    {
      _features = new Dictionary<(short, int), IGTKeyObject>();
      _attributesWithFIForCno = new Dictionary<short, List<AttributeInfo>>();
    }

    public void Activate(IGTCustomCommandHelper CustomCommandHelper)
    {
      Trace.WriteLine($"{nameof(ExecuteFiCommand)} Activate Enter");
      try
      {
        _gtApplication = GTClassFactory.Create<IGTApplication>();
        _jobManagementService = GTClassFactory.Create<IGTJobManagementService>();
        _jobManagementService.DataContext = DataContext;

        var activeJob = DataContext.ActiveJob;
        var status = $"Execute functional interfaces for {activeJob}";

        _gtApplication.SetStatusBarText(GTStatusPanelConstants.gtaspcMessage, status);
        _gtTransactionManager.Begin(status);

        var changes = _jobManagementService.FindPendingEdits();
        int uncommitedComps = 0;

        foreach (var component in GetComponents(changes))
        {
          if (uncommitedComps >= CommitAfterUpdatedComponents)
          {
            _gtTransactionManager.Commit();
            uncommitedComps = 0;

            _gtTransactionManager.Begin(status);
          }

          ProcessComponent(component);
          uncommitedComps++;
        }

        _gtTransactionManager.Commit();
      }
      catch (Exception ex)
      {
        Trace.TraceError($"Error in {ex.Message}");
        _gtTransactionManager.Rollback();
      }
      finally
      {
        Dispose();
        CustomCommandHelper.Complete();
        Trace.WriteLine($"{nameof(ExecuteFiCommand)} Activate Exit");
      }
    }

    private void ProcessComponent(ComponentKey componentKey)
    {
      IGTKeyObject feature = GetFeature(componentKey.Fno, componentKey.Fid);
      if (feature == null)
        return;

      var component = feature.Components.GetComponent(componentKey.Cno);

      var attributesWithFI = GetAttributesWithFI(componentKey.Cno);

      var components = component.Recordset;
      components.MoveFirst();
      while (!components.EOF)
      {
        foreach (var attribute in attributesWithFI)
        {
          if (attribute.IsSpatial)
          {
            component.Geometry = component.Geometry;
          }
          else
          {
            var field = components.Fields[attribute.Name];
            field.Value = field.Value;
          }
        }

        components.Update();
        components.MoveNext();
      }
    }

    private List<AttributeInfo> GetAttributesWithFI(short cno)
    {
      if (_attributesWithFIForCno.TryGetValue(cno, out var attributes))
        return attributes;

      var recordset = DataContext.MetadataRecordset("G3E_ATTRIBUTEINFOFI_OPTABLE", $"G3E_CNO = {cno} and G3E_FINO is not null and G3E_FUNCTIONALTYPE in ('SetValue', 'Edit', 'Update')");

      var result = new List<AttributeInfo>();
      if (recordset.EOF && recordset.BOF)
      {
          return result;
      }

      recordset.MoveFirst();
      while (!recordset.EOF)
      {
        var attrInfo = new AttributeInfo()
        {
          Name = Convert.ToString(recordset.Fields["G3E_FIELD"].Value),
          IsSpatial = Convert.ToInt16(recordset.Fields["G3E_DATATYPE"].Value) == GdbSpatial
        };

        result.Add(attrInfo);
        recordset.MoveNext();
      }

      _attributesWithFIForCno.Add(cno, result);
      return result;
    }

    private IGTKeyObject GetFeature(short fno, int fid)
    {
      if (_features.TryGetValue((fno, fid), out IGTKeyObject val))
        return val;

      var feature = DataContext.OpenFeature(fno, fid);
      _features.Add((fno, fid), feature);
      return feature;
    }

    private IEnumerable<ComponentKey> GetComponents(Recordset recordset)
    {
      recordset.MoveFirst();
      while (!recordset.EOF)
      {
        var component = new ComponentKey()
        {
          Fid = Convert.ToInt32(recordset.Fields[0].Value),
          Fno = Convert.ToInt16(recordset.Fields[1].Value),
          Cid = Convert.ToInt16(recordset.Fields[2].Value),
          Cno = Convert.ToInt16(recordset.Fields[3].Value)
        };

        yield return component;

        recordset.MoveNext();
      }

      yield break;
    }

    public void Terminate()
    {
      Trace.TraceInformation("Terminate");
      Dispose();
    }

    public void Pause()
    {
      Trace.TraceInformation("Pause not supported");
    }

    public void Resume()
    {
      Trace.TraceInformation("Resume not supported");
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
      Dispose(true);
      GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }

    protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
      if (_disposed)
        return;

      try
      {
        if (disposing)
        {
          DisposeManagedResources();
        }
      }
      finally
      {
        _disposed = true;
      }
    }

    ~ExecuteFiCommand() => Dispose(false);

    protected void DisposeManagedResources()
    {
      if (_gtTransactionManager != null)
      {
        try
        {
          if (_gtTransactionManager.TransactionInProgress)
            _gtTransactionManager.Rollback();
        }
        catch
        {
          // ignore
        }

        if (Marshal.IsComObject(_gtTransactionManager))
        {
          Marshal.ReleaseComObject(_gtTransactionManager);
          _gtTransactionManager = null;
        }
      }

      if (_jobManagementService != null)
      {
        if (Marshal.IsComObject(_jobManagementService))
        {
          Marshal.ReleaseComObject(_jobManagementService);
          _jobManagementService = null;
        }
      }

      if (_gtApplication != null)
      {
        if (Marshal.IsComObject(_gtApplication))
        {
          Marshal.ReleaseComObject(_gtApplication);
          _gtApplication = null;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  public class ComponentKey
  {
    public short Fno { get; set; }
    public int Fid { get; set; }
    public short Cno { get; set; }
    public short Cid { get; set; }
  }

  public class AttributeInfo
  {
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public bool IsSpatial { get; set; }
  }
}

```

# Job support
Feature Editor supports integration with open jobs in the database in **offline** mode. Pending edits of a job a are converted to workset (see [Feature data mapping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html#feature-data-mapping)). User(s) edit the workset in the client offline without modifying the job in the database. After submitting, changes done in the workset are written back to the original job and the workset is closed.
## High-level workflows[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#high-level-workflows)
### Convert job to workset[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#convert-job-to-workset)
  * In Feature Editor, create new workset by converting it from an existing job. 
    * This workflow invokes [Workset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset.html) workload in Work Service.
    * Depending on configuration, the job in central database is updated (postable flag set to non-postable, workset identifier).
  * User opens the workset and performs modifications.
  * User submits the workset using regular Feature Editor submit workflow (see [Server workflows](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html)). 
    * Depending on configuration, the job in central database is updated (postable flag reset, workset identifier).

### Delete workset[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#delete-workset)
For worksets created from a job, the Delete workset workflow updates the job properties (depending on configuration), to avoid having the job tied to a workset, which is no longer active.
  * In Feature Editor, open the workset.
  * If the workset is not yet submitted, Select _Delete workset_.
  * Feature Editor deletes the workset locally. Depending on selected options, the workset is also delete from the server and related job is updated.

## Technical workflows[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#technical-workflows)
### Convert job to workset[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#convert-job-to-workset-1)
  * _Client_ : Select existing job.
  * _Client_ : Begin DTS transaction and get `tid`.
  * _Client_ : Upload [workset request](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset.html#worksetrequest) file `{tid}_workset.json` to the transaction.
  * _Client_ : Commit DTS transaction with `{ "type": "workset" }` body.
  * _DTS_ : Commit transaction.
  * _DTS_ : Run post process and call WorkService `workset` workload (async).
  * _Work Service_ : Run [Workset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset.html) workload and generate `{tid}_data.json` in the transaction storage.
  * _Client_ : Poll for existence of `{tid}_data.json` in `tid` transaction storage for defined time.
  * _Client_ : Revert transaction `tid` to open state.
  * _Client_ : Attach workset using `tid`.

### Abandon workset without submitting[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#abandon-workset-without-submitting)
If optional _Keep job attached to workset_ is not selected, this workflow is executed:
  * _Client_ : Upload [workset request](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset.html#worksetrequest) file `{tid}_workset.json` to the transaction, with.
  * _Client_ : Commit DTS transaction with `{ "type": "job2workset" }` body.
  * _DTS_ : Commit transaction.
  * _DTS_ : Run post process and call WorkService `workset` workload (async).
  * _Work Service_ : Run _Abandon workset_ command of the [Workset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset.html) workload.

## See also[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Job-support.html#see-also)
  * [Workset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset.html) workload in Work Service
  * [Job workset relationship](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Workset/Job-workset-relationship.html)
  * [GetJobAsWorkset](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Feature-Transaction-Service/GetJobAsWorkset.html) API

# Server workflows
Processing related to submitting and processing worksets on the server.
## Terms[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html#terms)
  * **Client** is the application which interacts with the user (Portal, Core Mobile).
  * **DTS** is the [Data Transfer Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service.html) instance, which acts as the endpoint for uploading transaction data and files and triggering the processing of the CRUD transactions.
  * [Interface files](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features/Interface-files.html)

## Submit workset[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html#submit-workset)
The following is a high-level workflow for submitting a Feature Editor workset for processing on the server.
  * Client begins a transaction in DTS. 
    * The result of this call is the `tid`, which is a unique handle to this transaction. The `tid` has to be kept by the client and linked to the client-side workset.
  * Client uploads the transaction [REQUEST_FILE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features/Interface-files.html) using DTS UploadFile API.
  * _Optional_ : client uploads one or more attachment files using DTS UploadFile API 
    * Note: this step together with the call to [BeginTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/BeginTransaction.html) API call can be done before the actual submission of the changed data. It is assumed that for browser clients like Portal, which have no local file storage, DTS serves as temporary storage for attached files.
  * Client completes the transaction submission by calling DTS [CommitTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html) API. 
    * The default configuration for DTS is to trigger automatic processing of the request when it receives CommitTransaction request with body containing a JSON document with JSON object at the top level, with property type set to features and property `process` set to `true`, example:

```
{
    "type": "features",
    "process": true
}

```

    * When automatic processing is not requested, set `process` to `false` or omit the property completely.
  * DTS receives the [CommitTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html) request, commits the transaction and triggers asynchronous [post-processing](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features/Post-processing.html) in Work Service. 
    * DTS sends a message to Work Service ([SubmitWork](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/SubmitWork.html) with the `tid`, which is the pointer to the transaction payload.
    * Work Service enqueues the request for asynchronous processing and returns a _wid_ , unique identifier of the queued work.
    * DTS receives the Work Service response and relays the _wid_ to the caller in the [CommitTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html) response.
  * Client receives the DTS [CommitTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/CommitTransaction.html) response, which contains the _wid_.
  * Client now has two options how to check the status of the server-side processing: 
    * Call DTS with the `tid` and request a file ([STATUS_FILE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features/Interface-files.html) and [RESULT_FILE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features/Interface-files.html)). These files are updated by the asynchronous processing in Work Service and contain intermediate status of the transaction processing. This mode is available to all clients, since is requires only access to DTS endpoints.
    * Call Work Service [GetWorkStatus](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkStatus.html) directly using the _wid_. This option is available only to some clients like Portal.

## Transaction processing[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html#transaction-processing)
This workflow begins when Work Service starts processing of the Features workload request received from client through DTS or from other sources. See [Features](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features.html) for details.
See [Workset Monitor Plugin](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Workset-Monitor-Plugin.html) for monitoring user interface.
## Check workset status[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html#check-workset-status)
This workflow can be initiated by the client application, typically an on-demand refresh of job state by the user.
##### Note
It is not supported by Feature Editor client for Portal or Core Mobile. It is available only in [Workset Monitor Plugin](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Workset-Monitor-Plugin.html).
  * Client makes a request to DTS with _tid_ and requests transaction file STATUS_FILE using DTS [GetTransactionFile](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionFile.html) API.
  * DTS checks for existence of the file and returns the file content or HTTP status 204 if the file doesn’t exist yet, because processing hasn’t yet started.
  * Client updates the job status locally 
    * Completed jobs can be removed from local storage on the client.
    * Jobs completed with error can be reactivated and resubmitted.

## Get workset result[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html#get-workset-result)
This workflow can be initiated by the client application once the submitted job has been processed and the status is either success or failure.
##### Note
It is not supported by Feature Editor client for Portal or Core Mobile. It is available only in [Workset Monitor Plugin](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Workset-Monitor-Plugin.html).
  * Client makes a request to DTS with `tid` and requests transaction file RESULT_FILE using DTS [GetTransactionFile](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/GetTransactionFile.html).
  * DTS checks for existence of the file and returns the file content or HTTP status 204 if the file doesn’t exist yet, because processing hasn’t yet started.
  * Client can process the job result locally – the definition of what can be done is beyond the scope of this document (e.g. get name of the created job, get list of G3E_FIDs created/updated/deleted).

## Resubmit a workset[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Server-workflows.html#resubmit-a-workset)
This workflow can initiated by the client application, typically an on-demand refresh of job state by the user.
##### Note
It is not supported by Feature Editor client for Portal or Core Mobile. It is available only in [Workset Monitor Plugin](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Workset-Monitor-Plugin.html).
  * Client makes a request to DTS [RevertTransaction](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Data-Transfer-Service/RevertTransaction.html) API with the original _tid_.
  * DTS reverts the originally committed transaction and opens it again.
  * Client makes changes and resubmits the job using Submit workset workflow again.

# Validation
Feature Editor performs a limited set of validations before submitting the workset. The validations can be also executed on demand. Any validation with **Error** severity prevents the workset from being submitted. Other levels of severity do not block submission.
## Supported validations[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Validation.html#supported-validations)  
| Name  | Description  | Default severity  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| RequiredAttribute  | Attribute with G3E_REQUIRED=1 must have a value.  | Warning  |  
| RequiredComponent  | At least one instance of a feature component with G3E_REQUIRED=1 or its alternative must be present.  | Warning  |  
## Validation severities[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Validation.html#validation-severities)
  * Error - Blocking errors.
  * Warning - Non-blocking errors.
  * Info - Information.

## Customization of severity[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Validation.html#customization-of-severity)
Severity of validations can be customized using the [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) table. Parameters `Validation:{name}` (e.g. `Validation:RequiredAttribute`) can be used to override the default severity.

# Workset Locking
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#overview)
When running in OpenID Connect mode, Feature Editor supports locking mechanism for worksets to allow sharing of worksets among multiple users and prevent concurrent editing. See related parameters in [Portal workspace configuration for Feature Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#plug-in-parameters).
Conditions to enable workset locking:
  * Environment is configured to use OpenID Connect mode.
  * The `userIdentifierClaim` is [configured](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#plug-in-parameters).

In Anonymous mode, workset locking is disabled. If `allowLockOverride` parameter is set to `true`, users are allowed to unlock locked worksets. Locking in Anonymous mode does not work, as there is no user identifier, which can be used to identify the owner of the lock.
##### Note
Set `allowLockOverride` to `true` also in cases when Workset Locking is not in use (i.e. Anonymous mode or OIDC mode with no `userIdentifierClaim`) to enable opening worksets shared by other users in read-write mode. If `allowLockOverride` is `false` or not configured, users will be able to open shared worksets, but not change them.
## Lock evaluation[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#lock-evaluation)
Workset lock is evaluated:
  * Before saving changes in the workset. The existing lock (if any) is compared with the current user information. If it differs, the changes may not be saved.
  * After opening a workset. If the saved lock differs from current information, the workset is switched to read-only mode on the client. If allowed in configuration, the user can override the lock.

## Workflows[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#workflows)
### Make workset writable[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#make-workset-writable)
If the workset is not locked or override is allowed, the user can lock the workset. This will enable changes to the workset and prevents other users from doing changes.
### Make workset read-only[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#make-workset-read-only)
If the workset is locked by the current user or unlocked, the workset is unlocked. This switches the workset on the client to read-only mode, which prevents the user from making changes to the workset.
## Lock storage[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#lock-storage)
Workset lock is stored in a file named `{tid}_lock.json` in the Data Transfer Service [transaction storage](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service/Upload.html), next to the workset data file (named `{tid}_data.json`). `{tid}` is the DTS transaction identifier, which also serves as the identifier of the workset.
The lock file contains the user identifier of the current user and the name of the user identifier claim.
## Concurrency violation[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Locking.html#concurrency-violation)
Feature Editor uses optimistic locking mechanism to detect concurrency violation, i.e. situations where one or more users perform changes to a single workset at the same time. Before saving changes, Feature Editor compares the last modification time of a workset when it was opened with the current last modification time. If these times don't match, it is assumed that the workset was modified by another session or user. The current changes are discarded.

##### Workset-Monitor

# Configuration and deployment
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor/Configuration-and-deployment.html#configuration)
  1. Update the database or install the [Feature Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html) data model manually.
  2. Configure Workset Monitor parameters in [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html#configurable-parameters-for-workset-monitor). 
     * See [Workset Monitor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html) for details on configuration possibilities.
  3. Publish metadata and follow steps [Deploy Feature Editor with Portal](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html#publish-feature-editor-metadata-to-ddc-files) to publish Feature Editor-related metadata.

## Deployment[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor/Configuration-and-deployment.html#deployment)
  1. Follow [Deploy Workset Monitor with Portal](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor/Deploy-Workset-Monitor-with-Portal.html).

# Deploy Workset Monitor with Portal
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor/Deploy-Workset-Monitor-with-Portal.html#overview)
Workset Monitor deployed with NetWorks Portal requires [Data Transfer Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service.html) for transactional upload and download of workset data and uploaded files.
## Data Model[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor/Deploy-Workset-Monitor-with-Portal.html#data-model)
Workset Monitor relies on the [Feature Editor](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html) data model. See section [Install data model](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Deploy-Feature-Editor-with-Portal.html) for details.
## Deploy services and Portal[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor/Deploy-Workset-Monitor-with-Portal.html#deploy-services-and-portal)
The Workset Monitor plugin runtime is automatically deployed with Portal under `plugins/hxgn-workset-monitor`, relative to Portal deployment folder. Workset Monitor is not automatically added to workspace. To add it to workspace, follow these steps.
Create customization XML file to add Workset Monitor to workspace:
  * Open a text editor (e.g. Notepad)
  * Copy the following XML to the editor

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<configuration>
    <workspace>
        <add path="/config/Workspace/Section[@type='function']/Function[@name='sidebar']/Config/JProperty[@name='items']/JArray" position="last">
            <JObject>
                <JProperty name="xtype" value="iframepanel"/>
                <JProperty name="title" value="Monitor"/>
                <JProperty name="url">
                    <JValue>plugins/hxgn-workset-monitor/index.html</JValue>
                </JProperty>
                <JProperty name="id">
                    <JValue>hxgn-workset-monitor</JValue>
                </JProperty>
            </JObject>
        </add>
        <add path="/config/Workspace" position="last">
            <Section type="plugins"/>
        </add>
        <add path="/config/Workspace/Section[@type='plugins']" position="last">
            <Plugin name="hxgn-workset-monitor">
                <TypeIdentifier>hxgn-workset-monitor</TypeIdentifier>
                <Path>plugins/hxgn-workset-monitor/</Path>
                <Parameters/>
                <Services>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.fm-job</TypeIdentifier>
                        <Path>/DataTransferService</Path>
                    </Service>
                    <Service>
                        <TypeIdentifier>hxgn.networks.resource</TypeIdentifier>
                        <Path>assets.localized</Path>
                    </Service>
                </Services>
            </Plugin>
        </add>
    </workspace>
</configuration>

```

  * In Anonymous mode, replace `/DataTransferService` with actual name of `/{DataTransferService instance}`
  * In OpenID Connect (OIDC) Mode, replace `/DataTransferService` with `proxy/networks/{DataTransferService instance}`
  * Save the file as `WorksetMonitor.xml`.
  * On tab Workspace, check _Enable Custom Configurations_ and do one of the following: 
    * Specify path to this XML file
    * Specify path to a folder which contains this XML file
  * Deploy the Portal instance.

# Workset Monitor
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#overview)
Worksets submitted from Feature Editor pass through multiple services until they reach the database. Data model in NetWorks database is used to track the processing.
[Workset Monitor Plugin](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Workset-Monitor-Plugin.html) provides the web user interface to track and monitor submitted worksets.
## Architecture[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#architecture)
Red lines denote flows by the Workset Monitor.
[![WorksetMonitor_Modules_v05.svg](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/WorksetMonitor_Modules_v05-942eb57c-43ae-4ffd-8812-e9bb3f95aaff.svg)](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/WorksetMonitor_Modules_v05-942eb57c-43ae-4ffd-8812-e9bb3f95aaff.svg)
## Data model[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#data-model)
  * [NWG_MESSAGE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGE.html)
  * [NWG_MESSAGELOG](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGELOG.html)
  * [NWG_MESSAGEARCHIVE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGEARCHIVE.html)
  * [NWG_MESSAGEARCHIVELOG](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGEARCHIVELOG.html)

## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#configuration)
  * [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html).

## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#workflow)
  * Client submits the workset to [Data Transfer Service (DTS)](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service.html).
  * DTS commits the transaction and creates a new record in [NWG_MESSAGE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGE.html) to track the processing.
  * DTS starts post processing in [Work Service Features workload](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features.html) and updates the processing record with the `wid` of the Work Service work.
  * Work Service [processes the request](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features.html) and updates the record with data as they become available (configuration, job identifier, state, logs).

## Configurable options[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#configurable-options)
For configuration of parameters, use table [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html#configurable-parameters-for-workset-monitor).
### Administrative roles[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#administrative-roles)
It is possible to define one or more roles as administrative via the `monitor:AdminRoles` parameter. Users in these roles have access to all workset monitor data in the Workset Monitor UI. Other users see only their own worksets.
By default, Oracle roles are used when evaluating roles. It is possible to use other OpenId Connect claim as a role via the `monitor:RoleClaim` parameter.
### User identification[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#user-identification)
When running with OpenId Connect, the `NWG_MESSAGE.NWG_USER` field is populated by the OIDC identifier of the user. This defaults to the `sub` (subject) claim, however this is usually a non-user-friendly string. Configure other claim (e.g. `email`) to be used as the user identifier using the `monitor:UserIdentifierClaim` parameter.
### User matching[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#user-matching)
Workset Monitor API can use two modes how to select worksets which belong to the current (non-administrator) user.
  * Database user All rows which have the same Oracle user (`NWG_MESSAGE.NWG_CREATEDBY`) are returned. In deployments, where multiple OpenID Connect users are mapped to a single Oracle user, users may see each other's data. This is the default.
  * OpenId Connect user All rows which have the same OIDC user identifier (`NWG_MESSAGE.NWG_USER`) are returned.

Set parameter `monitor:UserMatching` to choose the mode.
### Disabling Workset Monitor[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#disabling-workset-monitor)
To disable monitoring of worksets, set the `monitor:Disabled` parameter.
## Archiving[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Workset-Monitor.html#archiving)
Records from [NWG_MESSAGE](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGE.html) and [NWG_MESSAGELOG](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Data-tables/NWG_MESSAGELOG.html) are regularly cleaned up or archived. See [CleanUp process](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service/CleanUp-process.html).

# Feature Editor
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#overview)
  * Enable placement of new features in online and offline clients.
  * Enable editing of existing features in online and offline clients.
  * Provide web service API to retrieve: 
    * Feature and placement metadata
    * Feature data and geometries
    * Dialog tab and picklist content
  * Provide web service API to perform CUD operations over HxGN NetWorks features: 
    * Create, modify, and delete feature components.
    * Establish and remove relationships among features (selected types).
    * Create and delete detail windows and enable CUD of geometries in detail windows.

## Modules[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#modules)
The Feature Management solution consists of and/or affects these modules. Module names are in uppercase to distinguish them from individual services.
  * STORAGE – Metadata, feature data in central database. Temporary transaction storage.
  * CLIENT – Portal, Core Mobile
  * DATA – Metadata and data retrieval, CRUD operations for feature data
  * WORKFLOW – Services covering server-side workflows (queuing of update requests, custom processing)

[![FeatureManagement_Modules_v03.svg](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/FeatureManagement_Modules_v03-61eb5a10-6a5e-4d3f-81eb-89f240ce771a.svg)](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/FeatureManagement_Modules_v03-61eb5a10-6a5e-4d3f-81eb-89f240ce771a.svg)
### STORAGE[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#storage)
#### Submitted transactions[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#submitted-transactions)
Physical file location used by Data Transfer Service to store transaction files. The storage is also accessible to Work Service which processes uploaded requests.
#### Metadata[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#metadata)
See [Metadata tables](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Metadata-tables.html).
### CLIENT[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#client)
Client module. Feature Editor plug-in for Portal and Core Mobile. The functionality is described in detail in the client documentation.
  * Local workset management 
    * Create new local worksest
    * Display list of worksets
    * Submit a workset for processing
    * Delete a local workset
    * Review workset changes
  * New feature 
    * Place geometries
    * Edit attributes
  * Edit feature (newly placed or existing) 
    * Edit attributes
    * Edit geometries
  * Discard feature changes

### DATA[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#data)
The DATA module includes all services which provide read-only API to the client and read-write API for the WORKFLOW module.
This module includes:
  * [Feature Data Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Feature-Data-Service.html) Web Service which provides read-only access to feature data and metadata related to placement and editing of features.
  * [Feature Transaction Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Feature-Transaction-Service.html) Web service which provides CRUD API for features.
  * [Coordinate System Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Coordinate-Systems-Service.html) User internally to perform database-to-configuration and configuration-to-database transformation of geometry coordinates.
  * [Data Transfer Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Data-Transfer-Service.html) Used by online clients to store workset temporary data. Used by online and offline clients to submit worksets for processing.

### WORKFLOW[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#workflow)
The WORKFLOW module covers long running asynchronous processes related to posting job data to the HxGN NetWorks database.
  * [Work Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service.html) with [Features](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Work-Service/Workloads/Features.html) workload handles the actual processing of feature CRUD messages. The Features workload covers API requests to Job Service (create job), CRUD operations by FTS, file operations and invocation of post-processing after the transaction.
  * [Job Service](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Job-Service.html) handles management of HxGN NetWorks Core jobs – creating.

## Limitations[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor.html#limitations)
Not supported functionality:
  * Evaluation of style and label rules. All geometries are presented using the default style for the style and label rule defined for given G3E_FNO/G3E_CNO. It is possible to override this style using [NWG_GENERALPARAMETER](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Reference/Metadata-tables/NWG_GENERALPARAMETER.html) configuration.
  * Custom placement techniques and construction aids. Only interactive placement and OffsetPointSPT placement techniques are built-in.
  * Relationships.
  * Details and schematics.
  * Functional interfaces.
  * Foreign key query interface. 
    * Support was added in version 11.01.2401.
  * Editing features in an existing job. 
    * Support was added in version 11.01.2401.

# Usage with older databases
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#overview)
### Requirement[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#requirement)
Use newer NetWorks Web Services and Portal with an previous version of the HxGN NetWorks Core database. The goal is to use newest versions while not forcing the desktop clients (Core Designer/Analyst, NetViewer) to upgrade.
## Terminology[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#terminology)
  * **OLD** refers to the older version of HxGN NetWorks Core and/or Web Services. This is typically the version installed in the database.
  * **NEW** refers to the newer version of HxGN NetWorks Web Services and Portal, which we're going to install side-by-side with the **OLD** version.
  * **CR** refers to HxGN NetWorks Core.
  * **WS** refers to HxGN NetWorks Web Services and Portal.

### Architecture[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#architecture)
Running mixed versions of Web Services and Portal and HxGN NetWorks Core requires at least **two** separate machines, one for each version. It is **not possible** to mix versions on a single machine, due to shared references to COM objects.
The architecture diagram displays a minimal architecture necessary for upgrading the Web Services part of the database. The **OLD** machine is used for upgrading the database (WS part). The **NEW** machine is an example of a deployment of **WS** with related **CR** parts. Depending on deployment needs, there may be multiple such machines, all of them using the central database and metadata. For the purpose of this document, we display only one such machine.
[![CR_WS_different_versions_v2.svg](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/CR_WS_different_versions_v2-4960fb58-719d-479f-8c1e-95cdab5f0c22.svg)](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/.attachments/CR_WS_different_versions_v2-4960fb58-719d-479f-8c1e-95cdab5f0c22.svg)
### Limitations[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#limitations)
Current version of **WS** is tested for mixed-version deployment with latest **3** releases of **CR**. E.g. for version 11.01.2302 this means versions 11.01.2201, 11.01.2202 and 11.01.2301. Mixed-version deployments with older versions of **CR** are viable, but issues may occur and must be resolved on a case-by-case basis.
## Installation[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#installation)
### Upgrading database[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#upgrading-database)
The goal of upgrading the database is to keep the CR part of the database intact on **OLD** version and only upgrade the **WS** related part to **NEW** version. To upgrade the database, two machines are needed: one with **OLD** CR and WS, and another one with **NEW** WS.
  1. Install a machine with **OLD** G/Technology version, including the **Database Upgrade Wizard**.
  2. Install corresponding **OLD** version of WS on the same machine. Run the post-installation wizards to ensure NetWorks is registered as NetWorks Core add-on in the Registry. If necessary, run scripts (see NetWorks Installation Guide) to register _NetWorks Web Services and Portal_ in `G3E_ADDON` table.
  3. Download the **NEW** version of **WS** setup you want to upgrade to and install it on the **NEW** machine. **Important** DO NOT try to install **OLD** and **NEW** versions on the same machine.
  4. On **OLD** machine, delete or move the content of the database script folders (see list below) and replace it with the content from the corresponding folder on **NEW** machine.   
  
In the following text, `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%` to the WS installation location. The default installation path is `c:\Program Files (x86)\Intergraph\NetWorks`. Replace it with the actual location of your WS installation on both machines.
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\ADM\`
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\GTDWS\`
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\IncrementalUpgrades\`
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\PLSQL\`
  5. On **OLD** machine, find files named `PopulateVersionMapping.sql` under the folders:
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\ADM\IncrementalUpgrades\`
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\GTDWS\IncrementalUpgrades\`
     * `%WS_INSTALL_PATH%\IncrementalUpgrades\`
  6. This step is necessary only if your **OLD** version is older than **11.01.2201**.  
  
Edit the files and find all rows with INSERT statements, where the `G3E_GTECHVER` is **newer** than your current **OLD** version for **CR**. Update the `G3E_GTECHVER` value for all these rows to your current (**OLD**) **CR** version.   
  
This step is necessary to let the `Database Upgrade Wizard` perform the upgrade. You can get the current **CR** database version by executing `SELECT METADATAVERSION.CMVERSION FROM DUAL`.
**Example.** Upgrading a HxGN NetWorks Core database, version `10.04.1910` to WS version `11.01.2301`.
`SELECT METADATAVERSION.CMVERSION FROM DUAL` returns `10.04.1910.00010`.
Find all rows where `G3E_GTECHVER` is newer than `10.04.1910.00010` and update them to `10.04.1910.00010`.
Original row:
INSERT INTO G3E_VERSIONMAPPING (G3E_VMNO, G3E_AONO, G3E_GTECHVER, G3E_ADDONVER) VALUES( G3E_VERSIONMAPPING_SEQ.NEXTVAL, (SELECT G3E_AONO FROM G3E_ADDON WHERE G3E_NAME='NetWorks'), '11.01.2201.00001', '11.01.2201.00001');
Updated row:
INSERT INTO G3E_VERSIONMAPPING (G3E_VMNO, G3E_AONO, G3E_GTECHVER, G3E_ADDONVER) VALUES( G3E_VERSIONMAPPING_SEQ.NEXTVAL, (SELECT G3E_AONO FROM G3E_ADDON WHERE G3E_NAME='NetWorks'), '**10.04.1910.00010** ', '11.01.2201.00001');
  7. On **OLD** machine, open Windows **Registry Editor**. Locate key `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Intergraph\GTechnology\Add-Ons`. For the addons listed below, set the **ProductVersion** key to the **NEW** version, for example: from `11.01.2201.00047` to `11.01.2302.00100`.
     * `GTDWS`
     * `NetWorks`
     * `NetWorksAdministrator`
  8. On **OLD** machine, open the `Program` folder of **WS** (default is `c:\Program Files (x86)\Intergraph\NetWorks\Program\`). Open file **version.txt** in text editor (as Administrator) and update the version to **NEW** , for example: from `11.01.2201.00047` to `11.01.2302.00100`. Save the file.
  9. On **OLD** machine, run the **Database Upgrade Wizard**.
  10. When **Database Upgrade Wizard** completes, the CR part of the database stays at the **OLD** version and the **WS** part is upgraded to **NEW** version.

## Runtime[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#runtime)
**NEW** **WS** software must be installed on separate machines without any **OLD** version of the software.
### Configuration files[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#configuration-files)
It is possible to share the same configuration (FileUNCPaths.xml, CCM file, DDC metadata and data files), as their structure is unaffected.
### Customization[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#customization)
If there are custom binaries used (functional and other interfaces) by **NEW** **WS** , it is necessary to compile them against the **NEW** **CR** assemblies. In such case, the `FileUNCPaths.xml` file cannot be shared. **OLD** and **NEW** machines must have their own `FileUNCPaths.xml`, each pointing to the proper version of the binary files.
### Other applications[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#other-applications)
Other applications from **CR** like NetPlot, NetExport, CAD-to-DDC conversion tooling, to be used by **NEW** **WS** must be installed from **NEW** **CR** setup on the **NEW** machine.
## Licensing[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Installation/Usage-with-older-databases.html#licensing)
**OLD** and **NEW** installations may require different licenses and versions. It is necessary to configure the license system to provide proper licenses for each version.
