# Print
## General[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal/Print.html#general)
  * Print functions by re-rendering the current map on the server. This is currently subject to a time limit of 10 minutes. If you have a particularly slow performing map service or a map service that is under heavy load during the rendering process then this can lead to a timeout error when printing.

## Print not working[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal/Print.html#print-not-working)
For systems having an issue with NetWorks Portal Print the steps to resolve it are as follows.
  1. On the NetWorks server, install or upgrade Node.js to the latest LTS version.
  2. If the folder `c:\ProgramData\Intergraph\NetWorks\Cache\Puppeteer\` already exists on the server then either rename it or delete it.
  3. Create the folder `c:\ProgramData\Intergraph\NetWorks\Cache\Puppeteer\`.
  4. In this folder create a new text document and rename it to `.puppeteerrc`.
  5. Edit this file and add the following line.

```
cacheDirectory: C:\\ProgramData\\Intergraph\\NetWorks\\Cache\\Puppeteer\\.cache\\puppeteer

```

  6. Open the Node.js command prompt and change the folder too `c:\ProgramData\Intergraph\NetWorks\Cache\Puppeteer\`.
  7. To install:
     * The **latest version** : In the command prompt enter `npm install puppeteer` and wait until it completes.
     * A **specific version** : In the command prompt enter `npm install puppeteer@{version}`, where `{version}` is the version to install (e.g. `npm install puppeteer@22.8.2`) and wait until it completes.

Note that `npm install` requires an internet connection to Github to function. In the case where the server does not have an internet connection then it is recommended to follow the above steps on a machine that does, and once complete copy the folder `c:\ProgramData\Intergraph\NetWorks\Cache\Puppeteer\` onto the server using the same folder path. It is still required the Node.js is installed on the server. In cases where the server does not have an internet connection then the steps to install puppeteer should be completed  _before_ the Portal is deployed to avoid issues.

# HxGN NetWorks Portal on mobile devices
  * Close button on dialog boxes fails intermittently. May require the user to tap multiple times.
  * Function tabs are difficult to grab, resize, and close.
  * File downloads fail on iOS devices.
  * Export redlines to "WKT (Well-known text)" and "NetWorksPortal GeoJSON" fails to generate an output file on iOS devices.

# HxGN NetWorks Portal
Known issues are listed sub divided by functional area.
## General[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#general)
  * UI components for services are not automatically disabled or hidden if the service is not deployed. For example the Search and Trace tabs require an Analysis Service to be deployed to function. If not then this can lead to error messages being shown to the user. Currently the portal workspace XML file must be adjusted to hide elements which are not required.
  * String resources (i.e. labels and tooltips) are cached by the portal. If a user changes their browser language settings then these resources will not automatically be updated. The user must either do a 'hard' refresh (Ctrl+F5 on most desktop browsers) or clear cached files from their browsing history.
  * The portal workspace is cached on the client and is reloaded only when the it is detected that the workspace file's last updated timestamp has changed. However currently the check is only performed when the portal's IIS application is recycled. After making changes to the workspace xml file then the portal's application pool in IIS should be recycled and then the portal should be refreshed.
  * The browser location (GPS) and clipboard APIs are disabled by browsers if the HTTPS protocol is not used. This is normal behavior. It is recommended that the Portal is always configured to use HTTPS protocol in production environments. Issues can also occur if the portal is referencing services such as WMS services that are not using HTTPS. Where possible it is recommended that all services are accessed using HTTPS. If HTTPS is not available for a service then it is recommended that they are accessed via a proxy. See [Proxy](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/web.config-file/Proxy.html) and the following section.
  * The browser clipboard paste API is [not available](https://caniuse.com/?search=readText) in the Firefox browser. This is used by the Portal in the coordinates toolbar paste function.

## OpenID Connect[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#openid-connect)
##### Important
OpenID Connect is available only together with HTTPS. This is not a bug in the Portal. It is a requirement enforced by the user agent (browser).
Background: Without HTTPS the required cookies are not sent by the browsers and a session cannot be established.
When using the Portal together with OpenID Connect, requests to map services must be routed through the portal. If the Portal is deployed from the Admin Console this is done automatically however, if the Portal is deployed and configured manually then you must do the following.
In the portals `web.config` file in the `<proxyUrls>` section ensure that you have a sub element with the name set to 'networks' which links to your NetWorks server e.g.

```
<proxyUrls>
    <add name="networks" path="http://myserver"/>
</proxyUrls>

```

If your server requires HTTPS then replace `http:` with `https:`. Replace `myserver` with the name of your server.
In your workspace xml file change URLs of `NetWorksWMSSource`, `NetworksWMTSSource`, `NetWorksWFSSource` and `NetworksVectorSource` items to use the proxy. To do this replace the protocol and server/domain name with the text `proxy/networks` e.g.

```
<Section type="mapsource">
    <NetworksWMSSource name="mywms" username="My WMS">
        <Url1>http://myserver/mywmsservice/wms</Url1>
        ...
    </NetworksWMSSource>
    <NetworksWMTSSource name="mywmts" username="My WMTS">
        <Url1>http://myserver/mywmtsservice/wmts</Url1>
        ...
    </NetworksWMTSSource>
    <NetworksVectorSource name="myvector" username="My VectorService">
        <Url>http://myserver/myvectorservice</Url>
        ...
    </NetworksVectorSource>
    <NetworksWFSSource name="mywfs" username="My WFS">
        <Url>http://myserver/mywfsservice/wfs</Url>
        ...
    </NetworksWFSSource>
    ...

```

Should read as.

```
<Section type="mapsource">
    <NetworksWMSSource name="mywms" username="My WMS">
        <Url1>proxy/networks/mywmsservice/wms</Url1>
        ...
    </NetworksWMSSource>
    <NetworksWMTSSource name="mywmts" username="My WMTS">
        <Url1>proxy/networks/mywmtsservice/wmts</Url1>
        ...
    </NetworksWMTSSource>
    <NetworksVectorSource name="myvector" username="My VectorService">
        <Url>proxy/networks/myvectorservice</Url>
        ...
    </NetworksVectorSource>
    <NetworksWFSSource name="mywfs" username="My WFS">
        <Url>proxy/networks/mywfsservice/wfs</Url>
        ...
    </NetworksWFSSource>
    ...

```

Note that there is no leading `/` character in the modified URL.
### IDX10501: Signature validation failed. Unable to match key[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#idx10501-signature-validation-failed-unable-to-match-key)
See [Support for Azure AD with claims mapping](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Security/Support-for-Azure-AD-with-claims-mapping.html).
## NetWorks WMS Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#networks-wms-service)
When creating WMS metadata in NetWorks it by default creates two internal settings, `MaxHeight` and `MaxWidth` and these are set to 2048 pixels. If you try to request an image from a NetWorks WMS service with a greater height and width then this it will report an error. In particular this can be a problem when trying to print A3 format with a rotated frame as the print service will try to request an image with an extent that contains the rotated frames extent. This can result in an image size greater than 2048 pixels. It is possible to adjust the `MaxHeight` and `MaxWidth` via a SQL client. The following will list the currently defined services together with the table name which holds the settings for the service.

```
select GAO_TITLE, GAO_ABSTRACT, GAO_CAPABILITIESTABLE from gaonet_services;

```

You can then inspect the capabilities table which contains the following columns

```
GAO_CAPNO  - Primary key
GAO_ELEMENTNAME  - Varchar2(40)
GAO_ELEMENTVALUE – Varchar2(400)
GAO_EDITDATE – Date

```

You can then find the records where `GAO_ELEMENTNAME` is equal to `MaxHeight` or `MaxWidth` and adjust the values from 2048 to, for example, 8192. Then you need to publish metadata and restart the WMS service.
## WFS Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#wfs-service)
  * All WFS services limit the number of features that are returned per request. As such when viewing a large geographic extent you may not be able to fetch all the features within this extent if total number of features within the extent is greater than the limit. Currently the only work around is to limit the availability of the WFS services when zoomed out which can be done via the portal configuration.
  * When printing data from WFS services the portal prints the data which has been loaded into the portal. This means that if you start a print before all the WFS data is loaded then not all data will be printed.

## Vector Service[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#vector-service)
  * Clicking on a label may not result in a feature being selected. Selection currently is based on the distance from the click point to the origin point of the label which is not always obvious for the user.
  * To view symbology in the portal the fonts for a legend must be published on the web server with the portal. For Windows based client it is sufficient to only publish fonts in TTF format however for mobile devices you must convert them to WOFF format.
  * To print symbology the TTF fonts must be installed on the same server that is hosting the Portal.
  * Symbols on the client are rendered using TTF fonts, which are loaded asynchronously on the client. If the font is not yet downloaded at the time of rendering, the first map may be rendered using default font. It is possible to force preloading of font files by adding `<link rel="preload"` elements to Portal's index.html file. The `?NNNNNN` suffix in the URL must match the suffix used in `fonts.css` file (by default deployed to `vectorfonts/`).  
See also [Preload fonts when deploying Portal](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Administration-Console/Preload-fonts-when-deploying-Portal.html).

```
<head>
    <!-- ... -->

    <link rel="preload" href="vectorfonts/fonts/Hxgn-Electric-1.ttf?cd81d3" crossorigin="anonymous" as="font"  />

    <!-- ... -->
</head>

```

## Jobs/Long term transaction[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#jobslong-term-transaction)
Jobs as implemented in the portal function differently to how they function in G/Designer. The user can only select a single job and this is used as a parameter in requests to NetWorks services. The job is opened for 'view' or 'edit' only for the duration of a request. Whether the job is opened for 'view' or 'edit' depends on the type of request. Generally jobs are always opened for 'view' except for update requests from the Feature Editor and for WFS transactions. Note that:
##### Note
It is not currently possible for a user to 'lock' a job for exclusive use.
## Jobs/Analysis results[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#jobsanalysis-results)
When running a Trace that covers features added/removed in Job or adding Query or Search results to a legend, these geometries are not removed from map once the job is closed, due to limitations on Portal side. Please note that it does not cause Portal to fail and features are not visible with map legends (vector, wms, wfs...) after job is closed, they are only visible with legend entry created dynamically by running a trace or adding search/query results to a legend. Possible way to solve this is to remove this legend entry and re-run trace or search/query and add results to legend
## Redlining[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#redlining)
To print redline symbology the fonts used in redlining must be installed on the same server that the Portal is deployed on. The default fonts delivered with the Portal can be found in a deployed Portal instance under the folder `assets\fonts` e.g. `C:\inetpub\wwwroot\nwportal\assets\fonts`.
The following symbol fonts should be installed.
`assets\fonts\AFLOEB\afloeb.ttf` `assets\fonts\AKFJERNV\akfjernv.ttf` `assets\fonts\ELDKSYMBOL\eldksymbol.ttf` `assets\fonts\INGR_WATER\ingr_water.ttf`
When printing redline angle decorations the angle arc between the lines is not printed.
The color 'Fuchsia', that is available in Designer, is missing in the Portal. If required this can be added by adding `{ display: "Fuchsia", value: "#FF00FF"}` to the colors list in [settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html). It will be added by default in a future release.
When appending redlines from file, if a redline is associated with a color not available in the Portal [settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html) then the color code will be shown in the UI and not its name. Users will not be able to select that color. The same applies if one of the the colors in an associated [categories.xml](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Redlines/Categories.html) file is not in the Portal settings. To resolve this the color should be added to settings.
When appending redlines from file, if a redline is associated with a font not available in the Portal [settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Redline.html) then users will not be able to select that font in the font family or symbol family picklists. The same applies if one of the the fonts in an associated [categories.xml](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Redlines/Categories.html) file is not referenced in the Portal settings. To resolve this, a reference to the font should be added to settings.
Removing a category from an [categories.xml](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Redlines/Categories.html) file already associated with the Portal will cause any redlines associated with that category and saved in a users browser to be hidden and no longer accessible. This is by design. It is recommended that before removing a category from the file that users save any redlines they wish to keep into a file. If a category is removed by accident then adding it back in, restarting the Portal IIS Application pool and asking users to refresh their browser can bring the redlines back. However, if they have used the 'Reset Client' function in the mean time then the redlines will have been permanently removed.
Redline decorations such as total length, segment length and angle are specific to the Portal and are not saved to when saving redlines to a Redline XML, GML or WKT file. When you append a Redline XML, GML or WKT file then the current settings in the UI (i.e. whether the decoration check boxes are checked or not) are used to determine whether decorations are added to the redlines which are appended.
Redline freehand linestrings are saved in Redline XML, GML or WKT as Redline linestrings. This is a limitation of those formats.
## Print[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#print)
See [Print](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal/Print.html).
## Feature Editor (legacy) limitations[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#feature-editor-legacy-limitations)
  * Enabling add and/or delete component is not enabled automatically. It requires modifications to the workspace XML file.
  * Clicking in an empty attribute field without making a change may result in Feature Editor asking you to Save before switching Attribute tabs.
  * There is only limited support for functional interfaces within dialog web services and not all function correctly. For example, if GTFiberSlackLoopLengthAttributeSetValue, GTLinearFeatureAttributesUpdate, and GTSubset-tingAttributeUpdate Fiber Optic Works functional interfaces are configured in a NetWorks enabled database, and the user performs an edit operation on fiber features using Feature Edit command in Networks, then an error is thrown in NetWorks Portal.
  * When printing area geometry which has been created or edited using the Feature Editor only the outline of the area is printed. This will be improved in a future release.

## Attach[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#attach)
  * It is not possible to upload another file while a previous conversion is running.
  * The portal is by default limited to uploads of 4MB. See [this document](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.web.configuration.httpruntimesection.maxrequestlength?view=netframework-4.8) for more details. To increase this limit add a maxRequestLength attribute to the httpRuntime element in the portals web.config file e.g.

```
<system.web>
  ...
  <httpRuntime targetFramework="4.8" maxQueryStringLength="32768" maxUrlLength="65536" requestValidationMode="2.0" maxRequestLength="16384" />
  ...
</system.web>

```

## NetPlot[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#netplot)
  * To use NetPlot from Portal, DirectPlot client Id must be configured in Portal _web.config_ e.g. `<add key="directPlotExportClientId" value="1" />`
  * See [NetPlot](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/NetPlot.html) under Troubleshooting for _G/Technology PDF Printer_ usage configuration.

## Trace[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#trace)
  * When rendering Traces using WMS or Vector service and using the same style, stroke thickness might be different even if line weight is the same. This is caused by difference how OpenLayers and OGC services treat the line width.

## Startup[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#startup)
  * Portal fails to start when the IIS app. pool account for Portal application does not have access rights for the folder which contains the workspace XML files. If this happens, add proper access rights to the folder manually.

## Feature Editor plug-in[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Portal.html#feature-editor-plug-in)
  * When switching to a new legend (one that has not been opened in the current session) then placed and edited geometry from the active workset may not be visible. If this occurs then highlighting or fitting a feature or graphic component from the plugin feature editor will display all current geometry in the active legend. This will be rectified in a future release.
  * It is possible, from the plugin feature editor, to fit to a detail feature or detail graphic component while viewing another detail. This will typically result in an empty map being displayed. If this occurs then using the browser back button or the 'Home' button in the portal toolbar will restore the view to the active detail geometry. This will be rectified in a future release.
  * New jobs created by submitting Feature Editor worksets are populated with a limited number of properties only. This may cause issues if a custom property is required. A workaround is possible by following workflow described in: [Default values for job attributes](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Feature-Editor/Extensibility/Default-values-for-job-attributes.html).
  * When placing or editing geometry the onscreen guidance message can obscure toolbar buttons. It is possible to change where the message is displayed relative to the browser viewport, its maximum width and whether it closes after a delay using [settings](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Configuration/Settings/Settings.html). See "placementMsg.align", "placementMsg.autoClose" and "placementMsg.width".

# HxGN NetWorks Vector Service
## Note[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Vector-Service.html#note)
The Vector Service is primarily designed to publish vector geometry from a NetWorks database in vector format for rendering in a client. In this respect it is similar to a WFS service. Secondarily its supports the fetching of legend structures and basic style rules. To contrast with the current WMS service the Vector Service offers:
  * Better performance and scalability.
  * Fine control of what is displayed in the map.

However it:
  * Only publishes vector data.
  * Only supports basic styling.

The Vector Service is currently intended to complement the existing OGC services and not to completely replace them.
Features not supported:
  * Raster components (only returns raster polygon, not actual raster)
  * Attached CAD, DDC or raster files

## Limitations[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Known-Issues/HxGN-NetWorks-Vector-Service.html#limitations)
  * It only supports publishing of NetWorks feature geometry and secondary data published in DDC files. It does not support publishing of attached Raster or CAD files.
  * It currently only supports publishing of data in GeoJSON format. As GeoJSON does not support curves, arc geometry will always be 'flattened' ie. an arc will always be split into multiple line segments.
  * See [Vector Service rendering compatibility](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/portal/Map-display/Vector-Service-rendering-compatibility.html).

# HxGN NetWorks Web Services
  * If a service is deleted in IIS, not using NetWorks Administrator, and a redeploy is attempted in the Service Deployment module, the application pool does not start. This results in an error: "Service unavailable." The user must manually restart the service in IIS.
  * An exception error is shown when disconnecting at the configuration level when the database is a multi-language database. This error can be ignored.
  * Dialog Web Service does not support the Edit dialog type for support interfaces such as pair count, cable section, and duct configuration.
  * When ServiceType or ServiceUrl participates in Attribute Filter on the WFS service, the request becomes invalid and the service throws the following exception: `<ows:ExceptionText> Attribute ServiceType is not supported in filtering </ows:ExceptionText>`. These attributes are added for programmatic support of custom command development and should not be used in WFS queries.
  * Under cases of heavy load, MapServer processes may begin to log "Type Mismatch" errors on the GetFeaturesInAreaByFNO method. If a MapServer begins to exhibit this behavior, the MapRequestService must be restarted to resolve the issue.
  * When initially starting NetWorks Administrator after installation, you may see an error stating, "The program can’t start because GTActivateContext.dll is missing from your computer. Try reinstalling the program to fix this problem." This error message may also be followed by another error message stating, "LegendBuilderModule: Unable to initialize the license file." To resolve the issue, restart your computer.
  * NetWorks Administrator cannot differentiate between configurations with the same name on multiple databases. The DeployedServices.xml does not maintain a reference to the database alias name. If you attempt to switch databases for a single installed instance of NetWorks Administrator, the software attempts to manage and/or deploy services defined in the configuration of the newly connected database with metadata that was created for the configuration in the previously connected database. This results in unexpected behavior and errors. If you have configurations with the same name in multiple databases, you must manage each of these separately by installing NetWorks Administrator on a separate server.
  * In the Service Metadata module, while creating or updating WFS service, you may see the following error: "Numeric or value error: character string buffer too small." This error occurs if you select more features, (for example, 600 features) and click Save. To resolve this issue, select smaller numbers of features (for example, 100 features) and click Save.
  * In the Designer WMTS Sites module, the "Referrer Url" is validated only when the corresponding edit box loses focus. This happens when the user explicitly performs any action outside this edit box.
  * Deploying NetWorks Service after deploying a NetWorks Portal instance is not picked up when attempting to redeploy the NetWorks Portal instance again. A new NetWorks Portal instance needs to be created.
  * NetWorks Services may throw a {"Message":"Bad Request"} error to NetWorks Portal 1.3 clients attempting to execute a file upload on unsupported file types in Feature Info.
  * WFS-T does not work correctly if the updated attributes are not defined in `G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION`. In order to use WFS-T, maintain all attributes and component view fields in `G3E_COMPONENTVIEWCOMPOSITION`.
  * NetWorks Portal uses Solution service to determine location of Analytical Service and Dialog Web Services. It uses database alias (not configuration) for the lookup. If there are more configurations registered on the system with the same database alias and multiple deployed services, Solution service returns all services using the database alias, which might cause the Portal to use a different solution than expected. In general, limit the the deployed Analytical and Dialog web services services to one instance per database alias on a single machine.
  * NetWorks Administration Console might fail when custom localized resource assemblies are used and these assemblies contain localized XAML resources. Always use localized assemblies without embedded XAML resources.
  * After uninstallation of NetWorks Administrator, NetWorks installed on the same machine may become corrupted and fail. This is due to removal of some shared COM component registration during uninstallation. To resolve this issue, either reinstall the NetWorks Administrator or execute the following in command line as Administrator:

```
pushd "c:\WINDOWS\SYSWOW64"

set REGSVR32=regsvr32 /s

%REGSVR32% ComCt232.ocx

%REGSVR32% ComDlg32.OCX

# NetPlot
HxGN NetWorks Portal supports integration with **NetPlot** via the Direct Plot API, which is hosted in the NetPlot Web Service.
Beginning with version 11.01.2201, Portal supports plotting to the built-in **G/Technology PDF Printer** , which produces PDF files. In Portal, **G/Technology PDF Printer** is automatically added to the list of available NetPlot, without registration in GDR_GNVPRINTERS. However, this works only where there is at least one other printer configured and mapped to a plot configuration.
To use **G/Technology PDF Printer** as the only NetPlot printer, make the following configuration changes:
  * On table **GDR_GNVPRINTERS** , remove constraint **MS_C_GDR_GNVPRINTERS_PRINTERID** , which restricts GDR_PRINTERID to values greater than zero.
  * Register **G/Technology PDF Printer** in **GDR_GNVPRINTERS** with GDR_PRINTERID set to **-1**.
  * Complete configuration in other GDR_ tables. In GDR_PLOTCLIENTCONFIG, reference the **G/Technology PDF Printer** using GDR_PRINTER=-1.
  * In Portal deployment folder, edit file `assets\js\settings.js` and remove the record for _G/Technology PDF Printer_ from the `netplot` section: 
```
netplot: {
      frameoverlap: 0.1, // Value between zero and 0.5 representing the percentage of overlap
      defaultPrinters: [{
          printerID: -1, 
          printerUsername: 'G/Technology PDF Printer'
      }]
  },

```
after:
```
netplot: {
      frameoverlap: 0.1, // Value between zero and 0.5 representing the percentage of overlap
      defaultPrinters: []
  },

```

##### Important
This configuration affects using NetPlot from G/NetViewer, use with caution.
**Incremental Upgrades**
This manual configuration breaks the HxGN NetWorks Core Incremental Upgrade process, because the **MS_C_GDR_GNVPRINTERS_PRINTERID** constraint is re-created by the scripts, which interferes with the value of -1 for GDR_PRINTERID. The **MS_C_GDR_GNVPRINTERS_PRINTERID** constraint must be dropped manually during the upgrade.

#### Service-Deployment

# Detail WMS fails to deploy if no detail present in database
**Overview**
When deploying a WMS with Detail legend, it fails during deployment when retrieving the GetCapabilities document.
**Causes**
The WMS service produces the Capabilities document using available data and metadata. If the service extent is not available it tries to determine it from available data via a _Fit all_ operation. If there are no Detail maps available, this operation fails.
**Workaround**
If the WMS definition `GAONET_SERVICES` in contains explicit configuration of extents (map range), WMS uses this value instead of determining the extents from data.
**Workflow**
  * Specify the service extent in `GAONET_SERVICES`, fields `GAO_SERVICETERRITORY_MINX`, `GAO_SERVICETERRITORY_MINY`, `GAO_SERVICETERRITORY_MAXX`, `GAO_SERVICETERRITORY_MAXY`. Use WGS84 values.
  * Publish metadata.
  * Deploy Detail WMS again.

# ORA-12154 reported by services
Vector, Deltas and other services use managed provider for Oracle, which has no explicit Oracle home. It is necessary to instruct the provider about the location of the **tnsnames.ora** file.
This issue is also present when the user account for the application pool does not have access rights to the file system location where **tnsnames.ora** is located.
**Possible solutions**
  1. Set a system wide `TNS_ADMIN` environment variable. See Oracle documentation on `TNS_ADMIN`.
  2. Define a service instance using Administration Console. Open file **NetWorksDeployedServices.xml** in a text editor (stored typically under `c:\ProgramData\Intergraph\NetWorks\DeployedServices\`) and add `TNS_ADMIN` property to the service instance XML element. Redeploy the service afterwards.
  3. Make sure the user account used to run the app. pool or the Windows Service has access rights (ACL) to the folder which contains **tnsnames.ora**. If the location is on network, it may be necessary to run the app. pool using the built-in Windows _NetworkService_ account or other more privileged account than _ApplicationPoolIdentity_.

# Slow service and portal startup
## Overview[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Service-Deployment/Slow-service-and-portal-startup.html#overview)
NetWorks services run as IIS applications in work processes known as Application Pools. By default, IIS stops the work process when the application is idle for a certain time (default is 20 minutes). Any subsequent requests to this application (service) require full restart of the application which takes some time.
## Configuration[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Service-Deployment/Slow-service-and-portal-startup.html#configuration)
To configure IIS application pool to keep the application alive, configure the following via IIS Manager.
  1. Find the application pool for your service.
  2. Open Advanced settings and set the following properties:  
| Name  | Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Start Mode  | AlwaysRunning  |  
| Idle Time-out (minutes)  | 0  |  
| Idle Time-out Action  | Suspend  |  
  3. Find the application.
  4. Open Advanced settings and set the following properties:  
| Name  | Value  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Preload Enabled  | true  |  

Note that for Preload Enabled to take affect you must of installed the 'Application Initialization' feature as noted in the HxGN NetWorks Web Services Installation Guide PDF. See <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/host-and-deploy/iis/advanced?view=aspnetcore-8.0#application-initialization-module> for more information.
## Batch configuration from command line[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Service-Deployment/Slow-service-and-portal-startup.html#batch-configuration-from-command-line)
This workflow can be automated. Create a text file named `alwaysRunning.bat` on the disk with the following content:

```
@echo off
SET APPCMD=%SystemRoot%\system32\inetsrv\APPCMD.exe

SET POOL=%1
SET APP=%2
SET SITE=%3

IF "%SITE%" == "" (
  SET SITE=Default Web Site
)

%APPCMD% set apppool %POOL% /autoStart:true /startMode:AlwaysRunning /processModel.idleTimeout:00:00:00 /processModel.idleTimeoutAction:Suspend
%APPCMD% set app "%SITE%/%APP%" /preloadEnabled:true

```

To configure properties for a single application, start the Command Prompt as Administrator and move to the folder containing `alwaysRunning.bat`.
Execute the following:

```
alwaysRunning.bat {pool} {application} [{site}]

```

where:
  * `{pool}` is the name of the application pool
  * `{application}` is the name of the application (virtual directory under the site)
  * `{site}` is the name of the site in IIS. If not specified, defaults to `Default Web Site`.

## Examples[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/troubleshooting/Service-Deployment/Slow-service-and-portal-startup.html#examples)
`alwaysRunning.bat WmsElectricPool WmsElectric`
`alwaysRunning.bat WmsElectricPool WmsElectric mysite.com`

# GetComponentGeometry
Get geometry of geographic component of a feature.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetComponentGeometry.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/data/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_CNO}
**Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_FNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |  
| G3E_FID  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FID  |  
| G3E_CNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_CNO  |  
**Query parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetComponentGeometry.html#response)
If a feature is available, the HTTP status code is 200 and response body contains data of the feature as GeoJSON FeatureCollection. If there are multiple component instances, each instance is returned as separate Feature.
If a feature is not available for input parameters, HTTP status code is 200 and the FeatureCollection contains no features.
If input parameters are invalid (non existent FNO, no primary geometry defined), HTTP status code is 400 and the response body contains error description.

**Query parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetComponentInstanceGeometry.html#response)
If a feature is available, the HTTP status code is 200 and response body contains data of the feature as GeoJSON FeatureCollection. If there are multiple component instances, each instance is returned as separate Feature.
If a feature is not available for input parameters, HTTP status code is 200 and the FeatureCollection contains no features.
If input parameters are invalid (non existent FNO, no primary geometry defined), HTTP status code is 400 and the response body contains error description.

# GetFeatureGeometries
Get geometry of geographic component instance of multiple features in one call.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatureGeometries.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
/data/geometry
**Query parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
**Rules**
Request is an object with an array of feature class, feature instance or component instance identifiers in Features property. Rules:
  * If only G3E_FNO and G3E_FID are specified, the service returns feature primary geometry of the feature.
  * If only G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO are specified, the service returns component instance geometry (G3E_CID=1).
  * If G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO and G3E_CID are specified, the service returns component instance geometry for this key.

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatureGeometries.html#response)
If a feature is available, the HTTP status code is 200 and response body contains data of the feature as GeoJSON FeatureCollection. If there are multiple component instances and G3E_CID is not specified, each instance is returned as separate Feature. Property **TT** of the GeoJSON feature contains formatted tooltip of the component view.
If a feature is not available for input parameters, it is not included in the response FeatureCollection. HTTP status code is 200.
If input parameters are invalid (non existent FNO, no primary geometry defined), HTTP status code is 400 and the response body contains error description.
## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatureGeometries.html#sample)
**Sample Request**

```
{
  "Features": [
    {"G3E_FNO": 323, "G3E_FID": 1027138, "G3E_CNO": 5943, "G3E_CID": 1 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 323, "G3E_FID": 1027139, "G3E_CNO": 5947, "G3E_CID": 1 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700, "G3E_FID": 1027138, "G3E_CNO": 19600, "G3E_CID": 1 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700, "G3E_FID": 1027138, "G3E_CNO": 19600 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700, "G3E_FID": 1027138 }
  ]
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
{
    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "features": [
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "geometry": {
                "type": "Point",
                "coordinates": [
                    1339868.619,
                    7069218.436
                ]
            },
            "properties": {
                "ID": "1027227,323,1,5943,0",
                "TT": "Ele-Station - Inventory 1027227",
                "ROT": -0.43
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "geometry": {
                "type": "Point",
                "coordinates": [
                    1340998.715,
                    7068057.414
                ]
            },
            "properties": {
                "ID": "1027139,323,1,5943,0",
                "TT": "Ele-Station - Inventory 1027139",
                "ROT": 1.02
            }
        }
    ]
}

```

**Sample Error Response**

```
{
    "Success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_NO_COMPONENT_VIEW_FNO_CNO",
    "ErrorMessage": "No component view metadata for G3E_FNO=153 and G3E_CNO=555."
}

```

# GetFeatures
Get feature data for selected legend settings with geometries in GeoJSON format.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
/data[?tt={tt}]
**Query parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| tt  | int  |   | When set to `1`, component view tooltips are returned with each geometry in property `TT`.  |  
**Body**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| lsno  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_LSNO  |  
| bbox  | Double[]  | Y  | Bounding box in CS coordinates, formatted as [XMIN, YMIN, XMAX, YMAX].  |  
| resolution  | Double  | Y*  | Client resolution, CS ground unit per pixel (e.g. meters per pixel). Mandatory if scale not specified.  |  
| scale  | Double  | Y*  | Display scale. Use 500 for 1:500, etc. Mandatory only if resolution is not specified. If scale is specified, it has priority over resolution.  |  
| detailId  | Integer  | N  | G3E_DETAILID. If specified, the results are filtered for given detail. Applicable only to detail legends.  |  
| entries  | LegendEntry[]  | Y  | List of legend entries to retrieve. Order of entries in the list is not important.  |  
| filters  | Object  | N  | Property map with filtering conditions. The conditions are referenced by `f` property of `LegendEntry` type. See [Filter operators](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/techdoc/Services/Vector-Service/Filter-operators.html) for list of supported operators.  |  
| features  | Integer[]  | N  | List of feature identifiers to use as a filter when outputting data. The array should be formatted as G3E_FNO1,G3E_FID1,G3E_FNO2,G3E_FNO2,...  |  
Type **LegendEntry**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| l  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_LENO. When "features" are specified, a special value of `-3` can be used to automatically include all legend entries related to FNOs in the "features" list.  |  
| s  | Integer  | N  | When 1, return legend entry without scale dependency.  |  
| f  | String  | N  | Ad-hoc filter defined for the legend entry. The value is a reference to a property on the `filters` object in main request.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html#response)
Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
Each feature has the following properties:  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| ID  | String  | Y  | ID of the component view instance, formatted as `{G3E_FID},{G3E_FNO},{G3E_CID},{G3E_CNO},{G3E_LENO}`  |  
| SNO  | String  | Y  | G3E_SNO  |  
| LBL  | String  | N  | Label (for TextGeometry)  |  
| ALN  | Number  | N  | G3E_ALIGNMENT (for TextGeometry)  |  
| ROT  | Number  | N  | Rotation in radians (for TextGeometry and OrientedPointGeometry)  |  
## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html#sample)
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/data

```
{
    "lsno": 7,
    "bbox": [1338540.407641353, 7068952.277151424, 1338960.51271478, 7069218.015257571],
    "resolution": 0.29858214173896974,
    "entries": [{
            "l": 3060000
        }, {
            "l": 3060700
        }, {
            "l": 3060300
        }, {
            "l": 3060500
        }, {
            "l": 3060200,
            "f": "0"
        }, {
            "l": 306000,
            "f": "0"
        }, {
            "l": 306400,
            "f": "1"
        }
    ],
    "filters": {
    	"0": "STATE = '3'",
    	"1": "CATEGORY = '1' AND HEIGHT > 100",
    }
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
{
    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "features": [
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "geometry": {
                "type": "LineString",
                "coordinates": [[1338750.22, 7069436.964], [1338750.364, 7069436.17], [1338752.576, 7069434.972], [1338751.842, 7069433.611], [1338738.708, 7069409.277]]
            },
            "properties": {
                "ID": "1030714,306,1,5643,3060000",
                "SNO": "306000030"
            }
        }, 
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "geometry": {
                "type": "LineString",
                "coordinates": [[1338769.94, 7069428.729], [1338763.533, 7069414.469], [1338759.012, 7069406.039], [1338754.856, 7069398.334], [1338745.668, 7069380.628], [1338744.476, 7069378.329]]
            },
            "properties": {
                "ID": "1030715,306,1,5643,3060000",
                "SNO": "306000030"
            }
        }
    ]
}

```

### Using feature list[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html#using-feature-list)
This request returns looks for features specified in `features` parameter in the bbox and returns all legend entries in legend settings = 7 related to these FNOs.
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/data

```
{
    "lsno": 7,
    "bbox": [1338540.407641353, 7068952.277151424, 1338960.51271478, 7069218.015257571],
    "resolution": 0.29858214173896974,
    "entries": [{
            "l": -3
    }],
    "features": [306,1028719,306,1030520,306,1030598]
}

```

# Features
Methods returning feature data.  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| POST  | [/data](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html)  | Get feature data for selected legend entries as GeoJSON FeatureCollection.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeaturePrimaryGeometry.html)  | Get geometry of primary geographic component of a feature.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_CNO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetComponentGeometry.html)  | Get geometry of geographic component of a feature.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_CNO}/{G3E_CID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetComponentInstanceGeometry.html)  | Get geometry of geographic component instance of a feature.  |  
| GET  | [/data/{G3E_LSNO}/{G3E_LENO}/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_CNO}/{G3E_CID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeature.html)  | Get a single feature specified by its identifiers.  |  
| POST  | [/data/geometry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatureGeometries.html)  | Get geometry of geographic component instance of multiple features in one call.  |  
**See also**
  * [3D support](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service.html)
  * [Component view attributes in output](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service.html)

## Geometry

# Get extent of feature instance geometries in legend
Get extent of primary or all geometries of a feature instance in specified legend. The API follows the same logic as [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_LSNO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html), but returns only the maximum extent of the geometries found.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_LSNO}/bbox[?a={all}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}]`
**Parameters**
See parameters of [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_LSNO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html).
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#response)
See response of [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/bbox](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries.html#response).

# Get extent of feature instance geometries
Get extent of geometries of a feature instance. The API follows the same logic as [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html), but returns only the extent of all geometries found.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
`/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/bbox?g={geographic}&d={detail}&a={all}&s={synthesized}&lsno={lsno}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}`
**Parameters**
See parameters of [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html). Parameters `attrs` and `tt` are not available.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries.html#response)
If at least one geometry is found, the response is a JSON object with `minx`, `miny`, `maxx`, `maxy` properties. If no geometry was found, the values of these properties is `null`.
## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries.html#sample)
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/geometry/323/1027199/bbox?g=1&a=1&s=0
**Sample Response**

```
{
    "minx": 4501960.8700075885,
    "miny": 5924732.676801309,
    "maxx": 4505125.91809738,
    "maxy": 5927850.008099294
}

```

**Sample Response when no geometry was found**

```
{
    "minx": null,
    "miny": null,
    "maxx": null,
    "maxy": null
}

```

# Get extent of multiple feature instance geometries in legend
Get extent of primary or all geometries of one or more feature instances in specified legend.
This is a POST version of method [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_LSNO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html).
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-multiple-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/geometry/{G3E_LSNO}[?a={all}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}]`
**Parameters**
See parameters of [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_LSNO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html).
**Request body**
See request body of [/geometry/{G3E_LSNO}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-multiple-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html).
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-multiple-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#response)
See response of [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/bbox](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries.html#response).

# Get extent of multiple feature instance geometries
Get extent of geometries of one or more feature instances.
This is POST version of method [Get extent of feature instance geometries](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-feature-instance-geometries.html).
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-multiple-feature-instance-geometries.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
`/geometry/bbox?g={geographic}&d={detail}&a={all}&s={synthesized}&lsno={lsno}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}`
**Parameters**
See parameters of [/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html).
**Request body**
See request body in [/geometry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-multiple-feature-instance-geometries.html).
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-extent-of-multiple-feature-instance-geometries.html#response)

# Get feature instance geometries in legend
Get primary or all geometries of a feature instance in specified legend.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_LSNO}[?a={all}&tt={tooltips}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}]
**Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_FNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |  
| G3E_FID  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FID  |  
| G3E_LSNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_LSNO (legend settings number)  |  
| all  | Integer  |   | Flag - primary or all geometries. 0 = Return only primary geometry. 1 = Return all geometries. Default is 0.  |  
| tt  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns component view tooltip in property `TT`.  |  
| detailid  | Integer  |   | Detail identifier (G3E_DETAILID). When present, detail component views are filtered to this value.  |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#response)
If a feature is available, the HTTP status code is 200 and response body contains data of the feature as GeoJSON FeatureCollection. If there are multiple component instances, each instance is returned as separate GeoJSON Feature.
If a feature is not available for input parameters, HTTP status code is 200 and the FeatureCollection contains no features.
If input parameters are invalid (non existent FNO, no primary geometry defined), HTTP status code is 400 and the response body contains error description.
Style and label rules are evaluated. The response contains properties which allow styled rendering of the geometry (SNO, ROT, LBL, ALN).

# Get feature instance geometries
Get geometries of a feature instance. Depending on the filter conditions, the method returns primary geographic or detail components, all geographic or detail components, optionally also synthesized components. When legend settings number are specified, the components are filtered by G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL of the legend.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/geometry/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}?g={geographic}&d={detail}&a={all}&s={synthesized}&lsno={lsno}&tt={tooltips}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}
**Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_FNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |  
| G3E_FID  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FID  |  
| g  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns geographic components. Default is 0.  |  
| d  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns detail components. Default is 0.  |  
| a  | Integer  |   | When `0`, returns only primary geometries. When `1`, return all geometries. Default is 0.  |  
| s  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns synthesized components. Default is 0.  |  
| lsno  | Integer  |   | When set, only components with G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL of this legend are returned.  |  
| tt  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns component view tooltip in property `TT`.  |  
| detailid  | Integer  |   | Detail identifier (G3E_DETAILID). When present, detail component views are filtered to this value.  |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
Allowed combinations of parameter values:  
| geographic  | detail  | all  | GTComponentGeometryConstants equivalent  | Note  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| 1  |   |   | gtddcgPrimaryGeographic  | Primary Geographic Components  |  
| 1  |   | 1  | gtddcgAllGeographic  | All Geographic Components  |  
|   | 1  | 1  | gtddcgAllDetail  | All Detail Components  |  
|   | 1  |   | gtddcgPrimaryDetail  | Primary Detail Components  |  
| 1  | 1  |   | gtddcgAllPrimary  | All Primary Components  |  
| 1  | 1  | 1  |   | All Geographic and Detail Components  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html#response)
If a feature is available, the HTTP status code is 200 and response body contains data of the feature as GeoJSON FeatureCollection. If there are multiple component instances, each instance is returned as separate GeoJSON Feature.
If a feature is not available for input parameters, HTTP status code is 200 and the FeatureCollection contains no features.
If input parameters are invalid (non existent FNO, no primary geometry defined), HTTP status code is 400 and the response body contains error description.
Style and label rules are **not** evaluated. The response does not contain properties which allow styled rendering of the geometry (SNO, ROT, LBL, ALN). The **ID** property is formatted as `{G3E_FID},{G3E_FNO},{G3E_CID},{G3E_CNO},{G3E_VIEW}`.

# Get features in area
Get geometries of one or more feature instances which spatially relate with a polygon area. Depending on the filter conditions, the method returns primary geographic or detail components, all geographic or detail components, optionally also synthesized components. When legend settings number are specified, the components are filtered by G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL of the legend.
## Workflow[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-features-in-area.html#workflow)
  * Determine the MBR of the filter geometry provided in request. This value is used to perform primary spatial filtering.
  * Determine the list of component views to query, based on filter conditions.
  * For each component view: 
    * Query the geometry data.
    * Perform secondary spatial filter.
    * Write feature geometries to the output.

## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-features-in-area.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
/geometry/area?g={geographic}&d={detail}&a={all}&s={synthesized}&ag={ag}&lsno={lsno}&tt={tooltips}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}
**Query Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| g  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns geographic components. Default is `0`.  |  
| d  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns detail components. Default is `0`.  |  
| a  | Integer  |   | When `0`, returns only primary geometries. When `1`, return all geometries. Default is `0`.  |  
| s  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns synthesized components. Default is `0`.  |  
| ag  | Integer  |   | G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL.  |  
| lsno  | Integer  |   | When set, only components with G3E_ALTERNATEGEOORDINAL of this legend are returned. If `ag` is also specified, this parameter is ignored.  |  
| tt  | Integer  |   | When `1`, returns component view tooltip in property `TT`.  |  
| detailid  | Integer  |   | Detail identifier (G3E_DETAILID). When present, detail component views are filtered to this value.  |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
See [Get feature instance geometries](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html) for allowed combinations of parameter values.
**Request body**
JSON object with the following properties:
  * `features`: Array of G3E_FNO to retrieve, encoded as JSON objects with G3E_FNO and optionally also G3E_CNO property.
  * `filtergeometry`: Geometry of the polygon in GeoJSON notation. Only simple polygons (outer rings) are accepted.
  * `spatialoperator`: Spatial operator to use. The nomenclature and semantics follow OGC [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM). The operator logic is `{filter geometry} {operator} {feature geometry}`, i.e. `filter geometry Covers feature geometry`. Allowed spatial operator values: 
    * `Covers`: Filter geometry covers the feature geometry.
    * `CoveredBy`: Filter geometry is covered by feature geometry.
    * `Intersects`: Filter geometry intersects the feature geometry in any way, i.e. they have at least one point in common.
    * `Disjoint`: Filter geometry does not intersect the feature geometry in any way. Equivalent of `NotTouches` in Core. **Warning** : this operator only returns disjoint geometries which are within the MBR of the filter geometry.
    * `MBRIntersects`: MBR of filter geometry intersects the MBR of the feature geometry. This operator does not follow OGC standards.

Example:

```
{
    "features": [{
            "G3E_FNO": 323
        }, {
            "G3E_FNO": 306,
            "G3E_CNO": 5633
        }
    ],
    "filtergeometry": {
        "type": "Polygon",
        "coordinates": [
            [
                [
                    4502152.985,
                    5925671.195
                ],
                [
                    4502079.975,
                    5925671.195
                ],
                [
                    4502079.975,
                    5925625.005
                ],
                [
                    4502152.985,
                    5925625.005
                ],
                [
                    4502152.985,
                    5925671.195
                ]
            ]
        ]
    },
    "spatialoperator": "CoveredBy"
}

```

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-features-in-area.html#response)
See [Get feature instance geometries](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries.html).
## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-features-in-area.html#sample)
**Sample Request**
POST http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/geometry/area?g=1&a=0&s=0
**Body**
See above.
**Sample Response**

```

    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "features": [
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "geometry": {
                "type": "Point",
                "coordinates": [
                    1339530.303,
                    7068895.281
                ]
            },
            "properties": {
                "ID": "1027199,323,1,5943,V_E_STATIO_32300_I_PT",
                "ROT": -0.45
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "Feature",
            "geometry": {
                "type": "Point",
                "coordinates": [
                    4502516.266,
                    5925772.648
                ]
            },
            "properties": {
                "ID": "1027227,323,1,5943,V_E_STATIO_32300_I_PT",
                "ROT": -0.43
            }
        }
    ]
}

```

# Get multiple feature instance geometries in legend
Get primary or all geometries of one or more feature instances in specified legend.
This is a POST version of method [Get feature instance geometries in legend](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html).
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry/Get-multiple-feature-instance-geometries-in-legend.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
/geometry/{G3E_LSNO}[?a={all}&tt={tooltips}&detailid={detailid}&resolution={resolution}]
**Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_LSNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_LSNO (legend settings number)  |  
| a  | Integer  |   | Flag - primary or all geometries. 0 = Return only primary geometry. 1 = Return all geometries. Default is 0.  |

| detailid  | Integer  |   | Detail identifier (G3E_DETAILID). When present, detail component views are filtered to this value.  |  
| resolution  | double  |   | Resolution (ground units per pixel). When provided, the arc geometries are stroked to match this resolution. When not provided, default resolution is used.  |  
**Request body**
JSON object with array of G3E_FNO/G3E_FID pairs wrapped in `features`. Example:

**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/displaycontrol/{G3E_LSNO}/{G3E_DCROWNO}/filterattributes
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| G3E_LSNO  | NetWorks legend settings number  |  
| G3E_DCROWNO  | Display control node number  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Legends/GetFilterAttributesForDCNode.html#response)
Instance of **FilterAttributesResponse**.

Type **FilterAttribute**  
| Property  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |

| G3E_FIELD  | string  | Name of the attribute in the published component view.  |

| dataType  | string  | Data type of attribute. Allowed values: string, integer, float, dateTime.  |

# GetPredefinedFiltersForDCNode
Get list of predefined filters for display control node.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Legends/GetPredefinedFiltersForDCNode.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/displaycontrol/{G3E_LSNO}/{G3E_DCROWNO}/predefinedfilters[?onlySelf={onlySelf}]
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Description  |  
| --- | --- |  
| G3E_LSNO  | NetWorks legend settings number  |  
| G3E_DCROWNO  | Display control node number  |  
| onlySelf  | When 0 (default), predefined filters for this node and parent nodes are returned. When 1, only predefined for this node are returned.  |  
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Legends/GetPredefinedFiltersForDCNode.html#response)
Instance of**PredefinedFiltersResponse**.
Type**PredefinedFiltersResponse**  
| Property  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| filters  | PredefinedFilter[]  | List of predefined filter definitions.  |  
Type**PredefinedFilter**  
| Property  | Type  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| username  | string  | Name of the predefined filter.  |  
| filter  | string  | Filter condition.  |  
## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Legends/GetPredefinedFiltersForDCNode.html#sample)
**Sample Request**
http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/displaycontrol/1/600/predefinedfilters
**Sample Response**

```
{
    "filters": [
        {
            "username": "State = Planned Out of operation",
            "filter": "STATE IN ('6')"
        },
        {
            "username": "State = In operation",
            "filter": "STATE IN ('-1', '0', '2', '6') OR STATE IS NULL"
        }
    ]
}

```

## Styles

# GetLegendKey
Returns legend key i.e. style rules (name and style identifier) used to render the provided list of legend entries.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Styles/GetLegendKey.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
/style/key
**Request Parameters**
None.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Styles/GetLegendKey.html#response)
Response is a dictionary keyed by `G3E_LENO` with legend entry information (`leno`, `name`) and a list of styles in the `styles` property. Each style object has two properties: `sno` with style identifier and `name` with user name of the style rule.

# GetStyleMap
Get style definitions.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Styles/GetStyleMap.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/style/map
**Request Parameters**
None.
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Styles/GetStyleMap.html#response)
Response is a structure with 2 dictionaries.
  * `styles` - Contains list of style definitions indexed from 0. The ID is temporary only.
  * `map` - Maps G3E_SNO to style definition in styles.

## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Styles/GetStyleMap.html#sample)

http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/style/map

# GetComponentViewInstanceTooltip
Get formatted tooltip for a component view instance specified by its identifiers.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Tooltips/GetComponentViewInstanceTooltip.html#request)
**Method**
GET
**URL Template**
/tooltip/{G3E_FNO}/{G3E_FID}/{G3E_CNO}[/{G3E_CID}]
**Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| G3E_FNO  | Integer  | Y  | G3E_FNO  |

# GetTooltips
Get formatted tooltip for feature classes, feature instances or component instances in one call..
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Tooltips/GetTooltips.html#request)
**Method**
POST
**URL Template**
/tooltip
**Rules**
Request is an object with an array of feature class, feature instance or component instance identifiers in Features property. Rules:
  * If only G3E_FNO is specified, the service returns feature class name.
  * If only G3E_FNO and G3E_FID are specified, the service returns feature instance tooltip.
  * If only G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO are specified, the service returns component instance tooltip (G3E_CID=1).
  * If G3E_FNO, G3E_FID, G3E_CNO and G3E_CID are specified, the service returns component instance tooltip for this key.
  * If the service does not found any tooltip for the given key, it returns null.

## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Tooltips/GetTooltips.html#response)
The response is an array of objects with `t` property. The order of objects corresponds to the order of identifiers in request.
## Sample[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Tooltips/GetTooltips.html#sample)
**Sample Request**

```
{
  "Features": [
    {"G3E_FNO": 323, "G3E_FID": 1027138, "G3E_CNO": 5943, "G3E_CID": 1 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 323, "G3E_FID": 1027139, "G3E_CNO": 5947, "G3E_CID": 1 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700, "G3E_FID": 1027138, "G3E_CNO": 19600, "G3E_CID": 1 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700, "G3E_FID": 1027138, "G3E_CNO": 19600 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700, "G3E_FID": 1027138 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 700 },
    {"G3E_FNO": 701 }
  ]
}

```

**Sample Response**

```
[
    {
        "t": "Ele-Station - Inventory - Ele-Station - Inventory - 1027138"
    },
    {
        "t": "Ele-Station-Name - Inventory - Ele-Station-Name - Inventory - 1027139"
    },
    {
        "t": "Sew-Pipe - Sew-Pipe - 1027138"
    },
    {
        "t": "Sew-Pipe - Sew-Pipe - 1027138"
    },
    {
        "t": "Sew-Pipe 1027138"
    },
    {
        "t": "Sew-Pipe"
    },
    {
        "t": "Sew-Connection Pipe"
    }
]

```

# Vector Service
Vector Service provides NetWorks feature data as GeoJSON geometries with additional properties required for rendering on the client.
Only vector geometries published in DDC are supported.
## API[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service.html#api)
  * [Coordinate System](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/CoordinateSystem.html)
  * [Legends](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Legends.html)
  * [Styles](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Styles.html)
  * [Features](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features.html)
  * [Geometry](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Geometry.html)
  * [Tooltips](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Tooltips.html)

## Job Support[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service.html#job-support)
All requests working with feature data accept additional optional parameters **{jobs}** and **{force}** passed in the query string.
**Format**
`?jobs={jobs}&force={force}`
**Parameters**  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| jobs  | String  | N  | Comma separated list of job names.  |  
| force  | String  | N  | When set to 1, Vector Service forces the refresh of deltas from database. When missing or any other value, job deltas are cached in memory and refreshed only after the cache becomes stale. Default is 10 minutes.  |  
**Sample Request**
`http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/data?jobs=JOB1,JOB2`
`http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/data/323/123454?jobs=JOB3`
`http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/tooltip/323/123454?jobs=JOB3&force=1`
## 3D Support[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service.html#3d-support)
`/data` and `/geometry` endpoints support additional query parameter **dims** with allowed values of `2` (default) and `3`. When `3` is passed in (or configuration parameter GeoJSON:Dimensions is set to 3), the vertices in GeoJSON output include the Z dimension as stored in the DDCs.
**Sample Request**
`http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/data/323/123454?dims=3`
##### Note
  * Polyline and polygon clipping is **turned off** when 3D geometries are requested. Configuration parameters can't override this behavior.
  * Vertex reduction (dependent on resolution) follows the configuration in the [GetFeatures](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service/Features/GetFeatures.html) endpoint. The default for vertex reduction is **on** , which may cause the geometries to be distorted if they should be visualized with a different resolution. If you want full geometries to be returned, turn off vertex reduction in the configuration.

## Component view attributes[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Service.html#component-view-attributes)
`/data` and `/geometry` endpoints support additional query parameter **attrs** with allowed values of `0` (default) and `1`. When `1` is passed in, `attributes` property is added to the GeoJSON Feature `properties`. The `attributes` is an JSON object, whose properties are the component view fields. Geometry and binary fields are not added to the output.
**Sample Request**
`http://machinename/NetworksVectorService/geometry/323/1027199?g=1&attrs=1`
**Sample Response**

```
{
    "type": "Feature",
    "geometry": {
        "type": "Point",
        "coordinates": [
            4502310.509,
            5925580.203
        ]
    },
    "properties": {
        "ID": "1027199,323,1,5943,V_E_STATIO_32300_I_PT",
        "ROT": -0.45,
        "IsPrimary": 1,
        "attributes": {
            "G3E_ID": 28,
            "G3E_FNO": 323,
            "G3E_CNO": 5943,
            "G3E_FID": 1027199,
            "G3E_CID": 1,
            "STATE": 0,
            "DATA_CATEGORY": 0,
            "CATEGORY": 0,
            "SUBUNIT": 0
        }
    }
}

```

# Get Tile
Returns the vector tile in the MapBox vector tile file format using the specified zoom level, tile row and tile column.
## GET[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Tile-Service/Get-Tile.html#get)
**Request URL Template**
http://{hostname}/{service instance}/{zoom:int}/{x:int}/{y:int}.mvt
**Request Parameters**  
| Parameter Name  | Optional or Required  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| zoom  | Required  | Specifies the tile zoom level used to get the vector tile, as described in the Slippy Map Tilenames specification.  |  
| x  | Required  | Specifies the tile column used to get the vector tile, as described in the Slippy Map Tilenames specification.  |  
| y  | Required  | Specifies the tile row used to get the vector tile, as described in the Slippy Map Tilenames specification.  |  
**Sample Request**
http://hostname/NetworksVectorTileService/8/70/92.mvt
**Sample Response**
The response is a vector tile in the MapBox vector tile file format.
**Get Tile Errors**  
| Response  | HTTP Status Code  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| Tile not found.  | 404  | Check the column and row of the tile requested in the query.  |  
| Zoom level must be between the {minimum} and {maximum} zoom level.  | 422  | The zoom level specified in the query is not between the minimum and maximum zoom level as defined in the Tile JSON.  |
