# Vector Tile API Overview
The HxGN NetWorks Vector Tile Service is a standard RESTful web service that provides an API to retrieve vector tiles. Vector tiles contain vector data instead of a rendered image. They contain geometries and attribute data used by the style specification document — in a compact, structured format. The Vector Tile Service is developed using the Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) Specification, which explicitly provides information about file formats and extensions, projections and bounds, and the internal structure of the vector tiles.
  * Tiles are generated on demand and cached at the specified location.
  * Tiles are encoded using Google Protobufs (PBF) and have a file extension of .mvt.
  * Uses Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) as the projection.
  * Includes support for a single tile matrix set that follows the Google zoom levels.
  * Tile size is fixed to 512 x 512.
  * Includes only attributes that are published as part of the HxGN NetWorks Core component view.
  * Follows the Slippy Map Tilenames Specification when representing the file naming convention. 
    * http://hostname/NetworksVectorTileService/zoom/x/y.mvt

The Vector Tile Service also provides an API to get a Mapbox Style Specification document. A Mapbox Style Specification defines the visual appearance of a map: what data to draw, the order to draw it in, and how to style the data when drawing it. Before the Style Specification document can be retrieved through the API, administrators have to publish the document during the deployment of the Mapbox Vector Tile Service.
  * Uses a style filtering approach similar to HxGN NetWorks Core where the attributes published as part of the MVT file are used when defining filters.
  * Display is controlled by specifying the minimum and maximum zoom levels similar to the legend entry minimum and maximum display scale.
  * Allows data-driven styling of spatial data based on the attributes published as part of the MVT file.
  * Supports scale dependent display of symbols and text.
  * Similar to HxGN NetWorks Core, the label text content is derived from attributes published as part of the MVT file.
  * Mapbox plugin libraries are available for Leaflet and OpenLayers that can render the Mapbox vector tiles using the Mapbox style specification. Mapbox also provides their own Mapbox GL library to render interactive maps.

# Vector Tile Service
The Vector Tile Service provides a RESTful API for retrieving and publishing MapBox vector tiles.
## Retrieve Vector Tiles[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Tile-Service.html#retrieve-vector-tiles)  
| Method  | Uri  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| GET  | [/{zoom}/{x}/{y}.mvt](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Tile-Service/Get-Tile.html)  | Returns the vector tile in the MapBox vector tile file format using the specified zoom level, tile row and tile column.  |  
| GET  | [/Tiles.json](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Tile-Service/Get-Tiles-JSON.html)  | Returns the TileJSON metadata.  |  
| GET  | [/Style.json](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Vector-Tile-Service/Get-Style-JSON.html)  | Returns the MapBox JSON style specification document.  |

# Work-Service

# CancelWork
Cancel work request before completion. The method tries to instruct the Work Service to remove the work request from the queue if it has not been completed yet.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#uri)
**DELETE** /work/**{workload}** /**{wid}**
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| workload  | String  | Y  | Workload type (e.g. convertcad, print, trace)  |  
| wid  | String  | Y  | Work request identifier.  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#request-body)
N/A
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#response)
### Normal response (200) - Work request was cancelled.[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#normal-response-200---work-request-was-cancelled)

```
{
    "success": true,
    "wid": "013456789acfwetedserstsfre"
}

```

## Bad request (400) - Invalid identifier[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#bad-request-400---invalid-identifier)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "errorCode": "ERR_NO_SUCH_WORK_REQUEST",
    "errorMessage": "Work request identifier was not found"
}

```

### Bad request (400) - Work already completed[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#bad-request-400---work-already-completed)
Returned when the request has been already completed.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "errorCode": "ERR_COMPLETED",
    "errorMessage": "Work request has been already completed"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html#server-error-500)
Returned when internal processing in the Work server fails.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_INTERNAL_ERROR",
    "ErrorMessage": "Error details"
}

```

# GetWorkLog
Get log of work request processing.
## Request[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#request)
### URI[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#uri)
**GET** /work/**{workload}** /**{wid}** /log?start=**{start}** &count=**{count}**
### Parameters[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#parameters)  
| Name  | Type  | Mandatory  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| workload  | String  | Y  | Workload type (e.g. convertcad, print, trace)  |  
| wid  | String  | Y  | Work request identifier, returned originally from SubmitWork  |  
| start  | Integer  | Y  | Index of the first log line returned (0-based). Default is 0.  |  
| count  | Integer  | Y  | Number of log lines to return. Default is 1000, maximum is 100000.  |  
### Request body[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#request-body)
N/A
## Response[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#response)
Response body contains payload as returned from processing. Format depends on the workload type.
Example:

```
{
    "start": 0,
    "total": 10,
    "lines": [
        "Starting...",
        "Sleeping for 5 seconds...",
        "5",
        "4",
        "3",
        "2",
        "1",
        "0",
        "Writing response to tmp8781.tmp",
        "Exiting with 0."
    ]
}

```

### Bad request (400) - Invalid identifier[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#bad-request-400---invalid-identifier)
Returned when the request has invalid parameters.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "errorCode": "ERR_NO_SUCH_WORK_REQUEST",
    "errorMessage": "Work request identifier was not found"
}

```

### Authentication failure (401)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#authentication-failure-401)
Returned when authorization token is missing or invalid.
### Server error (500)[](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkLog.html#server-error-500)
Returned when internal processing in the Work server fails.

```
{
    "success": false,
    "ErrorCode": "ERR_INTERNAL_ERROR",
    "ErrorMessage": "Error details"
}

```

# Work Service  
| Verb  | Method  | Description  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| POST  | [SubmitWork](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/SubmitWork.html)  | Submit new request.  |  
| GET  | [GetWorkStatus](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkStatus.html)  | Get status of work request.  |  
| GET  | [GetWorkResult](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/GetWorkResult.html)  | Get result of work request.  |  
| POST  | [CancelWork](https://pra-sgiv-mlg403/networksfoundationdoc/doc/api/Work-Service/CancelWork.html)  | Cancel execution of work request.  |
